article.articleHeadline: こめお「食材の使い回ししてない」ネット上の噂を否定...。実際に初日の参加者も食中毒に・・・ :【2ch】ニュー速クオリティ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Komeo denies online rumors that he reused ingredients... Even the participants on the first day suffered food poisoning... :【2ch】Nyusoku Quality
article.articleSummary: Two consecutive days of foodborne illness emerged in Japan from a crab ramen event, fueling online rumors that ingredients were reused. On the first day only about 50 portions were served, yet roughly 100 participants reportedly fell ill, prompting scrutiny of kitchen hygiene and handling practices. Lab-reported discussions indicate detection of Salmonella and norovirus in samples, suggesting a multifactorial outbreak beyond a single reuse issue. Speculation circulated that the crab might be China-sourced, raising concerns about sourcing and sanitary controls. The organizer, Komeo, denies online rumors of ingredient reuse as investigations proceed. The episode highlights vulnerabilities in temporary food stalls, and underscores the need for strict hygiene, safe sourcing, and prompt public health responses in outbreak settings.

triage.headline_ja: こめお「食材の使い回ししてない」ネット上の噂を否定...。実際に初日の参加者も食中毒に・・・ :【2ch】ニュー速クオリティ
triage.triage_reason: 日本国内の単発イベントでの食中毒（ノロウイルス等）であり、対象国での発生ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域として日本と中国が付与されているが、実際の発生は日本国内のイベントに限定される。中国は原材料の産地としての憶測に過ぎず、発生国ではないため対象外。日本は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Đã có 100.000 ca tay chân miệng, Bộ Y tế nhắc phải phòng chống từ nhà trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There have been 100,000 cases of hand, foot and mouth disease; the Ministry of Health reminds that prevention should begin at schools.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 100,000 hand, foot and mouth disease cases were recorded in Vietnam in the first eight months of 2026, more than 2.5 times the previous year, with about 3,000 new cases weekly. The outbreak mainly affects children under five, who make up 87.3% of cases, particularly in daycares and kindergartens. High-activity areas include Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. The Ministry of Health cautions that HFMD numbers may rise further, with dengue and COVID-19 posing additional risks. To curb transmission in schools, it urges the Ministry of Education and provincial authorities to strengthen prevention in early-education facilities, emphasize the 3 clean rule—clean eating, clean living spaces, clean hands—ensure water, soap, and handwashing facilities, and regularly clean classrooms and touched surfaces; monitor student health and promptly report suspected cases, coordinating with local health authorities for clusters.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の症例が10万件に達し、保健省が学校での予防強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで手足口病（EV71関連）症例が前年比2.5倍の約10万件に急増し、5歳未満児童を中心に学校・保育施設での感染拡大が懸念される。保健省が全国的な対策強化を指示しており、社会的・行政的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム国内の手足口病流行に関するもので、デング熱・COVID-19も併記されているがHFMDが主題。重症度・死亡例の具体的数値は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Air Pollution in Bengaluru: Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria & Biofilms Worry
article.articleSummary: Bengaluru’s air quality deteriorated in late 2025 (AQI ~150–180), raising concerns that polluted air carries antibiotic-resistant bacteria and promotes lung biofilms. A Delhi study led by JNU researchers found high levels of antibiotic-resistant bacteria in polluted air, prompting worries for Bengaluru. Prolonged PM2.5 exposure can alter the respiratory microbiome and weaken lung defenses, contributing to COPD (affecting over 55 million people in India) and increasing lung cancer risk via chronic inflammation. Biofilms—bacterial communities in a protective matrix—shield microbes from immune attack and antibiotics, enabling persistence. Bacteria such as Haemophilus influenzae, Moraxella catarrhalis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa can form biofilms in airways. Indian data show biofilm-associated resistance: a 2015 Bangalore study found 49.45% of Staphylococcus isolates formed biofilms, with MRSA at 75.3% and resistance to erythromycin, clindamycin and ciprofloxacin. A 2026 Cureus review links strong biofilm producers among Klebsiella pneumoniae to carbapenem and multi-class resistance; quorum sensing and gene transfer complicate COPD and lung cancer outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルールの大気汚染:抗生物質耐性菌とバイオフィルムへの懸念
triage.triage_reason: 大気汚染と抗菌薬耐性・バイオフィルムに関する一般的な解説・総説記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントやアウトブレイクの報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は大気汚染と呼吸器微生物叢・バイオフィルム形成・薬剤耐性の関連についての科学解説記事であり、過去の研究（2015年、2026年）を引用した総説。特定のアウトブレイクや急性感染症イベントの報告ではないため対象国のイベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 盧寵茂：已預料夏季流感季節較為厲害　九成九學校參加外展接種
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lo Chung-mau: The summer influenza season is expected to be more severe; 99% of schools participate in outreach vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong remains in a summer influenza season, with the influenza positivity rate well above baseline and some pediatric severe cases requiring hospitalization, Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau said. There has been no winter-like influenza peak or dual peak with COVID-19, underscoring vaccination as the priority. The influenza vaccination program is set to roll out soon, with more than 99% of schools participating in outreach vaccination efforts. Separately, authorities acted against outlets promoting the WT1 vaccine that claims to prevent multiple cancers. The Department of Health and police have conducted enforcement actions; no injections or adverse events have been reported, and investigations suggest purchases could involve overseas individuals. Mainland media coverage prompted actions, and authorities in the mainland have responded.

triage.headline_ja: 盧寵茂：夏季インフルエンザ流行は厳しくなると予想済み　学校の99％が出張接種に参加
triage.triage_reason: 香港で夏季インフルエンザの陽性率が基準値を大きく上回り小児重症例も発生しているが、季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行パターン内であり、COVID-19との二重ピークは見られていない。ワクチン接種推進が主な対応。別件のWT1ワクチン詐欺事案は公衆衛生イベントではなく規制執行事案のため本評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Govt flags Abhayrab rabies vaccine batch as substandard, probes if spurious, document shows
article.articleSummary: India’s drug regulator flagged Abhayrab rabies vaccine batch KE25012 as substandard and potentially spurious after a Central Drugs Laboratory potency test found it did not meet requirements. Rabies deaths in India total 5,726–6,000 annually. The field sample was judged 'not of standard quality' and 'misbranded', though sterility, moisture and identity tests passed. Significant discrepancies with a retained reference sample—labeling, QR code verification, cap colour, licence details and packaging text—raised questions of identity and authenticity and triggered a possible spurious-drug investigation under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Drugs Controller General Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi urged state regulators on Aug 27 to maintain strict vigilance over KE25012’s movement and distribution. This is the second alert in under two years; January 2025 flagged counterfeit batch KA24014. Indian Immunologicals Ltd, holding about 40% of the market and having shipped over 210 million doses, exports Abhayrab to 40+ countries, including South Africa, Turkey, UAE and Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、Abhayrab狂犬病ワクチンのバッチを規格外と指摘、偽造の可能性を調査—文書で判明
triage.triage_reason: これは狂犬病の流行事例ではなく、インドで製造されたワクチンの品質・偽造疑惑に関する規制当局の対応記事である。40カ国以上に輸出されている点で国際的影響の可能性はあるが、実際の健康被害報告は現時点でなく、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は狂犬病そのものの流行ではなく、インド製狂犬病ワクチン（Abhayrab）の特定バッチが規格外・偽造の疑いで規制当局によりフラグ付けされたという医薬品安全性・規制の問題である。南アフリカ、トルコ、UAE、ベトナムは輸出先として言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生・問題事例ではないため verified_locations から除外した。ワクチンの信頼性低下が狂犬病予防率に影響する可能性があり、続報（回収状況、健康被害報告の有無）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: बरसात में छिपा है ब्रेन का दुश्मन ये कीड़ा, पेट से होते हुए दिमाग पर कर सकता है अटैक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hidden in the rains, this worm, the brain's enemy, can attack the brain after traveling from the stomach.
article.articleSummary: Tapeworm infection can attack the brain during the monsoon, causing neurocysticercosis with cysts forming in the brain. In Faridabad, Fortis Hospital neurologist Dr. Vinit Banga warns that ingestion of tapeworm eggs through contaminated food, dirty water, or surfaces can lead, via the bloodstream, to larvae reaching the brain, eyes, or muscles. This results in seizures, persistent headaches, dizziness, speech difficulties, memory and concentration problems, and can sometimes cause epilepsy. Monsoon-related flooding, poor sanitation, street foods, unwashed produce, and unsafe water heighten risk. Prevention centers on washing hands with soap before meals and after using the toilet, thoroughly cleaning fruits and vegetables, drinking only clean water, avoiding street-cut produce, and maintaining household cleanliness. The article emphasizes awareness during rains to mitigate neurocysticercosis risk.

triage.headline_ja: 雨季に潜む脳の敵、この虫は胃から脳へと移動して攻撃する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 個別医療機関による健康啓発・予防啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや集団発生の報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の症例クラスターやアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、季節性（雨季）における嚢虫症・神経嚢虫症の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 印度抽检发现一批狂犬病疫苗不合格 疑为假冒品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India spot checks find a batch of rabies vaccines substandard, suspected to be counterfeit.
article.articleSummary: India spot checks found a batch of Abhayrab rabies vaccine substandard and suspected counterfeit. Rabies causes nearly 100% fatal illness; India reports about 6,000 deaths annually, with Abhayrab a frontline defense. On Aug 27, the head of India's drug regulator directed state authorities to tightly monitor batch KE25012 and take action if necessary. The Central Drug Laboratory in Kasauli found the on-site sampling failed potency tests, labeling the lot as quality not up to standard and mislabeling. While sterility, moisture, and identity tests passed, the sample differed from the retention sample previously submitted by Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL) in several aspects, including labeling, design, QR verification, cap colour, license information, and packaging text. Regulators said the discrepancies raise questions about authenticity and warrant investigation under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Reuters sought comment; no response. IIL holds about 40% of India's domestic rabies vaccine market and says it supplied over 210 million doses in 20+ years.

triage.headline_ja: インドで抜き取り検査により狂犬病ワクチンの一部ロットが規格不適合、偽造品の疑い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」の2項目に該当し、致死率の高い狂犬病予防ワクチンの品質・真正性問題であるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の発生そのものではなく、狂犬病ワクチン（Abhayrab、ロットKE25012）の品質不適合・偽造疑惑に関する規制当局の対応事案。ワクチン供給への影響が広がれば狂犬病予防体制に重大な影響を及ぼす可能性があるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 盧寵茂：夏季流感季節較預期嚴重 99%學校參加外展接種｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lo Chung-mau: The summer influenza season is more severe than expected; 99% of schools participate in outreach vaccination | METROHK.com.hk
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a summer influenza season more severe than expected, with influenza-positive rates well above baseline and a rise in severe pediatric hospitalizations. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau stressed vaccination as the key defense, noting the vaccination outreach program rapidly expanding; more than 99% of schools have joined the outreach vaccination initiative. Despite the heightened activity, there has been no winter influenza peak and no evidence of a dual surge with COVID-19, according to officials. The vaccine rollout is set to expand further in the near term. Separately, authorities have taken law enforcement action against outlets promoting the 'WT1' vaccine claimed to prevent multiple cancers. So far, no one has been vaccinated with WT1, no adverse reactions reported, and investigations suggest purchases may involve non-residents; Mainland media coverage of the actions has been extensive, with local authorities responding.

triage.headline_ja: 盧寵茂：夏季インフルエンザ流行が予想より深刻、学校の99％が外部接種プログラムに参加
triage.triage_reason: 香港の夏季インフルエンザが例年より重症化傾向にあるが、地元当局が既にワクチン接種拡大などで対応しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの重症化傾向であり、地元当局が既にワクチン接種拡大策を実施中。国際的拡大の兆候はなく、WT1ワクチン関連の法執行事案は別件として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Govt steps in to contain lumpy skin disease in J&K
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) outbreaks in Jammu and Kashmir involve nine active epicenters with 59 cattle affected (55 active cases) and no deaths to date. Ganderbal is the worst-affected district with 52 cases across seven epicenters, followed by Bandipora (3) and Srinagar (2). Agriculture Production Minister Javid Ahmad Dar chaired a meeting with the Animal Husbandry Department to review containment, including district-wise surveillance, vaccination coverage, medicines and vaccines stock, and sample collection and testing. Officials were directed to strictly follow treatment protocols and accelerate vaccination to prevent further transmission, with intensified surveillance and timely intervention in high-incidence areas. Emphasis on stronger field coordination, deployment of veterinary experts and field staff, and regular visits to affected zones. Awareness campaigns, including door-to-door outreach, to educate farmers on preventive measures, early reporting, and proper livestock care. Adequate medicines and vaccines must be maintained; Heads of Animal Husbandry Kashmir attended.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンムー・カシミールでのランピースキン病封じ込めに向け政府が対応
triage.triage_reason: 家畜(牛)のランピースキン病アウトブレイクで人への感染性はなく、死亡例もないため公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、複数の発生地点があり監視は継続すべき。
triage.notes: 本疾患は家畜(牛)を対象とするウイルス性疾患であり、ヒトへの感染性はない。地方農業当局が国内対応として監視・ワクチン接種を強化しており、外部支援の必要性は現時点で示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 政府當局指今年夏季流感季節較厲害　現時確診比率較基準線高很多
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government authorities say this summer's influenza season is more severe, with the current rate of confirmed cases much higher than the baseline.
article.articleSummary: In Hong Kong, authorities report this summer’s influenza season is more severe than baseline, with current confirmed cases significantly higher and several pediatric patients requiring hospitalization. After an August peak, influenza activity remains high as schools reopen and group activities increase transmission risk, making it difficult to predict when the season will end. The influenza vaccination program is about to roll out, with over 99% of schools participating in outreach vaccination efforts. Separately, the Department of Health and other agencies have taken enforcement action over venues offering a so-called WT1 vaccine that allegedly prevents multiple cancers. No injections have been reported, and no adverse vaccine-related events have been recorded; investigations suggest purchases may involve non-residents, with mainland media reporting on the inquiry.

triage.headline_ja: 政府当局、今年夏の流感（インフルエンザ）シーズンは深刻化と発表　現在の確診率は基準線を大幅に上回る
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの活動が基準値を大幅に上回り小児入院例もあるが、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられ、国際的拡大等のIHR基準は満たさない。学校再開に伴う感染拡大リスクがあり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の記事のため、China(1814991)に集約。季節性インフルエンザの通常の増加パターンであり、新型株や異常な病原性の言及はない。WT1ワクチンに関する取締りは別件で、感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: கடந்த ஆண்டை ஒப்பிடுகையில் தமிழகத்தில் டெங்கு, பன்றிக் காய்ச்சல் அதிகரிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in dengue and brucellosis in Tamil Nadu compared to last year.
article.articleSummary: Two mosquito-borne and zoonotic diseases—dengue fever and brucellosis—are rising in Tamil Nadu. From January 1 to August 30, dengue cases reached 13,573 with 9 deaths (case fatality 0.06%). Monthly counts rose through July (2,339) and August (3,315). Chennai district bears the heaviest dengue burden (2,584 cases), followed by Coimbatore (1,999). The monsoon season is driving transmission; authorities urge heightened prevention. Brucellosis in India totals about 9,000 annually; Tamil Nadu reports 1,558 cases and 1 death, ranking second in the country. In 2026, brucellosis shows rising June–August figures, with August at 645 cases versus 46 the previous year. Authorities note the need for awareness, environmental hygiene, mosquito control, and public health measures; residents should isolate for five days if fever develops and avoid unnecessary public exposure, without causing panic.

triage.headline_ja: 昨年と比較してタミルナドゥ州でデング熱とブルセラ症（豚熱）が増加
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・ブルセラ症ともにタミルナドゥ州で季節性（モンスーン）に伴う増加が報告されているが、既知の風土病であり異常性や国際的拡大リスクは低い。死亡例はあるが致死率は低く、国内対応で管理可能とみられる。
triage.notes: 季節性の媒介動物・人獣共通感染症の増加報告であり、地域保健当局が注意喚起を行っている段階。継続的な症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Foot-and-mouth disease is a supply chain crisis, not just a farming problem
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak in South Africa is a national disaster with sweeping supply-chain impacts. A January 2026 study by the Bureau for Food and Agricultural Policy estimates five-year livestock-sector costs at R13.1 billion: R11.3 billion in lost production and R1.8 billion in lost export revenue. Declared a national disaster in February 2026, the crisis disrupts farms, abattoirs, cold stores, transporters, exporters and international markets, affecting movement, certification and storage. Beef exports declined 26% year-on-year; some bovine-meat categories fell 56.6% by mid-2026, with Middle Eastern markets down 65–95%. China, Mozambique, Zimbabwe, Namibia and the UK have restricted imports since January 2025, while UAE, Jordan, Hong Kong and Kuwait remain open under revised conditions. Traceability remains largely voluntary, complicating rapid response; Red Meat Industry Services plays a central role. The situation highlights multidisciplinary supply-chain risk management and cross-sector coordination.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫はもはや農業だけの問題ではなく、サプライチェーン危機である
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の発生国は南アフリカであり対象国リストに含まれない。中国・モザンビーク・ジンバブエ等は輸入規制を課している側であり発生国ではないため、対象国での発生事例に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物疾患（口蹄疫）による南アフリカの経済・サプライチェーン被害を扱ったものであり、ヒトの感染症事例ではない。発生地域リストに中国等の対象国が含まれるが、これらは輸入規制を課す側の国であり、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Dog Bite in Thailand: Rabies Shots and Where to Get Them
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure after a dog bite in Thailand requires urgent post-exposure treatment. Wash the wound with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, then seek same-day medical care. A clinician will assess whether rabies vaccine and possibly rabies immune globulin (RIG/HRIG) are needed, with follow-up doses. Typically, unvaccinated patients may require RIG; vaccination schedules commonly run on days 0, 3, 7, and 14 per CDC guidance. WHO guidance explains when immunoglobulin is needed and vaccination is indicated, depending on exposure category. Rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms appear, but prompt post-exposure treatment is highly effective before symptoms. Small punctures can carry risk, so care is advised even for minor wounds; assess wound, infection, and tetanus status. In Chiang Rai, foreigners can access care at major private hospitals; clinics may use intradermal or intramuscular schedules—follow the facility’s dates. Do not wait for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タイでの犬咬傷:狂犬病ワクチンとその接種場所
triage.triage_reason: 個別の犬咬傷後の狂犬病曝露後予防に関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は一般的な旅行者向け医療ガイダンスであり、タイにおける狂犬病の集団発生や異常な増加を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Uốn ván nặng, bé trai 7 tuổi co giật liên tục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe tetanus, 7-year-old boy with continuous seizures.
article.articleSummary: Severe tetanus in a 7-year-old boy treated at Bình Dương General Hospital in the Ho Chi Minh City area, Vietnam. He presented with continuous rigidity and seizures, progressing to respiratory failure requiring endotracheal intubation and extended mechanical ventilation. About a week before admission, he developed dysphagia; vaccination history was unclear. Seizures were easily triggered by external stimuli, especially loud noises. After evaluation, tetanus was diagnosed and tetanus antitoxin serum (SAT) was given. Following treatment, rigidity decreased; the patient continued intensive care with ventilation, sedation, muscle relaxation, antibiotics, nutrition, and passive mobilization. After roughly one month of treatment and ventilation, he was weaned from the ventilator and discharged. The case illustrates that tetanus can be very severe in children and stresses full vaccination and proper wound care to prevent infection.

triage.headline_ja: 重症破傷風、7歳男児が持続的なけいれん発作
triage.triage_reason: 単発の破傷風症例報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染しない疾患のため国際的拡大リスクは無く、公衆衛生上の異常性・社会的関心も認められない。
triage.notes: 破傷風は非伝染性疾患であり単一症例。個人の重症例報告に留まり、公衆衛生上の警戒事案には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 6 Fakta 165 Siswa-Guru SMP di Tana Toraja Diduga Keracunan MBG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six Facts: 165 Students and Teachers at a Junior High School in Tana Toraja Allegedly Poisoned by MBG
article.articleSummary: 165 students and teachers from SMPN 1 Makale and SMPN 2 Makale in Tana Toraja, South Sulawesi, are suspected of MBG-related food poisoning after consuming Free Nutritious Meals on 2 September 2026. By 4 September 2026, 165 were treated across three hospitals: RSUD Lakipadada (84 patients; 9 remained hospitalized, 75 discharged), RS Sinar Kasih (50; 7 hospitalized), and RS Fatima (6; 43 discharged). Inpatients total 22; outpatients 143. Affected individuals reported nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and diarrhea, with symptoms appearing about a day after the meal. MBG samples were collected and sent to BPOM Makassar for testing. The MBG provider, SPPG Makale Batupapan 1, was suspended for 30 days. The menu included yellow chicken, fried tempeh, mixed vegetables, and melon; investigators caution that contamination by bacteria or virus is possible but not yet confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 6つの事実：タナ・トラジャの中学校で生徒・教師165人が給食(MBG)による食中毒疑い
triage.triage_reason: 165名が食中毒様症状で医療機関を受診する規模の集団発生だが、原因（細菌・ウイルス等）は未確定であり、感染症としての人-人感染の可能性は低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原因は食品由来の食中毒（給食プログラムMBG）が疑われており、感染症のヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いと考えられる。検査結果待ちのため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Gurugram dengue tally crosses 50-mark after three fresh cases
article.articleSummary: In Gurugram, Haryana, three new dengue cases in the last 24 hours lift the season total to 53. Malaria remains at five cases for the year with no deaths, and no new malaria cases were reported today. Post-monsoon stagnation sustains mosquito breeding, prompting intensified testing and fever surveillance in vulnerable neighborhoods. On Friday, 126 dengue blood samples were collected, bringing the season’s tested total to 9,155. Authorities issued 1,919 show-cause notices under the Municipal Corporation Act for mosquito breeding at properties. Rapid Fever Mass Survey covered 1,311 households, with over 1.12 million houses surveyed since January to detect fever clusters and reduce breeding sites. Anti-larval spraying and fogging have been intensified district-wide. For malaria, 74 blood slides were prepared today, lifting the total malaria slides to 189,775 since January 1; no malaria deaths have been reported this year.

triage.headline_ja: グルガオンでデング熱感染者数が50人を超える、新規3症例確認
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリア発生であり、症例数は限定的（デング53例、マラリア5例）で死亡例もなく、通常の公衆衛生対応（サーベイランス・防蚊対策）の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: モンスーン後の蚊媒介性疾患の季節的増加であり、地元自治体による通常の対応（フィーバーサーベイランス、防蚊活動）が行われている。死亡例なし、感染拡大の異常性なし。

article.articleHeadline: தமிழகத்தில் அதிகரித்து வரும் டெங்கு, பன்றிக்காய்ச்சல் - மருத்துவர்கள் எச்சரிக்கை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and swine fever on the rise in Tamil Nadu - doctors warn
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Tamil Nadu (Jan 1–Aug 30, 2026) totals 13,573 cases with 9 deaths (0.06% mortality). Chennai district leads with 2,584 cases; Coimbatore follows with 1,999. Monthly data show rising transmission, peaking in August at 3,315, with July 2,339 and June 1,384. Looming monsoon raises concerns for further spread. Swine flu (H1N1) in India nears 9,000 cases; Tamil Nadu accounts for 1,558 and 1 death, ranking second among states. In 2024 and 2025 the state reported 1,777 and 1,288 cases; this year already 1,791, with August at 645 (vs 46 last August). Authorities urge vigilance, five-day isolation for fever cases, masking, hygiene, vector control, and preventive measures, noting Chennai’s higher transmission due to dense population.

triage.headline_ja: タミルナードゥ州でデング熱と豚インフルエンザが増加 - 医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・H1N1症例の増加であり前年同月比で増加率が高いものの、死亡率は低く新規病原体でもないため、経過観察が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱・H1N1ともに既知の季節性疾患であり、モンスーン到来による感染拡大の懸念はあるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。前年同月比での大幅増（H1N1: 46→645）は注視すべき指標。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: le gouvernement lance un nouveau plan de riposte contre l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the government launches a new response plan to the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo launches a new Ebola response plan named 'One Health' to shift from treating patients to addressing drivers of transmission. The plan, announced in Kinshasa, emphasizes strengthened epidemic surveillance for faster case detection and systematic contact tracing, with teams ready to rapidly intervene in affected or at-risk areas. It prioritizes closer engagement with communities, better health-system capacity, and early access to care. Central to the plan is communication to counter rumors, explain prevention measures, and encourage rapid reporting of suspected cases. It also seeks improved coordination across human and animal health, environment, administration, and partners, aiming to adapt to the epidemic’s evolution and reduce avoidable deaths. The government calls for collective mobilization with communities at the heart of the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ流行対策として政府が新たな対応計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR(2005)上の即時通知対象疾患であり、DRC政府が流行対策として新計画を発表していることから公衆衛生上の重大性・国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける既存エボラ流行への新たな『ワンヘルス』対応計画の発表を報じている。具体的な症例数・死亡者数のデータは本文に記載なく、流行の規模・重症度の詳細は不明。続報でのRRA実施が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: डीआर कांगो ने 180 दिन का इबोला रिस्पॉन्स प्लान लॉन्च किया, 1.3 बिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर फंड की मांग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches 180-day Ebola response plan, seeks $1.3 billion in funding.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo and partners launched an updated 180-day multisectoral Ebola response plan, seeking $1.3 billion to accelerate containment. The plan, supported by WHO, Africa CDC and others, provides an operational roadmap for the next six months to tackle the Bundibugyo virus outbreak. As of 2 September, the outbreak has reached 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths across six provinces and 60 health zones. Health authorities are particularly concerned that most deaths occur in the community, with many contacts not identified promptly and patients not reaching health facilities before death. WHO warns that delays in case finding and contact tracing impede response. DR Congo Health Minister Roger Kamba urged broad engagement from communities, government agencies, partners and donors to halt transmission. The UN Resident Coordinator Damian Mama underscored the need for scalable, coordinated funding; the May-declared outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in DRC to date.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、180日間のエボラ対応計画を開始、13億米ドルの資金を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模流行が継続し、症例数・死者数が急増、DRC史上最速拡大のアウトブレイクであり国際的な資金支援要請がなされているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 6,342症例、3,072死亡（致死率約48%）、6州60保健地区に拡大。WHO・Africa CDC支援下で対応計画策定中。DRC史上最速拡大のエボラ流行とされ、コミュニティ内死亡・接触者追跡の遅れが懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: डीआर कांगो ने 180 दिन का इबोला रिस्पॉन्स प्लान लॉन्च किया, 1.3 बिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर फंड की मांग - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launched a 180-day Ebola response plan, seeking $1.3 billion in funding - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: DR Congo launched a 180-day multisectoral Ebola response plan, seeking $1.3 billion to accelerate outbreak control. In partnership with the WHO, Africa CDC and other donors, the plan provides an operational roadmap for the next six months. As of September 2, 2026, the Congo Ebola outbreak has recorded 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths across six provinces and 60 health zones. Health officials are particularly concerned that most deaths occur in the community, with many contacts unidentified and patients not reaching health facilities before death. WHO representatives and UN Resident Coordinator Damian Mama emphasized the need for timely case finding, community engagement, and flexible funding to sustain a large humanitarian response. The outbreak, declared in May, is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak yet in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴが180日間のエボラ対応計画を発表、13億米ドルの資金拠出を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴのエボラ流行はこれまでで最速の拡大ペースであり、6,342症例・3,072死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されている。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際支援要請もあり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が約48%と非常に高く、コミュニティ内での死亡が多く接触者追跡が不十分であることが強い懸念材料。WHO・Africa CDC・国連が資金確保に向け協働している。

article.articleHeadline: 8 Anjing Positif Rabies, Distan Denpasar Bali Gelar Vaksinasi dan Sterilisasi Peringati Tumpek Uye
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8 Rabies-Positive Dogs, Denpasar, Bali: Agriculture Agency Holds Vaccination and Sterilization to Commemorate Tumpek Uye.
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention efforts in Denpasar, Bali, Indonesia: On 5 September 2026, during Tumpek Uye, the Denpasar City Agriculture Agency held an integrated animal health service offering rabies vaccination, general animal care, and sterilization for dogs and cats at the Pura Agung Jagatnatha parking area. Head Ni Made Suparmi said the routine event aims to prevent transmission and to curb the local population of rabies-susceptible animals; sterilization targets 40 animals. Registration for sterilization is online, and stray dogs around the venue are captured and sterilized. A broader house-to-house vaccination sweep was conducted across Denpasar, Banjar, and villages. As of early September 2026, there were 8 rabies-positive dogs in Denpasar, a substantial decline from about 14 by September 2025. The agency continues coordinating with the City Health Department on human bite cases.

triage.headline_ja: 犬8頭が狂犬病陽性、デンパサール（バリ）農業局がトゥンペック・ウエ記念でワクチン接種と不妊手術を実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病陽性犬数は前年より減少しており、地元当局による定例の予防対策（ワクチン接種・不妊手術）が実施されている状況で、異常な拡大や国際的懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による通常の狂犬病予防プログラムの一環であり、陽性犬数は減少傾向。人への感染例の詳細は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: आजमगढ़ में स्वाइन फ्लू की दस्तक, H1N1 के 4 मरीज मिले, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu makes inroads in Azamgarh; 4 H1N1 patients detected; Health department on alert.
article.articleSummary: Four confirmed H1N1 (swine flu) cases in Azamgarh, India, have prompted an intensified outbreak response as of 2026-09-05. The positives are a 1-year-old child, a 36-year-old woman, a 45-year-old man, and a 64-year-old elderly man; two cases from urban areas and two from rural areas. Isolation wards have been established at Azamgarh Mandaliy District Hospital (five beds), a 100-bed hospital (seven beds), Karma (three beds), and Ahrola (four beds). Chakrapanpur Medical College’s Super Facility Hospital on its third floor has a dedicated H1N1 isolation ward with 50 testing kits. 24-hour doctor staffing and daily monitoring are in place under nodal officer Dr. Atul Srivastav. Despite formal preparations, crowded OPDs and drug counters with many patients and attendants not wearing masks raise transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: アザムガルでスワインフルの兆候、H1N1の患者4人確認、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1の局地的な小規模発生であり、公的機関が対応体制を整えているが、感染拡大の兆候（マスク未着用等）が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり新規性は低いが、混雑した外来やマスク未着用など感染拡大リスクの要素があるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: डीआर कांगो ने 180 दिन का इबोला रिस्पॉन्स प्लान लॉन्च किया, 1.3 बिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर फंड की मांग | DR Congo launches updated 180-day Ebola response plan, seeks $1.3 billion funding
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches 180-day Ebola response plan, seeks $1.3 billion funding.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo and partners launched an updated 180-day multisectoral Ebola response plan to accelerate the campaign, seeking about $1.3 billion. Supported by WHO and Africa CDC among others, the plan aims to serve as an operational roadmap for the next six months. The outbreak, officially declared in May, is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in DR Congo to date. As of 2 September, Bundibugyo virus cases reached 6,342 with 3,072 deaths, spanning six provinces and 60 health zones including Kinshasa. Xinhua reports most deaths occur in communities, with many patients dying before being identified as contacts or reaching health facilities. WHO Executive Representative Anne Ancia warned that late detection delays contacts and resource mobilization. Health Minister Roger Kamba urged broader engagement of communities, government agencies, partners and donors; UN Resident Coordinator Damián Mama called for flexible, scalable funding. Africa CDC pledged ongoing national support.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴ、180日間のエボラ対応計画を開始し、13億ドルの資金拠出を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ史上最速で拡大しているエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、死者3,072人・症例6,342人、複数州・保健区域に拡大、国際的な資金支援要請がなされているためIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に公式宣言されたエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクで、DRコンゴ史上最も急速に拡大しているとされる。首都キンシャサを含む6州60保健区域に拡大しており、WHO・Africa CDCが支援。フルリスク評価（RRA）が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: le gouvernement lance un nouveau plan de riposte contre l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: the government launches a new response plan to combat the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, now spanning 60 health zones across six provinces, with Ituri province largely affected. On September 4, Kinshasa launched a 180-day response plan named Une Santé (One Health) costing about $1.3 billion, aiming to slow transmission and reduce fatalities in this 17th outbreak. The plan shifts from patient treatment to addressing transmission drivers, strengthening epidemiological surveillance, accelerating case detection, and implementing systematic contact tracing, with rapid response teams in affected or at-risk areas. It also emphasizes improving health-system readiness and early access to care, community engagement, and clear risk communication to combat rumors. Cross-sector coordination among human and animal health, environment, administration, and partners is emphasized to adapt to the evolving epidemic and cut avoidable deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のDRC：政府が新たな対応計画を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（6,342症例、3,072死亡）が6州60保健区に拡大しており、致死率も高く、政府が国家的対応計画を新設するなど深刻性・異常性・拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス型による大規模流行。政府が1.3億ドル規模の180日対応計画（One Health）を発表し、国際的な支援・協調も強調されている。致死率は約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: au moins 45 professionnels de santé morts d'Ebola depuis le début de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: at least 45 healthcare workers have died of Ebola since the beginning of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: At least 45 healthcare workers have died in the Democratic Republic of Congo since the Ebola outbreak began, including doctors, nurses, midwives, lab technicians, community health workers, maintenance staff, and drivers within health facilities. The initial risk arises in ordinary wards where patients may be treated before infection is detected, and these settings often have less robust protocols and limited personal protective equipment than specialized Ebola centers. In North Kivu, six evaluated facilities averaged 29% compliance with prevention measures; in Bas-Uele, the General Hospital of Ganga records 21.3%. Vaccine efficacy remains uncertain: the Ervebo vaccine is licensed for another Ebola species, but its effectiveness against Bundibugyo has not been demonstrated in humans. The WHO recommends using it within research protocols, prioritizing frontline healthcare workers, while maintaining other protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行開始以降、少なくとも45人の医療従事者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が継続中で医療従事者の死亡が多数発生し、感染管理体制の不備（防護具・遵守率の低さ）や新規株に対するワクチン有効性の不確実性が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラの株はBundibugyoと明記されており、既存承認ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が未確認である点がリスク評価上重要。医療従事者間の感染拡大と院内感染対策の不備が継続的曝露リスクを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Petugas Kesehatan Temukan Raja Singa dan HIV di Black Jack Toboali Bangka Selatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health workers find the Lion King and HIV in Black Jack, Toboali, South Bangka.
article.articleSummary: Voluntary Counseling and Testing (VCT) at Black Jack, a location in Toboali, Bangka Selatan Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands, Indonesia, screened about 45 people from a high-risk group, notably female sex workers. Initial screening identified three potential sexually transmitted infections, but follow-up testing confirmed two cases: one HIV infection and one syphilis infection. The remaining participant tested negative. Health officials provided counseling and disease-specific management for the HIV and syphilis cases and reinforced education for prevention and care. The effort, which expanded from 37 to about 45 participants, aims at early detection of HIV and other STIs among at-risk populations. These results demonstrate ongoing HIV and syphilis transmission risks in the Black Jack locale, underscoring the need for continued targeted testing and public health outreach. Date: as of 5 September 2026; event occurred around 31 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、南バンカ・トボアリのブラックジャックで梅毒とHIVを発見
triage.triage_reason: 地域の日常的なHIV/性感染症スクリーニング活動の一環であり、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 45人中2名がHIVおよび梅毒陽性という小規模なローカルスクリーニング結果であり、既知の性感染症のルーチン監視活動に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Phế cầu kháng thuốc - mối nguy đe dọa tính mạng trẻ nhỏ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antibiotic-resistant pneumococcus – a life-threatening threat to the lives of young children.
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae poses a life-threatening threat to young children in Vietnam. As of 5 September 2026, invasive pneumococcal isolates show high resistance: 75% resistant to third-generation cephalosporins; nearly 100% resistant to erythromycin and clindamycin at the National Pediatric Hospital; around 80% resistance in some antibiotic groups at Ho Chi Minh City Children's Hospital. Widespread antibiotic exposure drives selection for multi-drug resistance, complicating therapy; delays in meningitis treatment worsen outcomes. About 33% of Vietnamese children carry pneumococcus in the nasopharynx without symptoms, enabling household transmission. Serotypes 6A, 19F, 6B, 23F, 14, and 19A are prevalent; 19F is found in 17% of carriers and accounts for about 25% of invasive pneumococcal disease deaths at the National Pediatric Hospital. Vaccines PCV7, PCV10, PCV13, PCV20—and broader-coverage vaccines—offer protection; vaccine choice and timing should follow age and health authority guidance to reduce severe disease and antibiotic use.

triage.headline_ja: 薬剤耐性肺炎球菌 - 幼い子供の命を脅かす危険
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性肺炎球菌によるベトナム国内の小児健康への懸念は高いが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の緊急性を示す情報はなく、既知の公衆衛生課題としての性質が強い。
triage.notes: 薬剤耐性肺炎球菌感染症はベトナムで既知の公衆衛生課題であり、突発的なアウトブレイクではなく慢性的な耐性菌問題として報告されている。ワクチン接種による予防が推奨されている。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai gejala awal demam berdarah dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Watch out for the early symptoms of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever alert from Jakarta, Indonesia, emphasizes monitoring early symptoms that mimic flu. Dr. Gia Pratama Putra notes that dengue presents with high fever (up to about 40°C), chills, fatigue, severe headache, joint and muscle pains, nausea or vomiting, and bleeding signs such as nosebleeds, gum bleeding, or red spots/rash. During the 2–7 day febrile phase, fever can be extreme; a critical phase may follow on days 3–7 with a fall in temperature to around 37.5–38°C or lower, often after rapid thrombocytopenia. If untreated, this can progress to shock, organ impairment, or severe bleeding; improvement of fever may precede deterioration. Families should seek urgent care if abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, lethargy, or altered consciousness occur. Prevention focuses on Aedes aegypti control via the 3M Plus program (drain/cover water, recycle breeding items, insect repellent, community cleanup). Jakarta-sourced report from ANTARA, 2026-09-05.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の初期症状に注意
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱に関する一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常な流行や新規事象の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 医師による季節性デング熱の症状解説・予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数急増やアウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 各学校、各班级注意！晋安疾控发布重要提醒！
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attention all schools and classes! Jin'an CDC issues an important reminder!
article.articleSummary: As autumn term begins in Jin'an District, primary and secondary schools and kindergartens are urged to bolster campus infectious disease prevention. Three priority categories are highlighted: respiratory infections spread by droplets (COVID-19, influenza, tuberculosis, chickenpox, pertussis, measles, rubella, mumps); enteric infections (hand-foot-and-mouth disease, norovirus, rotavirus); and vector-borne diseases (dengue, chikungunya, fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome). Key measures assign schools the role: tighten environmental hygiene, eliminate standing water, improve ventilation in classrooms and dormitories, disinfect toilets, safeguard food and drinking water quality, and ensure ample handwashing facilities. Daily morning health checks are mandated; when symptoms meet alert criteria, reports to the CDC and education bureau follow verification. Response includes prompt medical evaluation, isolation, cleaning and ventilation, and risk-based adjustments (masks, staggered meals, limits on gatherings, temporary closures). Vaccination guidance covers routine MMR, hepatitis A, meningococcal, and Japanese encephalitis vaccines; influenza and hand-foot-and-mouth vaccines are voluntary. Parents and students are urged to cooperate.

triage.headline_ja: 各学校、各クラス注意!晋安疾病予防管理センターが重要な注意喚起を発表!
triage.triage_reason: 学校向けの一般的な感染症予防に関する行政広報であり、具体的な異常発生や重症例の報告はなく、通常の季節的注意喚起にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は中国福建省福州市晋安区の学校向け予防啓発通知であり、対象国リストの中国(China)は含まれるが、特定の異常発生事例ではなく通常の予防的行政措置のため見送りと判断。地域の疾病予防センターによる季節前の定期的注意喚起。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, les données mobiles entrent dans la lutte contre Ebola (Point santé)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, mobile data are being used in the fight against Ebola (Health News).
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 3,000 deaths, with 6,186 confirmed cases, 1,409 recoveries, and 830 active patients as of 3 September 2026 (case fatality 48.6%). WHO cites over 6,250 cases and 3,039 deaths across six affected provinces (60 health zones). UN relief plans total about $2.1 billion, with $1.3 billion requested for the next six months; CERF has allocated more than $57 million to DRC and nearby countries. Anonymized mobile-phone data are being used to map movement from Ituri to other areas to sharpen surveillance. At RC76 in Addis Ababa (Aug 24–28, 2026), thirteen African countries signed a cross-border health-emergency protocol, including Ethiopia, Kenya, Uganda, Angola and Tanzania, to share information and coordinate pre-declaration actions. A global mpox vaccine stock launched 27 August 2026, set to be operational by end-September; 145 countries/territories reported 190,683 mpox cases and 529 deaths (2022–Jul 31, 2026), with two-thirds in Africa; zoonotic transmission persists in parts of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ対策にモバイルデータ活用（保健ニュース）
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが死者3,000人超・致死率48.6%に達し、WHO・UN・CERFが大規模国際支援を展開、13カ国が越境保健緊急協定に署名するなど国際的関心・対応が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エチオピア・ケニア・ウガンダ・アンゴラ・タンザニアはRC76会議での越境協定署名国として言及されているが、実際の発生地域はDRCのみ。mpoxに関するグローバルワクチン備蓄の記述もあるが、本記事の主題はDRCのエボラ流行対応。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Maurice prolonge les mesures de quarantaine jusqu'au 7 décembre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Mauritius extends quarantine measures until December 7.
article.articleSummary: Ebola-related quarantine measures in Mauritius have been extended for three months, from September 8, 2026, to December 7, 2026, following approval by the Council of Ministers. The extension targets travelers who have visited, transited through, or stayed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) or South Sudan within the 21 days before arriving in Mauritius. Implemented via an advisory under Article 4(1) of the Quarantine Act 2020, the measures aim to mitigate Ebola risk associated with travel from these regions. The policy applies to incoming travelers meeting the criteria during the specified period; no additional countries are cited.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：モーリシャスが検疫措置を12月7日まで延長
triage.triage_reason: モーリシャスがDRC及び南スーダンからの渡航者に対する検疫措置を3か月延長したことは、DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限の実例を示しており、IHR基準を2つ以上満たすため。
triage.notes: 本記事はモーリシャスの検疫政策延長に関する行政的続報であり、DRCにおける新規症例数や現在の流行状況についての具体的データは含まれていない。ただしDRCで継続中とされるエボラ出血熱への渡航関連対策として国際的な関心・注視が必要と判断し、続報の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Nepal Flood Death Toll Reaches 1,344 as Water Contamination and Disease Threats Rise
article.articleSummary: Catastrophic flash floods on August 26 in Nepal have raised the death toll to 1,344 as of September 5, 2026, with search and rescue ongoing across Bhote Koshi and Devighat river corridors. Ground operations involve the Nepalese Army and a 19-member Indian tunnel-rescue unit for recovery and identification. A secondary crisis centers on drinking-water contamination: Bidur testing found E. coli in 5 of 15 sources, signaling immediate risk of waterborne, vector-borne, and other communicable diseases. Officials plan a targeted cholera vaccination for about 100,000 vulnerable residents and measles immunizations for more than 75,000 children in high-risk zones. Emergency funding includes NPR 10 million for Rasuwa and Nuwakot each, NPR 5 million for Dhading, and NPR 135 million across 15 local governments. India has delivered relief flights; U.S. lawmakers urge deploying a Disaster Assistance Response Team for long-term rehabilitation.

triage.headline_ja: ネパール洪水の死者数1,344人に達し、水質汚染と感染症リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による死者1,344人という深刻な被害に加え、水系病原体（E. coli）検出、コレラ・麻疹の緊急ワクチン接種計画、国際支援要請など複数のWPRO基準に該当し社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへの移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 主題国はネパールだが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。インドは救助隊派遣・救援物資提供の支援国として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, swine flu cases surge in Tamil Nadu; doctors urge vigilance ahead of monsoon
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Tamil Nadu total 13,573 with 9 deaths from Jan 1 to Aug 30, 2026, with a sharp rise in July–August. Monthly counts rose to 2,339 (July) and 3,315 (August), up from 1,880 and 1,832 in the previous year’s same months. Chennai accounts for 2,584 of the state’s dengue infections; Coimbatore 1,999. Swine flu cases exceed 1,500 in 2026, ranking Tamil Nadu second nationwide; August swine flu surged to 645, up from 46 in August last year. Health officials attribute spread to Chennai’s density and lapses in public-health precautions. Isolation for swine flu patients should be at least five days; fever or respiratory symptoms should avoid crowds, wear masks, and seek timely care. For dengue, authorities urge eliminating stagnant water and mosquito breeding sites; emphasis on environmental cleanliness, mosquito control, public awareness, and early treatment to avert further surges during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱・豚インフルエンザ症例が急増、医師らがモンスーン前の警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: スワインフル症例が前年同月比で急増(46→645件)し、デング熱も例年より高い水準で推移しており、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当し社会的関心（医療従事者・行政の呼びかけ）も高いため、フルRRAでの精査対象とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・豚インフルエンザともにインドで季節的に流行する感染症であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。ただし前年比での急増傾向が見られるため、モンスーン時期の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 广州多人在大家乐一门店就餐后高烧腹泻，有孩子休克进ICU，疾控中心：已采样，等检测结果__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several people in Guangzhou developed high fever and diarrhea after dining at a Dajia Le restaurant branch; a child went into shock and was admitted to the ICU; the CDC said samples have been collected and results are pending — New Express Net
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou, China — Several diners developed high fever and diarrhea after dining at Da Jia Le (Dajia Le) restaurant, Panyu District, Tianhe City branch. A 13-year-old boy experienced severe abdominal pain, vomiting, and shock, later admitted to ICU; symptoms began about two hours after an Aug 28 dinner of Italian meat sauce fried pork chop rice. On Aug 29, two adults and four children at the same branch fell ill; two 3-year-olds developed high fever (up to 39.9°C) and diarrhea, with hospitalization delayed before fever subsided by Sept 3. Stool culture from one child on Sept 1 tested positive for Salmonella. The Guangzhou CDC has collected samples; results are pending. The branch has ceased operations; the company is conducting self-investigations and will compensate if confirmed. A 2025 Hong Kong Da Jia Le outlet reported a Salmonella outbreak linked to cross-contamination in takeaway meals.”

triage.headline_ja: 広州のダジャレ（大家楽）店舗で複数人が食事後に高熱・下痢、子供1人がショック状態でICU入院。疾病予防管理センターはサンプル採取済みで検査結果待ち
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの集団食中毒事案（サルモネラ疑い）で重症例（ICU入院）があるが、原因は特定されつつあり店舗も営業停止済みで、国際的拡大リスクは低い。検査結果待ちのため続報を注視。
triage.notes: 疾患タグはParatyphoid/Typhoidだが、記事内容は特定の1店舗でのサルモネラ属菌による集団食中毒事案であり、腸チフス・パラチフスとは異なる可能性が高い。原因菌の最終確定検査結果は未公表。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases: डासांची उत्पत्तीस्थळे, आजाराचा वाढता विळखा! तीन महिन्यांत २.९४ लाख घरांची तपासणी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Cases: Mosquito Breeding Grounds, the Disease's Expanding Reach! 294,000 Households Inspected in Three Months.
article.articleSummary: Pimpri-Chinchwad, India – Dengue risk rises as mosquito breeding grounds persist beyond the monsoon. From June–August, health authorities inspected 294,186 households; larvae were found in 2,261 homes. They examined 14,520,725 potential breeding containers, with 2,428 containers positive for larvae. Interventions included emptying 3,784 containers and treating 2,381; inspections covered 1,272 tires/drums and 1,368 constructions. Enforcement yielded 2,248 notices and 366 fines, totaling Rs 619,000 (June: Rs 167,000; July: Rs 344,000; August: Rs 108,000). Dengue cases show upticks: July had 23 positives among 650 suspected; August had 25 positives among 642 suspected. Malaria and chikungunya are also reported; August saw over 30,000 fever cases. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water, maintain cleanliness, and promptly remove breeding sites to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：蚊の発生源、広がる病の脅威！3か月間で29万4000戸を検査
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・マラリア・チクングニアの地域的な発生と対策活動が報告されているが、季節性の通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や重大な異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による蚊媒介感染症対策の定期報告記事。感染者数は限定的（月間20〜30例程度）で、季節性の増加傾向にとどまる。継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Haryana में लंपी वायरस का तांडव: 15 दिन में ली पहली जान, 15 लीटर दूध देने वाली गाय की मौत...100 से अधिक पशु चपेट में
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lumpy Skin Disease wreaks havoc in Haryana: first death in 15 days, a cow producing 15 liters of milk dies... more than 100 animals affected.
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) outbreak in Haryana, India, as of 5 September 2026, with the first death in Narnaul district. A dairy cow from Hoodina village, yielding about 15 liters of milk, died after LSD infection. Statewide, Haryana has over 100 active LSD cases, 97 of which are in Narnaul district alone. In addition to Narnaul, new cases have emerged in the Bahal area and nearby villages; Mahendragarh district borders Rajasthan on three sides, raising inter-state transmission risk due to movement of infected animals. Symptoms include high fever with nodules and deep wounds. Authorities have intensified surveillance and launched a large vaccination drive. Farmers are advised to isolate infected animals, protect stock from flies and mosquitoes, and contact the nearest veterinary hospital if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤーナ州でランピースキン病が猛威：15日間で初の死亡例、15リットルの乳を出す牛が死亡…100頭以上の家畜が感染
triage.triage_reason: ランピースキン病はウシ科動物の感染症でヒトには感染せず、インドでは既知の疾病であり公衆衛生上の深刻な影響はない。地域当局によるワクチン接種・監視体制で対応中であり、国際的懸念や社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病はヒトに感染しない動物疾病（ウシ科）であり、家畜の経済的損失・州間拡大リスクはあるが公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: तमिलनाडु में डेंगू और स्वाइन फ्लू के मरीज बढ़े, डेंगू के 13,573 मामले सामने आए और नौ लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and Swine Flu Cases Rise in Tamil Nadu; 13,573 Dengue Cases Reported and Nine People Died.
article.articleSummary: Dengue and Swine Flu cases rise in Tamil Nadu: 13,573 dengue infections and nine deaths Jan 1–Aug 30, 2026. Dengue monthly totals: Jan 1,722; Feb 1,322; Mar 1,228; Apr 1,201; May 1,062; Jun 1,384; Jul 2,339; Aug 3,315. Chennai leads with 2,584 dengue cases, followed by Coimbatore with 1,999. Officials warn of increased transmission as monsoon approaches. Last year Tamil Nadu recorded 25,533 dengue cases; current figures are lower than peaks seen in 2022–2024. Swine Flu infections exceed 1,500 statewide, ranking Tamil Nadu second in the country. August cases rose to 645 from 46 last August. Health authorities advise at least five days of isolation for swine flu patients, avoiding crowded places if fever or breathing difficulties, wearing a mask as needed, and prompt medical consultation. For dengue, remove standing water and mosquito breeding sites; emphasize sanitation, mosquito control, awareness, and timely treatment ahead of the rains.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱と豚インフルエンザの患者が増加、デング熱13,573例・9人死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・豚インフルエンザともにタミル・ナードゥ州で季節的な増加が見られるが、症例数は過去のピーク（2022-2024年）を下回っており、異常性は低い。ただし季節性豚インフルエンザ症例の急増（前年同月比）とモンスーン接近によるデング熱媒介蚊の増加リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱・豚インフルエンザともにタミル・ナードゥ州の風土病的・季節性の流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。豚インフルエンザの症例数急増（8月645例 vs 前年46例）は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Peduli Lingkungan untuk Mencegah DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caring for the Environment to Prevent Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: Fogging operations were conducted in Cibinong, Bogor Regency, West Java, on 5 September 2026 to interrupt the life cycle of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and prevent dengue fever (DBD) as Indonesia transitions from the rainy season to an extended dry season. Authorities urged residents to seal water storage containers and clean surroundings, alongside ongoing vector-control efforts to reduce transmission risk. The report emphasizes environmental health measures rather than clinical treatment or vaccination, with no specific dengue case or death counts provided. The actions reflect government efforts to protect public health through environmental management and targeted fogging during seasonal change.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防のための環境保全
triage.triage_reason: デング熱予防のための日常的なフォギング・環境衛生活動を報じる内容で、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告がなく、異常性や社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節性に発生している疾患であり、本記事は予防的な環境対策（フォギング、貯水容器の管理）を伝える内容。具体的な症例数・死亡数の記載がなく、通常の公衆衛生活動として扱うべきと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 盧寵茂：流感病毒陽性比率較基準線高　99%以上學校已參與外展疫苗接種計劃 (12:10) - 20260905
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lo Chung-mau: Influenza positivity rate higher than baseline; more than 99% of schools have participated in the outreach vaccination program (12:10) - 2026-09-05
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, Hong Kong reports an influenza positivity rate of 11%, well above the baseline 4.74, with pediatric severe cases requiring hospitalization. Officials say there is no winter influenza peak yet and no concurrent COVID-19 surge. The vaccination program begins on 17 September 2026; over 99% of schools have joined the outreach effort, with 14 schools not participating. Authorities aim for 100% participation and will contact nonparticipants to understand barriers. Separately, the Department is investigating claims of a Wilms’ tumour (WT1) cancer vaccine. Four clinics were searched, revealing 1,600 doses of unregistered vaccines and three people arrested; no WT1 doses were found. No adverse reactions have been reported. Investigations will assess possible fraud and whether injections were actually administered. Mainland media have widely reported the case; Mainland authorities have responded.

triage.headline_ja: 盧寵茂：インフルエンザ陽性率は基準線より高い　99%以上の学校が外部ワクチン接種計画に参加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの陽性率上昇と小児重症例が報告されているが、冬季ピークではなく通常のサーベイランス範囲内であり、COVID-19の同時流行もないため、異常事態とは言えない。
triage.notes: 小児重症例の発生は監視継続に値するが、現時点では季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の報告。別件のWilms腫瘍偽ワクチン詐欺事件は感染症シグナルではなく、本評価の対象外とした。

article.articleSummary: Tamil Nadu reports a dengue and swine flu surge from Jan 1–Aug 30, 2026: 13,573 dengue cases and 9 deaths, with dengue rising sharply through the year (January 1,722; February 1,322; March 1,228; April 1,201; May 1,062; June 1,384; July 2,339; August 3,315). Dengue remains most concentrated in Chennai (2,584 of 13,573) and Coimbatore (1,999). triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱と豚インフルエンザの患者が急増、デング熱13,573例・9人死亡

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू की वजह से बदलेगा बंगाल के स्कूलों का ड्रेस कोड, स्वास्थ्य मंत्री बोले- मोजे से नहीं रुकेगा मच्छर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue will change the dress code of Bengal's schools; the Health Minister said mosquitoes won't be stopped by socks.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in West Bengal prompts school uniform changes during the dengue-prone July–December period, according to Health Minister Dr. Sharadwat Mukherjee. In a high-level review at Health Building, the minister outlined temporary dress-code measures aimed at reducing mosquito bites among students. For government schools, boys would wear full-sleeve shirts and full-length pants, while girls currently wearing skirts would be required to dress in outfits that fully cover the legs, with salwar suits recommended. Knee-high socks were rejected as ineffective since they can trap skin and still allow bites. Officials expect an official circular on these changes for government schools soon; private schools would be urged to adopt similar safety measures, though the final decision would rest with each school's board. The emphasis is on awareness and action during September, October and November, the peak dengue season.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策で西ベンガル州の学校の制服が変更へ、保健相「靴下では蚊を防げない」と発言
triage.triage_reason: 季節性デング熱への行政対応（制服変更）に関する記事であり、重大な公衆衛生上の異常事態や急激な拡大を示す情報はないが、デング熱流行期における予防措置として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事は毎年恒例の季節性デング熱対策（学校の服装規定変更）についての行政発表であり、症例数や重症度に関する具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dual-gene isothermal assay validated for rapid Nipah virus detection
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus detection: India-developed dual-target RT-LAMP assay enables rapid, colorimetric Nipah detection without thermocyclers. Developed by ICMR-NIV Mumbai Unit, the assay operates at 62°C for 40 minutes and uses two conserved targets—the matrix (M) gene and the nucleocapsid (N) gene. A composite rule flags a sample positive if either target amplifies, improving robustness at low viral loads and guarding against mutations. Validation on 137 samples showed 100% analytical sensitivity (CI 72.2–100.0) and 100% specificity (CI 92.9–100.0); agreement with qRT-PCR was perfect (Cohen’s kappa 1.00). Cross-reactivity was assessed against 57 non-Nipah pathogens; 10 spiked clinical matrices and 50 Nipah-negative swabs were included. Nipah is a zoonotic henipavirus carried by fruit bats; outbreaks are monitored in South/Southeast Asia (notably India, Bangladesh, Malaysia). With no licensed vaccine or approved therapy, rapid field diagnostics could accelerate isolation and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 迅速なニパウイルス検出のための2遺伝子等温増幅法アッセイが検証される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断技術（RT-LAMPアッセイ）の開発・検証に関する報告であり、実際の感染症発生や症例報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドICMR-NIVムンバイユニットが開発した診断アッセイの性能検証に関する科学的報告であり、実際のニパウイルス感染発生を報じるものではない。地域情報（インド、バングラデシュ、マレーシア）はニパウイルスが一般的に監視されている地域として言及されているのみで、現時点での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Campagne de vaccination du cheptel et lutte contre la rage canine à Lodja - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Livestock vaccination campaign and fight against canine rabies in Lodja - ACP
article.articleSummary: Livestock vaccination campaign launched in Lodja, Sankuru province, central Democratic Republic of Congo, to reinforce herd protection amid alerts of animal health threats and a rise in canine bites. Minister Jean-Pierre Tshimanga announced the initiative on instruction from President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo and Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, aiming to curb deadly canine rabies and other zoonoses while supporting local herders and tightening regional sanitary security. Lodja, a key livestock basin in Sankuru, regularly confronts major health and logistical challenges, including limited basic veterinary care access and geographic isolation that enable recurring animal diseases such as peste des petits ruminants and contagious bovine pleuropneumonia, causing heavy stock losses. Low vaccination coverage of companion animals and stray dogs in rural areas sustains high rabies transmission risk, with serums often unavailable in time and rabies fatal once symptoms appear. Livestock mortality undermines food security and rural livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: ロジャでの家畜ワクチン接種キャンペーンと犬狂犬病対策 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生（狂犬病・小反芻獣ペスト・牛肺疫）に関するワクチン接種キャンペーンの発表であり、ヒトへの重大な健康被害の報告はないが、狂犬病の人獣共通感染リスクと地域の獣医療アクセス不足が継続的な懸念材料である。
triage.notes: 本記事は主に動物衛生（家畜・犬）に関する予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、ヒト症例の発生報告はない。狂犬病は人獣共通感染症であり地域の獣医療アクセス不足・低いワクチン接種率が継続的なリスク要因として言及されているため、動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: நேபாள பெருவெள்ளம்: பலி எண்ணிக்கை 1,344 ஆக உயர்வு! நோய்கள் பரவும் அபாயம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nepal floods: Death toll rises to 1,344! Risk of disease spread!
article.articleSummary: Nepal floods, as of Sept 5, 2026, kill 1,344 and leave over 4,800 missing after a tibet-nepal border landslide-triggered surge in the Lende River, with floods spilling into the Bhote Koshi River on Aug 26. Widespread destruction across border districts includes homes, buildings, vehicles, bridges, and water facilities. In hard-hit areas, 15 drinking-water sources are contaminated with bacteria, raising cholera risk. Health authorities are considering vaccination campaigns: cholera vaccines for about 100,000 people and vaccines for more than 75,000 children. Officials warn of increased risk of diarrheal and vector-borne diseases post-disaster. Ongoing search and rescue efforts target locating the missing, while public health measures aim to mitigate outbreak potential in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ネパール大洪水:死者数1,344人に上昇！感染症拡大のリスク！
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による水源汚染でコレラ・下痢性疾患等の流行リスクが高く、当局がワクチン接種を検討するなど公衆衛生上の懸念が大きいため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。ただし発生国ネパールは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はネパールの洪水災害とそれに伴うコレラ・感染症拡大リスクであり、チベット（中国）は地すべり発生地として言及されているのみで、感染症事例発生地ではない。ネパールは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。実際のコレラ症例確認情報はまだなく、リスク・予防的対応の段階である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentado urges dengue prevention measures amid Bohol outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of Sep 5, 2026, dengue outbreak in Bohol province includes 1,883 dengue cases and 21 deaths reported Jan 4–Aug 22, 2026, with Bohol declaring a province-wide outbreak after exceeding the epidemic threshold for three consecutive weeks and a case fatality rate of 1.12%. Most cases are in Tagbilaran City and the municipalities of Talibon, Ubay, Getafe, and Tubigon. Governor Erico Aris Aumentado signed an executive order on Aug 27 urging escalation of outbreak management and intensified dengue prevention across local government units, barangays, and communities. He reiterates calls to strengthen prevention measures and act early. Public health reminders emphasize that El Niño and dry weather do not directly cause dengue, but water storage and stagnant water create mosquito breeding sites. The 4 O'Clock Search and Destroy campaign is pushed as part of prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: アウメンタード知事、ボホール州のデング熱アウトブレイクを受け予防対策を要請
triage.triage_reason: ボホール州で流行閾値を3週連続で超過し州全域アウトブレイクが宣言され、死者21名・致死率1.12%と重症度が高く、行政による緊急対応（知事令）も発出されているためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンの風土病であり「異常」とは言えないが、症例数・死亡数の規模とアウトブレイク宣言という行政対応の大きさから、地域内での公衆衛生上の懸念事案としてピックアップ対象とした。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia Kejar Target Nol Kematian Akibat Dengue pada 2030
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia Aims for Zero Dengue-Related Deaths by 2030.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia targets zero dengue-related deaths by 2030 as dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, remains a major public health challenge. The first dengue cases were documented in 1968 in Jakarta and Surabaya, with 58 cases and 24 deaths; mortality later fell below 1% through improved case management, though the disease burden stays high. A Burden of Disease study by Gadjah Mada University estimates more than 2 million dengue hospitalizations in 2024, with an economic cost of about Rp9 trillion. Health professionals warn that early dengue symptoms can mimic common fever and may progress rapidly in certain phases, underscoring the need for vigilant diagnosis and timely care while pursuing the 2030 goal of eliminating dengue deaths.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア、2030年までにデング熱による死亡ゼロを目指す
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は既知の風土病であり新規性は低いが、疾病負荷が高く公衆衛生上の課題として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は政策目標に関する解説記事であり、急性のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。デング熱はインドネシアの風土病として毎年一定数発生しており、フルRRAではなく継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）启动新一阶段伊波拉疫情应对计划
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo launches a new phase of its Ebola outbreak response plan.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo launches a 180-day Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak response plan in Kinshasa to expand and coordinate efforts and halt further spread. Supported by WHO Africa Regional Office and Africa CDC, the plan emphasizes surveillance, contact tracing, patient care, community mobilization, risk communication, logistics, and preparedness in high-risk areas. It is estimated to cost about $1.3 billion. The plan highlights that most deaths occur in the community, many not listed as contacts or treated in facilities, with late case detection and weak tracing complicating transmission interruption. Health Minister Kamba urged cross-sector and donor involvement. As of Sept 2, the current outbreak has 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths across six provinces and 60 health zones. The outbreak began May 15; on Aug 12, WHO Director-General Tedros described it as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行対応の新段階を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（6,342症例、3,072死亡、6州60保健区）が継続中で、WHOが史上2番目に大きいエボラ流行と表明しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHO Africa地域事務局・Africa CDCの支援下で1.3億ドル規模の180日対応計画が始動。致死率が高く、コミュニティでの死亡・追跡不足が課題とされている。
