article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Case Chhattisgarh: स्वाइन फ्लू का हॉटस्पॉट ना बन जाए राजधानी रायपुर, पिछले 24 घंटे में मिले सबसे ज्यादा मरीज, प्रदेश में कुल मरीजों की संख्या 200 के पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Case in Chhattisgarh: Raipur, the Capital, Must Not Become a Swine Flu Hotspot; Most Patients Reported in the Last 24 Hours; Statewide Total Crosses 200.
article.articleSummary: Swine Flu (H1N1) cases are rising in Chhattisgarh, with Raipur—the state capital—at the center of transmission. In the last 24 hours, 12 new infections were confirmed in Raipur and 4 in Durg, taking the statewide total to 205 and the number under treatment to 57. To bolster care, Raigarh District Hospital and Raigarh Medical College have allocated 10 beds each for Swine Flu patients, with capacity to increase if needed. The health department has directed facilities to promptly identify, test, and treat suspected cases, and to isolate suspected patients. Common symptoms include fever, persistent cough, sore throat, body aches, weakness, and sometimes breathing difficulties. Citizens are advised to seek medical advice if symptoms appear, cover mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, wash hands regularly, and avoid crowded places while symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州スワインフルー(H1N1)感染:州都ラーイプルがホットスポット化のおそれ、直近24時間で最多の新規患者、州内累計200人超
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性に発生するH1N1感染の国内拡大事例であり、重症度や死亡者数など詳細情報が不足しているため、当面は続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性に流行を繰り返す疾患であり、国際的な異常性は低い。州保健当局が病床確保・検査体制強化などの対応を実施しており、国内公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられるが、患者数増加傾向のため経過観察が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: मलेरिया कब बन सकता है जानलेवा? बुखार से लेकर बेहोशी तक इन संकेतों को पहचानें, डॉक्टर ने बताई जरूरी सावधानियां
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When can malaria become life-threatening? Recognize these signs—from fever to unconsciousness—doctors advise essential precautions.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, in New Delhi during the monsoon, malaria risk rises as infected female Anopheles mosquitoes transmit malaria parasites. Early symptoms resemble viral fever: high fever with chills, headache, weakness, nausea, and vomiting, and may progress without prompt testing. Do not self-medicate with antimalarials; laboratory confirmation by doctors is essential to determine the disease and appropriate treatment. Timely diagnosis and proper therapy reduce the risk of severe complications. After starting treatment, complete the prescribed regimen and avoid altering doses without medical guidance, even if symptoms improve. Signs of severe malaria include extreme weakness, repeated vomiting, breathing difficulty, very low urine output, unusual bleeding, confusion, seizures, or unconsciousness—seek urgent hospital care. High-risk groups include children under five and pregnant women. Preventive measures include eliminating standing water, using mosquito nets, and protecting against bites at dusk and night.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアはいつ命に関わる状態になるのか？発熱から意識消失までの兆候を見極める—医師が必要な注意点を解説
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリアの一般的な健康啓発・予防啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアの症状・重症化サイン・予防策に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、具体的な集団発生や症例数の急増等は報告されていない。地理的にはニューデリー（インド）が言及されているが、対象国India自体は特異な発生報告ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 45 PSK di Black Jack Toboali Dites Kesehatan, Hasilnya : Satu HIV Satu Raja Singa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Forty-five sex workers at Black Jack in Toboali underwent health screening; the results: One HIV case, One Lion King.
article.articleSummary: On Aug 31, 2026, forty-five sex workers at the Black Jack area in Toboali, Bangka Selatan Regency, underwent voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) for sexually transmitted infections. Follow-up testing confirmed two infections: HIV in one individual and syphilis in another; a third initial positive result was later found negative, leaving two confirmed cases among the 45 tested. Counseling and disease-appropriate management were provided to the HIV-positive and syphilis-positive participants. This screening, coordinated by the Bangka Selatan Health Office (DKPPKB), aimed to detect infections early and reinforce ongoing surveillance among a highly mobile at-risk population. The report highlights the continued need for periodic testing in settings with elevated risk due to mobility between cities; no infection source or imported/exported case details were reported.

triage.headline_ja: トボアリのブラックジャックで性風俗従事者45人が健康検査、結果はHIV1名・梅毒1名
triage.triage_reason: 通常の性感染症スクリーニング活動の一環であり、症例数も少なく異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局による日常的なVCT(自発的カウンセリング・検査)活動の報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: DOH: Leptospirosis cases surging
article.articleSummary: Following torrential rains and flooding, leptospirosis cases surge across the Philippines, with 824 cases recorded August 2–15, up 77% from 465 for July 19–August 1. Cumulative total for January 1–August 15 is 6,253, about 12% lower than 7,084 in the same period in 2025. Areas monitoring include National Capital Region, Ilocos, Central Luzon, Calabarzon, Northern Mindanao, and Davao Region, with some reporting epidemic-threshold levels twice in the past four weeks. The DOH notes the outbreak is ongoing, while stressing preparedness and response capacity. Metro Manila DOH hospital bed capacity for leptospirosis totals 602 beds (including 260 surge beds); currently 562 patients are admitted. Stock up includes 1,204,200 doxycycline capsules augmented to affected areas, 2,624,089 capsules in stock across Centers for Health Development, and 40,812 capsules at DOH-retained hospitals in Metro Manila.

triage.headline_ja: DOH：レプトスピラ症症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンで洪水後のレプトスピラ症症例が急増し、一部地域で疫学的閾値を超え、マニラ首都圏の病床がほぼ満床（602床中562人入院）となるなど公衆衛生上の負荷が高まっているため。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はヒト-ヒト感染しないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、洪水による曝露継続とマニラ首都圏の病床逼迫が懸念材料。累計症例数は前年同期より約12%少ないため、季節的増加の範囲内である可能性もある。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca tay chân miệng tăng, siết phòng dịch ngay từ trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising hand, foot and mouth disease cases prompt tighter prevention measures starting at schools.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 100,000 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases were recorded in Vietnam in the first eight months of 2026, up 2.5-fold from 2025, with 87.3% under age 5. The Ministry of Health urged tighter prevention in schools as students return to class, noting ongoing high transmission in Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. HFMD typically peaks September–October; symptoms include fever, mouth ulcers, and blisters on the palms, soles, knees, or buttocks. Authorities emphasize early detection and reporting, and schools must ensure clean environments, handwashing with soap, adequate water, and regular disinfection, following the “three clean” guideline. If cases cluster, schools should coordinate with local health authorities. An EV71 vaccine has been approved; Long Chau plans rapid distribution across 200+ vaccination centers. Vaccination, plus hygiene and surveillance, is highlighted to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の症例増加、学校での感染対策強化へ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで手足口病(HFMD)の症例数が前年比2.5倍と急増し、複数省・市で継続的な流行が見られるため、異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさの基準に該当し社会的関心も高いと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は主にベトナム国内の季節性HFMD流行と学校での予防対策強化について述べており、重症度や死亡例の具体的データは記載されていない。EV71ワクチンの承認・普及も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 aligns with seasonal flu as outbreak pattern shifts - virologist
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s 2026 COVID-19 outbreak diverges from six-year patterns, with cases peaking later and an expected decline in October as school holidays begin. Virologist Dr. Yong Poovorawan, head of the Centre of Excellence in Clinical Virology at Chulalongkorn University, said early 2026 activity was extremely low, then resurged in the last two months, now at a national peak. COVID-19 cases are about 100,000 with 16 deaths, while influenza infections reach about 350,000 with around 50 deaths, making flu roughly three times more common but with similar mortality to COVID-19. Dr. Yong notes influenza seasonality and that the current dominant COVID-19 sub-strain appears no longer significantly more severe than seasonal flu. Historically, Thailand’s outbreak follows Songkran and the rainy season, tapering by August; this year’s pattern mirrors influenza in timing, with both viruses peaking together but COVID less lethal than earlier waves.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が季節性インフルエンザと同調、流行パターンが変化―ウイルス学者
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の重症度は季節性インフルエンザ並みに低下しており、既存の流行パターンの変化を報告する情報であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 季節性の流行パターンに関する専門家コメントであり、危機的な公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: নেপালে ফের ধস, মৃত বেড়ে ১৩৪৪, নিখোঁজ ৪৯০০ জন, জলের সঙ্গে ছড়াচ্ছে সংক্রামক রোগ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another landslide in Nepal; death toll rises to 1,344; 4,900 missing; waterborne infectious diseases spreading.
article.articleSummary: Nepal’s floods and landslides have killed 1,344 and left 4,898 missing, with 8,631 rescued alive as of 2026-09-05. A fresh landslide in Darchula district partially blocks the Chowlani River, raising downstream flood risk and warning of possible dam breach; the slide occurred in Apihimal Rural Municipality’s Bhattar area. Bidur area was among the hardest hit on Aug 26. Drinking-water sources show contamination, with 5 of 15 tested positive for E. coli, signaling waterborne disease risk and potential cholera. Rescue teams also recovered two workers from the Trishuli-3A hydropower tunnel; about 600 children remain missing in Rasuwa and Nuwakot. Security forces are searching for roughly 4,798 missing across affected districts. India reports 275 Indians still missing, 166 rescued, and 1,907 Indians have safely returned from China; India has dispatched about 95 tonnes of relief and 54 specialists to assist.

triage.headline_ja: ネパールで再び地滑り、死者1,344人に増加、行方不明4,900人、洪水とともに感染症が拡大
triage.triage_reason: ネパールの洪水・地滑り災害に伴い飲料水源からE.coli陽性が検出され、コレラ等の水系感染症拡大リスクが指摘されているが、実際の感染症症例数や確定診断は報告されておらず、対象国での発生も確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はネパールの大規模自然災害（洪水・地滑り）による人的被害と、それに伴う水系感染症（コレラ・E.coli）のリスクである。インドと中国は行方不明者の救助・帰国支援の文脈で言及されているのみで、両国内での感染症発生を示す記述はない。ネパールは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nepal flash floods: Disease threat grows as water sources contaminated; toll rises to 1,344
article.articleSummary: Five of 15 drinking water samples from Bidur Municipality in Nuwakot district tested positive for E. coli, signaling potential cholera and other waterborne diseases after Nepal’s August 26 floods. Authorities chlorinated affected sources, but regular supplies remain disrupted, forcing survivors to rely on tankers. Health officials report diarrhoeal infections and fever in displacement camps, though no major outbreak has been recorded yet. Authorities may vaccinate around 100,000 vulnerable people against cholera if diarrhoeal cases rise; plans also target more than 75,000 children under 15 for measles and rubella. The death toll reached 1,344 on Saturday, with rescue operations on day 11. Rescuers face mud, boulders and debris inside hydropower tunnels; two workers were rescued from Upper Trishuli 3A on Friday, nine days after entrapment. India is aiding with tunnel specialists, medical personnel, and forensic experts; a 19-member DNA-analysis team is assisting, alongside relief supplies; emergency funds released to districts.

triage.headline_ja: ネパール鉄砲水:水源汚染で感染症リスク拡大、死者数1,344人に
triage.triage_reason: 洪水による水源汚染でコレラ・大腸菌など水系感染症リスクが拡大しており、避難所での集団感染の可能性と外部（インド）からの支援実施が確認されるため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにNepalが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。Indiaは支援国として言及されているのみで、感染症イベントの発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Patient Claims Insurance Company Rejected His Mediclaim For Dengue Over Platelet Count: 'Not Serious Until Below 70,000'
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, a dengue patient in India claimed his mediclaim was rejected on discharge after a hospitalisation decision hinged on a platelet count. The patient, Chirag Kothari, said his platelet count was around 100,000 (1 lakh) but the insurer allegedly deemed dengue not serious enough for admission, citing a threshold of less than 70,000. Independent verification, policy terms, and documentation were not provided. The claim sparked online debate about medical insurance in India, with critics arguing premiums fail to deliver coverage at the point of need. ManipalCigna publicly urged the patient to share policy and claim numbers via direct message to review the case on priority. The article relies on user-generated content and lacks independent verification of the claims.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者、保険会社が血小板数を理由に医療保険請求を却下したと主張:「7万未満でないと重症とみなされない」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は個別の医療保険請求トラブルに関する内容であり、公衆衛生上のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではないため、疫学的シグナルとしての該当性がない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の感染状況そのものではなく、個別患者の保険金請求トラブルとSNS上の議論を扱った内容。公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Kesehatan Palu terima dua unit X-ray untuk perluas deteksi TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palu City Health Office Receives Two X-ray Units to Expand TB Detection.
article.articleSummary: Two portable X-ray units were received by Palu City Health Office, Central Sulawesi, from the Ministry of Health to broaden early detection of tuberculosis (TB) in the city. In Palu, TB case finding up to mid-August 2026 reached 1,062 confirmed cases, about 51.4% of an estimated 2,066. Of those identified, over 85% have started treatment. The program emphasizes expanded contact tracing of close contacts—family, neighbors, and other frequent social contacts—and may provide Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy (TPT) to eligible contacts even if asymptomatic. TPT coverage among contacts is around 23% and needs boosting. The initiative supports the national TB elimination target by 2030. Authorities are engaging communities and educational institutions for TB education and the importance of adhering to treatment, while encouraging stigma reduction toward people with TB.

triage.headline_ja: パル市保健局、結核検出拡大のためX線装置2台を受領
triage.triage_reason: 既知の結核対策プログラムの通常業務報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核の国家的排除目標(2030年)に向けた通常の検診拡大・機材配布に関する記事であり、突発的な感染拡大やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nuevo caso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: New Ebola case confirmed in Kayna health zone, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, in territory controlled by the AFC/M23 rebel group. A 21-year-old man on the surveillance list for Ebola response was laboratory-confirmed to be infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, per Xinhua reporting. The confirmation followed identification by response teams coordinated by M23. This case appears more than two months after rebels unilaterally declared the outbreak over in their territories at the end of June 2026, after 21 consecutive days without new cases. The report highlights ongoing risk of transmission and reporting in contested areas and the need for continued surveillance and laboratory confirmation in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、感染終息宣言後にエボラ新規感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 終息宣言から2か月以上経過後の新規エボラ確定例であり、異常性が高く、紛争地域での監視体制の脆弱性からヒトーヒト感染拡大リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 反政府勢力(M23/AFC)支配地域での発生であり、公式な保健当局との連携・検証体制が不十分な可能性がある。終息宣言後の再燃例であるため、サーベイランスの信頼性・地域の安全確保が今後の対応の鍵となる。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh Tay chân miệng gia tăng, Bộ Y tế yêu cầu tăng cường phòng dịch tại trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease on the rise; the Ministry of Health calls for strengthening outbreak prevention measures in schools.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease is rising in Vietnam. In the first eight months of 2026, about 100,000 cases were recorded nationwide, more than 2.5 times higher than the same period last year. In the last four weeks, cases remain high in Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. The illness mainly affects children under 5, especially in nurseries and kindergartens, comprising about 87.3% of cases. Health authorities warn that cases may continue to rise; dengue fever and COVID-19 could complicate the outbreak. The Ministry of Health instructed the Ministry of Education and local authorities to strengthen prevention in schools, with emphasis on hygiene and early detection. Measures include ensuring clean water, soap and handwashing facilities; promoting the 3 clean principle (eat clean, live clean, hands clean); regular cleaning of classrooms and toys; prompt reporting of suspected cases to parents and health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が増加、保健省は学校での感染対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで手足口病症例が前年同期の2.5倍に増加し複数都市で継続しているが、重症度・国際的拡大の情報はなく、国内での既存対応(学校向け予防強化)にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: COVID-19・デング熱は流行を複雑化させる可能性がある要因として言及されているのみで、主題は手足口病(HFMD)の増加。5歳未満の乳幼児(保育園・幼稚園)が主な患者層で全体の87.3%を占める。重症例・死亡数の記載はなく、国内保健当局主導の学校衛生強化対応が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : " Si nous n'agissons pas d'urgence, davantage de vies seront perdues et la menace s'aggravera ", l'ONU tire la sonnette d'alarme face à la progression de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: "If we do not act urgently, more lives will be lost and the threat will worsen," the UN sounds the alarm as the epidemic progresses.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by the Bundibugyo virus, passes 100 days since its official declaration as the country’s 17th Ebola epidemic. As of August 31, 2026, the health ministry’s INSP reports 6,186 laboratory-confirmed cases, 3,007 deaths, and 1,409 recoveries (case fatality rate 48.6%). The outbreak spans six provinces amid insecurity and weakened health systems, complicating case identification, contact tracing, patient care, and community engagement. The UN warns that, despite intensified response, transmission outpaces control efforts; urgent action is required to contain spread. The crisis compounds humanitarian vulnerability, disproportionately affecting women and girls, including pregnant women, and children at risk of exploitation or trafficking. The Congolese government leads the response with support from WHO, Africa CDC, IASC partners, and other humanitarian actors, with a call for increased international funding and action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱: 「緊急に行動しなければ、さらに多くの命が失われ、脅威は悪化する」— 感染拡大を前に国連が警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.6%、6,000例超・3,000人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が6州に拡大し、国連が国際支援を要請する深刻な事態であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行（ブンディブギョウイルス）、発生から100日超、致死率48.6%、治安悪化と医療体制脆弱化により対応が困難。WHO、Africa CDC、IASCが支援中で国際資金拡充が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Нов вирус от кърлежи разболява като грип
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A New Tick-Borne Virus Causes Flu-Like Illness.
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, a newly identified tick-borne nairovirus in China, causes flu-like illness, fatigue, GI symptoms, and indicators of thrombocytopenia and liver injury. Beijing researchers found ALTNV in 10.4% of 3,163 patients with tick bites, as part of a long-running surveillance since 2009; results published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Among 56 patients infected with ALTNV alone, fatigue, GI symptoms, thrombocytopenia, and elevated liver enzymes were most common; all recovered without lasting sequelae. Dual infection with Dabie bandavirus (DBV) led to more severe disease, with respiratory and renal dysfunction; 7 of 38 co-infected patients died. ALTNV is genetically distinct from DBV, though both can circulate in the same regions and be transmitted by the same tick. No specific antiviral exists; treatment is supportive. Prevention focuses on tick-bite avoidance: long clothing, repellents, and thorough skin checks after outdoor exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 新種のマダニ媒介ウイルスがインフルエンザ様症状を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 中国・北京で新規に同定されたマダニ媒介ナイロウイルス(ALTNV)がNEJMに報告され、単独感染は軽症だが、Dabieバンダウイルスとの重複感染では致死例(7/38)も見られるため、新興病原体として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は2009年からの長期サーベイランスデータに基づく学術報告（NEJM掲載）であり、急性アウトブレイクではない。ヒトーヒト感染の証拠はなく、マダニ媒介性のみ。今後の症例報告や地理的拡大の続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: PGI में Swine Flu के 170 Positive मरीज, पंजाब के मरीजों की सबसे बड़ी गिनती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 170 Swine Flu–positive patients at PGI, the largest number of patients from Punjab.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-05, PGI in Chandigarh reports 170 positive cases this year of swine flu (H1N1) and influenza B, with about half in September. Punjab leads with 68 cases, followed by Haryana (34), Chandigarh (28), Himachal Pradesh (20), and Uttar Pradesh (10). The patients include 83 men, 87 women, and 36 children. Common symptoms are fever ≥101°F, persistent cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, body and head pain, fatigue, and shortness of breath. PGI has established isolation wards and ensures testing and treatment for flu patients. Public health measures emphasize masking in crowded places, frequent hand washing, covering the mouth when coughing or sneezing, and distancing if fever is present. High-risk groups—older adults, young children, pregnant women, and those with heart or lung disease—should take extra precautions and avoid self-medicating with antibiotics; seek medical advice promptly.

triage.headline_ja: PGI(チャンディーガル)でスワインフル陽性患者170人、パンジャブ州が最多
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1/B)の国内報告で、季節的に想定内の範囲だが、症例数増加傾向があり地域公衆衛生当局の対応状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: H1N1およびインフルエンザBの季節性流行報告。PGI(医療機関)は隔離病棟を設置し対応中で、重症度や死亡者数についての記載はなし。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंड: गढ़वा में डेंगू ने दी दस्तक, एक व्यापारी की मौत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jharkhand: Dengue Makes Its Presence Felt in Garhwa; One Trader Dies; Health Department on Alert - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever has emerged in Garhwa district, Jharkhand, with one death and one patient recovered and discharged. The health department has placed the district on high alert and set up a 10-bed isolation ward at Sadar Hospital to manage cases. In the past ten days, multiple dengue-like cases have appeared, with two confirmed so far. The deceased was a prominent trader who reportedly did not seek treatment at a government hospital and died of dengue after traveling to Daltonganj (now Medininagar) for care. A second patient with dengue symptoms received treatment and recovered. Civil Surgeon Dr. John F. Kennedy stressed vigilance, noting only one or two positive dengue tests in the district. Authorities urged the public to prevent mosquito breeding, maintain sanitation, and seek prompt testing at Sadar Hospital for fever and body aches.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州:ガルワでデング熱発生、商人1名死亡、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: インドで季節性・地方病として毎年発生するデング熱の小規模事例（確認症例2件、死亡1名）であり、地元保健当局が既存の医療体制（隔離病棟設置等）で対応可能なレベル。国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクはなく、異常性も低い。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの一部地域で季節性に流行する地方病であり、本事例は単一地区における限定的なクラスター（確認2例、死亡1例）。保健当局は既に隔離病棟設置等の対応を実施しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंड: गढ़वा में डेंगू ने दी दस्तक, एक व्यापारी की मौत, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jharkhand: Dengue strikes Garhwa, a trader dies, Health Department on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, dengue fever has struck Garhwa district, Jharkhand, with one death and one recovered patient reported. A 10-bed isolation ward has been prepared at Sadar Hospital as the health department remains on alert. Over the past ten days, several dengue-like cases were detected, including two confirmed cases: a senior businessman who died after reportedly not seeking government hospital care, and another patient who recovered and was discharged after treatment. District Civil Surgeon Dr. John F Kennedy noted only one or two dengue-positive tests in the district, and the deceased had traveled to Daltanganj, now officially Medininagar, for care. Authorities urge vigilance during the dengue season: eliminate standing water around homes, maintain cleanliness, and seek prompt testing and treatment at Sadar Hospital for fever and body pains to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州:ガルワでデング熱発生、商人1名死亡、保健当局が警戒
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱による地域限定の小規模発生であり、死亡者は1名のみ、地元保健当局が通常の対応（隔離病棟設置、注意喚起）を行っている段階でIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 地元ヒンディー語メディアの単発報道であり、季節性デング熱の通常発生パターンに合致。確定症例数も1〜2例と少なく、地区保健局のみで対応可能なレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Les médecins mettent en garde contre les groupes d'enfants susceptibles de devenir gravement malades lorsqu'ils contractent la dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn about groups of children at risk of becoming seriously ill when they contract dengue fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, prompts warnings about groups of children at risk of severe illness. There is no specific antiviral for dengue; management is supportive, focusing on symptoms and potential complications. For fever, appropriate antipyretics are used; dehydration is treated with oral rehydration or IV fluids, with transfusion for bleeding and dialysis for severe liver or kidney injury. At-risk children include infants, young children, obese children, and those with chronic cardiovascular, renal, pulmonary, or neurological diseases. Proactive prevention—eliminating mosquito breeding sites and reducing vector contact—remains essential. Household water storage should be tightly sealed and regularly cleaned to prevent larval development; containers should have airtight, flat lids to avoid pooling, with routine water changes. In week 34, Ho Chi Minh City reported 1,250 dengue cases, up 10.5% from the seasonal average, signaling a rising outbreak risk.

triage.headline_ja: 医師らが警告：デング熱で重症化しやすい子供のグループについて
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市でデング熱症例が季節平均より10.5%増加しているが、風土病としての季節性変動の範囲内とも解釈でき、重症度や異常性に関する具体的データが不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムを含む東南アジアの風土病であり、週34時点で1,250例・季節平均比10.5%増との報告。増加傾向は監視すべきだが、現時点では通常の季節変動の範囲内である可能性もあり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू का कहर : प्रदेश में 200 से ज्यादा संक्रमित, एक्टिव केस 57, इनमें 44 अस्पताल में
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu ravages: More than 200 infected in the state, 57 active cases, of which 44 are hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases (Influenza A(H1N1)) in Chhattisgarh, India, reach 205 total; 57 active, 44 in hospitals, and 13 in home isolation as of 5 September 2026. Raipur district bears the heaviest burden with 89 cases, followed by Durg and Bilaspur at about 26 each. Korba has 11, Raigarh 10, and Dhamtari 9; Mahasamund and Rajnandgaon each report 4 cases, with smaller totals (1–3) in several other districts. Transmission occurs via droplets from coughing or sneezing, causing high fever, body pains, sore throat, cold and cough; illness typically lasts 3–5 days but can be longer in older adults or those with other conditions. The upsurge coincides with August rains and weather fluctuations. No severe COVID-19 cases are noted among these swine flu patients; the infections are attributed to Influenza A(H1N1).

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルー猛威：州内感染者200人超、活動性症例57件、うち44人が入院
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1インフルエンザ流行であり、雨季との関連が示唆される国内既知の現象。重症例・死亡報告はなく、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)の地域内流行で、致死例の報告なし。ローカルメディアの報道であり、社会的・政治的関心の高まりを示す情報は本文中に確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор зафиксировал высокую активность Сайлюгемского очага чумы на границе с Монголией
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor recorded high activity of the Sailyugem plague focus on the border with Mongolia.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor records high epizootic activity in the transboundary Sailyugem plague focus along the Russia–Mongolia border. The 29,000 km² focus is 60% in Mongolia; Russia coordinates with Mongolia’s National Center for Zoonotic Infections, conducting surveillance, vaccination as indicated, and preventive measures. More than 200 field samples confirmed intensified infection activity, including near the border. Although centered in the Altai Mountains, the news concerns residents of the Transbaikal region, where the Zabaykalsky Steppe plague focus—historically linked to tarbagan marmots—has shifted to another rodent. Human infection occurs via direct contact with wild animals (hunting, dressing game, skinning, meat processing or consumption of rodent meat); incubation 2–6 days; fever 39–40°C, severe headache and muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, and hemorrhagic skin rashes. At-risk groups include hunters, tourists, and agricultural workers; ongoing rodent and flea monitoring informs risk forecasts and preventive actions.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア連邦消費者権利保護・福祉監督局（Rospotrebnadzor）、モンゴル国境のサイリューゲムペスト自然疫源地で高い活動を記録
triage.triage_reason: 動物間（げっ歯類）のペスト自然疫源地における活動報告であり、人的症例の発生は確認されていない。また発生地域はロシア・モンゴルであり、CEPR監視対象国リストに該当する国（中国含む）が事象の主体ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア・モンゴル国境のサイリューゲムペスト自然疫源地における動物間感染活動の高まりを報告するもので、人的症例は報告されていない。中国が発生地域リストに含まれているが記事本文では言及がなく、主題国（ロシア・モンゴル）はCEPR対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Febre do Nilo Ocidental: saiba mais sobre infecção rara que já tem casos confirmados no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile fever: Learn more about a rare infection that already has confirmed cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever, a viral infection transmitted primarily by Culex mosquitoes that become infected after feeding on wild birds, reached Brazil with four confirmed cases in 2026 and one fatality. The cases, two in São Paulo and two in Santa Catarina (including a 77-year-old woman who died), mark ongoing activity after previous detections in 2014 (first human case in Piauí) and 2018 (virus in a horse in Espírito Santo). Most infections are asymptomatic or mild; when symptoms occur, they include sudden fever, malaise, vomiting, myalgia, eye and head pain, and skin rashes. Severe disease can involve neurological manifestations such as encephalitis, meningitis, or acute flaccid paralysis. Diagnosis relies on antibody detection in blood after five days or in CSF after eight days; samples go to public health laboratories. No vaccine or antiviral exists; prevention through vector surveillance, use of repellents, physical barriers, and eliminating standing water is essential.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイル熱：ブラジルで既に確定症例が出ている稀な感染症について詳しく知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで西ナイル熱の確定症例4件（うち死亡1件）が報告されているが、症例数は少なく地理的に散発的。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく蚊媒介性のため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、重症化（脳炎・死亡）例があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 過去にも2014年（ピアウイ州で初のヒト症例）、2018年（エスピリトサント州で馬に感染）と散発的発生歴あり。今回はサンパウロ州とサンタカタリーナ州で計4例確認、うち77歳女性が死亡。ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬はなく、媒介蚊対策が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Phase 2 Trial Advances First Targeted Dengue Treatment
article.articleSummary: Phase 2 trial of Dengue-mAb (VIS513), a Serum Institute monoclonal antibody targeting all four dengue serotypes (DENV-1–DENV-4). In 250 adults aged 18–60 (median 30; ~72% men) with fever onset within 48 hours, at 12 hospitals in India (Sept 2021–May 2023), a single IV infusion of 3, 5, 7, or 9 mg/kg was compared with placebo. Primary outcomes: 24-hour viremia reduction and fever clearance; safety. At 24 hours, adjusted viral reductions were 1.93–2.35 log units for Dengue-mAb vs 1.29 log for placebo. Among 32 with detectable viremia at baseline, 5–9 mg/kg groups cleared virus by 8 hours; placebo by 72 hours. 24-hour fever clearance ranged from 92.9% to 100% with antibody vs 58.3% placebo; median clearance: 3.5 h (5 mg/kg) or 2 h (7 mg/kg) vs 26.8 h placebo. Phase 3 required for approval; safety: no serious treatment-related adverse events. Although encouraging, results do not prove prevention of severe dengue or hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: 第2相試験、初のデング熱標的治療薬の開発が前進
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱治療薬の臨床試験結果に関する報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は治療薬の臨床試験（第2相）に関する科学的報告であり、疾病発生・流行状況を報じるものではないため、感染症イベントとしてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Demam Bukan Selalu Flu! Kenali Gejala Awal DBD Sebelum Terlambat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever Isn't Always the Flu! Recognize the Early Symptoms of Dengue Fever Before It's Too Late.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Bengkulu's Sukamerindu Health Center area, Kota Bengkulu, Indonesia, highlight early dengue symptoms that mimic flu. Dr. Gia Pratama Putra warns that initial dengue infection presents with high fever, chills, weakness, severe headache, joint and muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, and bleeding signs such as nosebleeds or rashes. In the dengue illness timeline, fever can spike to nearly 40°C for two to seven days; a subsequent critical phase may occur days 3–7 with falling temperature (to ~37.5–38°C or lower) and rapid drop in platelets, risking shock, organ dysfunction, or severe bleeding if untreated. Families should monitor febrile relatives for warning signs like severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, lethargy, or reduced consciousness, seeking urgent care. Prevention focuses on Aedes aegypti control and the 3M Plus approach—drain and cover water containers, recycle potential breeding sites, apply anti-mosquito repellent, and community cleanup.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱は必ずしもインフルエンザではない！手遅れになる前にデング熱の初期症状を知ろう
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症状啓発・予防に関する一般的な健康教育記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人向けの症状啓発・予防啓発の医療情報記事であり、具体的な症例数や流行状況、異常な増加についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Нов вирус плаши учените: пренасят го кърлежи - Здраве -- Новини Стандарт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new virus scares scientists: it is transmitted by ticks - Health -- Standart News
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, Asian Longhorned Tick Nairovirus (ALTNV) was identified in China, transmitted by Haemaphysalis longicornis ticks. Beijing’s State Key Laboratory of Pathogen and Biosafety researchers detected ALTNV in 10.4% of 3,163 patients seeking care after tick bites, within a long-running surveillance cohort begun in 2009. ALTNV is genetically distinct from Dabie bandavirus (DBV), which can cause severe fever with thrombocytopenia. Among 56 patients infected only with ALTNV, fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, thrombocytopenia, and elevated liver enzymes were common, with full recovery and no lasting sequelae. Dual infection with ALTNV and DBV yielded more severe disease, including respiratory and renal impairment; among 38 co-infected patients, 7 deaths occurred. There is no specific antiviral for ALTNV; treatment is supportive. Prevention emphasizes tick-bite avoidance—long clothing, repellents, and thorough skin checks after outdoor exposure. Findings published in the New England Journal of Medicine.

triage.headline_ja: 新型ウイルスが科学者を脅かす：マダニが媒介 - 健康 -- Standart News
triage.triage_reason: 北京の研究チームがマダニ媒介の新規ウイルス（ALTNV）をNEJMで報告し、既知のDabie bandavirusとの重複感染例で死亡例も確認されており、新規病原体としての異常性と一定の重症度が認められるため。
triage.notes: 本疾患はマダニ媒介性であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はないため国際拡大リスクは低いが、新規病原体としての科学的関心は高く、NEJM掲載により国際的な注目を集めている。単独感染例は軽症・回復良好だが、既知ウイルスとの重複感染例では死亡例（7/38）が報告されており、今後の監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 6 000 cas et près de 3 000 décès
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 6,000 cases and nearly 3,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 6,000 cases and 3,000 deaths, spreading across 60 health zones in six provinces. Deaths occur in communities rather than in treatment centers, with many unlinked to known contacts, signaling hidden transmission chains and ongoing risk until every chain is identified and stopped. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns the outbreak is the second-largest ever and the fastest, stressing community trust and access as critical. Response efforts include strengthened testing and treatment capacity, safe-burial teams, and ongoing vaccine and therapeutic trials, under government leadership with Africa CDC. The UN appeals for humanitarian funding; plans for six months total $1.3B, while the revised 2026 plan seeks $2.1B (including $300M for Ebola). CERF has allocated $57M; Uganda is Ebola-free after 42 days, with preparedness reinforced in South Sudan and Central African Republic.

triage.headline_ja: 6,000人以上の感染者と約3,000人の死者
triage.triage_reason: DRCで6,000例超・3,000人超の死亡を伴うエボラ出血熱の大規模流行が継続し、WHO事務局長が史上2番目の規模かつ最速の流行と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間新規感染なしでエボラ終息宣言済み、中央アフリカ共和国・南スーダンは準備強化段階であり実際の発生地としては確認されないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: CHDC Congo triển khai kế hoạch ứng phó trong 6 tháng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: DR Congo rolls out a six-month response plan.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 6,342 Ebola cases and 3,072 deaths as of Sept 2, 2026, with transmission across 60 health zones in 6 provinces—the largest and fastest-spreading outbreak in the country's history, officially declared May 15. To curb it, DR Congo and partners launched a 180-day, multi-sector response plan, requesting about $1.3 billion. WHO Africa Office, together with Africa CDC, emphasizes timely detection, complete contact tracing, and rapid resource mobilization, warning that late case finding and missed contacts drive mortality. Health Minister Roger Kamba calls for cross-sector measures with community and government involvement; UN Resident Coordinator Damien Mama urges integration into broader humanitarian efforts with predictable funding. Flowminder (Sweden) is using anonymized Vodacom mobile data to map movement and forecast spread, identifying high-risk areas, though coverage is currently limited to a single operator; efforts aim to broaden data sources.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴ民主共和国が6ヶ月間の対応計画を展開
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大・最速拡大のエボラ流行が発生し、6342症例・3072死亡、6州60保健区に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Swedenは技術支援（Flowminderによるモバイルデータ解析）提供国であり、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Febre do Nilo: 'Não há preocupação em relação a epidemia', diz coordenadora da Vigilância em Saúde de SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile fever: 'There is no cause for concern regarding an epidemic,' says the São Paulo Health Surveillance Coordinator.
article.articleSummary: West Nile fever has been added to São Paulo state's routine arbovirus sentinel surveillance to monitor disease distribution across the territory, per Regiane de Paula, coordinator of Health Surveillance. The move aims to keep authorities prepared and to track spread via the surveillance panel. São Paulo state confirms its first two cases in history in the interior cities of Ribeirão Preto and São José do Rio Preto. Separately, two cases were confirmed in Santa Catarina this year, in Caçador and Imbituba, with the second resulting in death. West Nile fever is transmitted by Culex mosquitoes, the common mosquito, with wild birds as natural hosts; birds become infected and then mosquitoes pass the virus to other birds and, occasionally, to humans. A migratory bird route from Argentina passes through Santa Catarina and São Paulo, potentially informing spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウエストナイル熱：『流行の懸念はない』とサンパウロ州保健監視局コーディネーターが発言
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州で史上初のウエストナイル熱症例確認、サンタカタリーナ州でも死亡例が出ているが、当局は流行の懸念はないとしており、監視体制強化の段階にとどまるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州で初の症例、サンタカタリーナ州で死亡例1件確認。当局は監視強化と説明しているが公式には流行否定。渡り鳥ルート（アルゼンチン経由）が拡散要因として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱境外移入再增3例 高雄1男2童確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three more imported dengue fever cases; one man and two children diagnosed in Kaohsiung.
article.articleSummary: Three imported dengue fever cases were confirmed in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on 2026-09-05: two girls, aged 10 and 8, recently visited Vietnam; symptoms included fever and rash; both tested NS1 positive and PCR positive upon return; no community exposure and no mosquito-control spraying required. The third case is a 59-year-old man in Sanmin District who returned from Cambodia on Aug 27; he developed fever and myalgia from Aug 31; NS1 rapid test positive on Sep 3, with PCR confirming dengue virus serotype 1; he was hospitalized and isolated as authorities initiated epidemiological investigation and tight preventive measures. Health officials advise continuing mosquito precautions after travel, prompt medical care for fever, rash, or myalgia with travel history, and use NS1 testing; after rainfall, 48 hours is critical for vector control—advise checking and draining standing water in tires, pots, balconies, and rooftops using 'survey, drain, clean, brush'.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱の境外移入例が3例増加、高雄で男性1名と児童2名が確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入性デング熱の散発例であり、コミュニティ内感染や蔓延の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾、カンボジア、ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはVietnamのみ該当（記事に地名として明示されているが対象国リストの一部）。実際の発生地は台湾（対象国外）であり、輸入元としてベトナム・カンボジアが言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: जिला अस्पताल में आरटीपीसीआर पर अटकी स्वाइन फ्लू की जांच
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu test stuck at RT-PCR at the district hospital
article.articleSummary: Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, 5 September 2026 — Swine influenza (H1N1) is suspected in a large number of patients with flu-like symptoms, but the divisional district hospital has not started RT-PCR testing. A rapid antigen test is available, but RT-PCR testing remains unavailable. Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Pradeep Varshney said state-ordered RT-PCR kits are delayed in arrival; once they reach the hospital, RT-PCR testing for suspected swine flu cases will begin. No lab-confirmed case counts are reported yet. The situation underscores a bottleneck in molecular diagnostics at the district level while presumptive swine flu cases are being identified.

triage.headline_ja: 地区病院でスワインフルの検査がRT-PCR待ちで滞留
triage.triage_reason: H1N1疑い患者が多数存在するが検査体制の遅れで確定症例数が不明であり、季節性インフルエンザの範囲か拡大の兆候か判断できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）はインドでは季節的に流行する既知の疾患であり、突発的異常事象とは言い難い。RT-PCR検査キット不足という診断体制の問題が主題であり、確定症例数や重症度データが不足しているため続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: La Une de la presse cette semaine à Kinshasa - À la Une: une rentrée scolaire sous "deux feux rouges", Ebola s'enracine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This Week's Front Page in Kinshasa - On the Front Page: a back-to-school season under "two red flags," Ebola takes root.
article.articleSummary: Ebola takes root in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 6,000 confirmed cases and about 3,000 deaths across six provinces as of 2026-09-05. The outbreak remains far from controlled, with transmission chains multiplying and the virus entrenched beyond local areas. It is active in provinces including Ituri (Bunia) and North Kivu (Beni). Health facilities report shortages of personal protective equipment and stockouts, hindering response efforts. Catholic bishops (CENCO) warn official figures may underrepresent the outbreak’s true scope and call for a strengthened, better-supported response. The report frames Ebola as a regional threat requiring intensified surveillance, resources, and public health measures to curb ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 今週のキンシャサ紙面：新学期は「二つの赤信号」の下で――エボラが定着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確認症例6000件超、死者約3000人、6州にまたがるエボラ流行が制御不能な状態で拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: カトリック司教団（CENCO）が公式統計の過小評価の可能性を指摘し、対応強化を要請。PPE不足など医療体制の逼迫が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Temuan Kasus Hepatitis, Kenali Bahaya dan Cara Penularannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis Case Findings: Understand the Dangers and How It Is Transmitted.
article.articleSummary: Around a dozen workers were found infected with hepatitis in early August during routine health screenings at a local community health center in Indonesia, triggering public health concern. Hepatitis refers to liver inflammation caused by viruses; Hepatitis B and C are most dangerous due to potential chronic infection leading to liver dysfunction, cirrhosis, and liver cancer. Transmission depends on the virus: Hepatitis A and E spread fecal-oral via contaminated food or water, with higher risk in areas with poor sanitation or food-handling hygiene; Hepatitis B, C, and D spread through blood or body fluids, including non-sterile needles, high-risk sexual contact, and mother-to-child transmission at birth. If someone nearby is infected, obtain medical evaluation to determine type and severity; implement basic household hygiene, avoid sharing personal items, separate eating utensils for Hep A/E, and wash dishes with dish soap and running water, per Indonesian health guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: 肝炎症例の発見:危険性と感染経路を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 地域の健康診断で少数の労働者に肝炎が見つかったという一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な集団発生や重症例の急増を示す情報がなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は一般啓発・健康教育目的の内容であり、具体的な発生地域や感染者数、症例数の詳細な報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する明確な発生国が特定できず verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur Swine Flu Alert: कानपुर में H1N1 की दस्तक, पहला मरीज गंभीर, भूलकर भी इन लक्षणें को न करें नजरअंदाज - kanpur swine flu alert first h1n1 case reported in kanpur patient in serious condition
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur Swine Flu Alert: H1N1 makes its presence felt in Kanpur, the first patient is in serious condition, do not ignore these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) detected in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with a 55-year-old man confirmed positive at a private lab and admitted to Lala Lajpat Rai Hospital’s influenza ward in the maternity block on a ventilator; the patient is in serious condition. Treat­ment started on symptoms while awaiting confirmatory RT-PCR results from the microbiology department. A trained team is managing care in a dedicated swine flu ward. Family members said he had previously been treated at a rural private hospital before deterioration. To curb the outbreak, 25 paramedical staff were vaccinated in the first phase. A swine flu OPD and help desk are active. Twenty beds are reserved for swine flu, with six ventilators for severe cases; if cases rise, additional staff will be deployed to the 4th floor maternity block (20 beds). Doctors are instructed to perform RT-PCR for symptomatic patients, especially those with hypertension, diabetes, liver or kidney disease.

triage.headline_ja: カンプール豚インフルエンザ警報：カンプールでH1N1確認、最初の患者は重篤な状態、これらの症状を見逃さないように
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の報告であり、H1N1はインドで季節性に発生する疾患のため異常性は低いが、患者が重症（人工呼吸器管理）であり地域の医療体制整備が進んでいるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: カンプールの病院が豚インフルエンザ専用病棟・OPD・ヘルプデスクを設置し、医療従事者へのワクチン接種を開始するなど地域レベルでの対応が進行中。単発症例であり大規模流行の兆候は記事からは確認できない。H1N1はインドで季節性に発生するため『異常』とは言えないが、患者の重症度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 'सरकार बदलने से मच्छरों को कम काटने के लिए नहीं कह सकते', डेंगू के बढ़ते मामलों को लेकर मंत्री का अजीबोगरीब बयान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "We can't tell mosquitoes to bite less by changing the government," says minister in a bizarre remark about rising dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue continues to surge in West Bengal, India, with over 4,000 cases and seven deaths reported in recent weeks as of September 5, 2026. Chief Minister Shubhendu Adhikari says the current dengue burden is about half of last year’s. Health Minister Sharadvat Mukherjee urged schools to allow students to wear clothing that fully covers arms and legs during the dengue season. Urban Development Minister Agnimitra Paul sparked criticism with the remark that governments cannot deter mosquitoes by changing governments, drawing political backlash amid the health crisis. The episode drew attention on social media after a video circulated by former Rajya Sabha MP Jawahar Sircar. The report emphasizes ongoing urban dengue risk in Bengal and ongoing public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 「政府が変わったからといって蚊に噛む回数を減らせとは言えない」、デング熱の増加を巡る大臣の奇妙な発言
triage.triage_reason: インド西ベンガル州でデング熱の症例・死亡者数が報告されているが、季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はない。政治的関心は高いが公衆衛生上の緊急性は限定的。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州における季節性流行で、昨年より少ない規模とされている。記事の主眼は保健大臣の発言を巡る政治的論争であり、公衆衛生上の新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 'Salwar, not skirts with knee-high socks': Bengal health minister urges schools to change girls' uniforms to tackle dengue- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: During the post-monsoon dengue peak in West Bengal, Health Minister Dr. Sharadwat Mukherjee urged a three-month (September–November) temporary change in school uniforms to reduce mosquito bites. Boys should wear full-length trousers and full-sleeved shirts; girls should swap skirts for salwar suits that cover the legs. Knee-high socks were rejected as protective. A government circular for government schools is expected, with private schools encouraged to adopt similar measures, though individual institutions retain final say. The move is part of broader dengue-prevention efforts, including awareness and vector-control campaigns, as children spend significant time outdoors. Authorities also emphasized not delaying medical care if symptoms appear to prevent progression to severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: 「スカートよりサルワールを、膝丈ソックスではなく」ベンガル州保健相、デング熱対策で学校の女子制服変更を要請
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州における季節性デング熱への予防的対策（制服変更の呼びかけ）であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増の報告はなく、通常の季節的公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 毎年恒例の季節性デング流行に対する予防的行政措置についての記事であり、感染規模や重症度に関する具体的データは記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: CHDC Congo triển khai kế hoạch ứng phó trong 6 tháng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: DR Congo rolls out a six-month response plan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) triggers a new six‑month, multi‑sector response plan launched Sept 4 with an estimated $1.3 billion in funding. Supported by WHO, Africa CDC (ACDC) and partners, the plan aims to accelerate control of a complex outbreak. As of Sept 2, DRC had 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths, with transmission in 60 health zones across six provinces. A large share of deaths occur in the community, involving individuals who were not identified as contacts or who did not access care before death. WHO’s Anne Ancia warns that late detection and missed contacts cost lives, calling for rapid, scaled‑up action. Health Minister Roger Kamba urges cross‑sector measures involving communities, government agencies, partners and donors. UN Resident Coordinator Damien Mama emphasizes integrating Ebola response with broader humanitarian efforts and ensuring flexible, predictable funding. Flowminder, using anonymized Vodacom data, maps population movements to identify high‑risk areas; data are aggregated to protect privacy.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行:コンゴ民主共和国が6か月間の対応計画を展開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6,342症例・3,072死亡と大規模流行しており、複数県・60保健地区に拡大、国際的な資金・支援体制が動員されている重大な公衆衛生事象であるためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く(約48%)、コミュニティ内での死亡が多いことから追跡不能な感染連鎖が懸念される。WHO・Africa CDC等の国際機関が大規模支援を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: DepEd heightens dengue, leptospirosis protocols in schools nationwide
article.articleSummary: Public schools nationwide in the Philippines are tightening dengue and leptospirosis prevention, monitoring and reporting as heavy monsoon rains and tropical cyclones trigger seasonal outbreaks. DepEd issued dual advisories directing school heads, health personnel and staff to enforce strict sanitation and implement the Department of Health’s Enhanced 4S Strategy—search and destroy, secure self-protection, seek early consultation, and support fogging only when indicated by local health authorities. Regular inspections of classrooms, grounds, gardens, restrooms, storage areas, gutters and drainage will target mosquito breeding, with the 4Ts—Taob, Taktak, Tuyo, Takip—integrated into routine sanitation. For dengue, educate students, promote long sleeves and repellents, and promptly refer symptomatic individuals for medical care. For leptospirosis, restrict exposure to floodwater, wear protective gear if unavoidable, cover wounds, and wash exposed skin after contact. A Dengue and Leptospirosis Case Monitoring and Reporting Tool enables 24-hour reporting, complementing DOH/local systems; parents and communities urged to coordinate.

triage.headline_ja: 教育省、全国の学校でデング熱・レプトスピラ症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン季における例年の予防的対応であり、異常な感染急増や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性のデング熱・レプトスピラ症に対する教育省の予防プロトコル強化を報じるものであり、具体的な症例数や死亡者数、異常な流行状況の記載はない。毎年のモンスーン季に見られる定例的な公衆衛生対応と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Les habitants de Rwampara, ancien épicentre d'Ebola, deviennent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The inhabitants of Rwampara, the former Ebola epicentre, are becoming.
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains in focus in the Rwampara health zone of Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, formerly the epidemic epicenter. Early resistance fueled transmission, with up to ten deaths daily in the community and at Rwampara Hospital; some families lost two, five, or seven relatives. Through sustained community sensitization by response teams and local authorities, attitudes have shifted and adherence to prevention measures has improved. Consequently, no new cases have been recorded in recent weeks, and residents now participate in awareness efforts in neighboring villages, contributing to a reduction in mortality in Rwampara. However, pockets of resistance persist in Nizi, Lopa, Iga, Miala, Soleniama, and Mungamba across Ituri’s Irumu and Djugu territories, complicating the response and underscoring the need for continued vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 旧エボラ流行の中心地ルワンパラの住民たちが、対策の担い手となる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、一部地域で抵抗（ワクチン・対策拒否）が残存し感染拡大リスクが継続しているため、深刻度・流行しやすさの観点からピックアップが妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCイトゥリ州ルワンパラ保健地区における既知のエボラアウトブレイクの経過報告。近隣数週間新規症例なしと改善傾向を示す一方、ニジ、ロパ、イガ、ミアラ、ソレニアマ、ムンガンバなど一部地域で対策への抵抗が継続しており警戒が必要。ルワンダ・バハマは発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及がなく、地理情報の誤付与と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Raigad Health Campaign: गणेशात्सवात साथरोग प्रादुर्भाव रोखण्यासाठी सज्ज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Raigad Health Campaign: Ready to prevent the spread of co-infections during Ganeshotsav.
article.articleSummary: Raigad district in the Konkan region will roll out the 'Dhanvantari Health Campaign' during Ganeshotsav to curb spread of infections amid crowding and monsoon conditions. In Alibag, the district health department will coordinate with primary health centers, sub-centers, gram panchayats and allied agencies. The campaign targets dengue, malaria, chikungunya, diarrhea, jaundice, typhoid, and leptospirosis, with special health teams stationed at major Ganesh mandaps to provide first aid, conduct screening for dengue and malaria, and carry out vector-control measures such as site checks and fumigation, along with diagnostic kits. The aim is timely treatment and prevention of spread during the festival, with broad public awareness from gram panchayats to district level through health workers, Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers, and social media. Citizens are urged to ensure proper waste disposal, avoid water stagnation, and maintain drinking-water purity, following festival guidelines, with stock of medicines maintained at rural and district facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ライガド県健康キャンペーン：ガネーシュ祭期間中の感染症流行防止に向けて準備完了
triage.triage_reason: 祭り期間中の予防的公衆衛生キャンペーンの案内であり、具体的な症例数の急増や異常な流行の報告はない。ルーチンの季節的対策として実施されている。
triage.notes: 本記事はガネーシュ祭に伴う季節性感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、腸チフス、レプトスピラ症等）予防のための行政主体の予防キャンペーン告知であり、実際の感染急増や異常事態を報じるものではない。対象国リストにインドは含まれるが、イベント自体が予防的措置の案内でありシグナルとしての緊急性は低いため、verified_locationsは実際の発生事例ではないため空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增3例境外登革熱 柬埔寨與越南返台皆確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports 3 new imported dengue fever cases; all returnees to Taiwan from Cambodia and Vietnam diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Three new imported dengue fever cases reported in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, all returnees from Cambodia and Vietnam. A 59-year-old man from Sanmin District returned from Cambodia on Aug 27; he developed fever and myalgia on Aug 31. Dengue NS1 rapid test was positive on Sep 3, with PCR confirming dengue virus serotype 1, and he is hospitalized in isolation. The other two cases are a 10-year-old girl and an 8-year-old girl who accompanied relatives to Vietnam; after arrival they developed fever and rash and tested positive by NS1 rapid test and PCR. They did not enter the community, so no community spraying is planned. Health authorities are conducting case investigation and emergency vector-control at residences and activity sites. Public guidance: pre-travel mosquito precautions, post-travel health monitoring, seek prompt medical care if symptomatic, and consider testing for asymptomatic individuals; clinicians should apply TOCC history and NS1 testing; emphasize mosquito control within 48 hours after rainfall.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で新たに3例の輸入性デング熱、カンボジアとベトナムからの帰国者全員が陽性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入例（カンボジア・ベトナム渡航後発症）の日常的なサーベイランス報告であり、地域内伝播や重症化、国際的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国リスト外）における輸入性デング熱症例の報告であり、カンボジア・ベトナムは渡航歴として言及されているのみで、当該国での流行事象を主題とする記事ではないため verified_locations は空とした。地域内伝播なし、既に検疫・媒介昆虫対策実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : un plan de 180 jours face à l'ampleur de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a 180-day plan in response to the scale of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC launches a revised 180-day multisectoral plan to intensify and coordinate the Ebola response to Bundibugyo. Implemented with WHO, Africa CDC, UN system and partners, the plan strengthens surveillance, case detection, management, contact tracing, and community interventions. Declared in May 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 6,000 cases and 3,000 deaths, the deadliest in the country. No vaccine or treatment is approved specifically for Bundibugyo; Ervebo is being used to protect health workers and those exposed. A Kisangani campaign began August 27 in Tshopo with more than 50,000 doses mobilized, some for research. An OMS-supported phase-3 trial will test Ervebo cross-protection with about 20,000 doses; two Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are under safety evaluation in the UK and Canada, with efficacy trials planned in DRC from Oct/Nov. The strategy covers monoclonal antibodies and antivirals. Goals: slow transmission, accelerate medical responses, and place communities at the center amid insecurity and access challenges; case fatality near 50%.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行の規模に対応する180日計画
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が6,000症例・3,000死亡・致死率約50%と深刻で、同国史上最悪規模。IHR基準複数該当し、国際機関の大規模支援も継続中のためフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: UK・Canadaはブンディブギョ株特異的ワクチンの安全性評価実施国であり、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。
