article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Chhattisgarh: छत्तीसगढ़ में Swine Flu का विस्फोट! 205 केस, 57 एक्टिव... अंबिकापुर जेल में 100+ बंदियों में हड़कंप
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreak in Chhattisgarh reports 205 confirmed cases with 57 active infections as of 05 September 2026. The surge is described as a swine flu explosion, indicating rapid transmission across the state. In Ambikapur jail, more than 100 inmates faced panic due to the outbreak, signaling potential clustering in crowded settings. The report lists case and active counts but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, symptoms, exposure sources, or treatment. Ongoing outbreak dynamics appear centered on this jail-related cluster alongside broader community transmission in Chhattisgarh. Public health authorities are monitoring the situation and responding to the evolving outbreak on 5 September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: チャッティースガル州でスワインフル感染爆発！205症例、アクティブ57例…アンビカプル刑務所で100人以上の受刑者が動揺
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所という密集環境でのクラスター発生と急速な症例増加(205例、うち57例がアクティブ)が報告されており、WPRO基準（異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、メディア報道による社会的関心も認められるため、フルRRAでの確認が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの流行自体は毎年発生するが、刑務所という密集環境でのクラスター化と『感染爆発』という表現から急速な拡大が示唆される。重症度（死亡・入院数）や検査確定情報、対応状況の詳細が不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 2 Kemungkinan Sumber Kontaminasi E-coli di Menu MBG SMPN 6 Boyolali : Air atau Manusia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two Possible Sources of E. coli Contamination in the MBG SMPN 6 Boyolali Menu: Water or Humans.
article.articleSummary: Two possible sources of Escherichia coli contamination were identified in the MBG (Makan Bergizi Gratis) menu served to students at SMP Negeri 6 Boyolali, Indonesia: the water used for washing ingredients and cooking, and human handling by volunteers/workers at the SPPG Siswodipuran 2 kitchen, which is suspended pending review. Laboratory results (Labkes) confirmed E. coli in the nasi and sayur components, with the vegetable soup notably linked to carrot and chicken, and water used in cleaning/cooking also testing positive for the bacteria. Boyolali Health Office and MBG task force indicate improved sanitation procedures are needed; measures like chlorine (kaporit) and alum (tawas) application should be maintained. SOPs for volunteers and staff should be tightened. The affected students are reported healthy now.

triage.headline_ja: ボヨラリ県立第6中学校のMBG給食メニューにおけるE.coli汚染源の可能性2つ：水または人間
triage.triage_reason: 単一学校での給食汚染事案で、学生は既に回復しており国際的拡大リスクや重症例は認められない。局所的な食品衛生管理の問題であり、緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 地元保健当局とMBGタスクフォースが対応中であり、衛生管理の改善措置（塩素・ミョウバン使用、SOP強化）が講じられている。学生は健康を回復済み。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄增3例境外登革熱　2女童入境即就醫免社區噴藥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports 3 more imported dengue fever cases; two girls sought medical care upon arrival, no community spraying.
article.articleSummary: Three imported dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, on 2026-09-05. A 59-year-old man returning from Cambodia, residing in Sanmin District, developed fever and myalgia on Aug 31 after arriving Aug 27; NS1 rapid test positive and he was hospitalized. PCR confirmed dengue virus type 1 infection. Two girls aged 8 and 10 who traveled to Vietnam to visit relatives, returned to Kaohsiung and were brought to hospital; NS1 rapid tests and PCR were positive. Because the two children did not enter community settings after arrival, no community-wide spraying is required. The Kaohsiung City Health Bureau has conducted epidemiological investigations around residences and activity sites and activated emergency prevention measures. Travelers are urged to use mosquito protection, monitor health after returning, seek care for fever, rash, and clinicians should apply TOCC screening and NS1 testing as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で境外性デング熱3例増加　女児2人は入国後すぐ受診、地域一斉消毒は不要
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における輸入症例（カンボジア・ベトナム由来）3件の報告であり、地域内伝播や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。対象国（カンボジア・台湾）は評価対象国リストに含まれず、ベトナムも渡航者の発症国であり感染発生国ではないため、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾（対象国外）における輸入症例報告であり、感染発生国であるカンボジア・ベトナムについても、これらは渡航先であり、地域内での発生・拡大を示す情報ではない。対象国リストに台湾・カンボジアは含まれず、ベトナムは症例の渡航先国として言及されているのみで、ベトナム国内での流行拡大等の主題ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增3例境外登革熱 柬埔寨與越南返台皆確診
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports three new imported dengue fever cases; returnees from Cambodia and Vietnam diagnosed.
article.articleSummary: Three imported dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung, Taiwan on 2026-09-05: a 59-year-old man returning from Cambodia and two children, ages 10 and 8, who accompanied relatives to Vietnam. The man developed fever and myalgia after returning on August 27; a dengue NS1 rapid test was positive on August 31 and PCR confirmed dengue type 1, with hospitalization in Sanmin District. The two girls showed fever and rash during their Vietnam visit; they arrived at Kaohsiung Airport and were diagnosed positive by NS1 and PCR, with no detected community exposure. Public health has activated contact tracing at residences and activity sites; no community spraying is required. Authorities urge travelers to use mosquito protection abroad, monitor health on return, seek care for symptoms, and test asymptomatic individuals. TOCC-based screening and NS1 testing are emphasized; post-rain vector-control within 48 hours is advised to curb mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で境外登革熱3例増加、カンボジアとベトナムからの帰国者がいずれも確診
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入例（カンボジア・ベトナム渡航者）の登革熱症例であり、地域内伝播や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは台湾（対象国外）における輸入性登革熱症例の報告であり、感染はカンボジア・ベトナム渡航中に発生した可能性が高いが、現地での流行拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。台湾での地域内感染の証拠もなく、通常の輸入例対応（接触者調査・媒介対策）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ đồng nhiễm phế cầu khuẩn và vi rút hô hấp mùa tựu trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of the risk of pneumococcal and respiratory virus co-infections during the back-to-school season.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces heightened risk of pneumococcal disease and respiratory virus co-infections as children return to school, with crowded settings and weather shifts. Pneumococcus, Haemophilus influenzae and RSV circulate; co-infections complicate management, requiring differentiation of viral versus bacterial infections to guide antibiotics. Children under 5 are highest risk; older children can develop severe pneumonia or meningitis. Invasive pneumococcal disease may start like a routine respiratory illness but after 2–3 days progresses to high fever, headache, vomiting, neck stiffness and seizures, with bacteremia or meningitis. Duration is 7–10 days; complications may require 1–4 weeks. Serotype 19F accounts for about 25% of invasive deaths at National Children's Hospital; serotypes 11A/11D, 15A and 23A comprise about 33.5% of 2011–2023 cases across 10 hospitals. Pneumococcal vaccination is being rolled out in early 2026 in some localities; parents should vaccinate on schedule and avoid unnecessary antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 新学期シーズンにおける肺炎球菌と呼吸器ウイルスの重複感染リスクへの警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症・肺炎球菌感染に関する啓発的な注意喚起記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではないが、小児の重症化リスクに言及があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の啓発・注意喚起報道であり、特定のアウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではない。ワクチン接種推進の文脈も含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Bischofskonferenz im Kongo: Mehr Einsatz gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bishops' Conference in the Congo: More Efforts to Combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts stronger measures by the Catholic Bishops Conference (CENCO). Since the May 15 outbreak, national data through August 25 show 5,713 confirmed Ebola cases, 2,744 deaths, 1,269 recoveries, and 770 patients in isolation. The church notes actual cases may be higher due to under-recording of suspected cases outside health facilities. Shortages of PPE and supplies; irregular deliveries; underpaid healthcare workers; insufficient support for transport and communication. CENCO urges public compliance with health authorities: frequent handwashing, use of disinfectant, no handshakes, avoiding contact with blood/body fluids and clothing/bedding of patients, and that the deceased be handled by professionals. Misinformation, cultural beliefs, and traditional funeral practices hinder control; attacks on aid workers and destruction of treatment centers have occurred. The church will expand Ebola response in Ituri Province via Caritas and Catholic Relief Services to provide relief goods.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ司教会議:エボラ対策の強化を訴え
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模なエボラ流行(確定5,713例、死亡2,744例)が継続しており、医療資源不足やヒトーヒト感染拡大の懸念、対応妨害要因(誤情報・葬儀慣習・襲撃)が複合しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 教会関係者による報告であり、公式保健当局データとの整合性確認が必要。死亡率が極めて高い(約48%)点も要注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dilaga in Congo, oltre 3.000 morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in the Congo, over 3,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts a 180-day multisectoral plan to counter the fastest Ebola epidemic recorded in the country. As of September 2, 6,342 cases and 3,072 deaths were reported across 60 health zones in six provinces. The program, backed by the World Health Organization and Africa CDC with international partners, requires $1.3 billion and focuses on early diagnosis, rapid contact tracing, and community engagement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ拡大、死者3000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速とされるエボラ流行が発生し、6342症例・3072死亡、6州60保健区に拡大しており、国際的な対応（WHO・Africa CDC）が展開されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 史上最速の流行とされ、13億ドル規模の国際支援計画が進行中。致死率も高く(約48%)、フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Au moins 45 professionnels de santé morts d'Ebola depuis le début de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: At least 45 healthcare workers have died of Ebola since the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola taking a heavy toll on health workers: as of August 26, 2026, at least 158 healthcare workers have been infected and 45 have died since the outbreak began. Roles affected include physicians, nurses, midwives, laboratorians, aides, community health workers, cleaners, and drivers in health facilities. In many sites, protective measures remain insufficient, raising exposure risk in ordinary facilities where patients may be admitted before Ebola is detected. In North Kivu, six facilities averaged only 29% compliance with preventive measures; in Bas-Uélé, the Ganga General Hospital registered 21.3%. Vaccination with Ervebo, approved for a different Ebola species, has not demonstrated human efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO recommends its use only within research protocols, prioritizing frontline workers, while maintaining other protective measures to curb ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行開始以来、少なくとも45人の医療従事者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行で医療従事者に多数の感染・死亡が発生しており、感染対策の不備やワクチンの有効性未確認など公衆衛生上深刻かつ拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirusによる流行であり、既存承認ワクチン(Ervebo)の有効性が未確認である点が特に注目される。医療施設内の感染対策遵守率が著しく低い地域があり、医療従事者への感染拡大が継続するリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: প্যান্ডেলের বাঁশেও ডেঙ্গুর লার্ভা! পুজো কমিটিগুলিকে 'সাবধান' করল জেলা স্বাস্থ্য দপ্তর
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue larvae in the pandal's bamboo too! The district health department has warned Puja committees.
article.articleSummary: Jalpaiguri district in West Bengal reported 242 dengue cases so far this year, with daily counts rising as the Puja season approaches. The district health department warns Puja committees that dengue-bearing Aedes mosquitoes breed even in small water pockets, notably in water collected at the heads of bamboo used for pandals. To prevent outbreaks before the festival, Chief Health Officer Dr. Asim Halder will convene a meeting with Puja committees next week. Health workers are conducting house-to-house surveillance, urging tests for fever and swift treatment for positives. Entomologist Rahul Sarkar notes that bamboo water-collecting heads are particularly risky and recommends sealing them with sand or plastic. Surrounding litter and standing water around pandals—tea cups, pots—will be cleared as part of intensified vector-control messaging. In 2022, Jalpaiguri saw 3956 dengue cases and 4 deaths; 2023 had 993 cases; the current season runs from June to October per health calendars.

triage.headline_ja: パンダルの竹にもデング熱の幼虫！県保健局がプージャー委員会に「注意」を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州ジャルパイグリ県で季節性デング熱の増加（242例）が報告されているが、地域限定的な予防的注意喚起であり、過去数年と同程度の季節的流行パターンの範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 毎年季節的に発生するデング熱の地域的注意喚起記事。2022年には同地域で3956例・4死亡の記録があり、今年242例は現時点では比較的少ない。プージャー祭前の予防キャンペーンの一環であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nearly 2,000 fall ill in suspected food poisoning linked to...
article.articleSummary: Nearly 2,000 people, mostly students, fell ill from suspected food poisoning linked to President Prabowo Subianto's Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program, with outbreaks Tuesday–Thursday across East Java, Central Java, West Sumatra, Aceh and South Sulawesi, affecting about 1,950 individuals. The largest cluster was Central Java's Rembang regency: 752 students and 25 teachers at State Senior High School 1 Lasem. Sidoarjo, East Java, reported 730 illnesses at the Manbaul Hikam Islamic boarding school; 706 discharged. West Sumatra's Agam regency had 276 suspected cases; Aceh's Bener Meriah: 15 elementary students and a principal treated; South Sulawesi's Tana Toraja: 152 students treated. No deaths so far; investigations ongoing. Since MBG's launch in 2025, outbreaks have affected 50,059 people in 560 cases across 245 districts in 36 provinces (as of Sept 2). About 80–90% of past incidents were linked to food-safety lapses; authorities are tightening oversight of about 27,000 meal centers and have shut 833 kitchens. The program aims to feed nearly 90 million people through 2029, at roughly $28 billion.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの無償学校給食プログラムに関連した食中毒疑いで約2,000人が発症
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常・予想外」の2基準に該当し、全国的な政府プログラムに関連した大規模食中毒疑い事例であるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 感染症ではなく食品安全（食中毒疑い）事案だが、政府の全国的給食プログラムに関連し複数州で同時多発、死者は報告なしだが患者数が多く社会的関心が高いためピックアップと判断。過去実績（2025年以降36州で50,059人・560件）から継続的な構造的問題である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand Government Urges Early TB Detection and Complete Treatment
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, the Jharkhand government urged vigilance against tuberculosis, stressing early detection, proper testing and completion of treatment to defeat the disease. TB testing and treatment are free at government facilities, and patients undergoing TB treatment receive ₹1,000 per month as Nikshay Poshan Support via bank accounts during the treatment period. Symptoms prompting testing include a cough lasting two weeks or more, fever, night sweats, weight loss, chest pain, fatigue, coughing with sputum, or blood in sputum. Special screening campaigns in high-risk villages and wards use hand-held X-ray machines to identify suspected TB cases, including among people who may not yet have noticeable symptoms. The government invites participation in the Nikshay Mitra initiative by panchayat representatives, NGOs, community members, political party workers, self-help groups and the public to provide nutritional, livelihood and diagnostic support toward making villages, wards, panchayats, blocks and districts TB-free.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州政府、結核の早期発見と完全治療を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患であるTBに関する通常の公衆衛生啓発・支援施策の広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 結核の恒常的な公衆衛生対策・啓発キャンペーンに関する報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: OMS espera distribuir em Outubro três vacinas contra Ébola - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO expects to distribute in October three Ebola vaccines - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is described as out of control by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. In a recently released analysis, experts say all operational controls remain below target and call for expanded contact tracing, greater isolation capacity, and more widespread testing of the population. The World Health Organization emphasizes that hope rests with three experimental Ebola vaccines undergoing clinical trials, with distribution expected to begin in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in October or November 2026. The article notes an ongoing outbreak and the urgent need to bolster surveillance and public health measures to stem transmission, while announcing plans to deploy the vaccines in the DRC later this year. No specific case or death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: WHOは10月にエボラワクチン3種を配布する見込み - O País - 真実をニュースとして
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の伝播がCDCにより「制御不能」と評価されており、対策強化・ワクチン展開が計画されるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は報告されていないが、CDCが伝播を「制御不能」と評価しており、ワクチン展開の緊急性が示されている。続報でのケース数確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ಭೀತಿ: ಕೇವಲ 10 ನಿಮಿಷದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆಗಳ ಸಂತಾನೋತ್ಪತ್ತಿ ತಡೆಯಿರಿ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue scare: Stop mosquito breeding in your home in just 10 minutes.
article.articleSummary: Dengue alert in the NCR (National Capital Region) as new dengue cases are reported on 5 September 2026. The article emphasizes immediate home-based mosquito control to prevent Aedes breeding within hours, detailing a 10-minute inspection of home and balcony areas. Key steps include removing standing water from plant pots, saucers, trays, air-conditioner drains, and sump pits; drying and cleaning containers in sun; inverting saucers or filling with sand; inspecting AC drip trays and fridge trays; emptying and refreshing water in coolers; sealing rooftop tanks; and cleaning terrace drains, with checks every three days during higher dengue activity. Use BTI granules in non-potable water sites (ornamental ponds, basement slabs, rain drains). Apply skin repellents (DEET, Picaridin, PMD) on exposed skin, wear long clothing, and install window screens (magnetic/steel). Fogging is advised at dawn/dusk, alongside larval control and weekly water checks; seek immediate medical care for fever, muscle pain, bleeding, or dehydration.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱への警戒：わずか10分で自宅の蚊の繁殖を防ぐ方法
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な予防啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数・重症度データが乏しいため、通常の季節的流行の可能性が高いが情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主に家庭での蚊媒介対策の啓発コンテンツであり、NCR（デリー首都圏）での新規デング熱症例増加に言及しているが、具体的な症例数や死亡者数は記載されていない。季節性のデング熱流行への注意喚起記事と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: تأخیر و گرانی واکسن آنفلوانزا در آستانه فصل شیوع بیماری
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Delay and price hikes of the influenza vaccine on the eve of flu season.
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, Iran faces delays and price hikes in influenza vaccine supply ahead of the flu season. Akbar Abdollahi Asl, Director General of the FDA, states that vaccine orders and contracts for health departments and pharmacies were placed months earlier, but major manufacturers—Vaxigrip and Influvac—have delayed production and raised prices. Sanctions-related constraints, including financial transfer limits and transport difficulties, have worsened supply, with Abbott and other foreign suppliers affected. Domestic influenza vaccine production has stopped this year after three years of operation due to weak uptake of domestic versus imported vaccines. The country plans to source about one million doses for health departments from China and Russia, available late September to early October. For pharmacies, provisional bids from China, Russia, and some European countries suggest higher prices; with sufficient currency and quality guarantees, these vaccines could enter distribution in October. High-risk groups should be prioritized.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行シーズンを前にワクチンの供給遅延と価格高騰
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザワクチンの供給遅延・価格高騰に関する行政・経済的な話題であり、感染症の異常発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイランにおける季節性インフルエンザワクチンの供給・価格問題であり、疾病発生そのものの報告ではない。中国・ロシアはワクチン調達先として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため対象国リストからは除外。イラン・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれず、中国も発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: How Did Bhutan Stop Dog-Transmitted Rabies? The One Health Strategy Behind a Historic WHO Milestone
article.articleSummary: Bhutan is the first country in the WHO South-East Asia Region to eliminate dog-transmitted human rabies as a public health problem, with no human deaths from dog-transmitted rabies since June 2023. A WHO-supported assessment (Aug 17–22, 2026) confirmed elimination criteria were met, including two years without human deaths, strong surveillance, laboratory diagnosis, animal vaccination, timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), and rapid response capacity. The One Health strategy centered on dog vaccination and population management, PEP access, surveillance, and community involvement, coordinated by human health officials, veterinarians, local authorities, and communities. The national De-suung volunteer service, Guardians of Peace, aided implementation. PEP remains free and universally available across all 20 districts, with wound care, vaccines, and immunoglobulin as needed. Bhutan will maintain vaccination and cross-border coordination with Indian states to sustain gains and support the global Zero by 30 goal.

triage.headline_ja: ブータンはどのようにして犬媒介狂犬病を根絶したのか？WHOの歴史的達成の背景にあるワンヘルス戦略
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブータンにおける犬媒介狂犬病の撲滅成功を伝える肯定的な公衆衛生ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや新規感染拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: ブータンはWHO南東アジア地域で初めて犬媒介狂犬病を公衆衛生上の問題として撲滅したという成功事例の報告。インドは国境を越えた協力の文脈で言及されているのみで、疾患発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当なし。ブータン自体も対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Rybári žasnú, povodne v Nepále priniesli do riek nevídané úlovky. No v kontaminovanej vode číha aj hrozba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fishermen are astonished, floods in Nepal have brought unprecedented catches to the rivers. But in contaminated water a threat also lurks.
article.articleSummary: Floodwaters from Nepal carried debris, mud, and unusual fish into Indian rivers, prompting Bihar to warn against consuming unknown or unusually large floodfish. The Trishuli River's flow into Bihar via Gandak and Koshi brought strange catches to Champaran, Gopalganj, Bagaha, and Saran; some fish weighed up to 27–38 kg, with reports of 40–45 kg, and many died after capture. Some fish may be Bagarius bagarius (goonch catfish), an endangered species in fast rivers of the region. Authorities say contamination—sewage, debris, and carcasses—rather than the fish themselves poses the risk. Bihar's Department of Milk, Fisheries and Animal Resources and Nepal police issued warnings. Groundwater near the border has arsenic levels above safe limits, compounding concerns. Health risks from floodwater include diarrhea, cholera, typhoid, hepatitis A and E; standing water may boost dengue, malaria, chikungunya. Seek help for vomiting, severe diarrhea, or breathing problems; report unusual fish.

triage.headline_ja: 漁師たちが驚愕、ネパールの洪水がかつてない大物を川にもたらした。しかし汚染水には脅威も潜んでいる
triage.triage_reason: 洪水後の汚染水によるコレラ・チフス・A型肝炎等の一般的健康リスク警告であり、具体的な症例発生報告や集団感染の確認はないため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 本記事は洪水による環境汚染と異常な大型魚の出現が主題であり、感染症の実際の発生report ではなく、水系感染症（コレラ、チフス、A型肝炎、デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア）への一般的注意喚起にとどまる。ネパールは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。具体的な症例数や患者発生の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: No new measles cases in MP's Balaghat for 7 days amid intensified response
article.articleSummary: No new measles cases in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh for seven days as of 2026-09-05 amid intensified response to a July cluster of fever with rash and deaths in Birsa block. A National outbreak-response team was deployed on Aug 12, with surveillance expanded from three villages to about 50. 32,433 people have been medically examined; 431 children referred or admitted, 379 treated and discharged, 52 under treatment or observation. During outbreak-response immunisation, 14,637 children aged 1-10 received an additional measles-rubella dose. Public-health interventions include purification of over 600 drinking-water sources, insecticide spraying in 4,338 households, and fogging in affected and adjoining areas. Songudda PHC and a temporary Kundekasa hospital have been strengthened. Dastak 2026 screened ~158,000 children; 7,711 with severe acute malnutrition (518 admitted); 13,406 diarrhoea cases and 274 severe pneumonia managed. Deaths reviewed; multiple clinical factors; cannot attribute to a single pathogen. Continued monitoring, focusing on tribal and PVTG communities.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガットで対応強化から7日間新規麻疹症例なし
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・原因不明の発熱発疹クラスターで複数死亡と重度栄養失調・重症肺炎の合併があり、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）に2つ該当するため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既に対応が進み7日間新規症例なしとする続報。ただし7月の発熱発疹クラスターで複数死亡、重度栄養失調児518人入院、重症肺炎274例など背景の重症度が高く、部族地域(PVTG)での継続監視が求められる。国家対応チームが既に投入され国内で管理されているため、国際支援の必要性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: स्वास्थ्य विभाग की अपील, डेंगू से बचाव के लिए स्कूलों से यूनिफॉर्म के नियमों में बदलाव का अनुरोध
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department's appeal: request to modify school uniform regulations to prevent dengue.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal, India is facing rising dengue cases, especially among children. In response, the state Health Department urged a temporary three-month change to school uniform rules for September–November to curb transmission. Schools are advised to allow full-sleeve clothing and, for girls, to wear salwar (pants) instead of skirts to fully cover the legs; knee-length socks were deemed insufficient. The Health Minister appealed to all primary and secondary school heads to implement these measures to reduce mosquito bites inside school premises and thereby lower dengue infection rates. The initiative aims to raise awareness and protect students through a practical clothing adjustment during the peak dengue months.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局の呼びかけ：デング熱予防のため学校の制服規定の変更を要請
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で小児を中心にデング熱症例が増加しているとの記載があるが、具体的な症例数・重症度データがなく、季節性の風土病対策としての予防的措置に関する記事であるため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドにおいて季節性の風土病であり、本記事は保健当局による予防的な制服規定変更の呼びかけが主題。症例数の増加傾向が言及されているが定量的データはなく、重症化や大規模流行の兆候は明示されていない。今後の症例報告数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Dengue Cases Rise: Over 400 Suspected Cases Recorded in August
article.articleSummary: Pune, India, in the monsoon, reported over 400 suspected dengue cases and 14 chikungunya cases in August as water accumulation fuels mosquito breeding. The Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) intensified anti-larval treatment and fogging in hotspots and conducted containment around homes of residents who tested positive. Year to date, 1,231 suspected dengue cases and 47 confirmed dengue; chikungunya tally at 21. Private hospitals report rising dengue and chikungunya symptoms, but most patients are treated outpatient and recover without admission. Those with diabetes, heart disease, kidney disorders, or cancer may face higher complication risks and require hospitalization if worse. Officials urge eliminating stagnant water and regular checks of rooftops, containers, and other rainwater sites as monsoon rains persist and surveillance is intensified to curb further cases.

triage.headline_ja: プネーでデング熱患者が増加：8月に疑い例400人以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加であり、地域当局が対応中で重症例は限定的だが、モンスーン期の継続的な媒介蚊対策が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: プネー市（マハラシュトラ州）における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の増加。地方自治体（PMC）が防除措置を実施中で、重症化は基礎疾患を有する患者に限られる。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 香港再錄3宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records three more severe pediatric influenza cases | Telecommunications
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong records three more severe pediatric influenza cases on Sept 5, 2026, bringing the summer season’s total since late June to 16 severe pediatric infections, including one death. The Centre for Health Protection reports flu activity remains high, with positive-rate levels well above baseline. Health Secretary Lo Chung-mau says there is no concurrent flu-COVID surge at present, but vaccination is crucial. The flu vaccination program will commence soon, with over 90% of schools participating in the Outreach Vaccination Program. CHP Director notes widespread community transmission has driven up infections and severe outcomes; as schools reopen, influenza is expected to stay active and school outbreaks may occur, so schools and parents should remain vigilant and adopt preventive measures. This characterizes the current Hong Kong summer influenza season.}

triage.headline_ja: 香港再錄3宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案
triage.triage_reason: 香港での小児重症インフルエンザ症例の増加が続いているが、既知の季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区は中国(1814991)に含めて分類。季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例が増加しているが、当局は流行を管理下にあるとしており、国際的な緊急対応の必要性は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Foods Alive Recalls Organic Moringa Leaf Powder for Salmonella -- and Still Nobody Will Name the Supplier
article.articleSummary: Foods Alive Inc. (Angola, Indiana) recalls 8-ounce Organic Moringa Leaf Powder due to potential Salmonella contamination. Product with freshest-by date 110127 and lot number 02726 is implicated; no illnesses reported to date, and customers are urged to return to retailers for a refund or call 260-488-4497. Production and distribution are suspended as FDA investigates a supplier-reported positive Salmonella test in a related super greens powder mix; the contamination source has not been determined, and the supplier is unnamed. This recall follows an August 7, 2026 Lexunder Inc./Food To Live recall of nine green powder lines, with further recalls (e.g., September 4 Foods Alive; August 14 Hampton Grocers Lacnola Lactation Granola) tied to the same supplier network. A broader multistate moringa outbreak linked to Indian-imported moringa leaf powder sickened 131 people in 38 states with 36 hospitalizations (illnesses Aug 2025–Jun 14, 2026). Public health measures urged: name suppliers, publish ingredient customer lists, and provide direct purchaser notices. The recalled pouch may still be in households through November 2027."

triage.headline_ja: Foods Alive社、サルモネラ汚染によりオーガニックモリンガ葉パウダーをリコール ― それでも供給元は依然として公表されず
triage.triage_reason: 米国内での食品リコール事案であり、対象国（GeoNamesリスト）に該当する国での実際の発生は確認されない。原材料の輸入元としてインドが言及されているが、発症自体は米国内で起きているため対象外。
triage.notes: 本イベントは米国インディアナ州の食品リコール事案。原材料（モリンガ葉粉末）の輸入元としてインドが言及されているが、発症例はすべて米国内（38州、131人、36人入院、死亡なし）で発生しており、対象国リストに該当する国での実際の発生は確認できない。Angola（地名）はアフリカのAngola国ではなくインディアナ州の地名であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 兩女童染甲流　一嚴重一危殆　15歲男童染乙流情況嚴重
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two girls infected with influenza A—one in serious condition, the other in critical condition; a 15-year-old boy infected with influenza B in serious condition.
article.articleSummary: Three pediatric influenza cases in Hong Kong on 5 September 2026: a 6-year-old girl infected with influenza A developed encephalopathy and is in critical condition after transfer to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital Pediatric Intensive Care Unit; a 3-year-old girl with influenza A developed septic shock and is in severe condition in the Queen Elizabeth Hospital Pediatric Intensive Care Unit; and a 15-year-old boy with influenza B developed septic shock and is in severe condition in the Princess Margaret Hospital Pediatric Intensive Care Unit. None had travel during incubation, and household contacts were asymptomatic. Since late June, the influenza season has shown high activity, with 16 pediatric severe cases to date: 8 recovered, 2 stable, 3 severe, 2 critical, and 1 death. Health authorities warn of ongoing community transmission and anticipate continued school-year activity.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で女児2名がA型インフルエンザに感染、1名重症・1名危篤　15歳男児はB型インフルエンザで重症
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児重症例（脳症・敗血症性ショック）が複数発生し、累計死亡例も出ている。地域社会での感染継続と学校再開に伴う拡大が懸念され、WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例だが、対象国リストに従いChinaに分類。季節性インフルエンザの流行に伴う重症小児例の増加であり、新規変異株や異常な病原性については記事内で言及なし。続報でウイルス株の特性や重症化率の推移を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄市新增3例境外登革熱！自柬埔寨及越南返台　2女童入境即就醫未入社區
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung City reports 3 new imported dengue fever cases! Two girls who returned to Taiwan from Cambodia and Vietnam sought medical care upon arrival and had not yet entered the community.
article.articleSummary: Three imported dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on Sept 5, 2026. Two girls, 10 and 8, returned from Vietnam to visit relatives; after arrival they developed fever and rash and were taken to hospital. Dengue tests and PCR were positive. They had not returned home, so no community spraying; epidemiological investigations at their residences and protective measures were initiated. The third case is a 59-year-old man who returned from Cambodia on Aug 27; he developed fever and myalgia on Aug 31 and tested positive for dengue, hospitalized; infection confirmed as dengue virus type 1. The Health Bureau activated investigations and emergency controls to prevent community spread. Clinicians are urged to document travel history and use NS1 tests. Travelers to dengue-endemic areas Philippines, Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia should remain vigilant and seek prompt care if fever or rash; drain, cover, clean, and scrub around homes to reduce mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市で輸入デング熱3例が新たに報告！カンボジアおよびベトナムから帰国、2人の女児は入境後すぐ受診し地域内には未侵入
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市における個別の輸入デング熱症例（渡航者3名）であり、地域内感染や流行の兆候はなく、通常の輸入例として管理されているため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは台湾（対象国外）における輸入デング熱の個別症例報告。感染源として言及されるベトナム・カンボジアも、現地での流行拡大を示す情報はなく、一般的な流行地域としての注意喚起にとどまるため、対象国リストにおける verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists Discover New Tick-Borne Virus After Spread of Mystery Illness
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus, newly described in Asia, is linked to severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) caused by Dabie bandavirus (DBV; formerly SFTS virus), a tickborne hemorrhagic fever endemic in Asia with a case fatality of 10–30% and WHO priority status. The NEJM report notes that more than 30% of SFTS patients test negative for DBV, suggesting additional pathogens may cause the illness. The virus was found in patients bitten by ticks across several parts of China. Clinical features include fatigue, gastrointestinal illness, thrombocytopenia, and liver damage. Laboratory work shows ticks can transmit the disease to mice. Experts, including Dr. Sharon Nachman, emphasize ongoing Chinese research since 2009 and warn that antivirals are lacking for many tickborne viruses. Preventive guidance focuses on avoiding tick bites: wearing protective clothing, tucking pants, using repellents, and prompt tick removal.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者たちが原因不明の疾病流行後、新たなマダニ媒介ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新種のマダニ媒介ナイロウイルスが発見され、致死率10〜30%のSFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群、WHO優先病原体）との関連が示唆されており、公衆衛生上の重大性と異常性の両基準を満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はNEJM掲載の科学的知見（新規ウイルス発見）に基づく報道であり、実際の患者数・地理的拡大範囲などの疫学データは記載がない。続報でのアウトブレイク実態確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Centre Steps Up Outbreak Response In MP's Tribal Belt, Deploys National Team In Balaghat
article.articleSummary: Fever and fever-with-rash deaths in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, especially Birsa block among PVTG communities, trigger a national outbreak response. Authorities pursue an evidence-based approach, prioritising measles and malaria. A National Joint Outbreak Response Team (NJORT) was deployed on August 12 to coordinate surveillance, diagnosis and treatment with NCVBDC, the Immunisation Division, and an independent ICMR team; a national review on August 4 assessed epidemiology, mortality and containment. ICMR teams from Jabalpur support field work. MP deployed six Mobile Medical Units in Birsa and Baihar; the network expanded from 3 to about 50 villages, with 10 doctors and 10 CHOs. So far 32,433 people examined; 431 children referred; 379 treated and discharged; 52 under treatment. MR vaccination reached 14,637 children aged 1–10. Water purification (>600 sources), spraying (4,338 households), and fogging are underway. Kundekasa hosts a hospital; six MMUs operate in Birsa and Baihar. Nutrition screening identified 7,711 children with severe acute malnutrition (518 admitted); 13,406 diarrhoea and 274 severe pneumonia managed; suspected bacterial infections receive specialized care.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府、マディヤ・プラデーシュ州の部族地帯での感染症対応を強化、バラガートに国家チームを派遣
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・マラリアの疑いによる発熱・発疹による死亡例が発生し、脆弱な先住民（PVTG）コミュニティで国家対応チームが派遣される規模の公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: 死亡例、重症急性栄養失調児多数、国家合同アウトブレイク対応チーム（NJORT）の派遣など、深刻かつ組織的な対応が行われている。ただし現時点で国際拡大の兆候や渡航・貿易制限の情報はなく、対応は国内（インド）で完結している模様。

article.articleHeadline: 26歲男子生殖器官現丘疹確診猴痘　潛伏期於海外有高風險接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 26-year-old man with genital-area papules diagnosed with monkeypox; incubation period linked to high-risk exposure overseas.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox diagnosed in a 26-year-old man in Hong Kong after genital-area papules appeared; incubation linked to high-risk exposure overseas. He reported two high-risk contacts with a man abroad during the incubation period. Lesions began Aug 29 and spread to the face, limbs, and trunk. On Sep 3, he contacted the Centre for Health Protection hotline and was admitted to Tuen Mun Hospital for isolation. Laboratory testing by the Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox; patient remains stable. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 100 monkeypox cases (79 local, 21 imported), all male. Epidemiology indicates the majority engaged in high-risk sexual activity, including sex with strangers or unprotected sex. The Centre will report the case to the World Health Organization.

triage.headline_ja: 26歳男性、生殖器周辺に丘疹が現れ猴痘（サル痘）と診断される　潜伏期に海外で高リスク接触あり
triage.triage_reason: 香港における単発の輸入例であり、既知の疫学パターン（性的接触を介した感染）に合致するため異常性は低いが、継続的なサーベイランス対象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例だが、対象国リストのルールに基づきChina(1814991)に分類。2022年以降の累計100例（うち21例輸入）であり、香港では既知の継続的な流行状況にある単発症例。WHOへの報告予定あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Ceará tem mais de 13 mil casos confirmados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Ceará has more than 13,000 confirmed cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Ceará, Brazil, 2026: 13,226 confirmed cases, 22 deaths, 35 severe; Sobral leads with 2,525 confirmed. As of Sep 4, 2026, IntegraSUS records 43,362 notifications: 18,141 probable, 25,221 discarded. Regional spread concentrated in the Northern Region and the Litoral Leste do Vale do Jaguaribe. Serotype 2 remains the main driver; co-circulation of serotypes 1 and 3 could raise susceptibility and risk of severe disease. State-wide deaths numbered 22 this year, surpassing all of 2025 (3). Deaths recorded in multiple municipalities, including Sobral (3) and Fortaleza (2). There is no specific dengue treatment; management focuses on rest, fluids, and avoiding self-medication. Seek healthcare if bleeding or warning signs appear. Prevention centers on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Common symptoms: high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, nausea, fatigue, joint pain, and red rash.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：セアラ州で2026年の確定症例が13,000件を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州における季節性デング熱の流行で、死亡者数が前年比で大幅増加（22例 vs 前年3例）しているが、デング熱自体は同地域で毎年発生する風土病であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジル・セアラ州において毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は州保健当局の定例統計報告に基づくもの。死亡者数増加（前年3例→今年22例）とセロタイプ2主体にセロタイプ1・3の共循環による重症化リスク上昇が言及されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 流感肆虐 三日兩女童一少年命危｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza Ravages: Within Three Days, Two Young Girls and One Boy in Critical Condition
article.articleSummary: Three pediatric severe influenza cases were reported in Hong Kong as of September 5, 2026, involving a 6-year-old girl and a 3-year-old girl with influenza A and encephalitis/septic shock, and a 15-year-old boy with influenza B and septic shock. The 6-year-old is in critical condition in Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital Pediatric Intensive Care Unit; the 3-year-old in Queen Elizabeth Hospital PICU; the 15-year-old in Queen Mary Hospital PICU. All had no recent travel; household contacts were asymptomatic; a classmate of the 6-year-old had mild flu symptoms. Since late June 2026, Hong Kong’s flu season has been highly active, with 16 pediatric severe influenza cases to date: 8 recovered, 2 stable, 3 severe, 2 critical, 1 death. The 2026/27 seasonal vaccine program begins September 17; about 80 schools will host outreach activities in September with a new eHealth electronic consent form and QR codes. Parents urged to vaccinate and seek urgent care for warning signs; masks and good hygiene advised for high-risk households.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ猛威：3日間で少女2人と少年1人が重体
triage.triage_reason: 香港での季節性インフルエンザに伴う小児重症例（16例中1死亡）が報告されているが、季節性流行の枠内であり新規性・国際拡大リスクは低い。重症度は懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港（中国特別行政区）の事例のため China (1814991) に分類。季節性インフルエンザの通常の重症サーベイランス報告であり、パンデミック株や新規病原体の兆候はない。ワクチン接種プログラムの案内も含まれ、公衆衛生対応は平常運転の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: San Lazaro Hospital medical workers battle burnout amid leptospirosis surge
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis surge at San Lazaro Hospital (SLH) in Manila as flood-related cases overwhelm facilities; SLH handles nearly one-third of Metro Manila’s leptospirosis cases, with 120 beds allocated but 180 admissions already. Rooms usually accommodate five patients, but now use extra cots to fit eight per room. Dr. David Suplico said another surge is expected within two weeks after floods. Burnout among staff cited as floods occur successively. To cope, SLH implemented a compressed workweek; nurses may work up to 12 hours per day to meet a 40-hour week. Some workers are on calamity leave due to flooding; staff from Dr. Jose Fabella Memorial Hospital and the Philippine Red Cross plus the DOH are augmenting manpower. Incubation up to two weeks; cases tied to Metro Manila floods on Aug 17, with another surge anticipated from floods on Aug 29–30. Leptospirosis mortality can reach 50%. Nationwide DOH: 5,486 cases Jan–Aug 27, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: サン・ラザロ病院の医療従事者、レプトスピラ症急増の中で燃え尽き症候群と闘う
triage.triage_reason: マニラの洪水後にレプトスピラ症患者が急増し病院の収容能力を超過、医療従事者の疲弊が深刻化している。全国的にも症例数が多く、さらなる急増が予測されているため経過確認が必要。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は洪水後に季節的に発生する感染症でヒト-ヒト感染はないが、病院の収容能力超過と医療従事者の燃え尽き症候群、致死率最大50%という重症度、洪水継続による曝露の長期化が懸念材料。国内的にはDOHと赤十字による人員増強で対応中であり、現時点で国際支援の必要性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Băng tan có thể đánh thức những 'mầm bệnh' ngủ quên hàng nghìn năm?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Could melting ice awaken pathogens that have slept for thousands of years?
article.articleSummary: August 29 avalanche in the Himalaya near the Nepal–Tibet border underscores climate-driven hazards from rapid glacier melt. As ice and frozen ground thaw, long-trapped microbes can be released into modern ecosystems. In Siberia, ancient viruses recovered from permafrost—sometimes dubbed 'zombie' viruses—illustrate potential release of preserved pathogens as temperatures rise, though their capacity to cause human disease remains unproven. A historic example is the 2016 Yamal Peninsula outbreak in Siberia, where an unusually hot summer thawed soil containing Bacillus anthracis spores, triggering thousands of reindeer deaths and dozens of human infections, including a child; the outbreak highlighted anthrax as a risk linked to permafrost preservation. Scientists warn of antibiotic-resistance genes moving into modern bacteria, but no evidence of a forthcoming pandemic; any threat would require a suitable host and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 氷河の融解は数千年眠っていた病原体を目覚めさせる可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は気候変動と永久凍土融解による病原体再興リスクを一般論として解説する科学記事であり、現在進行中の具体的な感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。2016年ヤマル半島炭疽菌アウトブレイクは過去の事例として引用されているのみ。
triage.notes: 記事は科学解説・啓発的内容であり、現在発生中の感染症イベントではない。言及されているロシア（2016年）、ネパール、中国（チベット、ヒマラヤ雪崩）はいずれも過去の事例または地理的背景説明であり、対象国リストにおける現在進行中のイベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Khánh Hòa khẩn trương khống chế ổ dịch tả lợn châu Phi tại thôn Làng Nộc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Khánh Hòa Urgently Contains the African Swine Fever Outbreak in Làng Nộc Hamlet
article.articleSummary: An African swine fever outbreak in Làng Nộc Hamlet, Khánh Hòa Commune, Vietnam, was detected from Aug 29 to Sep 5 with 14 affected households and 74 pigs dead or culled. Laboratory confirmation identified African swine fever virus as the cause. Symptoms included anorexia, high fever, lethargy, abdominal and inguinal hemorrhages, and digestive disturbances. Local authorities implemented rapid containment: restricting movement of pigs and people, prohibiting sale, transport, slaughter, and disposal of sick animals; maintaining housing, and enhancing hygiene, disinfection, lime dusting, and spraying; and barring entry to farms. On Sep 5, remaining pigs in affected households were culled. The commune’s People’s Committee, with the Department of Agriculture and Environment and the Commune Service Center, will continue surveillance, technical guidance, and enforcement to prevent further spread and protect livelihoods and pig production.

triage.headline_ja: カインホア省、ランノック村でのアフリカ豚熱の発生を緊急封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（アフリカ豚熱）であり人への直接的健康影響はないが、養豚業への経済的影響と拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物疾病（豚のみ）であり人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染報告はない。地元当局により迅速な封じ込め措置が取られている。

article.articleHeadline: 衛生防護中心錄3宗兒童感染流感嚴重個案　徐樂堅籲家長早日安排子女接種流感疫苗 (19:08) - 20260905
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection records three cases of severe influenza in children; Dr Xu Lok-kin urges parents to arrange flu vaccination for their children as soon as possible (19:08) - 20260905.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-05, three pediatric influenza cases were reported in Hong Kong. A 6-year-old girl developed fever, runny nose and cough on Sept 3, sought care at Ruttonjee Hospital, then was transferred to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital’s PICU with seizures. Laboratory tests confirmed Influenza A with encephalopathy; she remains in critical condition. Two classmates in her class have mild flu symptoms. The second patient is a 3-year-old girl who began fever on Sept 2, was treated at a private hospital, then admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital’s Emergency Department and PICU with Influenza A and septic shock; currently serious. The third case is a 15-year-old boy with fever starting Sept 3, first seen at a private clinic, then transferred to Queen Mary Hospital’s PICU with hypotension; diagnosed with Influenza B and septic shock; currently serious. Dr Xu Lok-kin urges parents to arrange flu vaccination for their children as soon as possible.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心、児童のインフルエンザ重症例3件を記録　徐樂堅医師、保護者に子どものインフルエンザワクチン接種を早めに手配するよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児の重症インフルエンザ（脳症・敗血症性ショックを伴う）が3例報告され、メディア・保健当局の注目度が高いため、WPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ）と社会的関心の両方に該当する。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区は対象国リストのChina(1814991)に含めて集計。季節性インフルエンザだが、小児3例が脳症・敗血症性ショックを伴う重症化であり、地域内の注目度が高いためPICKUPと判定。ただし国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Zoomlion begins post-flood disinfection exercise in West Gonja to curb health risks
article.articleSummary: Zoomlion Ghana Limited, in collaboration with the West Gonja Municipal Assembly in the Savannah Region, has begun a post-flood disinfection and disinfestation exercise in West Gonja following the June 2026 floods. The operation targets markets, lorry parks, institutions, container sites and other high-activity public spaces to reduce environmental and public health risks from stagnant water and contaminated surroundings. Officials say the work aims to curb disease vectors and the risk of water- and sanitation-related diseases, including cholera. The intervention is part of a nationwide disinfection/disinfestation programme implemented with Metropolitan, Municipal and District Assemblies (MMDAs). Municipal Chief Executive Yakubu Yussif Castro commended the partnership and urged residents to dispose of solid waste properly and maintain sanitation practices, noting that collective action beyond the Assembly is essential for a safe environment.

triage.headline_ja: ズームライオン、洪水後の健康リスク軽減へウェスト・ゴンジャで消毒作業開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は洪水後の予防的消毒・害虫駆除活動の報告であり、実際のコレラ症例発生や流行を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事は洪水後の予防衛生活動（消毒・害虫駆除）に関するもので、コレラの実際の症例報告ではない。地方自治体（MMDA）とZoomlion社による予防的公衆衛生対策の一環。続報でコレラ症例が報告されれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: मुंबईत मलेरियाच्या रुग्णांमध्ये वाढ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in malaria cases in Mumbai
article.articleSummary: Mumbai, India, reports a rising malaria burden despite consistently low positivity on blood smears over the past decade. Annual parasite prevalence (APP) rose from 0.3 per 1,000 population in 2022 to 0.5 (2023), 0.6 (2024), and 0.8 (2025), indicating increasing transmission. The proportion of malaria-positive blood slides has remained very low, suggesting limited gains in disease control through screening. The municipal administration faces a central target to conduct malaria-related blood testing at 12% of the population; achieving adequate testing relative to population is deemed essential. The article emphasizes surveillance metrics—positive slide rate, APP, and annual blood examination rate—without detailing specific case counts or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでマラリア患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの年間寄生虫陽性率が緩やかに上昇しているが、重症例数や具体的な患者数の記載がなく、地域流行病であり国際的拡大の懸念は低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、APP（年間寄生虫指数）が2022年の0.3から2025年に0.8へ緩やかに増加しているが、依然として低水準。監視体制強化の必要性が指摘されているのみで、緊急性の高い公衆衛生イベントとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 3名兒童感染流感後出現併發症　兩人嚴重一人危殆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three children develop complications after contracting influenza; two are in serious condition and one is in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-05, three children contracted influenza and developed complications, with two in serious condition and one in critical condition. The Centre for Health Protection reported that the cases involve a 15-year-old boy and two girls aged 6 and 3. The two girls tested positive for Influenza A and developed encephalopathy and septic shock, with the 6-year-old in critical condition. The 15-year-old boy contracted Influenza B and developed septic shock. None had recent travel during the incubation period, and household contacts were asymptomatic. All had fever, runny nose, and cough preceding confirmation. The Centre warned that flu activity is expected to remain elevated at the start of the school term and that schools and parents should heighten vigilance for potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 3名の児童がインフルエンザ感染後に合併症を発症、2名が重症、1名が危篤
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザに伴う小児重症例（脳症・敗血症性ショック）が報告されているが、香港CHPは学期始まりに伴う季節性の流行拡大注意喚起の範囲内であり、異常性や国際的拡大の明確な根拠は乏しいため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例のため、対象国リストのChina(1814991)に統合して計上。季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例で、渡航歴なし・家庭内接触者は無症状。学校クラスターの可能性は今後の情報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Nový vírus z kliešťa nakazil stovky ľudí. V kombinácii so známou infekciou končí každý piaty prípad smrťou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new tick-borne virus has infected hundreds of people. In combination with a known infection, one in five cases ends in death.
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), a newly identified tick-borne orthonairovirus in China, infected humans initially presenting with flu-like symptoms but capable of fatigue, gastrointestinal symptoms, fever, and in some cases respiratory distress. In a study of 3,163 patients, ALTNV was detected in 10.4% via viral RNA or IgM antibodies; among those negative for Dabie bandavirus (DBV), ALTNV positivity was 15.1%. ALTNV is genetically distinct from DBV. Infections with ALTNV alone largely resolved, but co-infection with DBV produced more severe disease: 61% had respiratory symptoms; 84% developed kidney function impairment versus 66% with DBV alone; 7 of 38 co-infected patients died (18.4%). ALTNV RNA detected in 1.3% of 47,428 ticks across 15 Chinese provinces, most frequently in Haemaphysalis longicornis (1.8%). Lab experiments showed the tick species can transmit ALTNV to mice. There is no specific antiviral; management is supportive. Preventive tick avoidance remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 新種のダニ媒介ウイルスが数百人に感染。既知の感染症との合併症では5人に1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規に同定されたダニ媒介ウイルス（ALTNV）がヒトに感染し、既知のDabie bandavirusとの共感染で18.4%という高い死亡率を示しており、新規病原体としての異常性と重症度の観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本報告は学術研究（3,163名の患者調査、47,428匹のダニ調査）に基づくもので、公式な発生・アウトブレイク宣言ではない。ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠はなく、主にダニ媒介と考えられる。中国15省でダニからウイルスが検出されており、地理的分布は広範。今後の症例報告・公式発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Desmatamento aumenta risco de leishmaniose na Amazônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deforestation increases the risk of leishmaniasis in the Amazon.
article.articleSummary: Deforestation in Acre, Brazilian Amazon, increases transmission risk for leishmaniasis and Chagas disease. Field work shows longer-ago deforested areas host higher sandfly abundance, while landscapes with reduced forest cover elevate the chance that triatomines near homes are infected with Trypanosoma cruzi. Led by Gabriel Laporta (FMABC), the studies—published in Parasites & Vectors and PLOS One—analyzed 20 sites in a rural settlement in Cruzeiro do Sul during 2022 and 2024. Leishmaniasis cutaneous incidence there averages 3 cases per 10,000 annually, mainly affecting rural young men; Chagas vectors show higher infection near residences. These results, along with a 2025 study finding higher malaria risk in partially degraded areas (≈50% canopy), illustrate how land-use change drives endemic diseases. The work advocates embedding environmental indicators in surveillance and, in a new phase, restoration of degraded areas with native trees, digital modeling, and community-led interventions. Funded by FAPESP and Amazonia+10.

article.articleHeadline: Bengal govt aims to eliminate dengue, not hide case numbers: Minister Agnimitra Paul
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, dengue is being reported from three wards in Asansol Dakshin, West Burdwan district, West Bengal, with about 40–48 people infected and under treatment. West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul says the government aims to eradicate dengue and will report cases transparently after blood tests, rejecting claims of undercounting. To curb spread, authorities will distribute mosquito nets to low-income residents in affected wards, organize health camps, and emphasize cleanliness. If fever lasts more than two days, individuals should get dengue testing at government hospitals, with free testing and adequate test kits stocked. The administration stresses awareness as essential to eradicating dengue and preventing outbreaks, noting the Chief Minister directed accurate reporting following blood tests.

article.articleHeadline: 多名儿童在大家乐就餐后疑似食物中毒！涉事门店被约谈了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several children suspected of food poisoning after dining at Dajia Le! The store involved has been summoned for an interview.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella infection suspected after dining at Dajia Le restaurant, Tianhe City store in Guangzhou’s Panyu District. From Aug 28–29, multiple children developed vomiting, diarrhea and fever after meals; several cases were severe enough to require hospitalization, with stool samples reportedly testing positive for Salmonella. As of 12:00 on Sep 5, four children remain hospitalized (three at Guangdong Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital, one at Panyu Central Hospital), with 14 illnesses reported and 12 hospitalized since Aug 29. Guangzhou/Panyu authorities—Panyu District Market Supervision Administration and the Panyu District CDC—visited hospitals and the restaurant on Sep 2, ordered comprehensive disinfection and processing adjustments, and the restaurant halted operations for rectification while cooperating with investigations. Preliminary suspicion attributes contamination to eggs; lab results are expected within nine working days. Dajia Le has had prior Salmonella-related incidents in Hong Kong in 2025 and 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 多数の児童が大家楽で食事後に食中毒疑い！関係店舗が事情聴取を受ける

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Don't send girls to school in skirts'... Which disease was the West Bengal Health Minister trying to prevent by saying this?
article.articleSummary: West Bengal Health Minister Dr. Sharadvat Mukherjee urged state schools to prohibit skirts for girls during dengue season, advising salwar-suits or outfits that fully cover arms and legs for the next three months to reduce skin exposure to day-biting Aedes mosquitoes. He claimed this inexpensive measure could help halt dengue transmission, noting knee-length socks are ineffective. Fortis Hospital expert Dr. Ambesh Singh supported the approach as a practical preventive option. Alongside clothing changes, authorities emphasized dengue prevention through environmental controls: eliminate standing water in containers, keep water storage covered, and use mosquito nets and repellents when sleeping or outdoors. The guidance highlights a targeted clothing strategy, paired with standard vector-control practices, to curb dengue in West Bengal during the current season.

The mission also engaged Mangala communities on their role in surveillance, prevention, and control of the disease. Support focuses on case management, surveillance, infection prevention and control, and community engagement. Through this mission, WHO aims to bolster operational response and interrupt transmission chains of Ebola in the area.

Officials are urged to anticipate challenges that could jeopardize youth engagement and local acceptance, and to mobilize sufficient resources for responders, including health workers. The Health Ministry should guarantee proper support for all personnel involved to sustain the response. Published 2026-09-05, this reflects ongoing community-driven efforts in the Ebola response.

article.articleHeadline: ऊधमपुर में डेंगू के खिलाफ स्वास्थ्य विभाग का अभियान तेज, फॉगिंग के साथ लोगों को किया जा रहा जागरूक - udhampur dengue prevention health dept council boost efforts campaign fogging awareness cases update
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Udhampur, the health department's dengue fever prevention campaign has intensified, with fogging and public awareness — cases update.
article.articleSummary: As of September 5, 2026, dengue prevention in Udhampur district, Jammu and Kashmir, India, has intensified with joint health department and municipal council efforts. 16 dengue cases have been reported in 2026 so far. Fogging operations have been conducted across the city and rural areas for about a week, with accelerated testing at GMCH to ensure timely diagnosis and treatment of suspected cases. Dengue outbreaks have fluctuated since 2022: 2023 saw a record 729 cases (two deaths), 2022 had 559, 2024 had 328, and 2025 had 436. September is anticipated to pose a higher risk due to climate. Campaigns emphasize eliminating mosquito breeding sites, removing standing water, covering water storage, and using full-sleeve clothing and nets. Key symptoms include sudden high fever, headache behind the eyes, muscle/joint pain, weakness, nausea/vomiting, and rash; severe cases require immediate medical care. District Malaria Officer Mohammad Latif urged vigilance.

article.articleHeadline: Global trends in pediatric Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia research
article.articleSummary: Global pediatric Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia (MPP) is a leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia in children aged 5–17, with 3–5 year waves. COVID-19 NPIs cut transmission (8.61% pre-pandemic to 0.7–1.69% during), sparking a rebound from 2023 with pediatric prevalence at 28.6%. US hospital data show MPP admissions rising from 2.1% pre-pandemic to 12.5% in 2024, peaking 53.8% in July. Diagnostic tests remain imperfect: culture is slow/low-yield; serology limited; PCR remains the gold standard but cannot distinguish acute infection from carriage; combination testing is recommended; ELISpot is promising. MRMP reached 76.5% globally by 2019, >80% in parts of East Asia; resistance links to longer fever and hospitalization, driving use of second-line agents. RMPP prevalence ~37.8%, higher in East Asia, rising post-COVID to 86.5%; risk factors include elevated inflammatory markers and older age; resistance is not the driver. Bibliometrics show 2,357 publications (1992–2025) with a post-2021 surge; China and the US lead; Soochow University among top contributors.

article.articleHeadline: West Bengal Schools May Revise Dress Code to Curb Dengue; Health Minister Says Socks Aren't Enough
article.articleSummary: Kolkata, West Bengal, on 2026-09-05: to curb dengue transmission during the monsoon and post-monsoon peak, the state government plans temporary changes to school uniforms. Health Minister Dr. Sharadwat Mukherjee, at a Swasthya Bhavan review, announced proposed guidelines for government schools: boys would wear full-sleeved shirts and full-length trousers; girls, who normally wear skirts, should be allowed to wear salwar-kameez or other outfits that fully cover the legs during September–November 2026. A circular is expected; private schools may be urged to follow, though implementation rests with authorities. Knee-length socks were deemed insufficient protection, as mosquitoes can bite through fabric close to the skin. The strategy combines awareness, mosquito-control measures, and personal protection to reduce dengue risk among students during the three dengue-prone months.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、デング熱抑制のため学校制服の変更を検討 ― 保健大臣「靴下だけでは不十分」

article.articleHeadline: 一名26歲男子感染猴痘　目前情況穩定
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 26-year-old man infected with monkeypox; currently in stable condition.
article.articleSummary: A 26-year-old man in Hong Kong is diagnosed with monkeypox and remains in stable condition. He had two high-risk contacts with a man outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. Genital lesions began around August 29 and spread to the face, limbs, and trunk. After contacting the public health hotline on Thursday, he was admitted to Tuen Mun Hospital for isolation and treatment. Laboratory tests confirmed monkeypox virus positivity. The Centre for Health Protection will report the case to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 100 monkeypox cases, all in male patients. This case highlights ongoing vigilance for imported infections and the use of isolation and laboratory-confirmed diagnosis in public health response.

triage.headline_ja: 26歳男性が猴痘（サル痘）に感染　現在容体は安定
triage.triage_reason: 香港では2022年以降100例のサル痘症例が確認されており、本件は輸入例1例で隔離・治療済み、容体も安定しているため異常性・重大性は低い。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の症例のため、対象国リストのChina(1814991)に含めた。単発の輸入例であり、既に隔離・治療対応済み、WHOへの報告もIHR routine reportingの一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca mắc tay chân miệng tăng 2,5 lần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease cases rise by 2.5 times.
article.articleSummary: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases in Vietnam rose sharply in the first eight months of 2026, totaling nearly 100,000—more than 2.5 times the same period last year. The Ministry of Health notes the outbreak is concentrated in children under five, especially those in nurseries and kindergartens, who account for about 87.3% of cases. Several localities reporting higher numbers include Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. Health authorities urge the education sector and local governments to strengthen prevention in schools, emphasizing the 3-clean principle: clean eating, clean living, and clean hands; maintaining clean environments and well-ventilated classrooms; and rapid detection and reporting of suspected cases. HFMD is year-round, with peaks around September–October, aligning with school resumption; dengue and COVID-19 could complicate the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の症例数が2.5倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで手足口病の症例数が前年同期比2.5倍（約10万例）に急増しており、学校再開時期と重なり流行が拡大する可能性がある。公衆衛生当局が注意喚起を行っており、WPRO基準（異常性・持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）と社会的関心の両方が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム保健省の発表に基づき、5歳未満の乳幼児（特に保育園・幼稚園児）が87.3%を占めると報告。デング熱・COVID-19との同時流行リスクにも言及されているが、重症度・死亡例に関する具体的データは記載なし。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccination of healthcare workers at the medical college to prevent swine flu.
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, Government Medical College, Badaun, Uttar Pradesh, launched a targeted vaccination drive against swine flu (influenza A H1N1) and other respiratory infections for frontline staff. The campaign covered clinicians and healthcare workers in the Emergency Department, TB and Chest Medicine, Pediatrics, and Microbiology, who have daily direct patient contact. Vaccination aims to shield staff and ensure uninterrupted patient care. Principal Dr. Shiv Kumar stated that protecting healthcare workers is a priority, noting their routine exposure during patient treatment and the importance of timely vaccination and protective measures. Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Rituj Agrawal added that emergency and TB/Chest department personnel face direct contact, so vaccines were administered, with ongoing safety protocols to be maintained. Department physicians urged vaccination, mask use, hand hygiene, caution with infected individuals, and seeking medical advice for flu-like symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: BPOM Siap Siaga Hadapi Ancaman Pandemi Masa Depan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BPOM Ready and On Alert to Face Future Pandemic Threats.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia’s BPOM chief Taruna Ikrar states that the country must not start from zero when facing future epidemics or pandemics, highlighting pre-crisis preparedness as essential. The plan covers surveillance, rapid pathogen identification, vaccine research and development, clinical trials, manufacturing, and regulatory evaluation and authorization. The statements were made during the Table Top Exercise (TTX) '100 Days Mission in Indonesia Project' in Jakarta. The event was attended by Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin, Deputy WHO Representative Tara Kessaram, CEPI CEO Richard Hatchett, and other health stakeholders. Taruna notes that lessons from the COVID-19 experience demonstrate that in a pandemic, every day counts, underscoring the need for ongoing readiness rather than reactive response.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shimla: Three scrub typhus patients found, no case of swine flu.
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, Himachal Pradesh reports three new scrub typhus cases in Shimla district, with two patients from Mandi and one from Shimla. There are no active swine flu (influenza) cases in the state; health officials confirm zero swine flu cases and ongoing surveillance for suspected patients. Scrub typhus risk increases during the monsoon; transmission occurs via bites from infected mites. Early diagnosis and treatment enable recovery. People are advised to exercise caution in fields, shrubs, and grassy areas during rain; if fever, headache, body pains, or other symptoms arise, seek medical testing and avoid self-medication. Authorities maintain vigilance for swine flu, monitoring hospitals for suspected cases, though no active infections are currently reported.
