article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱一次增3例！柬埔寨返台男　2女童越南返台立即就醫防堵社區 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three new dengue fever cases in Kaohsiung at once! A man returning to Taiwan from Cambodia; two girls returning from Vietnam seek immediate medical care to prevent spread in the community - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: Three imported dengue cases were reported in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on September 5, 2026. A 59-year-old man living in Sanmin District returned from Cambodia on August 27 and developed fever and muscle pain on August 31. Dengue NS1 rapid test was positive on September 3, and dengue virus type 1 was confirmed by PCR; he was hospitalized with isolation. The other two cases are girls aged 8 and 10 who had recently visited Vietnam to see relatives. After returning to Taiwan, they traveled through Kaohsiung Airport and were taken to hospital, where both NS1 rapid tests and PCR were positive for dengue. The Health Bureau assessed no community exposure risk for the two children and did not launch citywide fogging. Authorities urge travelers to use mosquito protection, monitor health after return, and ensure clinicians perform TOCC queries and early NS1 testing to prevent community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄登革熱一次増3例！柬埔寨返台男 2女児越南返台立即就医防止社区感染 - OwlNews
triage.triage_reason: 台湾・高雄で輸入性デング熱3症例が確認されたが、当局はコミュニティ内感染リスクなしと評価しており、現時点で大規模な公衆衛生上の影響は認められない。ただし輸入症例の継続的発生は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは台湾（対象国リスト外）が主発生地であり、ベトナム・カンボジアは輸入元として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではない。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題は台湾国内での輸入症例対応であるため、参考情報として記載するが評価の中心ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Таящийся в клещах вирус нашли у каждого десятого пациента
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A virus lurking in ticks found in one in ten patients
article.articleSummary: China researchers report a newly identified nairovirus carried by Asian longhorned ticks, transmitted to humans after tick bites. In 3163 patients presenting with fever and infection signs, 10.4% tested positive for the virus. Infected individuals exhibited fatigue, fever, gastrointestinal disturbances, thrombocytopenia, and liver inflammation, symptoms that can resemble other tick-borne illnesses. Genetic analysis places the virus within orthonairoviruses but it is distinct from known members, suggesting standard diagnostic tests may miss it. Coinfection with another regional tick-borne pathogen correlated with greater respiratory and kidney injury, and mortality among coinfected patients reached 18.4%. There is no specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive. Authors propose the discovery will enable dedicated diagnostics and more accurate assessment of spread. Findings published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Location: China.

triage.headline_ja: マダニに潜むウイルス、患者の10人に1人から検出
triage.triage_reason: 中国でCCHF関連の新規ナイロウイルスが同定され、発熱患者の10.4%が陽性、他病原体との重複感染例では致死率18.4%に達するなど公衆衛生上の懸念があり、既知ウイルスと異なるため標準検査で見逃される可能性がある異常な事象であるためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: NEJM掲載の学術報告であり、アウトブレイク発生報告ではなく新規病原体の発見・特性記述が主題。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無や地理的拡大状況は記事中に記載がなく不明。今後の症例報告・拡散状況の続報を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: 美國麻疹疫情創35年新高　兒科減重藥處方暴增300倍 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The U.S. measles outbreak reaches a 35-year high; pediatric weight-loss drug prescriptions surge 300-fold.
article.articleSummary: US measles cases reach 3,134 this year, the highest annual total in over 35 years, per CDC; a Pennsylvania infant death tied to measles underscores the outbreak’s severity. Separately, prescriptions for GLP-1 weight-loss drugs in U.S. children under 12 have surged more than 300-fold since 2019, with 8–11-year-olds rising from 0.03% in 2019 to 9.3% in June. International health news include Indonesia’s free school-lunch program linked to food poisoning affecting more than 2,000 students and staff across three islands; France reports 81 Salmonella infections linked to contaminated pumpkin seeds; U.S. Cyclospora infections in Michigan exceed 14,700. In drug regulation, the FDA approves the first injectable treatment for Alexander disease at $285,000 per dose, while the EMA safety committee reviews injectable iron therapy for hypophosphatemia and osteomalacia risks.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の麻疹流行が35年ぶりの高水準に、小児向け減量薬の処方が300倍に急増
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼は米国の麻疹流行（対象国外）だが、インドネシアで2000人超が関与する学校給食による集団食中毒事案が言及されており、詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の国際ヘルスニュースをまとめたもので、主要トピックの米国麻疹流行は対象国外。インドネシアの学校給食による食中毒（2000人超影響）は原因病原体や重症度が不明であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: West Pokot boosts Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: West Pokot County, Kenya, boosted Ebola preparedness after a five-day training (Aug 31–Sep 4, 2026) for 30 frontline workers from Kacheliba and Pokot North sub-counties near the Uganda border. Organized by the Core Group Partners Project (CGPP) through IRC with the county health department, the training covered infection prevention and control, risk communication and community engagement, case management and disease surveillance to enable rapid identification, isolation, management and reporting of suspected EVD cases. West Pokot has not reported Ebola, but is high risk due to border proximity. The ongoing DRC outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has 5,794 confirmed cases and 2,786 deaths across 60 health zones in six provinces as of Aug 26; Uganda-linked cases last confirmed June 21, 2026. Suspected cases in northern Kacheliba are tested at KEMRI; none positive so far. The training aims to bolster border surveillance and risk communication to prevent panic.

triage.headline_ja: ウェストポコト郡、エボラ対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: 背景にあるDRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）アウトブレイクは5,794例・死亡2,786例と大規模かつ継続中で、ウガンダ国境付近での越境リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当のためフルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事自体はケニア・ウェストポコト郡での予防的訓練に関する報道だが、背景にあるDRCの大規模エボラアウトブレイク（進行中、6州60保健区、5,794例確定・2,786死亡）が実質的な発生国であるため、DRCをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 6 436 cas confirmés et 3 095 décès recensés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 6,436 confirmed cases and 3,095 deaths recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC): as of September 3, 2026, authorities report 6,436 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3,095 deaths, with 1,495 recoveries. The response continues across six provinces and 60 health zones, with Ituri remaining the epidemic’s main hotspot. Sud-Kivu has reached 95 days without a new confirmed case. Currently, 738 patients are in isolation or hospitalised. The case fatality rate stands at 48.1%, and contact tracing remains high at 88.5%. Health teams maintain surveillance, investigate alerts, treat patients, and carry out prevention and community awareness activities. The authorities urge the public to report any suspected symptoms using the free number 151. This outbreak is now the deadliest Ebola event in the DRC, surpassing the 2018-2020 epidemic (2,287 deaths, 3,470 cases per WHO).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：確認症例6,436件、死者3,095人を記録
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%と極めて高く、DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行となっており、6州60保健地域に拡大していることから、IHR基準の複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 既知の継続中エボラ流行の進捗報告記事。既にDRC史上最悪の流行と位置づけられており、継続的なモニタリングとフルRRAでの状況把握が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल सरकार का मकसद डेंगू को खत्म करना है, मामलों की संख्या छिपाना नहीं : अग्निमित्रा पॉल - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The West Bengal government's aim is to eradicate dengue, not to hide the number of dengue cases: Agnimitra Paul - Punjab Kesari
article.articleSummary: West Bengal minister Agnimitra Paul says the government's aim is to eradicate dengue and ensure transparency in reporting, not to hide cases. Speaking at a dengue awareness rally in Asansol South (Paschim Bardhaman district) organized by the Asansol Municipal Corporation, she said the Chief Minister directed officials to report dengue cases accurately after blood tests. The objective is to end dengue with clear reporting in records. In Asansol South, dengue cases have been reported from three wards, with about 40-48 people infected and under treatment. To curb transmission, mosquito nets will be distributed to low-income residents in affected areas, health camps will be held, and cleanliness emphasized. People with fever lasting more than two days should get tested at government hospitals, where dengue testing kits are provided free of charge.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州政府の目的はデング熱の撲滅であり、感染者数を隠すことではない：アグニミトラ・ポール州大臣
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州の一地区における季節性デング熱の通常の発生・対応に関する政治的発言であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 感染者数は約40-48名で局地的、デング熱は当該地域で季節性の風土病。記事内容は行政の透明性に関する政治的発言が中心。

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल सरकार का मकसद डेंगू को खत्म करना है, मामलों की संख्या छिपाना नहीं : अग्निमित्रा पॉल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The West Bengal government's aim is to eradicate dengue, not to hide the number of cases: Agnimitra Paul
article.articleSummary: West Bengal Health Minister Agnimitra Paul says the government aims to eradicate dengue and ensure transparent reporting after blood tests, not conceal cases. Speaking at a dengue awareness rally in Asansol South Assembly constituency (Bardhaman district), she noted three wards report infections with about 40–48 people currently under treatment. The Asansol Municipal Corporation organized the event, which began at Ramse Maidan and ended at Battala Market, with Commissioner Dilip Mishra and other officials in attendance. Preventive measures include distributing mosquito nets to low-income residents in affected wards, setting up health camps, and prioritizing sanitation and awareness. The directive is that any dengue case must be clearly listed in reports post-testing. Free dengue tests are available in all government hospitals; anyone with fever for more than two days should get tested for dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州政府の目的はデング熱の撲滅であり、感染者数を隠すことではない：アグニミトラ・ポール州大臣
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州の一地域における季節性デング熱の通常の行政対応・啓発活動に関する報道であり、患者数も40〜48人程度と限定的で、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は西ベンガル州で季節的に発生する既知の感染症であり、記事は地方選挙区での啓発活動と行政対応に焦点を当てた内容。公衆衛生上の危機的状況を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in RD Congo, superate le 3mila vittime. L'allarme dei vescovi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo, toll surpasses 3,000 victims. Bishops sound the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now responsible for over 3,000 deaths and about 6,200 confirmed infections across six provinces, marking the worst transmission on record during the country’s second major outbreak. Initial transmission zones have expanded to sixty health zones as armed conflict and mass displacement propagate spread, with 60% of deaths occurring outside specialized treatment centers. The circulating Bundibugyo variant lacks approved specific therapies, prompting emergency vaccination of healthcare workers. Catholic Bishops’ Conference appeals for more decisive measures and resources to stem the epidemic amid PPE shortages and inadequate health-worker pay. The WHO and Swedish Flowminder are using anonymous mobile-network data to map movements and forecast hotspots, with Kisangani cited as a recently anticipated site. Remote schooling by radio may be triggered if containment fails; schools reopen with hygiene kits and distancing. International appeal seeks about $1.3 billion for Kinshasa’s response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ、死者3千人超。司教団が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 死者3,000人超・感染者6,200人超と大規模な公衆衛生危機であり、武力紛争下での拡大、国際支援要請($13億)など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（第2次大規模流行）。武力紛争と人口移動が拡大要因。Bundibugyo株には承認済み特異的治療薬がなく、PPE不足・医療従事者への報酬不足も深刻。国際的に13億ドル規模の支援要請あり。

article.articleHeadline: India Immunologicals issues clarification after rabies vaccine found substandard
article.articleSummary: Abhayrab Rabies Vaccine from India Immunologicals Ltd (IIL) was clarified after the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation flagged vials as Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) and misbranded. The questioned vials were drawn from an unlicensed residential premises in Mukherjee Nagar, Delhi, and pertain to batch KE25012. IIL said the examined vials are not a product manufactured by its subsidiary Human Biologicals Institute. It stressed that no person vaccinated with this batch is affected, as every batch is released for sale only after independent testing and batch-release certification by the Central Drugs Laboratory. IIL has submitted batch manufacturing, quality-control, reconciliation and distribution records to the CDSCO and has asked authorities to identify the source of the vials, pledging full cooperation with the investigation.

triage.headline_ja: インド・イムノロジカルズ、狂犬病ワクチンが規格外と指摘されたことを受け声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: 規格外・偽造の疑いがある狂犬病ワクチンに関する製薬会社の声明であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: この記事は狂犬病の発生事例ではなく、未認可の場所から採取されたワクチンバイアルが規格外・偽造品と判定されたことに対する製薬会社の説明・反論声明。感染症イベントとしての性質は薄く、医薬品規制・品質管理の問題に分類される。

article.articleHeadline: बंगाल सरकार का मकसद डेंगू को खत्म करना है, मामलों की संख्या छिपाना नहीं अग्निमित्रा पॉल | Bengal govt aims to eliminate dengue, not hide case numbers: Minister Agnimitra Paul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengal government aims to eliminate dengue, not hide case numbers: Minister Agnimitra Paul
article.articleSummary: West Bengal aims to eliminate dengue with transparency in reporting, not hiding cases, says Minister Agnimitra Paul. Speaking at a dengue awareness rally in Asansol South, Bardhaman district, she said the Chief Minister has instructed officials to report dengue after blood tests, and that cases must be clearly documented in reports. The district reports 40–48 dengue patients currently under treatment, with cases in three wards of Asansol South. The government will distribute mosquito nets to low-income households, organize health camps, and emphasize sanitation and public awareness to prevent transmission. All hospitals have dengue testing kits available, and testing is free. The objective is to halt the outbreak by treating patients promptly and preventing water stagnation; anyone with fever for more than two days should get checked at a government hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州政府の目的はデング熱の撲滅であり、感染者数の隠蔽ではない：アグニミトラ・ポール州大臣
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は同地域の風土病的な季節性感染症であり、行政の透明性向上に関する政治的発言が主題。現時点で異常な拡大や重症化の情報はないが、流行しやすい感染症であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は西ベンガル州アサンソール南地区での40〜48件のデング熱患者と、州政府の対策（蚊帳配布、健康キャンプ、無料検査）に関する政治的声明が中心。感染規模は限定的で、季節性の通常の流行と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Kongolesische Bischöfe fordern mehr Einsatz im Kampf gegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese bishops call for greater effort in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists after it began on May 15, 2026, with thousands of fatalities. By the end of August, 5,713 confirmed cases and 2,744 deaths were reported, though church officials say the total could be higher due to unrecorded suspected cases. The Catholic Bishops' Conference is urging intensified measures to curb the epidemic, highlighting shortages of personal protective equipment and other supplies, irregular or absent deliveries to some health facilities, and inadequate pay and support for medical staff. The church plans to expand Ebola-response efforts in Ituri Province, using Caritas networks to provide additional relief goods. The article notes ongoing outbreak status and potential undercount, but does not provide new laboratory confirmation details or infection-source information.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの司教らがエボラ対策の強化を訴える
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにより5,713例の確定症例と2,744人の死者が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際支援の必要性が認められるため。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日から続くエボラ流行で、医療物資不足・医療従事者への支援不足などが指摘されている。教会関係者は未報告の疑い例を含めると実際の被害はさらに大きい可能性を指摘している。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する情報は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 香港26歲男子確診猴痘　潛伏期有高風險接觸 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox diagnosed in a 26-year-old man in Hong Kong; high-risk exposure during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, Hong Kong reports a laboratory-confirmed monkeypox case in a 26-year-old man. Genital lesions began on 29 August, spreading to the face, limbs and trunk. On 3 September, he sought help and was isolated; laboratory tests confirmed monkeypox and his condition is stable. He had two high-risk exposures with a man outside Hong Kong during the incubation period. The case will be reported to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 100 monkeypox cases: 79 locally acquired and 21 imported, all male. Most infections involved high-risk sexual behavior, including sex with strangers or unprotected sex. Vaccination is strongly advised for high-risk groups. Monkeypox is not typically spread via air, droplets, or casual social contact. Citizens, especially those at higher exposure risk, should avoid close contact with suspected cases or animals and seek prompt medical care for symptoms such as rash, fever, lymphadenopathy, fatigue, myalgia, or severe headache.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で26歳男性の猴痘（サル痘）感染確認　潜伏期に高リスク接触あり
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病（香港では2022年以降100例確認済み）の追加症例であり、重症度・国際的拡大リスクは限定的だが、性的接触を介した継続的な流行の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港はChina(1814991)に含めて集計。WHOへの報告予定と記載あるが、これは通常のサーベイランス報告であり緊急事態通報を意味しない。過去の継続的な国内発生パターンであり、既知のリスク行動（性的接触）に関連。

article.articleHeadline: जिला मलेरिया अधिकारी ने डेंगू वार्ड व गांव का किया निरीक्षण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: District Malaria Officer Inspects Dengue Ward and Village
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, Badayun district Malaria Officer Amit Kumar Tiwari inspected Community Health Centre Ujhani’s dengue ward, reviewed arrangements and patient care for dengue and other vector-borne diseases, and consulted health workers on current disease status and management. He then visited Sanjarpur village, inspected the Ayushman Arogya Mandir, assessed local health services and disease-related information, and spoke with frontline staff about outbreak status, prevention, and awareness efforts. He urged vigilance to prevent vector-borne diseases, and to intensify community outreach on protective measures. He directed health workers to ensure effective service delivery and broaden access to essential health facilities for residents, reinforcing district-level surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: 郡マラリア担当官がデング病棟と村を視察
triage.triage_reason: 通常のルーティン視察・監視活動の報告であり、異常な流行拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方行政官による定例の保健施設視察・監視活動を伝えるものであり、具体的な感染者数増加や異常事態の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Three severe paediatric influenza cases reported
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, Hong Kong CHP reports three severe paediatric influenza infections in previously healthy children. The six-year-old girl (onset 3 Sept) developed fever, runny nose and cough, convulsed and is in critical condition with influenza A and encephalopathy at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital PICU. The three-year-old girl (fever onset 2 Sept) had a convulsion and was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital PICU; laboratory-confirmed influenza A with septic shock, serious. The 15-year-old boy (fever 3 Sept; admission 4 Sept) had fever, runny nose and malaise; influenza B with septic shock, transferred to Queen Mary Hospital PICU, serious. No travel; household contacts asymptomatic; two classmates of the six-year-old had mild symptoms. Since end-June, 16 severe paediatric influenza cases: 8 recovered, 2 stable, 3 serious, 2 critical, 1 death. Vaccination programmes start 17 Sept; new e-consent via eHealth; ~80 schools in September; school outbreaks possible; ongoing hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で小児の重症インフルエンザ症例3件を報告
triage.triage_reason: 香港で脳症・敗血症性ショックを伴う重症小児インフルエンザ症例が複数報告され、季節性を超えて死亡例も含む累積16例に達しており、学校でのアウトブレイクの可能性もあることから、社会的関心とWPRO基準の複数該当によりフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例に関する香港CHPの定例的なサーベイランス報告。渡航歴なし、家庭内接触者は無症状。ワクチン接種プログラムが9月17日開始予定であり、学校での流行拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur Swine Flu Alert: H1N1 से कानपुर में पहली मौत, 55 वर्षीय व चार माह का बच्चा भी संक्रमित - kanpur swine flu alert first death reported 55 yearold patient and four month old baby also infected
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur Swine Flu Alert: First death in Kanpur due to H1N1, a 55-year-old and a four-month-old baby are also infected.
article.articleSummary: Kanpur records its first H1N1 swine flu death: 30-year-old Shivam from Kannauj dies Sept 1 at Anurag Hospital after Aug 28 admission with pneumonia-like symptoms; postmortem confirms H1N1. In Kanpur Dehat, 55-year-old patient is in serious condition at LLR Hospital and on a ventilator; samples sent, with results due by Monday, Sept 7, 2026. A four-month-old baby also tests positive for swine flu and has been taken to a Lucknow private hospital for treatment after confirmation. Postmortem findings were reported to CMO Dr Haridatt Nemi; Dr Vipul Chaturvedi states the hospital staff will be investigated. The alert points to ongoing H1N1 activity in Kanpur and nearby districts, with lab-confirmed cases and intercity referrals.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールでスワインフルー警戒：H1N1により初の死亡、55歳患者と生後4か月の乳児も感染
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザによる死亡・重症例が報告されているが、インドでは例年発生する疾患であり国際的拡大の兆候は乏しいため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1はインドで季節性に流行する疾患であり、複数都市（カンプール、カンプールデハト、ラクナウ）での症例確認は地域内拡大の可能性を示すが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。続報（PCR結果、追加症例）を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria parasites with a new drug defense are spreading rapidly
article.articleSummary: Malaria parasites in Uganda carry a new drug-defence genotype, PIN, linked to reduced sensitivity to artemisinin and lumefantrine in the first-line combination artemether-lumefantrine (in use since 2006). In northern Uganda, 84% of isolates and 55% in eastern Uganda harbor PIN by 2024, found in a 69-gene region on chromosome 7 centered on px1, with three SNPs and two deletions. Lab tests show PIN parasites require higher drug concentrations: lumefantrine 14.3 vs 6.2 nmol/L, artemisinin 3.7 vs 1.8, mefloquine 17.1 vs 11.0; disabling px1 makes parasites easier to kill. PIN appeared after rollout (2008) and predates Kelch13 artemisinin-resistant mutations (2016). Globally, PIN was rare (5/3,570 samples, 2001–2015; DRC and Kenya), but is spreading in Uganda. Lab tests cannot predict cure; CDC in 2026 advises longer courses for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな薬剤耐性を持つマラリア原虫がウガンダで急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダで第一選択薬（アルテメテル・ルメファントリン）への感受性低下に関連する新規遺伝子型PINが急速に拡大しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象であり、地域的拡大リスクも懸念されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダにおける薬剤耐性マラリア原虫（PIN遺伝子型）の拡大であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRC・ケニアは2001-2015年の歴史的な稀少検出例としての言及に留まり、現在の主要発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めなかった。CDCは2026年に渡航者への長期治療コース勧告を発表しており、政策的関心の高まりが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Doença da vaca louca: o que é, como é transmitida e quais os riscos para seres humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mad Cow Disease: What It Is, How It Is Transmitted, and What the Risks to Humans Are.
article.articleSummary: Mad cow disease, formally bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE), is a fatal neurodegenerative condition in cattle that gradually damages brain cells, altering movement and behavior. It has no cure. BSE is caused by prions, infectious protein particles without genetic material; when misfolded, they recruit other proteins and accumulate in the brain. Prions resist heat and standard sterilization, complicating decontamination. Transmission is believed to occur mainly through ingestion of contaminated feed containing prions from diseased animals, a mechanism highlighted during the 1990s United Kingdom outbreak. In humans, eating contaminated beef can cause variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (vCJD), a rare but fatal condition. Worldwide surveillance reports fewer than 250 vCJD cases; none have been reported in Brazil. Classic Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease in humans is predominantly sporadic (~85%), with ~15% hereditary; rare iatrogenic cases occur after exposure to contaminated human tissues. A recent human CJD case mentioned involving influencer Lito Sousa.

triage.headline_ja: 狂牛病とは何か、どのように感染するか、人間へのリスクは何か
triage.triage_reason: BSE/vCJDに関する一般的な解説記事であり、ブラジルでの新規発生や症例報告はなく（vCJD症例はブラジルで0件）、緊急性のあるシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事は教育・啓発目的の一般解説であり、ブラジルにおける実際のBSEまたはvCJD発生を報じたものではない。言及されているインフルエンサーのCJD症例は孤発性の可能性が高く、BSE関連とは明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: PBB Peringatkan Korban Meninggal Ebola di Kongo Tembus 3 Ribu Jiwa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN Warns Ebola Death Toll in the Congo Surpasses 3,000.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has killed over 3,000 people among 6,186 confirmed cases as of August 31, 2026. Ituri province is the epicenter, accounting for about 81.9% of cases, with 60 health zones across six provinces affected. So far, 1,409 have recovered and 830 remain in isolation or care. The response is hindered by ongoing fighting in eastern DRC between government forces and M23 rebels and a funding gap of about $1.1 billion, despite CERF contributions of roughly $57 million. More than 40 health workers have died; clinics and ambulances have been attacked. WHO notes Ervebo vaccine is not proven for Bundibugyo and should be used only within clinical trials; 70,000 doses are allocated (20,000 for Phase 3 trials, 50,000 for frontline workers). IOM has conducted almost 23 million health checks in DRC and neighboring countries; Uganda recently ended its outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、コンゴのエボラ死者数が3,000人を突破と警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高い大規模エボラ流行が継続し、紛争による対応阻害・資金不足・医療従事者の死亡が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは流行終息と記載されているため対象国リストに含まれるが本記事の主眼はDRC。ワクチン(Ervebo)はBundibugyo種に未証明であり臨床試験下でのみ使用との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Manila warns pet owners as rabies cases rise
article.articleSummary: Manila warns pet owners as rabies cases rise after a weekend dog show at Pandacan Senior Citizens' Park and Pet Park. Dr. Hector Dimaculangan, veterinarian and chief of the Manila City Pound, said seven dogs that bit victims tested positive for rabies. The city offers free anti-rabies vaccination and deworming for dogs via Manila City Pound rounds in barangays. Dimaculangan emphasized long-term pet care responsibility and warned that owners can be liable if a bite victim lacks treatment. On euthanasia, he noted severely ill dogs are put to sleep when treatment is no longer effective, after attempting care; age and prognosis may justify mercy euthanasia. The report centers on Manila's rabies public health response following weekend incidents.

triage.headline_ja: マニラ、狂犬病症例増加によりペット飼い主に警告
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでは狂犬病は地域的に流行している既知の疾患であり、本記事は市当局による通常の注意喚起・予防接種案内であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はフィリピンで地方病的に発生しており、本記事はマニラ市当局によるペット飼い主向けの注意喚起・無料ワクチン接種案内が中心。ヒト感染者の死亡等の重大事象は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : un plan de 1,3 milliard USD lancé pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: a $1.3 billion plan launched to strengthen the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo launches a $1.3 billion Plan of Preparedness and Response for Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) over six months, to strengthen surveillance and interrupt transmission. Officially unveiled on 4 September 2026 by Health Minister Roger Kamba, under the National Institute of Public Health (INSP), the plan centers on three pillars: data analysis, epidemiological anticipation, and community action, with a focus on decentralizing the response and placing local communities, including villages, at the heart of interventions. The objective is to bring response activities closer to transmission foci to rapidly detect cases, reinforce surveillance, and accelerate interruption of virus transmission. Backed by the WHO, Africa CDC, the UN system, and other partners, the initiative highlights the community-centric approach as key to effectiveness. Stakeholders are urged to own the plan and coordinate field interventions, with communities central to prevention, surveillance, and combatting EVD.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対応強化のため13億ドルの計画始動
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はDRCにおいて重大な公衆衛生上のリスクを伴い、WHOやAfrica CDC等の国際機関が関与する大規模な対応計画が発表されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行への対応強化策（予防・対応計画）の発表であり、新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではない点に留意。フルRRAにて現在の症例数・地理的範囲の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Agra News: स्वाइन फ्लू के बीच पेशेंट की हार्ट अटैक से मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agra News: Patient dies of a heart attack amid swine flu.
article.articleSummary: An 80-year-old doctor from Etah, Uttar Pradesh, Dr. Shileendra Gaud, died of a heart attack while being treated at a private hospital in Agra amid swine flu concerns. The patient, from Patiyali Gate, was admitted in Agra; swine flu testing reportedly confirmed H1N1 infection, and he died on Sunday. Health authorities in Etah and Agra launched contact tracing; relatives and close contacts were tested, with no positives reported. Etah CMO Dr. Rajendra Prasad said a sample from the Agra lab indicated suspected swine flu infection at around 2:30 am on Wednesday, but Agra’s health department rejected that confirmation, attributing the death to a heart attack. Officials urged vigilance and noted isolation wards have been prepared at SN Medical College and district hospital. New guidelines allow swine flu testing only for severe cases; as of now, only one confirmed case exists in Agra—a elderly woman currently under treatment.

triage.headline_ja: アグラのニュース：豚インフルエンザの中、患者が心臓発作で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例であり感染拡大の兆候は限定的だが、H1N1感染の有無について当局間で見解が分かれており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性のH1N1単発症例で、死因は心臓発作とされ、当局間でH1N1確定診断について意見の相違がある。接触者調査では陽性者なし。地域の季節性インフルエンザ管理の範疇であり、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'INRB mise sur des traitements spécifiques dans des essais cliniques - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: INRB bets on specific treatments in clinical trials - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, is being managed in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia. INRB reports a shift from purely symptomatic care to targeted therapy with MBP134 monoclonal antibody and remdesivir, both currently evaluated in INRB-led clinical trials. While these treatments are experimental, patient management includes supportive care and close medical follow-up per study protocol. INRB officials emphasize that care at Ebola Treatment Centers remains essential and that scientific progress reinforces confidence in the response. Surveillance, case management, and community sensitization continue as pivotal components. The message stresses collaboration between health teams and communities to strengthen the outbreak response and the evolving therapeutic landscape.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：INRBは臨床試験における特異的治療法に注力
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクがDRCイツリ州で継続中であり、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は治療法（MBP134単クローン抗体、レムデシビル）の臨床試験に焦点を当てているが、背景にエボラアウトブレイクが継続していることを示しており、既存のDRCエボラ流行状況の一部として評価。

article.articleHeadline: H1N1 यानी स्वाइन फ्लू का बढ़ा खतरा! पहचानें शुरुआती लक्षण और जानें कब डॉक्टर से संपर्क करें - Sanjeevni Today
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increased risk of H1N1 (swine flu)! Identify early symptoms and know when to contact a doctor - Sanjeevni Today.
article.articleSummary: India reports H1N1 influenza (swine flu) within influenza monitoring; the Health Ministry said in August 2026 that flu activity aligns with seasonal patterns and no new or unusual strain detected. Symptoms can start suddenly and include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches; vomiting or diarrhea may occur in children. Incubation is about 1–4 days. Diagnosing H1N1 by symptoms alone is difficult; testing may be advised. Seek medical advice for severe symptoms or if you have risk factors. High-risk groups include young children, older adults, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases. Urgent care is needed for trouble breathing, chest pain, confusion, persistent vomiting, or blue lips. Treatment ranges from rest and fluids for mild cases to antivirals for severe/high-risk cases; antibiotics do not treat viruses. Prevention emphasizes vaccination, hand hygiene, covering cough, and staying home when sick; vaccination is the most effective protection per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1(豚インフルエンザ)のリスク増大!初期症状を見分け、いつ医師に連絡すべきかを知る - Sanjeevni Today
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの範囲内であり、新規・異常株は検出されていないという保健省見解が示された一般啓発記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は症状啓発・予防啓発を目的とした一般向け医療情報記事であり、季節性の範囲内との保健当局見解が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu: remise des kits de protection contre Ebola dans une école à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: distribution of Ebola protection kits in a school in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: On August 5, 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola protection kits were distributed to students at Institut Butsili to curb Ebola virus disease transmission during the 2026-2027 school year. Handwashing kits were placed at the entrance of each classroom, with reminders to wash hands before entering and after toilets or recess. The initiative addresses parental concerns about safety amid an Ebola epidemiological situation in the health zone. Led by the NGO Esaader, with risk-communication support from Crec, the effort follows requests from teachers for protective resources such as handwashing basins, thermoflash devices, soap, and hydro-alcoholic gels to bolster school protection.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニの学校でエボラ予防キットを配布 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は本質的に重篤な疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニの保健地域で流行が継続していることが記事から確認され、学校での予防対策実施は住民の懸念（社会的関心）の高まりを示している。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のエボラ流行に対する学校での予防キット配布という対応措置についてのもので、新規症例数や死亡者数などの具体的な疫学データは含まれていない。既存の流行状況の継続確認として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : l'Eglise protestante renforce l'implication des leaders religieux dans la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: The Protestant Church Strengthens the Involvement of Religious Leaders in the Ebola Response - ACP
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak persists in Ituri and Haut-Uélé in the northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia hosting a training workshop as of 5 September 2026. Mgr Théodore Katembo, president of the Church of Christ in Congo (ECC) for Ituri and Haut‑Uélé, says strengthening religious leaders' capacity is key to improving community awareness and countering misinformation. The ECC-led initiative aims to equip religious leaders with understanding of Ebola, their role in the response, and how to support communities during the epidemic. Observed behavioral changes include regular handwashing in churches, households, and other spaces. Katembo urged continued prevention measures: handwashing, hydroalcoholic gel, and limiting physical contact. This engagement of faith actors seeks to boost prevention adherence and vigilance across affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:プロテスタント教会がエボラ対応における宗教指導者の関与を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報告であり、重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威かつ国際的拡大の既往歴があるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ対応における宗教指導者の関与強化に関する内容であり、新規症例数などの疫学的詳細は含まれていない。既存のアウトブレイク継続状況の一環として評価。

article.articleHeadline: IIL stands by rabies vaccine, as CDSCO flags 'fake' vials seized from unlicensed Delhi residence
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine Abhayrab from Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL) faced counterfeit concerns after CDSCO seized misbranded vials labeled Abhayrab, Batch KE25012, from an unlicensed premises in Delhi's Mukherjee Nagar on 22 April 2026. The Central Drugs Laboratory, Kasauli, reported the samples Not of Standard Quality and misbranded; the agency alerted state regulators. IIL said the questioned vials were not manufactured by Human Biologicals Institute (HBI), its vaccine division, and the Central lab identified 17 differences between the vials and IIL's retention samples. IIL noted the batch was tested in November 2025 and about 83,370 vials were supplied via authorised channels. The company has since submitted manufacturing, quality-control, reconciliation and distribution records to CDSCO (14 August 2026) and called for a formal investigation (4 September 2026). IIL added six security features, including a scratch-card verification, as counterfeit concerns persist; India reported 54 rabies deaths in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: IIL、CDSCOがデリーの無許可施設から押収した「偽造」ワクチンを指摘する中、狂犬病ワクチンの正当性を主張
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、偽造ワクチン（品質規制）に関する事案であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病ワクチンの偽造品問題とCDSCOによる規制対応に関するものであり、狂犬病そのもののアウトブレイク報告ではない。2024年のインドでの狂犬病死者数54人という背景情報が含まれるが、これは事件の文脈説明であり新規の感染症シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Drug regulator flags mainstream rabies vaccine after finding it 'sub standard'
article.articleSummary: India’s drug regulator has flagged Abhayrab, a mainstream rabies vaccine produced by Indian Immunologicals Ltd, as substandard and potentially spurious after batch KE25012 failed quality tests. Abhayrab accounts for over 40% of India's domestic rabies vaccine market, with more than 210 million doses supplied over two decades, and India reports about 6,000 rabies deaths annually. This marks the second time in under two years that concerns have centered on Abhayrab; in 2025 a counterfeit batch KA24014 was circulating, with the company not producing it, prompting U.S. and U.K. travel alerts for travelers who had received rabies shots in India. The Central Drugs Laboratory in Kasauli found the field sample substandard and misbranded, including packaging, labeling, and barcode discrepancies. As of 2026-09-05, neither Indian Immunologicals nor the federal regulator have commented to Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: インドの薬事規制当局、主要な狂犬病ワクチンを『規格外』と認定し警告
triage.triage_reason: インドの狂犬病ワクチン市場の40%以上を占める主力製品が規格外・偽装の疑いで指摘され、過去には同製品の偽造品流通で米英が渡航警告を出した前例があるため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的波及の可能性がありフルRRAで詳細評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本件はワクチンの品質問題であり感染症アウトブレイク自体ではないが、狂犬病致死率がほぼ100%であること、過去に偽造品流通で米英が渡航警告を出した前例があることから、公衆衛生・国際渡航への影響評価が必要と判断した。米国・英国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bohol declares dengue outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-05, Bohol province declared a dengue outbreak after documenting 1,883 cases and 21 deaths from 4 January to 22 August 2026. Governor Erico Aristotle Aumentado signed an executive order declaring a province-wide dengue outbreak and said there is an urgent need to escalate and intensify dengue outbreak management measures to control the transmission of dengue in the community and prevent the occurrence of deaths due to the disease. The action marks formal provincial-level priority for dengue response amid the reported case burden through late August 2026, underscoring the government's commitment to stronger outbreak management within the province. The executive order formalizes the province's intensified response and signals sustained action.

triage.headline_ja: ボホール州がデング熱の流行を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ボホール州で1,883症例・21死亡を伴うデング熱流行が州レベルで正式に宣言され、行政府による緊急対応強化が発表されたため、社会的・行政的関心の高いシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節的に流行する既知の風土病だが、州知事による公式な流行宣言と死亡例21件の報告があり、行政・社会的関心が高いためPICKUPと判断。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: मध्य प्रदेशमध्ये संसर्गजन्य आजारांमुळे ३० आदिवासी बालकांचा मृत्यू; राहुल गांधी यांनी व्यक्त केलं दुःख, म्हणाले, हे सरकारचे अपयश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Madhya Pradesh, 30 tribal children have died due to infectious diseases; Rahul Gandhi expressed grief, saying it is the government's failure.
article.articleSummary: In Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, 30 tribal children have died in the Baihar-Birsa area due to malaria and infectious diseases, with a 10-year-old among the deceased. Health teams conducting household surveys reported about 800 patients suffering from malaria, diarrhoea, skin rashes, and other skin diseases in the tribal belt, prompting fear in local villages. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi expressed grief on X, and blamed the state government for the tragedy, claiming it reflects overall governance failure. He urged Chief Minister Mohan Yadav to personally oversee immediate on-site medical investigation, relief measures, and healthcare provision. The incident highlights broader concerns about access to clean drinking water, nutrition, and timely medical treatment in the affected communities, amid an ongoing outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州で感染症により部族の子供30人が死亡；ラーフル・ガーンディー氏が哀悼の意を表し、政府の失敗と非難
triage.triage_reason: マラリア等感染症により部族地域で30人の子供が死亡、約800人の患者が発生しており公衆衛生上深刻。政治的関心も高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: マラリア・下痢・皮膚疾患等複数の感染症が同時発生している可能性があり、清潔な飲料水・栄養・医療アクセスなど構造的問題が背景にあると指摘されている。政治的な非難合戦の文脈もあり、続報で死者数・原因病原体の確定情報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Klaten 2026 Turun Drastis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases in Klaten in 2026 Drop Drastically
article.articleSummary: 127 dengue fever (DBD) cases and 1 death in Klaten Regency, Central Java, by week 34 of 2026 (January–August), down from 435 cases and 3 deaths in the same period in 2025. Health officials credit the drastic decline to heightened community engagement in simultaneous mosquito-nest eradication campaigns (PSN) and improved Jumantik larval monitoring at village and sub-district levels, along with environmental cleanliness and rapid medical response. Anggit Budiarto, head of Klaten’s Health Office, told Media Indonesia on September 5, 2026, that PSN, Jumantik, environmental hygiene, and expedited medical handling are key to reducing dengue transmission. Residents are urged not to become lax and to maintain these measures. The report underscores ongoing progress in dengue control in Klaten and the importance of sustained vector-control and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: クラテンの2026年デング熱症例、大幅に減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数が前年より大幅減少しているという肯定的な内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は同地域の風土病であり、本記事は症例減少を報告する内容。継続的なベクター対策の成果を示すもので、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | DRC Adds Mobile Data to Ebola Surveillance
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak exceeds 6,250 cases and 3,039 deaths across six provinces, with 6,186 confirmed cases, 3,007 deaths, 1,409 recoveries, and 830 currently in treatment (CFR 48.6%) as of Sept 3. WHO notes the fastest Ebola spread in history. Anonymized Vodacom Congo mobile data, analyzed with Flowminder, map movements from Ituri to other areas to guide surveillance. Thirteen African countries signed a cross-border health-emergencies cooperation agreement in Addis Ababa, including Ethiopia, Kenya, Uganda, Angola and Tanzania, to share data and coordinate early outbreak detection. Mpox stockpile launched Aug 27, 2026 by Gavi, operational by end-September, coordinated by ICG; 2022–2026 totals: 190,683 mpox cases, 529 deaths, with two-thirds in Africa. Nigeria’s Katsina diphtheria outbreak affects 29 local government areas; Kano reports two deaths; 500,000 vaccine doses deployed; Katsina vaccination drive began Aug 25, 2026, with 150 vaccinated so far.

triage.headline_ja: 週次保健アップデート：DRCがエボラ監視にモバイルデータを追加
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が6,250例・3,039死亡（致死率48.6%）に達し、WHOが「史上最速の拡大」と指摘。13カ国が越境保健協力協定を締結するなど国際的関心・対応が高まっており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事にはナイジェリア（ジフテリア）、エチオピア・ケニア・ウガンダ・アンゴラ・タンザニア（越境協定署名国）も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。エボラ流行の主題国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 专家：被蝙蝠咬破皮要立即接种疫苗 直接接触即为三级暴露
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts: A bat bite that breaks the skin requires immediate rabies vaccination; direct contact is a Category III exposure.
article.articleSummary: In Dalian, Liaoning Province, China, a bat flew into an apartment on the 18th floor in Ganjingzi District. Li’s son tried to catch the bat; it bit the child through skin, then escaped. A veteran pest-control expert said bats are natural hosts for multiple viruses and may carry rabies; because the child has a skin breach, this is a Category III rabies exposure. He urged immediate hospital vaccination and, if indicated, rabies immunoglobulin. The episode echoes guidance cited by Zhejiang clinicians on exposure levels: Level 1—intact skin with dog/cat contact requires only washing; Level 2—skin breaks require antiseptic cleaning and possible vaccination; Level 3—bleeding or mucous membrane contact, including direct bat contact, requires wound treatment plus passive immunization and vaccination. The 2023 Rabies Exposure Prevention standard explicitly adds direct bat contact as Category III.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家:コウモリに噛まれ皮膚が破れた場合は直ちにワクチン接種を、直接接触でも三級暴露に該当
triage.triage_reason: 個別の狂犬病曝露事例に関する啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生や集団感染を示す情報はない。単発の暴露対応事例で、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: これは個人の狂犬病曝露事例に関する医療啓発記事であり、集団発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。狂犬病自体は中国で常在するが、本記事は公衆衛生イベントというより一般向け医療情報提供の内容。

article.articleHeadline: На границе России и Монголии активизировался очаг чумы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A plague focus has become active at the Russia–Mongolia border.
article.articleSummary: Elevated plague activity has been detected in a mountainous zone at the Russia–Mongolia–Kazakhstan border. Rospotrebnadzor reports that analyses of over 200 field samples confirmed Yersinia pestis circulation; there have been no human cases, with transmission limited to wildlife. The natural plague focus in the Sailyugemsky region spans about 29,000 square kilometers, roughly 60% of which lies in Mongolia. Across Russia, 11 natural plague foci have been identified, seven extending beyond borders and adjoining Mongolia, Kazakhstan, China, Azerbaijan, and Georgia. In these zones, epidemiologists conduct continuous surveillance and vaccinate populations as indicated. The disease reservoir is wild rodents, with fleas as the primary transmission vector; human infections are rare and typically linked to direct contact with infected animals, such as during hunting or skinning. Ongoing monitoring and cross-border collaboration are under way.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアとモンゴルの国境でペストの自然疫源地が活発化
triage.triage_reason: 人への感染例はなく野生動物間での病原体循環が確認されたのみで、既知の自然疫源地における通常のサーベイランス事案であり、対象国での発生も確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・モンゴル国境（サイリュゲムスキー地域）の自然疫源地での野生動物間のペスト活動であり、人への感染例なし。中国・カザフスタン・アゼルバイジャン・グルジアはロシア国内の自然疫源地が国境を越えて隣接するという一般的説明の中で言及されているのみで、これらの国で実際にペスト活動が確認されたわけではないため対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria, Gastroenteritis remain health concerns in Prampram
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a significant public health concern in Prampram, with the coastal environment and the rainy season contributing to transmission, according to Cephas Kofi Borklo, a Physician Assistant at Prampram Polyclinic. Gastroenteritis also ranks among common conditions, linked to challenges with water supply and sanitation; symptoms include diarrhoea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fever. Remarks were made during the Prampram Homowo health walk and screening last weekend, organized with the Prampram Traditional Council and Asa Savings and Loans Limited as part of this year’s Homowo festival. The event provided free health services—blood pressure, blood glucose, BMI, sickle cell, breast cancer, mental health, NCD and maternal/child health screenings—and health education on hygiene and safe food handling, with a blood donation drive. Asa Savings funded test kits, medicines, and materials; residents were urged to seek early malaria care.

triage.headline_ja: プランプラムではマラリアと胃腸炎が依然として健康上の懸念事項
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・プランプラムにおけるマラリア・胃腸炎は地域で恒常的に見られる健康課題であり、地域保健啓発イベントに関する内容で、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の伝統的祭事に合わせた健康啓発・無料検診イベントの報告記事であり、疾病の急増や異常発生を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: des écoliers sensibilisés aux procédures de lavage des mains - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Schoolchildren Educated on Handwashing Procedures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Beni, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, continues to prompt public health responses. On 5 September 2026, the Ebola response communication cell demonstrated handwashing procedures in a primary school in Butsili, educating pupils on five steps using handwashing kits to reduce contamination in classrooms. The aim is to protect children from Ebola transmission by reinforcing correct hygiene practices in schools and the wider community. Communicator Gisèle Kahindo noted that many residents wash their hands only superficially due to insufficient training, stressing the need for ongoing education. The response team warned that several contact cases have tested positive, attributing this to informational gaps about the proper handwashing procedure, and called for additional trainings to ensure correct technique is adopted broadly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ベニ:小学生に手洗い手順を啓発 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国ベニで進行中のエボラ対応において、接触者の陽性例が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と流行の継続的リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行対応（手洗い教育）の一環だが、接触者陽性例の報告があり感染継続の可能性が示唆される。既存アウトブレイクの継続状況として続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: une attitude responsable préconisée pour vaincre collectivement Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: A responsible attitude recommended to collectively defeat Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Nord-Kivu region, notably Butembo and Beni (Lubero territory and surrounding localities), should be defeated through a responsible, disciplined, and united attitude. Civil society figure Me Angelus Musumba of Parlement Debout de Furu/Butembo urges residents to resist panic, rumors, and misinformation that fuel spread. Key challenges include misinformation, non-adherence to barrier measures, improper handling of corpses, opposition to response teams, and destruction of health facilities in Butembo, Beni and nearby areas. Solutions emphasize relying on information from health professionals and response teams, strict adherence to barrier measures (handwashing with soap and water), and never touching or washing Ebola victims’ bodies. The public should protect infrastructure, support responders, and engage youth as messengers in families, neighborhoods, universities, churches, and gathering places. Uganda’s experience is cited; control requires collective discipline and collaboration, not aggression toward healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:エボラを共同で克服するために責任ある態度が推奨される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州（ブテンボ、ベニ、ルベロ地域）でエボラ出血熱の感染拡大が継続しており、誤情報・遺体の不適切な取り扱い・対応チームへの妨害など制御上の重大な課題が報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの経験を過去の参考事例として引用しているのみで、現在ウガンダ国内で発生している事象ではないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。エボラは既知の高致死率疾患であり、地域社会での誤情報や対応チームへの敵対的行動が制御を困難にしている点が特に懸念される。
