article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad sees rise in viral fever, flu cases amid prolonged monsoon
article.articleSummary: As of Sep 5, 2026, Hyderabad, Telangana, reports rising viral fever and flu cases amid prolonged monsoon. Government and private hospitals see increased outpatient footfall: Govt Fever Hospital’s daily OPD rises to about 600 from 400; Niloufer Hospital reports around 100 children daily admitted with flu-like symptoms—fever, cough, headache, body aches. While any single diagnosis is not confirmed, viral fever remains most common, with dengue and typhoid suspected in several cases; H1N1 (swine flu) also features in discussions with overlapping symptoms. Telangana has not reported any H1N1 cases so far. Early symptoms of viral fever, H1N1, and dengue can be similar, emphasizing the need for testing. Health officials caution against self-medication and advise medical evaluation if fever persists beyond 72 hours. Prevailing weather could boost vector-borne, waterborne, and airborne infections; residents urged to prevent mosquito breeding and maintain hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバードで長引くモンスーンの中、ウイルス性発熱・インフルエンザ症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス性発熱・デング・腸チフス疑いの症例増加が報告されているが、確定診断や重症度・国際的拡大の情報が乏しく、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性の混合感染症（ウイルス性発熱、デング、腸チフス、H1N1疑い）の報告。テランガーナ州ではH1N1確定例は報告されていない。診断確定・重症度データ待ち。

article.articleHeadline: 128,634 dengue cases reported this year
article.articleSummary: 128,634 dengue cases were recorded in the Philippines from January to August 2026, 39% lower than the same period in 2025. The Department of Health (DOH) notes 209,631 dengue cases nationwide in 2025. An uptick emerged with 15,673 infections in the two-week period August 2–15, up 9% from July 19–August 1 (14,409). In Manila and across the country, health officials warn a potential spike as the rainy season creates ideal mosquito breeding conditions. Symptoms include fever with rash, muscle and eye pain, dizziness, and vomiting; residents are advised to seek prompt medical attention. The article does not provide laboratory-confirmation details. Ongoing surveillance and preventive measures are emphasized to curb transmission during peak season.

triage.headline_ja: 今年のデング熱症例、128,634件を報告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はフィリピンの毎年の季節性流行であり前年比39%減少しているが、直近2週間で増加傾向があり雨季のピークに向けた注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱は例年フィリピンで流行する既知の感染症であり、症例数は前年より減少しているが、直近2週間で増加傾向が見られるため今後の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 流感季節兒童嚴重個案增 六歲女童併發腦病變情況危殆 - 星島日報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe pediatric influenza cases rise during flu season; six-year-old girl with brain lesions in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Severe pediatric influenza cases rise in Hong Kong during the flu season. As of Sept 5, 2026, the Centre for Health Protection reports three pediatric severe influenza cases, bringing the total since late June to 16. The latest cases include: a six-year-old girl with influenza A and encephalopathy, currently in critical condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit of Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital; a three-year-old girl with influenza A and septic shock, in serious condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Queen Elizabeth Hospital; and a fifteen-year-old boy with influenza B and septic shock, in serious condition in the Pediatric Intensive Care Unit at Queen Mary Hospital. Eight have recovered, two are stable, three are severe, two are critical, and one has died. All three were previously healthy, with no recent travel and no symptomatic household contacts. Schools are advised to implement infection control measures. Influenza activity remains high.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ流行期に小児重症例増加、6歳女児が脳症を併発し危篤
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児の重症インフルエンザ症例が急増し、死亡例や脳症・敗血症性ショックなど重篤な合併症が報告されており、社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価に進む価値がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行に伴う小児重症例（脳症、敗血症性ショック、死亡例含む）の増加が報告されている。香港特別行政区の事例だが対象国リストの規定によりChina(1814991)に分類。渡航制限や国際的拡大の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Six morts du choléra en 24 heures dans la zone de santé de Kasongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six cholera deaths in 24 hours in the Kasongo Health Zone.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Kasongo Health Zone, Maniema Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with six deaths among 35 reported cases within 24 hours; overall, 36 cholera cases have been notified, including six fatalities in a single day. Affected riverine health areas include Kachura, Kauta Demufala, Kabeya, Kiyogo, Kankumba, and Lubaya. Health authorities report a severe shortage of protective kits and patient-care supplies in local facilities, forcing many cases to be managed in the community, which raises the risk of further transmission. Dr. Mubwana Zamuda Byza, the zone medical chief, warns that the lack of inputs jeopardizes the response and appeals to the Government and health partners for rapid action to strengthen the outbreak response and to reinforce hygiene measures among populations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国カソンゴ保健地区で24時間にコレラにより6人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 24時間で36例中6例死亡と致死率が高く、防護具・医療資材の深刻な不足によりコミュニティでの管理を余儀なくされ感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 医療チーフが政府・パートナーへ支援を要請しており、資材不足による対応の限界が指摘されている。コレラはDRCで既知の流行病であるため異常性は低いが、致死率と資材不足による拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca bệnh tay chân miệng tăng cao, Bộ Y tế yêu cầu tăng cường phòng bệnh trong trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of hand-foot-and-mouth disease cases is rising; the Ministry of Health calls for strengthening disease prevention in schools.
article.articleSummary: Week 35 (Aug 27–Sep 2, 2026) in Đồng Nai reports 315 hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD) cases, up 176 from the same week last year. Year-to-date HFMD totals exceed 9,600, a 77.2% increase YoY, with one death so far (unlike last year’s none). Ten new outbreaks were detected that week, bringing total outbreaks in 2026 to 341, of which 125 occur in schools; all outbreaks have been contained. As schools reopen, transmission risk rises, especially in nurseries and kindergartens, with potential school-based clusters. The Ministry of Health issued guidance to strengthen HFMD prevention in schools nationwide, urging enhanced awareness of signs, prevention, and management; ensure clean environments and hygiene. The “3 clean” principle for preschools—clean eating, clean living spaces, and clean hands—along with regular handwashing, readily available soap and water, daily health monitoring, and prompt reporting to parents and local health authorities when symptoms appear, are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の症例数が増加、保健省が学校での予防強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病の症例数増加と死亡例が報告されているが、既存の風土病であり国際的拡大リスクは低く、保健省による対応も進行中であるため、継続的な経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 手足口病はベトナムで季節性に流行する既知の疾患であり、前年比増加は懸念されるが、保健省が既に予防対策を主導しており国家的な管理体制下にある。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威としての性質は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 2,000, Including Students, Sickened in Suspected Food Poisonings from Eating Free School Meals
article.articleSummary: About 1,950 people, mostly students, have fallen ill in suspected food-poisoning outbreaks linked to Indonesia’s Free Nutritious Meals (MBG) program, with events reported Sept 1–3 across East Java, West Sumatra, Aceh, South Sulawesi and Central Java. The largest cluster occurred at Central Java’s State Senior High School 1 Lasem: 752 students and 25 teachers sick with diarrhea, nausea, vomiting and abdominal pain. In Sidoarjo, East Java, 730 people (706 recovering at home) became ill at the Manbaul Hikam Islamic boarding school. Other incidents: 152 junior high students in Tana Toraja, South Sulawesi; 276 students and teachers in West Sumatra’s Agam regency; and 15 elementary students plus a principal in Aceh’s Bener Meriah. No deaths reported as of Sept 5. Since MBG’s 2025 launch, total cases reach about 50,059 people in 560 outbreaks; authorities investigate, with Komnas HAM urging transparent probes. The program is projected to cost about $28 billion through 2029.

triage.headline_ja: 学校給食プログラムの食事による集団食中毒疑いで学生を含む2,000人が体調不良に
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア全国的な無償学校給食プログラム(MBG)に関連し、複数州で計約2,000人が発症、原因病原体不明かつプログラム開始以来累計5万人超に及ぶ規模で、政府機関(Komnas HAM)や社会的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 原因は食中毒が疑われているが病原体・原因物質は特定されておらず「Unknown Illness」として分類。国家プログラムに起因する反復的な大規模健康被害であり、続報（原因判明、死亡例の有無）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Китайские ученые обнаружили передающийся через укусы клещей новый вирус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese scientists have discovered a new virus transmitted by tick bites.
article.articleSummary: China's researchers have identified a previously unknown virus transmitted to humans by tick bites. The new pathogen is named Asian longhorned tick nairovirus, classified within the Orthonairovirus genus but markedly distinct from known species. In China, investigators analyzed data from 3,163 patients; infections presented with weakness, fever, gastrointestinal disturbances, thrombocytopenia, and liver inflammation, features that can resemble other tick-borne illnesses. Laboratory and genetic analyses confirm the virus as a novel orthonairovirus linked to the Asian longhorned tick. Experts note there are antiviral therapies for influenza, but not for many tick-borne viruses, including this one. Dr. Sharon Nahman cautions about the therapeutic gap. Dr. Olga Chistik explains ticks can inject anesthetic substances, so a tick may remain on the skin for a day after bite; prolonged attachment raises the risk of borreliosis (Lyme disease).

triage.headline_ja: 中国の科学者、マダニの咬傷で感染する新種ウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: 中国でマダニ媒介の新規オルソナイロウイルスが発見されたとの学術的報告。3,163例のデータ解析に基づくが、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではなく、重症度やヒト-ヒト感染の情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 新規ウイルス（Asian longhorned tick nairovirus）の発見に関する研究報告であり、既存のアウトブレイク事例ではない。ヒト-ヒト感染の有無や重症度・致死率など疫学的詳細情報の続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: DA intensifies ASF containment efforts in Cagayan Valley
article.articleSummary: ASF continues in Cagayan Valley, Region 2, Philippines, with sporadic localized cases affecting the hog industry. DA-RFO2 convened a strategy meeting at Techcom Conference Hall, assembling regulators, RADDL, provincial LGUs, the Bureau of Animal Industry, and the National Meat Inspection Service to form a Regional Animal Disease Outbreak Quick Response Team. The team will standardize rapid-deployment protocols for immediate isolation, humane depopulation when necessary, and quarantine measures to contain localized outbreaks and protect commercial production areas. A unified operational command of regional agricultural officers, laboratory diagnosticians, and local veterinary teams aims to eliminate administrative delays. Long-term biosecurity measures include regular interagency meetings with LGUs and law enforcement to enforce animal movement controls and biosecurity checkpoints across borders, plus enhanced RADDL-led surveillance for faster lab turnaround and proactive monitoring in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、カガヤン・バレーでのASF封じ込め対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（豚熱）であり人への健康被害はないが、家畜産業への影響と対応体制強化の動きがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は人には感染しない動物疾病であり、ヒト公衆衛生上のIHR基準には該当しない。畜産業への経済的影響と地域的な封じ込め対応が主眼。

article.articleHeadline: Baguio residents' vigilance against dengue sought
article.articleSummary: Baguio City’s CHSO warns dengue risk persists as rains create mosquito breeding sites. Dengue cases remain below the epidemic threshold but increased toward late July. Two suspected dengue deaths involve a 31-year-old and a 25-year-old male. CESU data show 585 dengue cases from Jan 1 to Aug 15, down 113 from 698 in the same period last year; 31 new cases were recorded Aug 9–15. Transmission is localized across 73 barangays during a four-week monitoring, with Asin Road (15), Irisan (12), Kias (12), and Camp 7 (11) leading. Asin Road, Irisan, Kias and Loakan Proper reported cases in all four weeks. About 60% of cases are aged 5–29; males accounted for 50.08% (293). Of total cases, 196 (≈34%) required hospitalization; case fatality rate 0.34%. Residents are urged to inspect homes and remove stagnant water; community participation is crucial in the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市民にデング熱への警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱は地域の流行病であり症例数は前年より減少、閾値以下だが、季節性のリスクとして経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 地方保健当局(CHSO)による季節性デング熱の注意喚起。死亡疑い2例含むが、症例数は前年同期比で減少しており流行閾値以下。局地的な監視・対策で管理可能と判断されるレベル。

article.articleHeadline: Abhayrab Rabies Vaccine Batch Flagged as Substandard in Delhi; Maker Denies Authenticity
article.articleSummary: Abhayrab rabies vaccine batch KE25012 recovered from an unlicensed Delhi residence was classified Not of Standard Quality and misbranded by the Central Drugs Laboratory in Kasauli, triggering a wider probe into counterfeit distribution. Enforcement action at Mukherjee Nagar yielded samples that failed potency tests but passed sterility and identity; 17 discrepancies with the genuine lot included packaging artwork, typography, logos, QR codes, and cap colours, raising questions under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Indian Immunologicals Ltd, the vaccine’s manufacturer via its Human Biologicals Institute, said the examined vials were not theirs; the company notes 83,370 genuine units from KE25012 had passed quality checks and were distributed through authorised channels, with certification dated November 7, 2025. The Drugs Controller General of India has instructed state controllers to vigilantly monitor KE25012. Earlier, four people were arrested after recovering nearly a thousand vials in the same Delhi neighbourhood; a January 2025 counterfeit alert involved the same batch. Rabies remains virtually 100% fatal once symptoms appear, underscoring the need for post-exposure prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで規格外の狂犬病ワクチン(Abhayrab)バッチが摘発、製造元は正規品ではないと否定
triage.triage_reason: 感染症のアウトブレイクではなく偽造・規格外ワクチンの流通問題であり、狂犬病自体の症例急増等は報告されていないが、致死率がほぼ100%の疾患の予防接種に関わる問題であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は狂犬病の感染拡大ではなく、規格外・偽造ワクチンの流通に関する規制当局の摘発事案。実際の狂犬病感染者数や曝露状況についての情報はなく、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Spurious Abhayrab anti-rabies vaccine detected in Delhi
article.articleSummary: Spurious Abhayrab anti-rabies vaccine detected in Delhi, India, marking the second such instance in two years. Delhi Police seized an unlicensed premises in north Delhi in April; CDSCO, via CDL, Kasauli, confirmed the samples are misbranded and Not of Standard Quality. The counterfeit vial differs from genuine batch KE25012 by 17 differences; four people arrested. CDSCO alerted state drug controllers on 27 August to monitor movement and distribution of this batch. Indian Immunologicals Limited (IIL) says the batch was tested and released by CDL in November 2025; 83,370 vials were supplied through authorized channels, with no market complaints. The batch is reportedly not exported to any country. This follows Australian authorities’ December 2025 alert about counterfeit Abhayrab circulating since November 2023. IIL states every batch is independently tested before sale and has provided records to CDSCO.

triage.headline_ja: デリーで偽造抗狂犬病ワクチン「Abhayrab」を検出
triage.triage_reason: 偽造狂犬病ワクチンの流通が確認され、公衆衛生上の重大リスク（無効なワクチン使用による狂犬病死亡）と、医薬品サプライチェーンの異常事態として2つ以上のIHR基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 本件はインド・デリーで発生した偽造抗狂犬病ワクチン(Abhayrab)の流通事件。狂犬病自体のアウトブレイクではなく医薬品偽造・品質管理の問題。オーストラリアでの偽造品流通報告は別バッチであり、今回検出されたバッチは輸出実績なしとされる。現時点で健康被害の報告はないが、偽造ワクチン使用による狂犬病予防失敗のリスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Com duas mortes confirmadas e outra suspeita por febre maculosa, cidade interdita locais públicos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With two confirmed deaths and another suspected case of spotted fever, the city closes public spaces.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed deaths from Rocky Mountain spotted fever in Jeceaba, a town of about 6,000 in central Minas Gerais, Brazil, with a third death under investigation. The third patient died after being transferred to Belo Horizonte on Sept 4; laboratory confirmation for the ongoing case is pending from Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed). Since Sept 3, the city has closed public spaces near possible tick foci as part of outbreak control and prevention. Access is temporarily restricted until tick sources are eliminated, with health guidance and education targeted at people who frequent wooded areas, trails, farms, fishing spots, and other tick-prone sites. The Health Secretariat was contacted for confirmation. Municipal actions include attention to stray animals and urging fishermen to take extra precautions. People are advised to wear long clothing, inspect for ticks after outdoor activities, and seek health care if symptoms arise, informing exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）で死者2名確認、疑い1名により都市が公共施設を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州の小都市で紅斑熱による死亡者が複数発生し、公共施設閉鎖などの行政対応がとられており、重症度・曝露継続・社会的関心の観点でスクリーニング基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（febre maculosa）はマダニ媒介性で人-人感染はしないため国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし地域内での複数死亡と行政による公共空間閉鎖など重症度・社会的関心が高く、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ernakulam continues to report highest number of influenza cases
article.articleSummary: Ernakulam district continues to report the highest influenza caseload in the State, with September trends showing no abatement. Of the 607 State cases in the first five days of September, 274 are from Ernakulam, with five deaths this month. In August, the State logged over 2,700 cases, 954 of which were from Ernakulam. The year-to-date total reaches 9,377 cases with 104 deaths. District Medical Officer Dr. R. Shahirsha stresses there is no cause for concern, attributing high numbers to a mobile population and increased testing that boosts reporting; social distancing and mask use are advised. Dr. G. Sathyajith Nair of the IAP Kochi Branch notes a decreasing severity and forecasts cases may dip in two months post-pandemic. Vaccination is emphasized, with vaccinated children least affected.)

triage.headline_ja: エルナクラム県、引き続きインフルエンザ症例数が州内最多
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行であり、地元医療当局も『懸念なし』と説明。異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 地元医療当局（DMO及びIAP Kochi支部医師）が、症例増加はモバイル人口と検査数増加によるもので重症度は低下傾向にあると説明しており、季節性インフルエンザの通常パターンと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na RDC: número de mortos ultrapassa 3 mil. O alerta dos bispos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: death toll surpasses 3,000. The bishops' warning.
article.articleSummary: As of 5 September 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 3,000 and infected about 6,200 across six provinces, the second and most transmissible Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. The Bundibugyo variant is circulating; no specific approved remedy exists, though emergency vaccinations are underway. The epidemic, which began in three zones, has expanded to roughly sixty health zones, with approximately 60% of deaths occurring outside specialized medical centers due to armed conflict and displacement. WHO and Flowminder are using anonymized mobile data to track movements and forecast hotspots, with Kisangani highlighted as a potential risk site. The international community is urged to provide $1.3 billion to support Kinshasa. Authorities have reopened schools with hygiene kits and distancing measures; if a contagion is detected, schools may close and shift to radio-based lessons.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：死者数3,000人超え、司教団が警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 6州に拡大し死者3,000人超・感染約6,200人という大規模流行で、武力紛争により医療アクセスが制限され、国際支援（13億ドル）が要請されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模かつ最も伝播力の高いエボラ流行とされ、Bundibugyoバリアントが原因。武力紛争・住民移動により医療アクセスが制限され、死亡の約60%が医療施設外で発生。WHOとFlowminderが移動データで拡散予測、Kisanganiがリスク地点として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Madhya Pradesh Adivasi Children Deaths: How Measles, Malaria Killed 29 Children in Balaghat
article.articleSummary: Measles and malaria triggered a deadly outbreak in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, killing 29 Adivasi children in Birsa block, though government records list 25 deaths. Victims, mainly Baiga and Gond children, showed high fever, rashes, cough, vomiting and periorbital swelling. First deaths were reported in Matla and Bondari; by late July Bondari was the outbreak’s center, with at least one sick child in every of its 103 homes. Lab tests gave strong evidence: NITHR found measles in 21/47 samples and malaria in 8/16; Jabalpur Medical College later detected measles virus in 17/64 serum samples and malaria parasites in 50/96. Measles may have spread due to low vaccination. Limited healthcare access: 5 km to the nearest sub-centre with no doctor; no ASHA workers; 72 vacant ASHA posts, 48 in Birsa block. Delayed response raises questions on vaccination, early detection, and outreach.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州アディヴァシ児童死亡事件：麻疹とマラリアがバラガット地区で29人の子供を死に至らしめた経緯
triage.triage_reason: インド・マディヤ・プラデーシュ州の先住民居住地区で麻疹とマラリアの複合アウトブレイクにより29人の児童が死亡し、低ワクチン接種率と医療アクセス欠如が背景にあることから、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の2項目が該当しPICKUPと判断した。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUkraine（Bondari, Odeska Oblast）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはインド・マディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガット地区の事案であり、Bondariは同州内の集落名と推測されるため、Ukraineは主題と無関係として除外した。ワクチンで予防可能な麻疹による多数死亡は、対策不十分・医療アクセス欠如という構造的問題を示唆しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities probing 'counterfeit' rabies vaccine, says drug regulator
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, authorities flagged batch KE25012 of Abhayrab rabies vaccine as not of standard quality and misbranded after a potency test failure by the Central Drugs Laboratory in Kasauli, Himachal Pradesh. The vials were seized on 22 April from Delhi residence during a police action. The batch comprised 83,370 vials, released on 7 November 2025 and distributed through Indian Immunologicals Ltd HBI network. The CDL found 17 differences between the questioned vials and genuine samples. Four people have been arrested; investigations aim to establish manufacture origin and whether patients were exposed. DCGI has asked State controllers to vigilantly monitor KE25012. IIL says KE25012 was not produced by the company; seized vials did not match the genuine product, suggesting counterfeit material may bear the batch number. No export of this batch has been confirmed, and this follows a 2025 counterfeit episode KA24014 with warnings about travellers receiving counterfeit vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 当局、'偽造'狂犬病ワクチンを調査中と薬事規制当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: 偽造狂犬病ワクチン（バッチKE25012、83,370本）がインドで流通し、患者への曝露が懸念される。狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%であり、公衆衛生への重大な影響と異常性からIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、偽造ワクチンの流通による公衆衛生リスク事案。狂犬病ワクチンが無効であった場合、暴露患者が致死的転帰をたどる可能性があるため重大性が高い。輸出の有無は未確認だが、過去にも同様の偽造事例（KA24014）があり継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Conceição de Ipanema reforça vigilância contra a leishmaniose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Conceição de Ipanema reinforces surveillance against leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis surveillance is underway in Conceição de Ipanema, Brazil, where health teams are conducting mosquito collections at several residences to analyze samples and identify potential vectors linked to disease transmission. The activity aims to monitor the presence of these insects, map areas needing targeted attention, and inform control measures. Results from laboratory analyses will determine whether additional interventions are required. If risk levels justify action, authorities may implement measures in the identified areas, including insecticide applications. The initiative is part of the municipality’s health surveillance efforts to anticipate risks, strengthen prevention, and enhance population protection. Community teams’ participation supports monitoring local conditions and enabling appropriate responses. The report is provided by Jornal Panorama with information and image from the Prefeitura de Conceição de Ipanema.

triage.headline_ja: コンセイソン・デ・イパネマ、リーシュマニア症対策の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常のベクター監視活動であり、異常な流行や重症例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響も認められないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体による通常のリーシュマニア症媒介蚊調査・監視活動を報じたもので、症例急増や異常事態の記載はない。地方自治体レベルの日常的な公衆衛生活動であり、国レベルでの対象国リスト該当イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Virukset | Afrikkalainen sikaruttovirus eli pahkasioissa ja punkeissa ennen kuin iski kesysikoihin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viruses | African swine fever virus, i.e., in warthogs and ticks before it struck domestic pigs.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever virus (ASFV) is a deadly DNA arbovirus circulating in Africa among warthogs and ticks before it struck domestic pigs. The first major outbreak in tame pigs occurred in Kenya in 1907; it took 14 years to confirm a new virus and to trace transmission between ticks and warthogs. By the 1960s, ticks in warthog burrows were known to harbour the virus, forming a cycle that harms neither species. The virus’s origin remains unknown, with no close relatives; its closest links are hypothesized to be viruses of sea-ear mollusks and amoebae, implying a multi-million-year history with soil reservoirs. In domestic pigs, ASFV evades early immunity and later triggers a cytokine storm and fatal hemorrhagic fever; wild boars show a different course. Vaccines are difficult: the genome encodes about 150–170 proteins, and live-attenuated vaccines risk recombination, as seen in China in the 2020s. ASFV is an arbovirus that is DNA-based, unlike typical RNA arboviruses.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス｜アフリカ豚熱ウイルスは家畜豚を襲う前、イボイノシシとダニの間で存在していた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASFVの起源・生物学・歴史に関する科学解説記事であり、現在進行中の発生事象を報告するものではないため、シグナルとして扱う必要はない。
triage.notes: 記事はASFVの進化史・免疫回避機序・ワクチン開発の困難さを解説する科学記事。ケニアでの1907年発生や2020年代の中国でのワクチン組換え事例は歴史的言及であり、現行の発生地域はケニア（対象国リスト外）であるため、対象国での現行イベントとしてのverified_locationsは該当なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Mainpuri News: नौ संदिग्ध मरीजों की हुई स्वाइन फ्लू की जांच, भेजे सेंपल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainpuri News: Nine suspected patients were tested for swine flu; samples sent.
article.articleSummary: Mainpuri, Uttar Pradesh, reports rising swine flu (H1N1) fears as nine suspected patients were tested on Saturday and samples sent to Saifai Medical College; 200 vials dispatched for testing and results are expected on Monday. If positive, patients will be admitted to the Safe House facility prepared by the health department for swine flu management. Separately, monsoon rains coincide with increased snakebite cases in Mainpuri: a man near Ashram Road Amrud Tree and a 40-year-old woman from Sevarampur were bitten and admitted to the district hospital, with treatment ongoing. In Ghior area, a 1.5-year-old boy, Kartik, suffered a scald injury after hot vegetable spilled on him; after initial care at a private facility, he was moved to the district emergency and referred to Saifai Medical College for urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: マインプリ・ニュース：疑い患者9名の豚インフルエンザ検査を実施、検体送付
triage.triage_reason: 地域的なH1N1疑い例の検査段階であり確定診断は未報告。季節性インフルエンザの範疇である可能性が高いが、続報（検査結果）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)は例年インドで報告されており、地方病院レベルでの対応可能な事例。検査結果（月曜日発表予定）待ちのため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Centre, Madhya Pradesh Scale Up Health Response to Balaghat Fever Outbreak; No New Measles Case in a Week
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh, traced to Birsa block since mid-July 2026, with fever, fever-with-rash and deaths among tribal communities in Birsa and Baihar blocks. By 5 September 2026, 32,433 people have been medically screened and 14,637 children aged 1–10 received an additional MR vaccine dose. Of admitted cases, 431 children were treated; 379 discharged, 52 under care. No new measles case reported in the past seven days. The response, led by the Centre and MP government with NJORT, includes ICMR, NCVBDC, and Jabalpur/NIC teams; surveillance expanded to about 50 villages. Officials cite deaths from multiple causes—measles, malaria, co-infections, dehydration, malnutrition, anaemia, and shock—rather than a single pathogen. Six Mobile Medical Units, over 10 doctors and CHOs, fever screening, OPD, nutrition support, water purification (600 sources), and insecticide spraying (4,338 households) are active. Dastak 2026 screens ~158,000 children with Vitamin A follow-up; temporary hospital at Kundekasa; reinforced PHCs.

triage.headline_ja: 中央政府とマディヤ・プラデーシュ州、バラガート熱性疾患アウトブレイクへの保健対応を強化――麻疹の新規症例は1週間発生なし
triage.triage_reason: 部族地域における麻疹アウトブレイクで死亡例・入院例が多数発生し、中央政府とNJORT・ICMR等が大規模介入を行っており、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性）に該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 死亡は麻疹単独ではなく、マラリア・共感染・脱水・栄養不良等複合要因とされている。既に新規麻疹症例は7日間報告されておらず、収束傾向にあるが、部族地域での大規模死亡・入院は公衆衛生上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Jean-Jacques Muyembe: Er schickte das Virus im Handgepäck
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jean-Jacques Muyembe: He Sent the Virus in His Carry-On Luggage
article.articleSummary: Jean-Jacques Muyembe, a Congolese virologist, helped spark Ebola’s discovery. In 1976, in Yambuku, Democratic Republic of the Congo, he collected blood samples under life-threatening conditions and sent them to Belgium, where the Ebola virus was first identified and later named. He stayed in the Congo, building research capacity and enforcing that Congolese biosamples be studied only in collaboration with Congolese teams. Through his institute, a new generation of scientists now works in high-security laboratories in the Congo on Ebola, Anthrax, and other pathogens, engaging international partners on equal terms. After subsequent Ebola responses, an early antibody approach in 1995 and the later development of the monoclonal antibody drug mAb114, Muyembe is being honored jointly with Peter Piot for half a century of pioneering work.

triage.headline_ja: ジャン=ジャック・ムイェンベ：彼は手荷物でウイルスを送った
triage.triage_reason: 1976年のエボラ発見の歴史的経緯と研究者の功績を紹介する歴史・人物記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的回顧・人物紹介であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola en RDC : les sociétés minières chinoises mobilisent 1 million de dollars - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response in the DRC: Chinese mining companies mobilize $1 million.
article.articleSummary: During the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Union of Chinese-capital mining companies in the DRC (USMCC) pledged $1,000,000 to support the government's response. The donation was officially delivered in Kinshasa on September 5, in a ceremony attended by the Chinese ambassador Zhao Bin and Mines Minister Louis Watum Kabamba. The gesture follows an August 19 appeal by the minister urging sector operators to contribute according to their means to bolster containment and care for affected communities. Beijing’s envoy framed the contribution as corporate responsibility and solidarity, highlighting the role of mining firms in the crisis-affected areas where they operate. This initial contribution could pave the way for broader private-sector engagement to reinforce Ebola response capacity in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ対応：中国系鉱山会社が100万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する記事であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）が2つ以上該当するためフルリスク評価へ進める。
triage.notes: 記事自体は中国系鉱山企業による資金拠出という支援活動の報道であり、新規感染拡大の情報は含まれていないが、既知のDRCエボラアウトブレイクの継続的深刻性を示すため、既存事案の進展として引き続き監視・評価が必要。中国（北京）は資金拠出元であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 6 400 cas confirmés depuis le début de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 6,400 confirmed cases since the start of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues across six provinces and 60 health zones as of September 3, 2026. Ituri remains the principal focal point of transmission, while Sud-Kivu has recorded 95 days without a new confirmed case. Since the outbreak began, 6,436 cases have been confirmed, with 1,495 patients recovered and 3,095 deaths, giving a case fatality rate of 48.1%. Currently, 738 patients are in isolation or hospitalized. Robust contact tracing remains strong at 88.5%. Field response teams are conducting ongoing epidemiologic surveillance, alert investigations, patient care, and intensified prevention and community engagement efforts to curb transmission. The report date is September 5, 2026, reflecting the situation through September 3, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：発生開始以来6,400例以上の感染確定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで6カ国州・60保健地域にわたり継続し、致死率48.1%と極めて深刻。IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心・支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 大規模かつ長期化するエボラアウトブレイクであり、既存の継続事案として既にRRA対象となっている可能性が高いが、症例数増加の続報として改めてPICKUP評価とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kolkata croaks its way through temp swings after viral surge onslaught
article.articleSummary: Post-viral throat infection surge hits Kolkata amid an ongoing viral outbreak that has affected thousands with swine flu and Influenza A, B, and parainfluenza. Temperature swings and humidity spurred co-circulation of rhinovirus, metapneumovirus, RSV, influenza viruses and adenovirus, triggering upper respiratory infections with sore throat, throat pain, difficulty swallowing and a croaking voice. Last week, clinics saw a surge as these infections produced a nagging cough; the outbreak could continue for about a fortnight more as temperatures stabilise. Charnock Hospital, BP Poddar, Manipal, Peerless and RTIICS report many patients, with youngsters most affected and elderly or those with comorbidities at higher risk. Two admissions involved secondary bacterial infections progressing to pneumonia. Treatments are largely symptomatic; antibiotics do not treat viruses. Advice includes warm water, anti-cough lozenges, steam inhalation, and avoiding rapid temperature changes and frequent AC exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 気温変動の中、ウイルス感染急増後にコルカタで喉の症状が広がる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の気温変動に伴う複数呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザ、RSV、メタニューモウイルス等）の同時流行であり、多くは対症療法で対応可能だが、豚インフルエンザ含む流行の継続性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 季節性の気温変動による複数ウイルスの共循環（ライノウイルス、メタニューモウイルス、RSV、インフルエンザ、アデノウイルス）で、地域病院が多数の患者を報告。一部で二次性細菌感染から肺炎へ進行した例あり。約2週間程度で収束見込みとの予測あり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Sud-Kivu : près de 450 cas suspects de choléra dont 13 décès notifiés en une semaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Kivu: nearly 450 suspected cholera cases, including 13 deaths reported in one week.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. In week 33 of 2026 (late August–early September), 449 suspected cholera cases and 13 deaths were recorded across 34 health zones, with 17 zones reporting at least one case. The most affected areas are Kimbi-Lulenge, Bunyakiri, Shabunda, Mulungu, and Ibanda in Bukavu. Of the 13 deaths, 9 occurred in health facilities and 4 in communities. The Division provinciale de la santé au Sud-Kivu (DPS) reported intensified follow-up of admitted cases and ensured continued supply of inputs to health zones. Cumulative cholera cases in South Kivu surpass 11,100 with 195 deaths since the start of 2026. The DPS release was issued September 4, 2026, indicating persistent transmission and ongoing public health response.

triage.headline_ja: 南キブ州：1週間で疑いコレラ症例約450件、うち13人死亡と報告
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州で持続的なコレラ流行が続いており、1週間で449例・13死亡、累計11,100例・195死亡に達しており、公衆衛生上の影響が大きく行政（DPS）の関与も見られるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil（Paraíba州、Mulungu）が含まれるが、記事内容はDRC南キブ州のコレラ流行に限定されており、Brazilは地名の同名一致によるノイズと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les entreprises minières chinoises font un don d'un million USD pour soutenir la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Chinese mining companies donate one million USD to support the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Union of Chinese-Capital Mining Companies in DRC (USMCC) donated US$1 million to the government to bolster the Ebola virus disease response. The gesture responds to an appeal by Mines Minister Louis Watum Kabamba for mining-sector actors to support state efforts against the outbreak. The official handover took place at the Mines Ministry, attended by Chinese ambassador Zhao Bin and representatives of Chinese-led mining firms. Minister Kabamba praised the contribution as strengthening efforts to confront the epidemic and protect affected communities, in line with President Félix Tshisekedi’s vision. Ambassador Zhao Bin said the donation reflects Chinese mining companies’ commitment to national solidarity and enhanced corporate social responsibility for Congolese communities. The minister had called on mining partners to mobilize within their capacities on 19 August to aid the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：中国系鉱山企業がエボラ対策支援のため100万米ドルを寄付
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラウイルス病流行に対する国際的な資金支援の動きであり、エボラという重篤な疾患の流行が継続していることを示すため、IHR基準（深刻性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。ただし本記事自体は寄付のニュースであり新規の疫学的進展情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCで進行中のエボラウイルス病流行への中国系鉱山企業による資金支援に関する報道であり、新規感染者数や地域拡大等の疫学的詳細は含まれていない。既存アウトブレイクの継続的な国際的関心・支援動員を示す情報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: Prefeitura de Jeceaba inicia campanha após casos de febre maculosa e 3 mortes - Correio de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: Jeceaba City Hall launches a campaign after cases of Brazilian spotted fever and 3 deaths - Correio de Minas
article.articleSummary: Jeceaba, Minas Gerais, Brazil reports a rising Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) outbreak, triggering a city-wide campaign by the City Hall's Health Department. In 2025, five cases were notified, two awaiting confirmation, with three deaths. Preventive actions include the temporary closure of public areas near tick foci to prevent exposure while foci are eliminated. Health teams are educating residents about transmission, symptoms, risk areas, and prevention, with emphasis on woods, trails, farms, fishing sites, and other tick-prone locales. The presence of capybaras along the Camapuã River (a tributary of Paraopeba) may sustain the star tick cycle in urban-adjacent areas. Actions are coordinated with multiple municipal agencies; for homeless animals, Agriculture and Environment authorities will assess measures. Fishermen are advised to wear long clothing, inspect after exposure, and seek healthcare if fever, headache, body aches, or malaise develop, reporting any risk exposure.

triage.headline_ja: アラート：ジェセアバ市役所がブラジル紅斑熱（febre maculosa）の症例と3名の死亡を受けてキャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高い紅斑熱の局地的発生（5例中3死亡）があり、ダニ媒介の環境的曝露継続と自治体の対応強化（キャンペーン開始）が確認されるため、経過確認のためピックアップと判断。
triage.notes: 本疾患はダニ媒介性でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし致死率が高く（3/5〜7例）、カピバラを介したダニサイクルの持続が懸念されるため、地域の公衆衛生対応状況を注視する必要がある。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur News : 4 महीने के मासूम को स्वाइन फ्लू, 55 साल का पेशेंट भी वेंटिलेटर पर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur News: Four-month-old infant has swine flu, a 55-year-old patient is also on a ventilator.
article.articleSummary: Four-month-old infant and a 55-year-old man in Kanpur have been confirmed with H1N1 swine influenza, signaling broader age-range spread. The 55-year-old is critically ill and on a ventilator at LLR Hospital, with test results pending (expected by Monday). The four-month-old was admitted with swine flu symptoms at Royal Children’s Hospital and subsequently taken to a private hospital in Lucknow for advanced care. A 30-year-old Kannauj district resident from the village Tera Jacket, Gurusahayganj died after hospital admission for abdominal pain; initial diagnosis was viral pneumonia, but postmortem testing confirmed H1N1. Health authorities are increasing vigilance, tracing contacts, testing hospital staff and close contacts, and monitoring severe respiratory infections across hospitals. Symptoms typically include breathing difficulties and pneumonia-like illness; vaccination and infection-control measures are being emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールニュース：生後4ヶ月の乳児が豚インフルエンザに感染、55歳の患者も人工呼吸器を装着
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）のインド国内での複数症例・死亡例だが、既知の疾患であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。重症例と死亡があり地域の医療監視強化が続いている点は注視が必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の疾患であり、毎年インド各地で流行が報告される。今回は複数の重症例・死亡例（乳児、高齢者、若年成人）があり、地域内での接触者追跡・医療従事者検査が行われている点から経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Tambaram steps up dengue prevention measures ahead of monsoon | Chennai News
article.articleSummary: Tambaram Corporation, Chennai, ahead of northeast monsoon, has stepped up dengue prevention, deploying 700 mosquito-breeding control workers across 70 wards to identify and eliminate breeding sites. In the last week, officials inspected 1.2 lakh houses and destroyed over 4,500 breeding sources, including stagnant pools, discarded tyres, coconut shells, garden pots and rooftop water. Abate larvicide is used in overhead tanks and stagnant water; fogging is carried out daily with vehicle-mounted and handheld machines in bus stands, markets, schools and other hotspots. Special fever camps with the health department screen residents and identify cases early. Commissioner S Balachander said owners of vacant plots, locked or vacant houses, and new construction sites will be issued notices under Section 61 of the Tamil Nadu Public Health Act 1939; non-compliance may incur fines, with cleaning costs recovered. Residents are advised to scrub and cover water storage containers and prevent stagnation around homes.

triage.headline_ja: タンバラム、モンスーンを前にデング熱予防対策を強化 | チェンナイニュース
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防対策に関する通常業務の記事であり、異常な発生や重症例の急増は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政による予防的な蚊媒介対策（幼虫駆除、燻蒸、発熱キャンプ等）を報じたものであり、具体的な患者数や死亡者数、アウトブレイクの発生は記載されていない。地方自治体レベルの通常の季節対策のためverified_locationsは空とした（デング熱自体は毎年インドで流行する既知の疾患であり特筆すべき異常性はない）。

article.articleHeadline: Global research trends in childhood Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia studies
article.articleSummary: Bowler and Pammi’s bibliometric analysis in Pediatric Research (2026) maps the global research landscape on pediatric Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia. In the post-COVID era, a renewed and aggressive resurgence is noted in Europe, North America, and East Asia after near-silence during mitigation measures. The study treats literature as data, tracing publications, collaboration networks, and thematic emphasis to reveal how attention aligns with disease burden and outbreaks. Research output is substantial but uneven, dominated by China, the United States, and other high-income settings. A central concern is macrolide resistance: 23S rRNA mutations at positions 2063, 2064, and 2617 have driven high resistance in parts of East Asia (often >80–90%), complicating therapy and shifting use toward tetracyclines and fluoroquinolones with age-related cautions. Diagnostic capacity is a bottleneck; culture is slow, and access to PCR/serology/panels is uneven, limiting surveillance where needed.

triage.headline_ja: 小児マイコプラズマ肺炎研究における世界的研究動向
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は文献の書誌学的分析（研究動向レビュー）であり、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイク報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は学術的な書誌学的分析（bibliometric analysis）であり、具体的な国・地域での新規発生イベントを報告するものではない。マクロライド耐性の問題等は言及されているが、既知の傾向のレビューであり新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Phế cầu kháng thuốc gia tăng, trẻ nhỏ đối mặt nguy cơ bệnh nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Antibiotic-resistant pneumococcus on the rise, young children face risk of severe disease.
article.articleSummary: Antibiotic-resistant Streptococcus pneumoniae is rising in Vietnam, increasing risk of invasive disease such as meningitis, sepsis, and pneumonia in young children. Surveillance at Ho Chi Minh City’s Children’s Hospital 1 and 2 (2012–2021) shows pneumococcus as the leading cause of bacterial meningitis in children under 5 (86.1%), followed by Haemophilus influenzae (7.6%) and Neisseria meningitidis (6.3%). A National Pediatric Hospital study of 274 invasive pneumococcal disease cases (2019–2022) recorded 24 deaths, with 84.7% of fatalities in the under-5 group. Antibiotic resistance is rising: 75.3% of invasive pneumococcal strains resistant to third-generation cephalosporins; erythromycin and clindamycin resistance are also high. Transmission can occur from asymptomatic adults. Vaccination remains important to reduce risk for covered strains, though not all; follow recommended schedules. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, avoiding close contact with sick individuals, and monitoring for warning signs; peak around August–September with school return, in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 薬剤耐性肺炎球菌が増加、幼い子どもが重症化リスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける薬剤耐性肺炎球菌の増加を報告する解説的記事で、既存サーベイランスデータに基づく季節性の注意喚起であり新規アウトブレイクではないが、小児の重症化・死亡例や高い抗菌薬耐性率は公衆衛生上注視すべき情報である。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、2012-2022年の既存サーベイランスデータに基づく薬剤耐性傾向の解説記事。季節性（8-9月に増加）の注意喚起であり、緊急のシグナルというよりは継続的な公衆衛生課題として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: 11 fresh H1N1 cases take caseload to 63 so far
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, Lucknow reported 11 new H1N1 (swine flu) cases, bringing the season total to 63. Among the new cases, 2 were hospitalised and 9 are in home isolation. Overall, 20 H1N1 patients have required hospitalisation; of these, 17 have recovered and been discharged, leaving 3 still in hospital. CMO office advised that patients with high fever accompanied by chest pain, breathlessness, low blood pressure, unconsciousness, bluish nail discoloration, or blood in sputum should be treated as serious cases, undergo Real-Time RT-PCR testing, and be hospitalised if required. Dr NB Singh stressed urgent medical attention for anyone with worsening pre-existing serious or chronic illnesses. The article does not provide details on the infection source or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: H1N1新規11例、累計63例に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の地域内流行で、重症例は少なく地元医療機関で対応可能な通常の公衆衛生報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の定例的な症例報告であり、地元保健当局(CMO)が通常の対応指針を発表している。重症化率・入院率は低く、17/20が回復済み。特段の異常性や国際的懸念は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura mineira adota medidas para conter surto de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais city hall adopts measures to contain a human scabies outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Scabies outbreak in Alfenas, a city in southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, with more than 150 cases since late August. To curb transmission, the municipal government formed a task force and suspended classes in the municipal network; the September 7 parade was also cancelled as a preventive measure. On 4 September, the health department announced weekend attendance for suspected cases at the Caic ambulance post at Escola Municipal Doutor João Januário Magalhães, open 8:00–12:00. Earlier, a coordination meeting on 28 August established a monitoring committee. In the local prison, cases have been reported for about three months, but no current inmates with symptoms. In the municipal schools, 50 confirmed cases among students and staff across five schools; only Dona Zinica and Dona Vanja Cemeis had seven-day suspensions. Transmission is person-to-person via prolonged contact; symptoms include intense nighttime itching and lesions in warm, moist areas; treatment rapidly reduces transmission within 24–48 hours.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の市庁、疥癬(ヒゼンダニ症)の集団発生を抑えるための対策を導入
triage.triage_reason: 地域限定の疥癬集団発生で重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低いが、学校閉鎖など公衆衛生対応が取られており動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疥癬は通常国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはみなされないが、学校・刑務所など集団施設での感染拡大が見られるため局地的な監視対象として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Response must outpace spread of Ebola: UN relief chief
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak is growing exponentially, with Ituri Province accounting for more than 5,000 of over 6,100 confirmed cases and 2,950 deaths reported by Monday. The outbreak is described by the UN as the fastest-growing Ebola event on record, following the Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC declared on 15 May; in the first 100 days the Bundibugyo event tallied 5,515 cases and 2,642 deaths, underscoring the scale. The UN warns that a $1.1 billion funding gap hampers response, despite scaling up operations, with IOM screening nearly 23 million people across DRC and neighboring countries to curb spread. The CERF has allocated over $57 million to Ebola response and preparedness. The crisis is aggravated by eastern DRC conflict displacing communities; MONUSCO expands protection and related programs. Uganda recently declared an outbreak ended due to rapid measures; authorities urge sustained political will, access, and resources to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 対応はエボラの拡大速度を上回らなければならない：国連救済責任者
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が急速に拡大しており（6,100例超、死亡2,950人）、史上最速の増加とされ、資金不足・紛争による対応困難も重なり国際的関心が高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に終息宣言済みのため対象国リストに含まれるが、現時点で活動的な発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めず。UgandaはGeoNames対象国リストにも含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 24 ashramshala students hospitalised with fever & cold after girl dies
article.articleSummary: 24 girl students at Visapur ashramshala in Kalwan taluka, Nashik district, Maharashtra, were hospitalized with fever and cold on Friday evening after an eight-year-old Std II student died earlier at Kalwan sub-district hospital. Doctors attributed the illnesses to a seasonal viral infection; all admitted students are stable and not in critical condition. The eight-year-old fell ill on Wednesday and died around 2 am on Friday. Authorities noted there is no outbreak or unusual disease, describing the spike as monsoon-related airborne illness. District collector Ayush Prasad ordered immediate health checks in tribal ashramshalas and hostels, emphasizing fever, cough, flu, and contagion prevention. Students raised concerns about food, drinking water, and facilities, prompting calls for a comprehensive inquiry and possible changes to the central kitchen system.

triage.headline_ja: 女子生徒の死亡後、24人のアシュラムシャラ(寄宿学校)生徒が発熱・風邪で入院
triage.triage_reason: 1人の死亡と24人の入院が発生しているが、当局は季節性ウイルス感染によるもので『アウトブレイクではない』と説明しており、死亡例と入院例の因果関係や病原体の確定情報が不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 地元寄宿学校（アシュラムシャラ）内での発熱・風邪の集団発生と1名の児童死亡。当局は季節性・モンスーン関連の呼吸器疾患とし、アウトブレイクを否定。死亡した児童の死因が他の入院例と同一かは記事から不明。食事・飲料水・施設環境への懸念が指摘されており、地元行政（郡長）が健康チェックを指示。国際的な拡大リスクは低いが、寄宿舎という集団生活環境でのヒト-ヒト感染可能性は要観察。

article.articleHeadline: 1,170 new TB cases detected in Solan during six-month campaign - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Solan district detected 1,170 new tuberculosis cases during a six-month intensive screening campaign, screening over 25,000 people in 637 vulnerable villages via Nikshay camps. Test reports confirmed TB in these individuals; 29 were multi-drug resistant (MDR-TB), requiring specialized, prolonged treatment; MDR-TB medicines cost about Rs 60,000 per course and are provided free by the government. The campaign, initially planned for 100 days, extended to six months to allow thorough screening of family members and other at-risk populations; Nikshay camps will be organized regularly. Solan records an average of more than 2,000 new TB cases annually. Family members identified are offered TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) and regular symptom screening to prevent transmission. The effort uses the central government’s Vulnerability Mapping for Tuberculosis (VMTB) AI tool to target high-risk villages and urban wards.

triage.headline_ja: ソラン地区、6か月間のキャンペーンで新規結核患者1,170人を検出
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核のスクリーニングキャンペーンによる検出数増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、定例の公衆衛生活動として管理されている。
triage.notes: インド国内での既存の結核対策プログラム（Nikshayキャンプ、VMTBツール活用）の一環であり、政府主導で管理されているため対象国リストへの該当なし（結核は日常的な疾患管理事案としてスクリーニング対象外と判断）。

article.articleHeadline: المخطوطات القديمة تكشف تاريخ جدري الأغنام الممتد لآلاف السنين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ancient manuscripts reveal the history of sheep pox spanning thousands of years.
article.articleSummary: Sheep pox virus (ovine pox) genomes were reconstructed from ancient parchments and teeth, revealing a long, interconnected history of the disease across Europe and the Eurasian steppes. An international team led by University College Dublin, reporting in Science Advances on Sept 2, 2026, identified 21 ancient genomes of the virus. Evidence came from medieval European parchment, notably the York Gospels and the Codex Corpus, and from sheep teeth at ancient pastoral sites in Eurasia. The oldest direct genetic signal dates to circa 1700 BCE (about 3700 years ago). Comparisons with modern strains show the virus’s genome remained relatively stable over millennia, including an ancient European lineage that later vanished. Researchers used non-invasive surface swabbing to extract DNA and proteins without damaging the manuscripts, highlighting parchments and leather as biological archives for investigating historical animal diseases and their origins.

triage.headline_ja: 古代の写本が数千年にわたる羊痘の歴史を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代DNA研究に関する歴史・学術的内容であり、現在進行中の感染症流行や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代の羊痘ウイルスゲノム研究に関する学術論文の報道であり、現在の家畜疾病発生事例ではないため、対象国における現行の感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Regulator flags rabies vaccine batch as substandard, possibly spurious - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: India’s regulator flagged Abhayrab batch KE25012 as substandard after the CDSCO lab in Kasauli found potency shortfalls; the sample was labeled 'not of standard quality' and 'misbranded.' In an August 27 letter, the DCGI urged regulators to monitor movement and act, citing discrepancies with a retained reference sample. IIL says the tested vials did not originate from its production; it asserts the genuine KE25012 was independently tested and released by the Central Drugs Laboratory on 7 November 2025, with 83,370 vials distributed through authorised channels and no market complaints. The samples were collected from an unlicensed Delhi premises (Mukherjee Nagar); four people were arrested, and none of the batch was exported. Abhayrab, India's first Vero cell rabies vaccine, accounts for ~40% of domestic supply; India records ~9.1 million animal bites annually and ~5,726 rabies deaths. Counterfeit warnings were issued by the UK, US and Australia in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 規制当局、狂犬病ワクチンのバッチを規格外・偽造の疑いありとして指摘 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: インドの規制当局が狂犬病ワクチンの規格外・偽造疑いを指摘し、英国・米国・豪州も偽造警告を発出するなど国際的な関心が高まっており、致死率がほぼ100%の狂犬病予防に関わる重大な公衆衛生リスクであるため。
triage.notes: 本件は狂犬病の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、狂犬病ワクチン（Abhayrab）の規格外・偽造疑いに関する医薬品品質問題。ただし狂犬病は未治療で致死率がほぼ100%であり、インドは年間約5,726人の狂犬病死亡者を記録していることから、偽造ワクチンの流通は深刻な公衆衛生リスクとなりうる。市場での健康被害報告は現時点でなし。英国・米国・豪州は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة توضح أعراض فيروس إيبولا وكيفية الوقاية منه - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health clarifies the symptoms of the Ebola virus and how to prevent it - Sawt al-Ummah
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo escalates as authorities report widespread spread, with response efforts stretched beyond capacity. A UN Ebola coordinator warns that delays in support will heighten lethality and cost. Ebola infection typically begins with sudden fever and fatigue, followed by severe muscle and joint pain, headache, sore throat, and abdominal distress; many patients develop diarrhea, a rash, and kidney or liver impairment, and some experience internal or external bleeding. Incubation is 2–21 days, with symptoms usually emerging around day 8–10 after infection. Transmission occurs through direct contact with an infected person's blood or secretions (including saliva, sweat, vomit, stool, urine, semen), contaminated surfaces or equipment, and handling the dead during traditional funerals. Animal-to-human exposure can occur from bats, primates, or wild ungulates. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, avoiding contact with fluids or contaminated items, and strict infection prevention for healthcare workers, including isolation and full PPE.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラウイルスの症状と予防法を説明 - サウト・アルオンマ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大し、対応能力を超えているとUNコーディネーターが警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラの症状・予防に関する啓発的内容だが、コンゴ民主共和国東部での流行拡大と国連の支援不足への警告が主題となっており、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Com 36 casos e 11 mortes, Secretaria de Saúde investiga casos de febre maculosa em Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 36 cases and 11 deaths, the Health Department investigates cases of spotted fever in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Spotted fever (Brazilian spotted fever) caused by Rickettsia rickettsii and transmitted by the star tick is under active surveillance in Minas Gerais, Brazil. As of August 27, 36 confirmed cases and 11 deaths have been reported in the state. In Jeceaba, a central-region municipality, one death is confirmed and two more are under investigation, triggering a state alert. Last year Minas Gerais recorded 48 cases with 7 deaths; 2024 had 95 cases and 4 deaths, and 2023 had 90 cases with 20 deaths, indicating ongoing transmission. The disease often affects adults 41–60 and is more common in men; the fatality rate in Minas is about 30%. The SES-MG, in partnership with Funed and municipal health secretaries, conducts daily investigations, issues alerts, and monitors risk-area environments. Prevention focuses on avoiding star ticks via repellents (icaridin), light clothing, closed footwear, and prompt tick removal; treatment is early antibiotics through SUS.

triage.headline_ja: 36症例11死亡、ミナスジェライス州保健局が紅斑熱（斑点熱）の症例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約30%と重症度が高く、州として警戒を発令しているため社会的関心と重症度基準を満たすが、毎年発生する既知のダニ媒介性風土病でありヒト-ヒト感染や国際拡大の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 紅斑熱（Rickettsia rickettsii、ダニ媒介）はミナスジェライス州で毎年発生している既知の風土病。2023年90例(20死亡)、2024年95例(4死亡)、2025年48例(7死亡)、今年は36例(11死亡)と推移しており、致死率が高い点は懸念材料だが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。地方保健当局による日常的な調査・対策が継続中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Punjab records first suspected swine flu fatality as cases climb to 220 - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports the first suspected swine flu death of the season in Jalandhar as cases rise to 220 across the state. The deceased is 85-year-old Mool Raj, a COPD patient from Tajpur, Jamsher Khas, who tested positive for H1N1 on September 2 at GMC Amritsar and died at Civil Hospital, Jalandhar; health authorities say a formal audit will determine if H1N1 caused the death given his immunocompromised status. Since January, 1,513 suspected cases have been tested, with 220 positives; 14 positives were recorded on Friday. District totals show Ludhiana leading with 72, SAS Nagar 36, Patiala 16, Moga 11, Jalandhar 10, Fazilka 1, others 2–8. Health Minister Dr Balbir Singh says the circulating H1N1 strain is not new or mutated. Since August, Punjab has set up flu corners and isolation units to tackle the surge.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州、豚インフルエンザ感染者220人に増加、季節初の疑い死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: パンジャブ州でH1N1（豚インフルエンザ）症例が220件に増加し継続的な感染拡大がみられ、保健省が対応（フルーコーナー設置等）を行っている。WPRO基準（持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、メディア・行政の関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 死亡例は85歳のCOPD・免疫不全患者で、H1N1との因果関係は現在監査中。保健大臣は流行株が新種・変異株ではないと発言しており、季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の可能性が高い。ただし症例数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Badaun News: निजी पैथोलॉजी लैब को रोजाना देनी होगी संक्रामक रोगों की रिपोर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Badaun News: Private pathology labs will have to submit daily reports on infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: In Badaun district, private pathology labs that test for infectious diseases must submit daily reports to the health department detailing how many patients were tested and how many were confirmed with vector-borne or other infections. Upon finding suspected dengue or swine flu cases, the health department will conduct dengue ELISA and swine flu RT-PCR confirmations. Report-based diagnosis is not final; dengue or swine flu cannot be confirmed by private labs alone. If a private lab indicates dengue or suspected swine flu, the respective patients will undergo ELISA and RT-PCR testing at the district hospital and Government Medical College for confirmation, after which treatment will be provided. The Chief Medical Officer Dr. Vikas Sharma has instructed the Infectious Disease Control Cell to require daily reports from private labs on fever patients and their test outcomes to ensure accurate reporting.

triage.headline_ja: バダウン県ニュース:民間病理検査ラボは感染症の日次報告が義務化
triage.triage_reason: 行政上の報告体制強化に関する内容であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行状況の記載がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は地方衛生当局による感染症サーベイランス体制の行政通達であり、デング熱・豚インフルエンザの具体的な発生状況や症例数の報告ではない。対象国リストのIndiaが地理的に該当するが、内容が行政手続きに限定されるためverified_locationsも空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ஆட்சி மாறியதால் கடிக்காதே என கொசுக்களிடம் சொல்ல முடியாது.. டெங்கு பரவல் குறித்து மேற்கு வங்க அமைச்சர் கருத்து
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cannot tell the mosquitoes not to bite due to the change of government... West Bengal minister's comment on the spread of dengue.
article.articleSummary: West Bengal faces a dengue surge as vector-borne illnesses rise. In recent weeks, more than 4,000 people have contracted dengue and 7 have died, though Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari’s government says the outbreak is now under control and dengue cases are roughly halved from last year. Urban development and municipal administration minister Agnimitra Paul argued that governance changes do not justify telling mosquitoes not to bite, signaling continued stringent measures to curb transmission. Health minister Saratvath Mukherjee urged schools to require students to wear full-body clothing during dengue season. In a separate issue, a Park Street, Kolkata, sidewalk incident involving Agnimitra Paul drew criticism after she questioned a mother warming milk for her baby in public; the Chief Minister later met the family and arranged accommodation. The report underscores ongoing outbreak management and political controversy surrounding public health messaging.

triage.headline_ja: 「政権が変わったからといって蚊に噛むなとは言えない」…デング熱の流行に関する西ベンガル州大臣の発言
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州で例年通りの季節性デング熱流行が報告されているが、政府は「制御下にあり前年より半減」としており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の該当は限定的。政治的논란が主でありシグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、媒介動物由来疾患として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの西ベンガル州で毎年季節的に発生する風土病であり、今回の報告も例年の流行パターンの範囲内。政府自身が「制御下にあり前年比半減」と述べている点から、深刻な公衆衛生上の異常事態とは言えない。記事は主に政治家の発言を巡る社会的論争に焦点を当てている。

article.articleHeadline: Fluctuating Feb heat drives spike in respiratory, dehydration and gastro cases in Pune
article.articleSummary: Pune India February spike in upper respiratory infections URTI gastroenteritis dehydration and unusual rise in urinary tract infections as daytime temperatures rise and diurnal gaps widen. Clinicians report URTI and dehydration surging over the past two weeks, with four to five gastroenteritis cases and two to three dehydration cases daily, earlier than the typical late March April peak. Flu like symptoms and chronic coughs persist for two to three weeks. Gastro cases have doubled, linked to contaminated food and water, with heat accelerating spoilage. UTIs are rising in high heat conditions. Experts highlight diurnal shifts hot afternoons and cool evenings around 17°C and pollution as factors amplifying viral transmission. The observations come from Pune clinicians across Dhayari and Baner area hospitals; the article provides no laboratory confirmation and no discussion of imported or exported cases, attributing the trend to erratic weather and environmental factors.

triage.headline_ja: 2月の気温変動がプネーで呼吸器疾患、脱水症、胃腸炎の急増を招く
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の気候変動による一般的な体調不良の増加であり、検査確認や異常な病原体の報告もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性気候要因による呼吸器・胃腸症状の増加を報じるもので、検査室での病原体確認なし。特定の感染症アウトブレイクとしての特徴に乏しく、インフルエンザとの直接的な関連付けも明確ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de sarampo chegam a 28 no estado de São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases reach 28 in the state of São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases reach 28 in São Paulo state, Brazil. By Sep 1, 2026, 28 cases were confirmed: 25 in São Paulo city, 2 in São Bernardo do Campo, 1 in Guarulhos. The two new cases in the capital on Sep 1 involve a child under 1 year and a woman in her 40s. About 20 cases are among people unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. A targeted vaccination strategy and the Multivaccination Campaign ended on Sep 1, with advice to keep vaccination up to date. Vaccination: first dose at 12 months and second at 15 months for children; ages 15 months–29 years should have two doses at least 30 days apart; ages 30–59 should have at least one dose; healthcare workers two doses. Dose zero remains available for babies 6–11 months 29 days in São Paulo, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, including after exposure, but does not replace routine vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州の麻疹症例が28件に達する
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の局地的な集積が確認され未接種者に多いが、重篤な合併症や急速な拡大の報告はなく、フルRRAに進むほどの深刻性は現時点で不明。
triage.notes: 州保健当局によるワクチン接種キャンペーンなど対応が進行中であり、地域内で管理可能と見られる。未接種者中心の感染拡大があり、今後の症例数推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 兩日4宗兒童流感重症 6歲女併發腦病變危殆 - 20260906
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four severe pediatric influenza cases in two days; a 6-year-old girl develops encephalopathy and is in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Six children aged 3–15 in Hong Kong were hospitalized with severe influenza over two days, four cases influenza A and two influenza B. A 6-year-old girl developed fever and seizures; respiratory sample positive for influenza A and diagnosed with influenza A–associated encephalopathy; condition critical. Two other girls were diagnosed with influenza A with septic shock. A 14-year-old girl had influenza A with severe pneumonia and septic shock. A 3-year-old girl, after initial care at a private hospital, had seizures and was diagnosed with influenza A with septic shock, admitted to Princess Elizabeth Hospital ED before transfer to Queen Mary Hospital paediatric ICU. Two 15-year-old boys had influenza B with septic shock and hypotension; one was admitted to Queen Mary Hospital paediatric ICU. Lab confirmation by respiratory samples; cases occurred across several Hong Kong hospitals: Ruttonjee, Eastern District, United Christian, Princess Elizabeth, and Queen Mary Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で2日間に4件の小児重症インフルエンザ、6歳女児が脳症を発症し危篤
triage.triage_reason: 香港で短期間に複数の小児重症インフルエンザ症例（脳症・敗血症性ショック含む）が報告され、WPRO重症度基準に該当し、メディア報道による社会的関心も高いと判断されるため。
triage.notes: 香港（特別行政区）は対象国リストのChinaに含めて評価。季節性インフルエンザの重症小児例クラスターであり、病原体自体は新規性がないが、短期間での重症例集中は監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Microplastics may ferry chemicals, pathogens and antibiotic resistance
article.articleSummary: New Energy & Environment Nexus review (Sept 5, 2026) led by Jingliang Shi of Jiangxi Agricultural University argues microplastics function as mobile platforms—"pollutant shuttles"—carrying chemicals, pathogenic microorganisms, and antibiotic resistance genes across ecosystems, food webs, and interfaces between water, soil and air. Chemical dimension features the Trojan horse effect: hydrophobic surfaces adsorb persistent organic pollutants and metals, which desorb upon ingestion by organisms (filter feeders, plankton, fish, livestock). Nanoplastics (<1 μm) may cross membranes and deliver pollutants to internal organs, while larger particles largely release in the gut. Biologically, plastics form plastisphere biofilms that shelter pathogens and resistance genes, enabling horizontal gene transfer. A bidirectional feedback loop amplifies risks: pollutants shape microbial communities and biofilms alter surfaces to adsorb more contaminants. The authors propose a three-tiered regulatory framework addressing physical, chemical, and biological drivers.

triage.headline_ja: マイクロプラスチックは化学物質・病原体・薬剤耐性遺伝子を運ぶ可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症アウトブレイクではなく、マイクロプラスチックの環境影響に関する学術レビュー記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や地域特異的な発生事例は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、江西農業大学の研究者による環境科学レビュー論文の紹介記事。中国が発生地域として付与されているが、これは研究者の所属機関の所在地であり、実際の疾病発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Sete cavalos morrem em fazenda de Goiás; exame confirma raiva em um deles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven horses die on a farm in Goiás; a test confirms rabies in one of them.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-05, seven horses died at a farm about 20 km from Santa Helena de Goiás in southwestern Goiás, Brazil, with rabies laboratory-confirmed in one animal; the other six deaths are suspected since samples could not be collected from animals that had already died. The response involved Agrodefesa, Epidemiological Surveillance, and the municipal Health Department. Three workers with direct contact are being monitored and remain asymptomatic. The confirmed case likely resulted from bites by hematophagous bats (Desmodus rotundus) observed on the necks of the horses. After confirmation, authorities will monitor bat roosts and conduct capture and population control by licensed teams; producers should not handle bats. Forty cattle on the same property received the first anti-rabies vaccine, with a booster due in 21–30 days. Properties within 12 km are designated perifocal areas and require enhanced surveillance and vaccination; vaccination of susceptible species is mandated in confirmed-focus areas.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州の農場で馬7頭が死亡、うち1頭で狂犬病を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（馬）における狂犬病確認事例で、吸血コウモリが感染源と推定される。ヒトへの直接感染例はないが濃厚接触者3名を経過観察中であり、周辺地域での監視強化が行われているため注視が必要。
triage.notes: 動物間（馬）での狂犬病発生事例であり、ヒトへの感染は確認されていない（濃厚接触者3名は無症状）。吸血コウモリが感染源とされ、地域当局により周辺農場の監視・ワクチン接種等の対応が実施されている。人獣共通感染症として今後の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉:染疫医务人员近30%殉职
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Nearly 30% of infected healthcare workers have died in the line of duty.
article.articleSummary: Across the Democratic Republic of Congo, the current Ebola outbreak has caused 3,072 deaths and 6,342 confirmed cases, with Ituri Province the worst-hit among six provinces and 60 health zones affected. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain remains without a licensed vaccine. Kinshasa authorities on Sep 4 launched a new 180-day response plan with a budget of $1.3 billion aimed at halting transmission and reducing deaths. Healthcare workers have paid a heavy toll: 45 fatalities among 158 infections reported as of Aug 26, translating to nearly 30% case fatality in infected staff. The risk extends beyond physicians and nurses to midwives, laboratory personnel, aides, community workers, maintenance staff, and drivers. The most urgent gaps are in routine medical facilities where patients may be infectious before detection, and where SOPs and personal protective equipment are still insufficient compared with dedicated Ebola treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:感染した医療従事者の約30%が殉職
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行が6,342症例・3,072死亡に達し、医療従事者の致死率も約30%と深刻。複数州に拡大し国家的対応計画が発動されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 既存のDRCエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）の続報。ワクチン未承認、医療従事者の高い致死率、大規模対応予算（$1.3B/180日計画）が特徴。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が継続しているため、既存のRRAの更新または新規評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ổ dịch lở mồm long móng trên đàn bò ở Trần Phú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak detected in a herd of cattle in Trần Phú.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease outbreak detected in a cattle herd in Tran Phu ward, Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam. On September 3, in Tan An Hamlet, 25 of 37 cattle owned by Mr. Vo Tat Toan showed signs; samples sent to the II Diagnostic and Testing Station confirmed foot-and-mouth disease virus serotype O in one specimen. By September 4, two more cattle from two other households had signs, totaling 27 cattle across three households. Authorities launched immediate controls: disinfection spraying, lime powder for barns and routes, and a ban on grazing in residential areas. Affected animals are isolated; movement, sale, or transport from the outbreak area is prohibited. Ongoing investigations and surveillance are underway to assess disease status in Tan An and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: チャン・フー地区の牛の群れで口蹄疫の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物の口蹄疫発生であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は現時点でないが、家畜疫病としての拡大・貿易制限リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物感染症（口蹄疫）であり、ヒト感染事例の報告はなし。当局により隔離・移動禁止等の対応が既に開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄登革熱境外移入+3 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung: Three More Imported Dengue Fever Cases
article.articleSummary: On 5 September 2026, Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reported three newly imported dengue fever cases. A 59-year-old man in Sanmin District returned from Cambodia on 27 August; he developed fever and myalgia on 31 August, NS1 rapid test was positive, and PCR confirmed dengue virus type 1, with hospitalization and isolation commencing 3 September. The other two cases involve a 10-year-old girl and an 8-year-old girl who accompanied relatives to Vietnam; they developed fever and rash during the visit and, after arriving at Kaohsiung Airport, were taken to hospital where dengue NS1 rapid tests and PCR were positive. The bureau has initiated epidemiological investigations and activated emergency control measures around the patients’ residences and exposure sites to mitigate potential community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で登革熱の輸入症例が3件追加
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄における輸入性デング熱症例（カンボジア・ベトナムからの帰国者）の報告であり、対象国（台湾は対象外）における国内発生ではなく、通常の輸入例対応であるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国外）における輸入症例であり、感染源国としてカンボジア・ベトナムが言及されているが、これらの国での発生・流行を示す情報はない。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるため参考として記載したが、記事の主題は台湾国内の輸入症例対応であり、ベトナム国内の感染状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉:染疫醫務人員近30%殉職
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Nearly 30% of infected healthcare workers have died in the line of duty.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has caused 3,072 deaths and 6,342 confirmed cases, with Ituri province the most affected among six provinces and 60 health zones (including North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo). Healthcare workers are heavily impacted: as of August 26, 2026, 158 infections among medical staff and 45 deaths, about 30% mortality among infected personnel. WHO notes weak infection-control in routine facilities beyond Ebola treatment centers, affecting doctors, midwives, laboratory workers, aides, community staff, maintenance personnel, and drivers due to insufficient protocols and PPE. In response, DRC launched a six-month, $1.3 billion intervention in Kinshasa on September 4 to curb transmission and reduce deaths linked to the 17th Ebola outbreak. No licensed effective vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:感染した医療従事者の約30%が殉職
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が拡大し、死者3,072人・確定例6,342人、医療従事者の高い死亡率（約30%）、首都キンシャサでの大規模介入（13億ドル）が実施されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株には承認済みワクチンが存在せず、医療従事者の感染・死亡率が高いことから、感染制御の失敗と地域拡大のリスクが懸念される。国際的な資金・支援投入がすでに行われており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Watch out for 'counterfeit' batch of rabies vaccine: Drug regulator to states
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine counterfeit alert in India: DCGI warns states to monitor a specific Abhayrab batch after Delhi samples earlier this year were found not potent and misbranded. Packaging anomalies include apostrophe vs comma, misspelling of 'L Pasteur' as 'L Posteur', altered font/text spacing, and a changed company logo, suggesting it is not a genuine Indian Immunologicals product. The batch was never exported from India; the DCGI communication is dated 27 August 2026. CDSCO directs State Drug Controllers to alert inspectors and maintain strict vigilance over movement, distribution, and availability, with regulatory action as needed. Four persons were arrested by Delhi Police in connection with the case; investigation ongoing. Rabies is almost 100% fatal, and Abhayrab holds about 40% of India's rabies vaccine market. International regulators (UK, US, Australia) scrutinized counterfeit batches last year, with some countries advising revaccination for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病ワクチンの『偽造』バッチに注意：医薬品規制当局が各州に警告
triage.triage_reason: 感染症のアウトブレイクではなく偽造ワクチン流通に関する規制上の警告だが、狂犬病はほぼ100%致死率でありワクチン市場の約40%を占める製品であるため、予防効果不全による公衆衛生リスクが懸念され経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は狂犬病の感染拡大事例ではなく、偽造狂犬病ワクチン（Abhayrabの模倣品）に関するインド医薬品規制当局(DCGI/CDSCO)からの注意喚起。当該バッチはインドから輸出されておらず、UK・US・Australiaは昨年の別件の偽造品調査であり今回のイベントとは直接関係しないため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。デリー警察により4名逮捕、捜査継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Cidade mineira registra morte por febre maculosa e interdita locais públicos | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais city records death from Brazilian spotted fever and closes public places
article.articleSummary: Jeceaba, a city in the Central Region of Minas Gerais, Brazil, has temporarily closed public venues with potential tick infestation after confirming a death from Brazilian spotted fever (febre maculosa) and probing two additional suspected cases linked to the star tick (carrapato-estrela). Local health surveillance has implemented emergency measures including vector-control operations and increased public education for visitors to forests, trails, and fishing sites; animal management in street environments is being coordinated with the Environment Secretariat. The Minas Gerais State Health Secretariat (SES-MG) reported 36 confirmed cases and 11 deaths from febre maculosa in the state through August 27. The disease's historical fatality rate in Minas is about 30%, mainly affecting men aged 41–60. Treatment is provided free by the SUS and should be started rapidly at first symptoms—high fever, body aches, and skin rashes—before laboratory confirmation to reduce complications. The Barbacena Regional Health Unit is closely monitoring Jeceaba.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州の都市がブラジル紅斑熱による死亡を記録し、公共施設を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病（マダニ媒介性リケッチア症）による州内の複数死亡例だが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域限定の公衆衛生対応事案として続報を注視。
triage.notes: 州保健当局（SES-MG）が既に36例確定・11死亡を公表しており、地域単位での対応（ベクター駆除、公共施設閉鎖）が進行中。マダニ媒介性疾患でヒト-ヒト感染はなく、既知の風土病として毎年一定数発生する疾患であるため、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 广州多人在大家乐用餐后高烧腹泻__新快网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people in Guangzhou develop high fever and diarrhea after dining at Dajia Le.
article.articleSummary: At Dajia Le in Guangzhou's Panyu District (Tianhe City store), several diners developed high fever and diarrhea after meals on Aug 28–29. By Sept 4, 14 people had fallen ill, with 12 hospitalized; as of Sept 5 noon, four children remained in hospital. One 3.5-year-old was diagnosed with Salmonella infection and dehydration; another 13-year-old classmate suffered severe dehydration and shock. Treatments included antibiotics for bacterial gastroenteritis. Health authorities say contamination of egg ingredients is a preliminary suspected source. The Panyu District Market Supervision Bureau and the CDC have conducted site inspections and sampling; results are pending. The restaurant has been closed for remediation. Dajia Le's brand said it would tighten supplier checks, and conduct full-store audits of food handling and sanitation across all outlets.

triage.headline_ja: 広州の大家楽でレストラン食事後に高熱・下痢を発症
triage.triage_reason: 単一レストランでの局所的なサルモネラ食中毒事例であり、既知の病原体・感染経路、当局が調査・是正措置済みで国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疾患名にParatyphoid/Typhoidと分類されているが、記事内容はサルモネラ属菌による食中毒（食品衛生事案）であり、腸チフス・パラチフスの流行を示す情報はない。局所的な食品由来感染症としてローカル当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Cuban Authorities Acknowledge Waste Management Issues Amid Dengue Surge on Isla de la Juventud
article.articleSummary: Isla de la Juventud, Cuba, reports a dengue and arboviral surge, with dengue serotype 2 most prevalent; La Fe records a more-than-40 weekly rise in diagnosed cases, though no severe cases reported. About 40 military personnel are deployed in La Fe for extramural fumigation, house-to-house investigations, and intensive sanitation campaigns. Waste management chaos accompanies the health crisis: Belmary began charging for collection in Chacón and Sierra Caballos in August; nonpayment flags residents, while rollout expands to Abel next week and Pueblo Nuevo studies tailor strategies; expansion planned to La Demajagua and Patria. Elsewhere, Sancti Spíritus sees five consecutive weeks of rising dengue; Guantánamo remains under Epidemiological Alert; Unión de Reyes, Matanzas, reports 154 febrile patients amid regular fumigation challenges caused by an energy crisis. Cuba closed 2025 with over 81,900 dengue/chikungunya cases and at least 65 deaths; officials warn lack of measures could trigger an epidemic.
