article.articleHeadline: Gobierno admite problemas con la basura mientras alerta por aumento del dengue en Isla de la Juventud
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government admits problems with garbage while warning about a rise in dengue on Isla de la Juventud.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising on Isla de la Juventud (Isle of Youth), Cuba, amid deficiencies in solid-waste collection. The municipal plan advances unevenly: Chacón is most advanced; 26 de Julio will add two carts; Abel starts next week; Pueblo Nuevo will study first; expansion is planned to La Demajagua and Patria. Since August, Belmary has charged for collection in Chacón and Sierra Caballos, with inspectors identifying non-payers. Public Health Director Bárbara Daudinó warned of escalating arbovirosis risk, noting dengue serotype 2 as the predominant circulating strain nationwide and transmission risk in the municipality. La Fe reports more than 40 new dengue cases versus the prior week; no severe cases yet. Microbiologists confirm circulation of multiple serotypes, including 2; about 40 soldiers joined medical teams for La Fe, with outdoor fumigation, house-to-house surveys, and intensified sanitation. Cuba recorded over 81,900 dengue/chikungunya cases in 2025 with at least 65 deaths; officials warn action is needed to prevent an epidemic.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu hits Lucknow; 24 new H1N1 patients detected in two days; active cases rise to 63
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreaks in Lucknow have intensified, with 24 new positive cases reported over the last two days (13 on Friday, 11 on Saturday), lifting active infections to 63. Twenty patients were hospitalized; 17 have recovered and returned home, one was already admitted, and two were newly admitted on Saturday. Three patients remain clinically stable, with no warning signs of severe illness reported. Health authorities have ordered strengthened surveillance and treatment arrangements in hospitals. Signs warranting urgent testing and care include high fever with shortness of breath, chest pain, low blood pressure, fainting, blue-tinged lips/nails, or coughing up blood; in children, persistent high fever, lethargy, poor feeding, seizures, or breathing problems are serious indicators. Routine cold symptoms need not trigger H1N1 testing; avoid antibiotics without medical advice. Two of the recent patients are hospitalized at Lok Bandhu Hospital and SGPGI.

article.articleHeadline: ભાસ્કર એક્સપર્ટ રિપોર્ટિંગ સ્ટોરી‎: કૂતરું હડકાયું થાય ત્યારે વાઇરસ ચેતાતંત્રના માર્ગે પ્રતિદિન 12‎થી 100 મિલીમીટર ઝડપે મગજ તરફ વધતાં જ હિંસક બને છે‎
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bhaskar Expert Reporting Story: When a dog trembles, the virus traveling along the nervous system pathways toward the brain advances at 12 to 100 millimeters per day and becomes aggressive.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Patan, Gujarat, India: The article explains that the rabies virus travels via nerves from a bite or saliva contact with mucous membranes to the brain at about 12–100 mm/day, making the disease almost always fatal. While dogs are key reservoirs, wild animals can also carry the virus. Transmission occurs when a rabid animal bites or saliva contacts wounds or eyes/mouth. Immediate post-exposure care within the first 15 minutes is critical: rinse the wound with soap and running water for 15 minutes to reduce viral load by 70–80%, apply antiseptics (Dettol, Savlon, or povidone-iodine). Do not tie or apply chili or turmeric to wounds. Seek urgent anti-rabies vaccination on days 0, 3, 7, 14, and 28; immunoglobulin should be given for severe wounds. In dogs, signs include excessive drooling, inability to swallow, red eyes, hoarse voice, unprovoked aggression, and avoidance of water or light.

triage.headline_ja: バスカル専門家報告記事:犬が狂犬病になると、ウイルスは神経系を通じて1日12〜100ミリメートルの速度で脳に向かい、凶暴化する

triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病の病態生理・予防啓発を目的とした一般解説記事であり、具体的な発生・症例報告ではないため対象国の実発生事例として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄增3例境外登革熱！　2童自越南返台「入境即就醫」未入社區免噴藥 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports 3 more imported dengue fever cases; two children returning from Vietnam sought medical care on entry, with no community-wide spraying.
article.articleSummary: Three new imported dengue fever cases were reported in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, on Sept 5. A 59-year-old man returning from Cambodia developed fever and myalgia after arriving Aug 27; dengue NS1 rapid test was positive on Sept 3, with PCR confirming dengue virus type 1 (DENV-1) and subsequent hospitalization. Two girls, aged 10 and 8, who travelled with relatives to Vietnam, sought medical care at the airport on entry and tested positive by NS1 and PCR; they had not yet entered community activities, so no community-wide spraying was deemed necessary. Health authorities urge travelers to follow pre-travel mosquito precautions, post-travel health monitoring, and seek care if symptoms arise; clinics should implement TOCC screening and NS1 testing. With recent rainfall increasing mosquito breeding, residents are advised to intensify source reduction (inspect, drain, clean, brush) within 48 hours after rain to curb vector proliferation.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL en première ligne grâce à son ancrage local | PlaneteAfrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL on the front line thanks to its local presence
article.articleSummary: On May 15, 2026, Africa CDC confirmed Ebola cases in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). About 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported initially, mainly in Mongbwalu and Rwampara near Bunia. SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL, present for 20 years, rapidly adapted operations to help contain what has become the DRC’s deadliest Ebola outbreak, with 2,900 deaths and 6,000 infections across six provinces by August 31. Ebola virus disease, first identified in 1976 along the Ebola River, spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; there is no airborne transmission. Tests for the Zaïre (Zaire) strain were initially negative, with Bundibugyo identified on May 14. The organization emphasizes hygiene and water quality to halt spread, deploying protective measures such as handwashing stations, chlorine, thermometers, gloves, and disinfection. In Mahagi, SI distributed cash to 5,000 displaced people over three weeks to ensure security and continue prevention campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL、現地基盤を活かし最前線で対応
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）史上最悪規模のエボラ出血熱流行（6州で6,000人感染、2,900人死亡）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イツリ州を中心とした大規模エボラ流行（6州、6,000感染、2,900死亡）を報告。ルワンダは発生地域タグに含まれるが、記事本文では流行地としての言及はなく除外。国際NGO（SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL）による支援活動が中心的話題であり、社会的関心・国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 家长必看！开学季，这两大类病毒孩子最易中招（附用药指南）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Must-Read for Parents! Back-to-School Season: These Two Types of Viruses Are Most Likely to Infect Children (Includes a Medication Guide).
article.articleSummary: Beijing, China — As the new school year begins, crowded campuses drive a high incidence of pediatric infections, mainly respiratory viruses (influenza, respiratory syncytial virus, adenovirus) and enteric viruses (norovirus, rotavirus). Influenza typically causes fever and body aches; RSV presents with cough and wheeze; adenovirus may yield prolonged fever, sore throat, and sometimes conjunctivitis. Norovirus causes abrupt vomiting and then diarrhea; rotavirus mainly causes profuse watery diarrhea in infants and young children, with vomiting. Symptoms can overlap, so a diagnosis cannot rely on symptoms alone. For home medication, check all active ingredients and avoid duplicate dosing; children’s immature liver metabolism, limited renal excretion, and developing blood-brain barrier require weight-based dosing to prevent liver/kidney injury. Seek urgent care for persistent high fever, lethargy, rapid breathing, frequent vomiting, inability to drink, or dehydration, especially in infants. Home care: rest, fluids, bland meals, and isolation to limit spread. Source: CCTV News, Beijing Daily App.

article.articleHeadline: 120 Rumah Beratap Asbes di Bukit Duri Bakal Dibedah, Ara Singgung TBC-Kanker
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 120 asbestos-roofed houses in Bukit Duri to be renovated, Ara mentions TB-cancer.
article.articleSummary: Jakarta, Indonesia — Housing Minister Maruarar Sirait (Ara) backs renovating asbestos-roofed houses under the BSPS program after visiting Bukit Duri, South Jakarta, on Sep 5, 2026. He warned asbestos exposure can cause serious illnesses, notably lung cancer and tuberculosis (TB). Local RW leaders said 120 asbestos-roofed homes are eligible for home-improvement aid, per Dirjen Sri Haryati via the Ayo Sehat health ministry site. The Environmental Litigation Group notes TB symptoms can resemble asbestosis, and a TB history can worsen outcomes in homes with asbestos. Asbestos fibers release tiny particles that lodge in the lungs, with disease latency typically 10–40 years or longer. The PKP Ministry advocates replacing asbestos with safer roofing such as tiles and has discussed banning new asbestos use, a policy Ara has sought previously, including at Manggarai.

triage.headline_ja: ブキドゥリの石綿屋根住宅120軒が改修へ、アラ大臣がTBC・がんに言及

article.articleHeadline: "노벨상 수상자도 대상에"...美, '코로나 기원' 수사 확대
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Nobel laureates are also targets"... the United States expands the probe into the origin of the coronavirus.
article.articleSummary: FBI and federal prosecutors have broadened the COVID-19 origin inquiry to include Anthony Fauci, former NIAID director, and at least eight scientists, among them a Nobel laureate, according to the New York Times. Investigators are seeking phone records, emails, and funding/compensation data, though the current evidentiary status and progress are unclear. The probe, initially focused on the Wuhan Institute of Virology, has expanded to examine whether some scientists helped downplay a laboratory origin and how NIH funding flowed to related research, including EcoHealth Alliance. Nobel laureate Richard Roberts, awarded in 1993 for physiology/medicine, appears in 2025 documents linked to his letter opposing NIH funding cuts to EcoHealth Alliance. Additionally, David Morens, a former Fauci adviser, pleaded guilty to concealing federal emails via a personal account, with prosecutors requesting related communications.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu: 300 H1N1 Cases in Dehradun; 41 COVID-19 Patients Detected, Health Department on Alert.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) in Dehradun has risen to 300 confirmed cases from 586 samples tested (201 in Dehradun, 99 from other states). Currently 101 patients are hospitalized and 197 have recovered; two deaths were recorded after a death audit. The gender split is 137 women and 163 men. On Saturday, 65 samples yielded 29 new cases (19 in Dehradun, 10 from other states), prompting the health department to stay on alert. COVID-19 reports two new cases in Dehradun (one local, one imported). Across 327 tests, 41 infections were confirmed (17 in Dehradun, 24 from other states); three patients are hospitalized. No further details on additional outbreaks provided.

article.articleHeadline: Twice in 2 years: Fake rabies jab probe plea after substandard vaccine found in Delhi home
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine Abhayrab by Indian Immunologicals Limited (IIL) faced a fresh counterfeit scare after Delhi police seized counterfeit vials bearing batch KE25012 from an unlicensed residential site in Delhi. CDSCO drew samples; the Central Drugs Laboratory in Kasauli found the vials to be not of standard quality and misbranded, with 17 differences from genuine KE25012. Four people were arrested; authorities alerted state regulators on Aug. 27 to maintain vigilance over movement and distribution. IIL says 83,370 genuine KE25012 vials were released through authorised channels; no market complaints reported. Since launch, IIL has supplied over 210 million Abhayrab doses globally, holding about 40% of India's anti-rabies vaccine market. Rabies is nearly always fatal once symptoms appear. About 3 million Indians receive anti-rabies vaccines annually. CDSCO confirmed KE25012 had no exports.

triage.headline_ja: 2年で2度目：デリーの民家で規格外の狂犬病ワクチンが発見され、偽造ワクチン捜査の申し立て

triage.notes: 本イベントは狂犬病の感染拡大ではなく、偽造・規格外ワクチン流通に関する医薬品規制上の問題。CDSCOにより輸出なしと確認され、国際的拡大の懸念は低いが、国内での偽造薬品流通が繰り返されている点は監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Milhões de pessoas em todo mundo vão contrair sarampo em 2026 - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Millions of people around the world will contract measles in 2026 - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Measles is projected to reach about 11 million infections in 2026, according to WHO. Most cases will occur in Africa and Asia, but outbreaks in the Americas and Europe involve hundreds to thousands. After a decline from 38 million cases in 2000 to 10 million in 2019, this trend reversed as vaccination coverage fell during the COVID-19 era. There is no cure; vaccines are safe and effective, and unvaccinated individuals face severe complications including deafness, blindness, and death, especially when malnourished or lacking access to care. Herd immunity requires >95% vaccination; two doses improve protection. In 2026, outbreaks are reported in Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Somalia, Sudan, and Yemen. Canada lost measles-elimination status in 2025; Mexico and the United States may lose elimination status at PAHO's November 2026 meeting. In the US, 2026 cases exceed any year since 1991, linked to pockets of low vaccination in conservative religious and Mennonite communities, with cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年、世界中で数百万人が麻疹に感染する見通し - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: WHOによる2026年麻疹感染予測（約1100万人）で、DRCを含む複数国での大規模アウトブレイクと排除ステータス喪失国の増加が報告されており、国際的拡大・重症化・予防接種率低下によるヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが複合的に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの世界的麻疹感染予測に関する概説記事であり、DRCは2026年にアウトブレイクが報告されている国として言及されている。他の言及国（ブルンジ、ソマリア、スーダン、イエメン、米国、カナダ、メキシコ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。具体的な症例数・地域詳細は記事本文になく情報が限定的。

article.articleHeadline: '17 differences flagged': Spurious rabies vaccine racket busted after raids in Delhi
article.articleSummary: Four people were arrested after a Delhi raid at a Mukherjee Nagar flat uncovered a counterfeit rabies vaccine racket. Spurious Abhayrab vials, batch KE25012, were found; Central Drugs Laboratory in Kasauli deemed the sample not of standard quality and misbranded, not produced by Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL), which holds about 40% of India’s domestic market. IIL reported 17 differences between seized vials and retention samples, including labeling, QR code, cap color, and packaging text. Genuine batch records show 83,370 vials released through authorised networks with no complaints; IIL supplied records to CDSCO and urged tracing of the source. DGCI issued guidance on August 27 urging state controllers to monitor batch movement. Context: India’s rabies burden is high—ICMR 2025 Lancet Infectious Diseases study estimates 5,726 annual deaths; India accounts for ~36% of global rabies deaths, with dogs driving most bites and vaccination completion remaining poor.

triage.headline_ja: 「17か所の相違点」を指摘：デリーでの家宅捜索により偽造狂犬病ワクチン密売組織が摘発

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First swine flu death in Kanpur; a 30-year-old man dies; infection also in a child.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreak in Uttar Pradesh with Kanpur reporting its first death. A 30-year-old man, Shivam, from Tera Jacket village in Gursahayganj, Kannauj district, developed fever and abdominal pain on 28 August, was admitted to Sharda Nagar Anurag Health Care Hospital, and died on 1 September; private pathology confirmed H1N1, with severe pneumonia causing nearly complete lung failure. Postmortem and police action followed; family alleges care lapses. A four-year-old child also tested positive; relatives took the child to Lucknow for treatment. A 55-year-old man at HALT ICU tested positive for H1N1 by private lab but negative by government medical college tests, with kidney and liver involvement and jaundice; he remains ventilated as a swine flu suspect. In Meerut, active cases reach 37 with 10 new cases confirmed on Thursday; most patients are women, over eight have recovered, with cases in Bhawanpur, Block Shastrinagar, Jagriti Vihar, Kankar Kheda, Mavana, Sanjay Nagar, and Jahidpur, managed largely at home.

article.articleHeadline: India News | UP: Kanpur CMO Issues Notices to Hospital, Diagnostic Centre After City Reports First Swine Flu Death
article.articleSummary: Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh records its first swine flu death as 30-year-old Shivam, a Kannauj resident, who died after admission to a hospital in Kanpur’s Rawatpur area on September 1. Kanpur Nagar CMO Hari Dutt Nemi issued notices to a private hospital and a diagnostic centre for allegedly suppressing information; an official probe began after a Delhi-based pathology lab confirmed the case. This follows August 29 guidelines from Varanasi CMO Dr NP Singh to reserve beds across district hospitals and community health centres and to raise public awareness. The Indian Medical Association had issued a public health advisory on August 26 noting a seasonal rise in Influenza A (H1N1), with Delhi reporting over 1,770 lab-confirmed cases and cases in Maharashtra, Karnataka and West Bengal. ICMR surveillance confirms circulating virus remains seasonal A(H1N1) with no novel mutations. Authorities urge timely treatment and hygiene to control spread.

article.articleHeadline: UP: Kanpur CMO issues notices to hospital, diagnostic centre after city reports first swine flu death
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (Influenza A/H1N1) death reported in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh—the city’s first. The 30-year-old Shivam of Kannauj died during treatment after being admitted on Sept 1 at a Kanpur hospital. The CMO issued notices to the private hospital and a diagnostic centre for alleged suppression of information; an official probe followed a Delhi-based pathology lab confirming swine flu. Public guidance stresses hygiene, seeking medical advice, rest and fluids; avoid self-medication and rumours. The IMA issued an advisory on Aug 26 about a seasonal surge, noting Delhi with over 1,770 lab-confirmed cases and additional cases in Maharashtra, Karnataka and West Bengal. ICMR surveillance confirms the circulating virus remains seasonal influenza A(H1N1) with no novel mutations.

article.articleHeadline: Gejala Awal DBD Mirip Flu Biasa, Kenali Tanda Bahayanya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early dengue fever symptoms resemble the common flu; recognize the danger signs.
article.articleSummary: Early dengue fever (Dengue virus) symptoms in Jakarta, Indonesia, can mimic influenza, risking delayed diagnosis and rapid progression to a critical phase. The illness typically starts with high fever, chills, malaise, headache, and muscle- and joint-pain, followed by nausea, vomiting, and bleeding signs such as nosebleeds, bleeding gums, and red skin spots. During the critical phase, a swift drop in platelets often precedes shock, organ dysfunction, or severe bleeding if not treated promptly. Family members should monitor fever patients for warning signs including severe abdominal pain, continuous vomiting, bleeding, reduced energy, or altered consciousness, and seek urgent medical care when they appear. Prompt, appropriate management is essential to prevent deterioration. The remarks come from Dr. Gia Pratama Putra, cited by Antara via Liputan6.com.

article.articleHeadline: El cocinero que acudió enfermo al trabajo y resultó ser el paciente cero de la pandemia de 1918, la mal llamada gripe española
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Cook Who Went to Work Sick and Turned Out to Be the Patient Zero of the 1918 Pandemic—the Misnamed Spanish Flu
article.articleSummary: Albert Gitchell, a cook at Fort Riley, Kansas, is considered patient zero of the 1918 influenza pandemic. On March 4, 1918, he developed fever, cough, and sore throat but continued working; the outbreak quickly spread globally, infecting about 500 million people (roughly 27% of the world’s population) and causing more than 50 million deaths. The pandemic reached Europe and beyond; some studies point to France as a possible origin, while others implicate the United States, workers from China, or an English army precursor in 1916–1917. Dubbed the Spanish flu because neutral Spain reported widely, the illness entered the Iberian Peninsula via Cádiz and Lisbon, contributing to about 696,000 deaths in Spain. Citizens faced masks, social distancing, and closures of theatres and cinemas. No vaccine was ever developed; the virus faded before isolation. The outbreak spread across continents, signaling a failed wartime containment and lasting public health lessons.

triage.headline_ja: 病気のまま出勤したコックが、1918年パンデミック（誤って『スペイン風邪』と呼ばれた）の患者ゼロだった

article.articleHeadline: CDSCO flags substandard anti-rabies vaccine Abhayrab, traces it to Delhi flat
article.articleSummary: India’s drug regulator CDSCO flags Abhayrab anti-rabies vaccine, batch KE25012, as misbranded and not of standard quality after a potency test failed. The batch is traced to an unlicensed residential premises in Mukherjee Nagar, north Delhi, from which vials were seized in April; four people were arrested. This marks the second counterfeit Abhayrab incident in India within two years. The regulator’s notice (Aug 27) states the vials, labeled for 2–8°C storage, were kept at room temperature during collection, and none of the batch was exported. Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL) contends the samples were drawn during enforcement and differ in 17 respects from retention samples, and are not manufactured by its Telangana-based Human Biologicals Institute division. Notable discrepancies include blue caps vs green caps, a hologram on the seal, a misspelled Louis Pasteur, and multiple labeling errors, suggesting counterfeit production.

article.articleHeadline: Demam Berdarah Tak Kenal Musim, Kewaspadaan Perlu Dijaga Sepanjang Tahun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Knows No Season; Vigilance Must Be Maintained Year-Round.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever has long been Indonesia's health challenge since its first report in 1968 as an outbreak in Jakarta and Surabaya, with 58 cases and 24 deaths (case fatality 41.3%). Through improved case management, fatality has fallen to below 1%. Dengue can affect anyone and is not confined to the rainy season; vigilance must be year-round. A Burden of Disease study by Universitas Gadjah Mada estimates more than 2 million dengue-related hospitalizations in 2024, with an economic burden about Rp9 trillion. Family life bears caregiving and financial costs. Early dengue mimics other fevers; monitoring is essential, with danger signs like severe abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, lethargy, agitation, or altered consciousness requiring prompt care. Prevention relies on 3M Plus, vector control, vaccination, and surveillance. Indonesia aims for zero dengue deaths by 2030 under the National Dengue Control Action Plan (2026–2029), supported by Wolbachia technology and vaccination, and strengthened early warning systems.

article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine Abhayrab batch KE25012 seized in Delhi's Mukherjee Nagar after four arrests; Central Drugs Laboratory, Kasauli, labeled the batch misbranded and not of standard quality. Delhi Police Crime Branch and Delhi Drugs Control conducted a search at an unlicensed premises; CDSCO sampled, with CDL reporting misbranding and identity concerns, raising possible spurious drug under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL) stated the vials examined were not manufactured by the company; the original batch reportedly consisted of 83,370 vials distributed through authorised channels. The regulator noted significant differences between the sampled product and a retained reference sample, including labeling, artwork, QR code verification, cap colour, licence details and packaging text. DCGI directed states to alert inspectors and take action under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. Abhayrab is exported to more than 40 countries, including South Africa, Turkey, Vietnam, Cambodia, Zimbabwe, Thailand and the United Arab Emirates.

article.articleHeadline: Parasita cerebral em águas residenciais: o que foi observado na Índia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cerebral Parasite in Residential Waters: What Was Observed in India.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India: The Indian Council of Medical Research links well water in Kerala to amoebic meningitis caused by Naegleria fowleri. Infection occurs after contact with or ingestion of contaminated water; the amoeba enters via the nasopharynx and rapidly migrates to the brain, causing primary amoebic meningoencephalitis with very high fatality. This is the first scientific evidence that rural wells used for drinking and domestic needs may be unsafe, sustaining outbreak risk in Kerala. Experts call for immediate strengthening of rural water quality monitoring and sanitation/purification measures to curb parasite spread. Note: information only; do not alter medical treatment without professional advice. Source: adapted from Pravda.Ru (Russian). Published 2026-09-05.

article.articleHeadline: 口袋百科丨家长必看！开学季，这两大类病毒孩子最易中招（附用药指南）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pocket Encyclopedia | A Must-Read for Parents! Back-to-School Season: These Two Major Types of Viruses Are Most Likely to Infect Children (Includes Medication Guide).
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-06, back-to-school season in China elevates pediatric infections from two virus families: respiratory viruses (influenza, respiratory syncytial virus [RSV], adenovirus) and enteric viruses (norovirus, rotavirus). Typical symptoms: influenza—fever and body aches; RSV—cough and wheeze; adenovirus—prolonged fever, sore throat, red eyes; norovirus—sudden vomiting followed by diarrhea in outbreaks; rotavirus—in infants, abundant watery diarrhea with vomiting. Symptoms can overlap, so diagnosis cannot rely on clinical presentation alone. For home medications, parents should verify active ingredients and avoid duplicate dosing; children have immature liver/kidney function and distinct pharmacokinetics, so do not halve adult doses or improvise. Urgent medical care is needed for persistent high fever, lethargy, rapid breathing, frequent vomiting, inability to eat or drink, or dehydration, especially in young infants or with underlying conditions. Home care emphasizes rest, plenty of fluids, easily digestible meals, isolation to prevent spread, and symptom-directed relief. Guidance from Beijing’s Capital Children’s Medical Center (affiliated with Capital Medical University) is highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: ポケット百科|保護者必見！新学期シーズン、子供が最もかかりやすい二大ウイルス（薬の使い方ガイド付き）
triage.triage_reason: 新学期に伴う一般的な小児感染症（インフルエンザ、RSV、ノロウイルス等）に関する啓発記事であり、特異な流行や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性の小児感染症予防啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu: स्वाइन फ्लू ने कानपुर में ली पहली जान, 30 वर्षीय युवक की मौत के बाद स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने उठाया बड़ा कदम
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu: Swine flu claims its first life in Kanpur; after the death of a 30-year-old man, the health department took a major step.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (Influenza A H1N1) has caused Kanpur’s first death, a 30-year-old Kannauj resident named Shivam who died after admission on 1 September at a Kanpur hospital in the Ravatpur area. Authorities allege the private hospital and a major diagnostic center concealed the case; Chief Medical Officer Hari Datt Nemi has issued formal notices and ordered investigations. The Delhi-based pathology lab confirmed H1N1 infection, prompting official action. In response to rising activity, the state health department advised district hospitals and community health centers to reserve beds and ensure availability of antivirals and antibiotics. The Indian Medical Association’s 26 August advisory urged against self-medication and to seek care for serious symptoms. ICMR surveillance confirms seasonal H1N1 with no new genetic changes; Delhi has over 1,770 lab-confirmed cases, with Maharashtra, Karnataka, and West Bengal also affected.

triage.headline_ja: スワイン・フルー：カンプールで初の死亡例、30歳男性の死後に保健当局が病院と検査機関を調査
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1による死亡例に加え、デリーで1770件超の確定例、複数州への拡大、病院による症例隠蔽疑惑という社会的関心の高さから、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: ICMRのサーベイランスでは遺伝的変異のない季節性H1N1と確認されているが、症例隠蔽疑惑と複数州への拡大、死亡例発生により社会的・行政的関心が高い。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: 孩子在餐厅就餐后休克进ICU 多人出现相似症状
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A child goes into shock and is admitted to the ICU after dining at a restaurant; many people developed similar symptoms
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou's Panyu District CDC is investigating a foodborne outbreak linked to Da Jia Le restaurant in Tianhe City, Guangzhou. Beginning Aug 28, diners experienced high fever, diarrhea, and vomiting; a 13-year-old developed shock and was admitted to ICU about two hours after the meal. On Aug 29, another group comprising two adults and four children reported similar illness, including two 3-year-olds who ate children’s meals; fever rose to 39.9°C. By Sep 1, stool culture from a child confirmed Salmonella infection; several others tested positive for the same pathogen. In total, more than ten people are affected. Police have been notified; the Panyu District Public Security Bureau is handling a report, while the CDC has collected restaurant samples awaiting laboratory results to confirm the source and guide measures.

triage.headline_ja: レストランで食事をした子供がショック状態でICUに搬送、多数が同様の症状を呈す
triage.triage_reason: 広州市パンユー区のレストランでのサルモネラ食中毒により13歳児がショックでICU入院するなど10名以上が発症し、警察・CDCが介入しているため社会的関心と重症例が確認できる。
triage.notes: 疾患タグはParatyphoid/Typhoidだが記事内では便培養でサルモネラ（非チフス性の可能性）が確認されており、単一レストランに起因する局地的な食中毒事例と考えられる。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、重症例（ICU入院）と当局介入により社会的関心が高いためPICKUPと判定。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: Officials Confirm The US State's First Locally Acquired Case Of Bone-breaking Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: Florida reports its first locally acquired dengue fever case in Citrus County on the west coast near Tampa, marking the state’s first locally transmitted dengue case. Florida has 23 locally acquired dengue cases this year, including eight in Hillsborough County and two in Pinellas County; statewide total: 108 cases. Nationally, the United States has 1,575 dengue cases (local and travel-associated). Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, intense muscle/joint/bone pain, nausea, vomiting and rash, typically 5–7 days after bite. Most recover within a week, but severe dengue can cause shock and internal bleeding if untreated. The CDC updated travel warnings for 11 countries/territories (Bolivia, Cambodia, Colombia, Kenya, Malaysia, Maldives, New Caledonia, Samoa, Sri Lanka, Tonga, Vietnam), urging precautions for travelers: insect repellent, long sleeves/pants, and screened or air-conditioned rooms; heightened risk for young children, older adults, and pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: 米国の州で初のローカル感染による「骨折れ熱」デング熱症例を当局が確認
triage.triage_reason: 米国フロリダ州における局地的デング熱感染の報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国フロリダ州における局地的デング熱感染。CDCが渡航警告を出した国（ベトナム、カンボジア、マレーシア等）は渡航先としての言及のみで、実際の発生国ではないため対象外。対象国リストに該当する発生国なし。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 cases surge late in Thailand, but disease no deadlier than flu
article.articleSummary: Thailand's COVID-19 wave is near its peak, with the Department of Disease Control reporting 99,691 cases and 15 deaths from Jan 1–Aug 31, 2026 (CFR ~0.02%). Virologist Prof Dr Yong Poovorawan of Chulalongkorn University says the dominant Omicron NB.1.8.1 variant spreads more easily but has not increased severity; overall COVID-19 deaths are about 16 among ~100,000 cases. In the same period, influenza has about 50 deaths among ~350,000 cases, while influenza cases total 333,032 with 48 deaths in Jan–Aug 2026. Most COVID-19 patients experience upper-respiratory symptoms (cough, sore throat, runny nose, low-grade fever). The pattern is increasingly influenza-like, with the current wave near its peak and expected decline in October when schools close after the Songkran period. NB.1.8.1 is more transmissible but not more lethal.

triage.headline_ja: タイでCOVID-19感染者数が終盤に急増、ただしインフルエンザより致死率は高くない
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の流行状況報告であり、致死率は低くインフルエンザと同程度、専門家も重症度増加なしと明言しており、異常性・深刻性ともに低い。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株NB.1.8.1による流行で、専門家が重症度上昇なしと明言。ピークを過ぎ10月には減少見込みとされ、通常の季節性感染症報告に相当する。

article.articleHeadline: Una enfermera canaria en el corazón del frente contra el ébola: "La población congoleña ya no sabe cuál de todos los peligros es peor" | Canarias7
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Canarian nurse at the heart of the front line against Ebola: "The Congolese population no longer knows which of all the dangers is the worst" | Canarias7
article.articleSummary: As of September 1, 2026, Ebola in the DRC’s South Kivu has reached 6,250 cases and 3,039 deaths (case fatality 48%). Canary nurse Pino González, coordinating Médicos del Mundo projects, spent June–July in South Kivu leading responses to Ebola and cholera amid war and mass displacement (about 1.7 million in South Kivu, 7 million nationwide) and fragile health services. Declared in May, the outbreak is the second-deadliest in history. The response spans 24 health centers and a cholera treatment center, with 325 community health workers; Médicos del Mundo totals 120 Congo-based staff, only ten international. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; poverty, limited water and sanitation, crowded living conditions, and armed conflict hinder case finding and contact tracing. PPE kits (impermeable gowns, gloves, masks, boots, goggles), disinfectants, and portable hand-washing devices have been distributed; safe burial practices are pursued with dignity and infection control. González appeals for support from Canary communities.

triage.headline_ja: カナリア諸島出身の看護師、エボラ対策の最前線で:「コンゴの人々はもはやどの危険が一番深刻か分からない」
triage.triage_reason: DRC南キブ州のエボラ流行は6250症例・3039死亡（致死率48%）で史上2番目に死者数の多い流行となっており、武力紛争下で200万人近くが影響を受けるなど深刻かつ異常な公衆衛生事象であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はカナリア諸島出身の看護師によるDRCでの人道支援活動を紹介するもので、カナリア諸島・スペインは発生地域ではなく活動報告者の出身地のため除外した。エボラとコレラの同時流行、武力紛争・大規模避難民（170万人）が対応を著しく困難にしている点が特筆される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Abhayrab Rabies Vaccine Under Scanner After Potency Failure: From Adulterated Spices To Repackaged Goods, What Exactly Are Consumers Buying In India's Expanding Grey Market?
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccine Abhayrab batch KE25012 in India failed a potency test at the Central Drugs Laboratory (Kasauli) and was labeled “not of standard quality,” with notable differences from a retained reference sample—including labeling, artwork, QR code, cap color, licence details and packaging text. While sterility, moisture and identity tests passed, regulators flagged concerns over the vaccine’s identity and authenticity under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, directing state regulators on Aug 27 to vigilantly monitor movement and distribution of the batch. Abhayrab is used for pre- and post-exposure rabies protection; the regulator did not specify how many doses were affected, exported, or caused harm. This follows a Jan 2025 counterfeit batch KA24014 that triggered Australia/UK guidance; Indian Immunologicals said the issue was separate. The report also highlights broader trust issues as India conducts food-safety raids in Hyderabad and Navi Mumbai revealing adulteration and relabeling in consumer goods.

triage.headline_ja: アバイラブ狂犬病ワクチンが効力不合格で監視対象に：偽造香辛料から再包装品まで、インドの拡大するグレーマーケットで消費者が実際に購入しているものとは？
triage.triage_reason: 感染症のアウトブレイクではなく狂犬病ワクチンの品質・偽造問題だが、過去に国際的な警告（豪州・英国）を引き起こした前例があり、ワクチン供給の信頼性に関わるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本件はワクチンの品質不良・偽造疑惑に関する規制対応の記事であり、狂犬病の感染拡大や症例報告ではない。過去の偽造バッチ（KA24014、2025年1月）が豪州・英国への注意喚起を引き起こした前例があるため、今後の展開（輸出有無、健康被害の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Miloš je u 46. godini dobio epilepsiju posle uboda zaraženog komarca virusom Zapadnog Nila
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Miloš, at age 46, developed epilepsy after being bitten by a mosquito infected with West Nile virus.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus infection acquired from a mosquito bite on the Tisa River in a small Vojvodina town caused Miloš, 46, to develop encephalitis and subsequent epilepsy. In late July 2025, while vacationing on Thasos Island, Greece, he experienced high fever (up to 40°C) and severe seizures. After deteriorating, he was treated in Kavala, placed in artificial coma, and transported to Serbia; nine days of treatment in Greece, followed by air-evacuation to Novi Sad. In Novi Sad’s Clinic for Infectious Diseases, he spent 10 days in intensive care and 45 days on a regular ward. Antibody testing later confirmed West Nile virus; the illness caused encephalitis and a large thrombus led to pulmonary complication, while a PET scan ruled out tumors. Today he lives with epilepsy due to brain damage in the left frontal lobe; he takes two anti-epileptic medications. The case illustrates that severe WNV can affect younger adults.

triage.headline_ja: ミロシュさん（46歳）、西ナイルウイルスに感染した蚊に刺され、てんかんを発症
triage.triage_reason: セルビア・ギリシャにおける個人の西ナイルウイルス感染後遺症に関する闘病記事であり、対象国（India等）とは無関係。新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や社会的関心の高まりも見られない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIndiaが含まれるが、記事内容はセルビア・ギリシャでの個人症例であり、Indiaは無関係（誤タグと判断）。対象国リストに該当する発生国がないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Malaria Cases: चाचण्या वाढल्या; मलेरियावर मात अजून दूरच! संसर्ग निर्देशांकाची वाढ चिंताजनक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai Malaria Cases: Tests Have Increased; Beating Malaria Is Still a Long Way Off! Rise in Transmission Index Is Concerning.
article.articleSummary: Malaria control in Mumbai shows rising transmission despite expanded testing. The city reports that annual malaria parasite incidence (API) rose from 0.3 in 2022 to 0.5 in 2023, 0.6 in 2024, and 0.8 per 1,000 population in 2025, indicating sustained transmission as testing increased. Blood testing numbers climbed from 1,428,265 samples in 2015 (ABER 11.3%) to 1,516,655 in 2024 (ABER 11.7%), and to 1,889,012 in 2025 (ABER 14.5%). By June 2026, 761,439 samples were tested, of which 3,394 yielded malaria positive. The slide positivity rate (SPR) remained around 0.5% across 2023–2025. Public health officials caution that merely increasing tests is insufficient; vector source reduction, effective mosquito control, timely diagnosis and treatment, and targeting malaria sources are needed. A Chembur bribery case involving two BMC employees is noted, alongside RTI activist Chetan Kothari’s disclosures.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのマラリア症例：検査は増加も撲滅にはまだ遠い！感染指数の上昇が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの流行地における継続的な監視データであり、突発的なアウトブレイクではないが、感染指数（API）の緩やかな上昇傾向が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: マラリアはムンバイの風土病であり、本記事は年次統計報告（API/ABER/SPRの推移）が主題。突発的な公衆衛生危機ではなく、既存の媒介動物対策プログラムの効果に関する行政報告に近い。汚職疑惑への言及もあり社会的関心は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Reports 53,362 Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease Cases in 2026
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 53,362 cumulative hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases nationwide in 2026 from Jan 1 to Sep 1, with 1 death (0.002 per 100,000) and 5,408 hospitalisations. The 2026 total remains lower than the same period last year. Children aged 0–4 are most affected, followed by 5–9 and 10–14. Symptoms include fever with mouth ulcers or red spots on the tongue, palate or inner cheek, plus rash or clear blisters on the palms, soles, torso or buttocks. Severe signs—high fever, poor fluid intake, lethargy, convulsions, vomiting or laboured breathing—may indicate encephalitis or myocarditis. Outbreaks are clustered in schools and childcare centres; measures include daily screening, sending sick children home, closing classrooms with two or more cases in a week, regular cleaning, handwashing facilities, and banning sharing of personal items. Parents should keep symptomatic children at home for five working days or until fully recovered; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、2026年に手足口病53,362例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病はタイで毎年発生する季節性疾患であり、2026年の累計は前年同期を下回っている。死亡率も低く、既存の対策（学校閉鎖・衛生管理等）で管理されており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: タイ保健当局による定例の手足口病サーベイランス報告。前年同期比で症例数は減少しており、重症化率・死亡率も低い水準。学校・保育施設での標準的な感染対策が既に実施されており、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: बदलते मौसम से बच्चों पर वायरल संक्रमण का तेज अटैक -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid surge in viral infections among children due to changing weather.
article.articleSummary: Rapid surge in viral infections among children in Jabalpur and the Mahakoshal region (Mandla, Katni, Dindori, Seoni, Shahdol, Umaria) as of 6 September 2026, due to fluctuating weather. District Hospital Victoria, Medical College Hospital, and private clinics report overcrowded OPDs with fever, cold, cough, sore throat, headache, and body aches. Children are most affected; daily pediatric OPD visits rose from about 70–80 to roughly 150. Fever in many cases lasts at least five days before subsiding. While not specifying a pathogen, clinicians note widespread viral infections affecting adults too (young adults, elderly, women) and some severe cases require admission in government facilities. Public health guidance includes isolating sick household members, seeking timely care, staying hydrated, eating well, resting, and avoiding crowded areas and outside food. No laboratory-confirmed pathogen details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動により子供のウイルス感染が急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス感染症の急増であり、病原体特定なし・重症度も限定的だが、小児科OPD受診が急増し一部入院例もあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 病原体不明の季節性ウイルス感染症の急増報道。ラボ確認情報なし。地域限定（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州マハコーシャル地方）で国際的拡大の懸念は低い。続報での病原体特定・重症度情報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng, chống bệnh truyền nhiễm, bảo vệ sức khỏe học sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactively prevent and control infectious diseases, protect students' health.
article.articleSummary: Ongoing dengue outbreaks in Vietnam as the new school year begins: Dong Nai reports over 9,000 dengue cases in 2026 with 5 deaths amid peak monsoon; Hai Phong records 8 dengue clusters, 25 new cases, 208 total this year, with high risk in Kien An, Le Chan and Cat Hai. Gia Lai reports 5,360+ cases and 1 death, with 69 active outbreaks across 36 communes/wards. Authorities urge intensified vector surveillance, environmental sanitation, larval-source reduction, and targeted fogging; symptoms include sudden fever, headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, nausea, with careful home monitoring. This supports the shift from treatment to proactive prevention per Resolution 72-NQ/TW. Hand, foot and mouth disease reaches about 100,000 cases nationwide in eight months, up 2.5× from 2025, mainly children under 5 in Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang and Hanoi; schools urged to strengthen prevention in nurseries and kindergartens.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症を積極的に予防・制御し、児童生徒の健康を守る
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱・手足口病(HFMD)の季節性流行報告で、症例数増加や死亡例はあるが既知の風土病の定期報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは低い。HFMDの前年比2.5倍増という数値は注視すべき異常値。
triage.notes: 疾患タグに『Foot And Mouth Disease（口蹄疫）』とあるが、記事内容は児童に多い『Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease（手足口病）』であり、動物疾病ではない。デング熱・HFMDともにベトナム国内の季節性流行報告であり、当局が積極的な対策を呼びかけている段階。国際支援要請の記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: HK residents urged to get flu jab with three more children infected
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Hong Kong remains high, with three additional pediatric infections and three severe cases of influenza A/B reported. The 6-year-old girl (Wan Chai) developed fever, runny nose and cough on Sept 3, was admitted to Ruttonjee Hospital’s A&E and later transferred to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital, diagnosed with influenza A complicated by encephalopathy. The 3-year-old girl developed fever on Sept 2, had convulsions and septic shock, and was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital with influenza A complicated by septic shock. The 15-year-old boy developed fever on Sept 3, was admitted after transfer to Queen Mary Hospital with influenza B complicated by septic shock. None had travel history; household contacts remained asymptomatic; two classmates of the 6-year-old had mild symptoms. CHP urges vaccination as seasonal programs begin Sept 17 and warns outbreaks may persist with school reopening, calling for infection-control measures in schools.

triage.headline_ja: 香港住民にインフルエンザワクチン接種を呼びかけ、子ども3人が新たに感染
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザによる小児重症例（脳症・敗血症性ショック）が複数報告されているが、渡航歴なし・家庭内感染なしで、季節性の想定内の事象であり国際的拡大の兆候はない。学校再開に伴う感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例だが、対象国リストのルールに従いChina(1814991)に含めた。季節性インフルエンザの毎年の流行報告であり、渡航歴なし・地域内で管理可能な事案。学校再開後の感染拡大状況を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Calabarzon races to vaccinate more children as measles-rubella campaign nears end
article.articleSummary: Calabarzon, Philippines pushes measles and rubella vaccination as the Ligtas Tigdas 2026 campaign enters its final stretch. More than 758,000 children aged six months to five years have been vaccinated, about 56.8% of the region’s 1.34 million-target population. The drive was extended to September 4 after bad weather disrupted activities, allowing health workers to reach more children. Laguna Province has the highest coverage at 71.7%, while other areas in Calabarzon remain below 55%. In addition to vaccination, over 674,000 children have received vitamin A supplementation, covering roughly 47% of the target population. Officials cite vaccine misinformation as a barrier and urge guardians to participate, stressing that measles and rubella are highly contagious but preventable with vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: カラバルソン地方、麻疹・風疹予防接種キャンペーン終了間近で子どもへの接種加速
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の流行そのものではなく予防接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はないが、ワクチン忌避や接種率の低さは流行リスクとして継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹・風疹の感染拡大事例ではなく、予防接種キャンペーンの進捗と課題（低接種率、ワクチン誤情報）を伝える内容。実際の症例数・発生状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Dengue brigades' reactivated in Albay barangays as cases rise
article.articleSummary: 1,457 dengue cases (Jan 1–Sep 2) with 11 deaths in Albay, Philippines, up 27.37% from 1,144 cases and 3 deaths in 2025. Among cases, 763 were female and 694 male. Executive Order No. 51, Series 2026, directed by Rosal, reactivates and strengthens the Aksyon Barangay Kontra Dengue (ABKD) and barangay dengue brigades across Albay for prevention and control. Activities include community clean-up drives, source reduction, health education, surveillance, reporting, referral, and mobilization of officials, health workers, volunteers, schools, establishments, civil society, and residents. Goal: improve community reporting and timely detection, reporting, and management of dengue concerns; residents urged to report breeding sites, suspected clusters, or unusual increases to brigades or health workers. Integrated with the 4 o'clock habit and the 4S/4Ts framework (4Ts: taob, taktak, tuyo at takip) to eliminate breeding sites; PHO to provide technical assistance and coordinate with local health offices, hospitals, schools, barangays, and stakeholders.

triage.headline_ja: 症例増加に伴い、アルバイ州のバランガイで「デング・ブリゲード」再稼働
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・アルバイ州でのデング熱症例・死者数の増加が見られるが、季節性の流行対応であり異常性や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、地方自治体レベルで対応が進められているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 前年同期比で症例数27.37%増加、死亡者数も3名から11名に増加しているが、地方自治体（PHO）が独自に対応策（EO No.51）を発動しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。季節性のデング流行対応としては一般的な内容。

article.articleHeadline: Sajadah dan Formulir TB 03: Catatan dari Puskesmas di Brebes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prayer Rug and TB-03 Form: Notes from the Brebes Community Health Center
article.articleSummary: Brebes, Central Java, recorded more than 3,100 tuberculosis (TB) cases in 2024, marking it as a TB hotspot. At Brebes Puskesmas, TB officer Anisa handles TB01, TB03, TB06 forms, referrals, medications, and sputum bottles, illustrating frontline case management. Four patients were lost to follow-up—three onion harvest workers from Losari who traveled to Indramayu—raising transmission and drug-resistance risks if treatment lapses. Following intervention, Anisa coordinated with a village midwife in Losari to supply meds via cadres; the patients were found three days later. Separately, a 30-year-old onion worker tested smear-positive TB and requires six months of OAT, facing stigma: neighbors ostracize, a child expelled from PAUD, and his wife threatened with relocation. To counter misinformation, Anisa organized a casual TB education session at a Balai RW with cooking and coffee; about 40 residents attended.

triage.headline_ja: 礼拝用マットとTB-03用紙：ブレベス保健所からの記録
triage.triage_reason: 既知の風土病である結核の通常の症例管理・地域保健活動を描いた記事であり、異常な増加や新規変異、公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブレベス地域の保健所職員による日常のTB患者管理（服薬追跡、スティグマ対応、住民啓発活動）を描いたヒューマンインタレストストーリーであり、アウトブレイクや急増を報告するものではない。2024年の症例数(3,100件)は年間累計データであり、突発的な異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: موج تازه کرونا و آنفولانزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New wave of coronavirus and influenza
article.articleSummary: Iran faces a renewed wave of COVID-19 and influenza. Infectious-disease experts attribute changes in patterns to rainfall shifts, increased travel, deforestation, expanded international links, and greater human–animal contact, with the pandemic playing a key role. Over the past three weeks, among people with cough and respiratory infections, cases of COVID-19 and influenza have risen. High‑risk groups—children under 12, older adults, pregnant women, and those with chronic diseases—are urged to wear masks in crowded settings. Influenza B circulated into summer and accounted for about 5–5.5% of infections; now influenza A is expected to predominate and may bring more severe disease. Influenza vaccines are constrained this year; about one million doses are being sourced from China and Russia, with distribution for eligible high‑risk individuals anticipated late September to early October. Symptoms overlap between the illnesses, requiring clinical assessment for accurate diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: コロナとインフルエンザの新たな波
triage.triage_reason: イランにおける季節性のCOVID-19・インフルエンザ流行の記事であり、対象国（中国・ロシア等）は感染発生国ではなくワクチン供給元として言及されているのみで、対象地域での発生事例ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイランにおける季節性COVID-19・インフルエンザ流行。中国・ロシアはワクチン調達元として言及されるのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, cinque casi nella Marca: tre in una sola settimana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue, five cases in Marche: three in a single week.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Marche: five imported infections this summer, with three in a single week; all acquired abroad in endemic countries and transmitted by infected mosquitoes. In San Vendemiano, Veneto, authorities initiated vector-control after a 50-year-old woman returning from Cuba was hospitalized in Conegliano with high fever, vomiting, rash, and thrombocytopenia. Measures include targeted adulticiding and widespread larviciding, along with removing standing water and distributing larvicidal tablets to residents. In Resana, a resident woman who recently returned from Sri Lanka was admitted; containment includes anti-mosquito treatments and porta-a-porta larvicide campaigns, with larvicides distributed to households. A boy from Vascon di Carbonera, who returned from Vietnam, was diagnosed. No antiviral exists; treatment is supportive. A live attenuated dengue vaccine is available through Ulss 2 travel clinics (two doses, 3 months apart). Travelers are advised to use repellents, wear protective clothing, and seek medical care promptly after returning from endemic regions.

triage.notes: 本記事はイタリア（マルケ州・ヴェネト州）における輸入デング熱症例（渡航歴：キューバ、スリランカ、ベトナム）についての報道であり、対象国リストに含まれるベトナムは患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、同国内での感染症発生・流行を示す情報ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: पंजाब में स्वाइन फ्लू से पहली मौत, मरीजों की संख्या 220 पहुंची
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First swine flu death in Punjab; patient count reaches 220.
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports 220 confirmed H1N1 swine flu cases this year, with Ludhiana (72) and SAS Nagar Mohali (36) most affected, followed by Patiala (16), Moga (11), Jalandhar (10), Ropar (9) and Fazilka (1); other districts report 2–8 each. The rise began in August, prompting enhanced surveillance and the installation of flu corners and isolation units in hospitals. In Jalandhar, 85-year-old Mool Raj of Tajpur, admitted with breathlessness, tested positive for H1N1 on September 2 at GMC Amritsar and died September 5 at Civil Hospital Jalandhar. Officials note he had COPD and other co-morbidities; whether death was due to H1N1 will be determined after a formal health audit. The health minister says there is no evidence of a new or mutated H1N1 strain. Since January, 1,513 suspected cases were tested, 220 positives; 14 new positives were recorded on Friday.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州で豚インフルエンザ（H1N1）による初の死亡例、患者数220人に到達

triage.notes: パンジャブ州（インド）における季節性H1N1豚インフルエンザの症例増加報告。死亡例は85歳男性でCOPD等の基礎疾患があり、死因のH1N1関連性は正式な健康監査待ち。保健相は新規・変異株の証拠なしと発表。地域限定的な季節性流行であり、現時点でフルRRAへの移行基準（IHR2件以上）は満たさないが、症例数増加傾向のため経過観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Sifilis Ancam Usia Muda di Fakfak, Puskesmas Bomberai Deteksi 24 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Syphilis Threatens Youth in Fakfak, Bomberai Public Health Center Detects 24 Cases.
article.articleSummary: Twenty-four syphilis cases were detected at Bomberai Public Health Center (Puskesmas Bomberai) in Fakfak Regency, West Papua, Indonesia, from January to July 2026. Monthly counts: January 3, February 4, March 6, April 2, May 1, June 6, July 2. The majority are from the young productive age group; pregnant women undergo comprehensive screening for syphilis and HIV to safeguard their babies. Detection depends on patients presenting with symptoms, as door-to-door outreach screening is challenging, leaving several cases undetected outside clinics. Authorities urge safer sexual behavior and consistent use of protection, and promote the Free Health Check Program (CKG) for early detection, spanning ages 18 and older. Public health messaging, including videos and advisories, will be used to encourage health screening and timely treatment where needed.

triage.notes: 地域の保健所レベルでの性感染症モニタリング事例。地方紙報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は限定的。継続的な性感染症対策の一環として扱われるべき事案。

article.articleHeadline: First suspected swine flu death in Punjab, H1N1 cases rise to 220
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports its first suspected swine-flu death of the season: an 85-year-old Jalandhar resident with COPD tested positive for H1N1 on Sept 2, 2026, and died Sept 5 while undergoing treatment. Health officials classify the case as suspected swine flu; final cause will be determined after a formal health audit. Confirmed H1N1 cases in Punjab reach 220 this year, with 1,513 suspected tested since January; 14 new cases were reported on Friday. Districts with the highest counts are Ludhiana 72, Mohali 36, Patiala 16, Moga 11, Jalandhar 10, Rupnagar 9, Fazilka 1, with others 2–8. Officials say the detected strain is not new or mutated. Surveillance has been intensified — flu corners and isolation units activated — as cases rise since August. Public urged to seek medical attention for flu-like symptoms; the Jalandhar death is not yet directly attributed to H1N1.

article.articleHeadline: Lucknow's active H1N1 caseload rises to 63 as 11 new infections reported
article.articleSummary: Lucknow’s active Influenza A (H1N1) tally rose to 63 after 11 new infections were reported on Saturday, lifting the active caseload from 52 to 63. Two patients were hospitalised and nine placed in home isolation. Since the season began, 20 H1N1 patients have been hospitalised; 17 have recovered and been discharged. The season’s first death—a 50-year-old woman—occurred on August 27. After two cases were detected at Balrampur Hospital on August 29, no new infections were recorded on August 28, 30 or 31, with four, six, and nine new cases reported on September 1–3, respectively. By September 6, 63 active cases remained, with four discharged on September 3 and two on September 4. Authorities have intensified surveillance and contact tracing, reinforced hospital screening and PPE, and urged mask use and distancing. A September 1 meeting capped private RT-PCR testing at ₹3,000.

triage.headline_ja: ラクナウのH1N1活動症例数が63人に増加、新たに11人の感染確認

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の地域的流行であり、IHR基準には該当しないが、症例増加・死亡例・行政の対応強化がみられるため経過を注視する価値がある。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: A rational multi-target RNA interference approach for effective suppression of Japanese encephalitis virus replication
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis virus (JEV), a major cause of viral encephalitis in the Asia-Pacific region, remains a public health concern due to suboptimal vaccine coverage and lack of approved antivirals. In HeLa cells, researchers designed small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) targeting prM, NS1, NS3, and NS5; individual siRNAs reduced viral protein expression and infectious virus production while preserving >85% cell viability. A multi-target siRNA cocktail further suppressed replication to about 5–6% of scrambled control levels and maintained cell viability after infection. Neither individual siRNAs nor the cocktail produced detectable increases in protein kinase R phosphorylation under the tested conditions. These findings support the feasibility of multi-target RNAi-mediated suppression of JEV replication in vitro and provide a basis for further evaluation of RNAi-based antivirals against related flaviviruses.

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎ウイルス複製の効果的な抑制のための合理的な多標的RNA干渉アプローチ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実験室でのin vitro研究報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・フィールドイベントではない。公衆衛生への直接的な影響や異常な流行状況の報告はなく、基礎研究レベルの知見提供のみである。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature誌掲載の査読済み研究論文であり、中国でのJEVアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、HeLa細胞を用いた実験室での治療法開発研究である。シグナルトリアージの対象外の基礎研究報告のため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增1例境外移入屈公病 菲籍移工入境即發燒採檢確診 未進入社區 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports 1 new imported case of Qu Gong disease; Filipino migrant worker on arrival developed fever, tested positive, and has not entered the community - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung, Taiwan reports 1 new imported case of Chikungunya fever in a 38-year-old Filipino migrant worker. He returned from the Philippines on Aug 19–Sept 4 and developed fever on Sept 4 at Kaohsiung Airport. Dengue NS1 was negative; he was isolated at Kaohsiung Municipal Min-Sheng Hospital. On Sept 5, Taiwan CDC confirmed chikungunya by PCR. He had not entered his residence or workplace, and no community exposure; contacts are being monitored and his wife is being tested with pending results. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; symptoms include fever, joint pain, headache, myalgia, fatigue, and rash, with arthralgia often long-lasting. Public health urges travelers to wear light clothing, use approved repellents, and report travel, occupation, and contact histories (TOCC). The Dengue Overseas Reward Program runs through 2026-12-31; new overseas students are not eligible; re-entry foreign workers receive 200 NT vouchers. Routine mosquito-control encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で新たに1例のチクングニア熱の輸入症例、フィリピン人労働者が入国時に発熱し検査で陽性、地域社会には入っていない
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例であり、地域社会への感染拡大は確認されていない。国際的拡大リスクや重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Palpa records 231 dengue cases in less than two months
article.articleSummary: Dengue surge in Palpa district, Lumbini Province, Nepal: 231 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases recorded in less than two months of fiscal year 2083/84 BS (through Bhadra 20). Cases reported across four major hospitals—Palpa Hospital in Tansen, Rampur Hospital, Lumbini Medical College in Prabhas, and United Mission Hospital in Tansen—as well as other facilities and private centers. Health officials cite climate change and expanded dengue testing, with many patients from outside the district treated at two large Palpa private hospitals contributing to the high count. Historical data show 432 cases in 2082/83 BS, 510 in 2081/82 BS, and 686 in 2080/81 BS. Dengue, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, typically rises during the rainy season; authorities urge eliminating mosquito breeding sites and adopting bite precautions.

triage.headline_ja: パルパ郡で2ヶ月足らずのうちにデング熱231例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ネパール・パルパ郡における季節性のデング熱流行であり、過去数年と同程度かそれ以下の水準で、対象国（India等）における発生ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にIndia (Uttar Pradesh)が含まれるが、記事本文の主題はネパール・ルンビニ州パルパ郡のデング熱流行であり、インドでの発生は確認できない。過去数年（432例、510例、686例）と比較して今年の231例は低水準で、季節性・毎年恒例の流行と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng, chống bệnh truyền nhiễm, bảo vệ sức khỏe học sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactively prevent and control infectious diseases, protect students' health.
article.articleSummary: From January 2026 through 6 September 2026, Dong Nai Province reported over 9,000 dengue fever cases with 5 deaths, as hot, humid rainy-season conditions boost Aedes mosquitoes. Authorities urge intensified surveillance, early outbreak detection, risk assessment, and proactive vector control, including insecticide campaigns; schools should strengthen hygiene and remove water-holding items. In Haiphong, 24–30 August recorded eight dengue clusters and 25 new cases; total 208 cases this year, about 240 fewer than 2025's same period. High-risk areas include Kien An, Le Chan, and Cat Hai. In Gia Lai, late August brought over 420 new cases, lifting totals to more than 5,360 with one death; 69 active outbreaks across 36 communes. Emphasis on larval source reduction, water container management, and prompt care. Nationwide hand-foot-mouth disease neared 100,000 cases in eight months, about 2.5 times higher, mainly children under five; MOH urges schools to reinforce hygiene and the '3 clean' principle.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症の積極的な予防・制御、児童生徒の健康保護
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム複数省でデング熱の死亡例を伴う流行が継続し、全国的に手足口病（エンテロウイルス71）が前年比約2.5倍に急増しており、IHR基準の重大性・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はドンナイ省・ハイフォン市・ザライ省で死亡例を伴い流行中。手足口病は全国で前年比約2.5倍に増加し主に5歳未満の小児に影響。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: طيران الإمارات: دولة الإمارات لن تسمح بدخول المسافرين الذين سبق لهم التواجد في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية وأوغندا وجنوب السودان بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emirates: The United Arab Emirates will not allow entry to travelers who have previously been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Emirates confirms the United Arab Emirates will not allow entry to travelers who have previously been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan due to Ebola-related concerns. The measure targets inbound travelers and those transiting through the UAE, requiring compliance with the entry rules of the traveler’s final destination. The announcement signals precautionary Ebola travel restrictions tied to exposure in the three African countries. The article provides no details on Ebola case counts, outbreaks, or laboratory confirmations. It emphasizes that transit passengers through the UAE must follow standard entry procedures relevant to where they are headed. The three affected locations are the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; the disease referenced is Ebola.

triage.triage_reason: UAEがエボラ関連でDRC等からの入国を制限する措置を発表しており、渡航制限基準（IHR）とエピデミック可能性（WPRO）に該当し、政府・社会的関心も高いと判断されるため。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增境外移入屈公病病例 菲籍移工入境即隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports new imported Qu Gong disease cases; Filipino migrant workers are quarantined upon entry.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reports one imported Chikungunya case. The patient is a 38-year-old Filipino migrant worker who visited the Philippines from Aug 19 to Sept 4 and arrived at Kaohsiung International Airport on Sept 4 with fever. A dengue NS1 rapid test was negative; he was isolated in hospital. On Sept 5, PCR confirmed Chikungunya. He had not yet returned home or to work, and had not been in the community, so no mass chemical spray is planned. Contacts, including his wife, are being tested. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus and causes fever, severe joint pain, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, and rash; joint pain may persist. Travelers to endemic areas should wear light-colored long sleeves and pants, use government-approved repellents, and monitor after return. Health authorities urge weekly home/work inspections to remove standing water and reduce transmission.

article.articleHeadline: स्वाइन फ्लू ने बढ़ाई चिंता, मंडल में 21 मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu raises concern, 21 patients in the mandal.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) cases in Bareilly division total 21: Bareilly 9, Badaun 8, Shahjahanpur 3, Pilibhit 1. In the last week, nine new infections emerged; the prior week had five, all district residents. Four new cases were reported on Friday, diagnosed in private labs. Free testing at the district hospital is planned once TRUNAT kits arrive; the supplier said Bareilly-bound kits were dispatched and should reach by Monday, enabling testing from Tuesday. A district control room has been activated and health workers deployed in three shifts. Medicines and vaccines are being provided at health centers. Notable contacts include four relatives of a Vasant Vihar woman and nine others; Nawabganj also reports an infection with intensified surveillance for a dialysis patient in Vasant Vihar. Saturday saw 2,500+ patients at the district hospital with fever, cough, cold, sore throat, and ear infection; OPD and lab crowds were heavy.

triage.headline_ja: 豚インフルエンザへの懸念高まる、管区内で21人の患者
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州バレリー管区における季節性H1N1インフルエンザの局地的クラスター（21例）であり、既知の病原体・地方レベルでの通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内で、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの地方クラスターであり、地元当局（検査キット手配、コントロールルーム設置等）で対応中。国レベル・国際レベルでの懸念事象ではないためverified_locationsは対象国リストの主題国としてIndiaが該当するが、事象の性質上重大性は低い。念のためIndiaは含めず判定した。

article.articleHeadline: 菲律賓籍移工探親後返回高雄發燒 入境機場確診屈公病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Filipino migrant worker returns to Kaohsiung with fever after visiting relatives, diagnosed with Qu Gong disease at the airport of entry.
article.articleSummary: A 38-year-old Filipino migrant worker arrived at Kaohsiung International Airport on September 4, 2026, with fever. Dengue NS1 rapid test was negative; he was hospitalized in isolation at Kaohsiung Municipal Min-Sheng Hospital. On September 5, the Taiwan CDC confirmed Qu Gong disease (Qu Gong disease) by PCR. The patient had departed the Philippines on August 19 and returned September 4; he did not return to his residence or workplace in Taiwan and did not participate in community activities after entry, so no emergency mosquito-control was launched at residence/work sites. Close contacts are being monitored; his wife is also being tested. Qu Gong disease is mosquito-borne, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, with sudden fever, joint pain (often prolonged), headache, myalgia, fatigue, and rash. The dengue prevention program incentives extend through 2026-12-31, offering NT$500 vouchers for eligible residents/students/new immigrants and families, with foreign re-entrants receiving NT$200; new foreign students are ineligible.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン籍移工が親族訪問後に発熱して高雄に帰国、入国空港でチクングニア熱と確定診断
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単一の輸入チクングニア熱症例であり、地域内感染や二次感染の兆候はなく、公衆衛生上の重大な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 患者はフィリピンから渡航後に発症した輸入症例であるが、フィリピン国内での流行状況や感染源の特定は記事内で言及されておらず、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。接触者監視は実施中だが、地域内伝播（蚊媒介）の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: India flags Abhayrab rabies vaccine batch as substandard, probes if
article.articleSummary: CDSCO flagged a batch of Abhayrab rabies vaccine (batch KE25012) as substandard and potentially spurious after a potency test failed. Indian Immunologicals Ltd (IIL), which makes Abhayrab and accounts for about 40% of India’s domestic market, said the vials examined were not manufactured by the company and were seized from an unlicensed premises in Mukherjee Nagar, Delhi. The regulator said no part of KE25012 had been exported and four people were arrested. IIL noted the original batch comprised 83,370 vials distributed through authorised channels; vaccines supplied via hospitals and licensed pharmacies were unaffected. Lab tests showed sterility, moisture and identity passed, but the sample differed from a retained reference in 17 aspects, raising concerns about identity and authenticity and prompting a probe under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act. A 2025 counterfeit KA24014 triggered US/UK/Australia travellers alerts. India records about 5,726 rabies deaths annually (2024 ICMR), with nearly 6,000 cited; Abhayrab is used pre- and post-exposure and is exported to 40+ countries.

triage.headline_ja: インドがAbhayrab狂犬病ワクチンの1ロットを規格外と指摘、偽造の可能性を調査
triage.triage_reason: 偽造・規格外の狂犬病ワクチンがデリーで摘発された事案。感染症の直接的な流行拡大ではなく、規制当局が調査中の薬事問題であり、過去に同様の偽造ロットが国際的な渡航者警告を引き起こした経緯があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症アウトブレイクではなく、狂犬病ワクチンの偽造・品質不正に関する薬事規制問題。当該ロットは輸出されておらず流通は限定的だが、2025年の別ロット(KA24014)偽造事件で米英豪が渡航者向け警告を出した前例があり、今後の国際的反応を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄新增境外移入屈公病病例 菲籍移工入境即隔離
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung reports a new imported case of Qu Gong disease; Filipino migrant workers are quarantined on entry.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reports an imported case of chikungunya fever in a 38-year-old Filipino migrant worker. The man returned from Philippines to Kaohsiung on Sept 4 after Aug 19–Sept 4 travel; he developed fever at entry, Dengue NS1 screening was negative, and he was quarantined and hospitalized. On Sept 5, the CDC confirmed chikungunya infection by PCR. He had not yet returned to residence or workplace and had no community exposure; authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring and testing his wife, who is awaiting results. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus and presents with fever, severe joint pain, headaches, muscle pain, fatigue, and rash; joint pain can persist. Travelers to endemic regions should wear light clothing, use approved repellents, and seek care promptly if symptoms arise, reporting TOCC. The bureau also urges weekly mosquito-control measures at home and work to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で新たな輸入チクングニア熱症例、フィリピン人移民労働者を入境時に隔離
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入症例であり、地域内伝播や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。対象国での発生でもない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（高雄）での輸入症例1件の報告であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。フィリピンは渡航先として言及されているのみで、フィリピン国内でのアウトブレイクを報じるものではないため verified_locations には含めない。接触者調査・配偶者の経過観察は実施中だが地域拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Drones e IA ajudam DF a combater criadouros do mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drones and AI help the Federal District combat Aedes aegypti breeding grounds.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Brazil’s Federal District (DF) shows 10,203 suspected cases in weeks 1–34 of 2026, per SES-DF’s Aug 31 bulletin; 195 confirmed dengue cases, 14 with alarm signs, and no deaths. Drones and AI assist Environmental Health Surveillance Agents (AVAS) to identify Aedes aegypti breeding sites from ~120 m altitude, with privacy protections. The DF is divided into five risk strata; Estrato 5, highest, includes Brazlândia, São Sebastião, Fercal, Estrutural, Varjão, Sol Nascente/Pôr do Sol and Arapoanga; Estrato 4 includes Paranoá, Planaltina, Ceilândia, Itapoã, Sobradinho II, Recanto das Emas, Sobradinho, Água Quente. After mapping, agents visit indicated properties; open caixas-d'água receive guidance and deadlines, with follow-up checks. In Sol Nascente, 1,500 houses were inspected; 150 not reached (~10% pending). Tools include ovitrampas and Larvicida Disseminating Stations (EDLs): 2,200 stations across 2,200 properties, supervised by 15 agents. Vaccination is available for ages 10–14.

triage.headline_ja: ドローンとAIが連邦区(DF)のデング熱媒介蚊発生源対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル連邦区における定例のデング熱対策（ドローン・AI活用の蚊媒介源特定）に関する記事であり、死亡例なし、症例数も通常のサーベイランス範囲内で、異常性・深刻性・社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: デング熱は媒介感染症として流行性・長期曝露の懸念は本質的にあるが、本記事は連邦区の定例サーベイランス報告と対策技術（ドローン・AI）の紹介が主題であり、症例急増や死亡例の報告はない。ルーチンの活動報告としてDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC deja ya más de 6.500 casos, con cerca de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already left more than 6,500 cases, with around ....
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 6,522 cases and 3,134 deaths, with 86 new infections and 30 deaths in the last 24 hours; 21 recoveries bring total recovered to 1,516. Case fatality rate is 48.1% and contact tracing completion is 86%. Ituri province in the northeast remains the epicenter, accounting for about 80.9% of detected cases. Declared mid-May in the eastern DRC, this is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history and could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which recorded 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO. The DRC ended a Kasai outbreak in December 2025 and is recognized for extensive Ebola experience. The virus was first identified in 1976 near Yambuku on the Ebola River.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、症例数が6,500件、死者数は約3,150人に達する
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%、症例6,522件・死亡3,134人に達し、DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行として西アフリカ流行(2014-16)を超える可能性が指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: リベリア・ギニア・シエラレオネは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較のために言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないため除外。Ituri州・Kasai州はDRC国内の地域であり、DRCとして集約。

article.articleHeadline: Haldwani News: ज्योलीकोट में जलजनित बीमारी का तांडव! 16 वर्षीय रितेश और दो बेटियों की मां की मौत, स्वास्थ्य व्यवस्था पर भी उठे सवाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Haldwani News: Ravages of a waterborne disease in Jyolikot! Deaths of 16-year-old Ritesh and the mother of two daughters; questions have also been raised about the healthcare system.
article.articleSummary: From late June, Jyolikot in Haldwani, Uttarakhand is hit by a waterborne outbreak, now evolving into a deadly liver disease with two deaths and several jaundice cases. Initially diarrhea and vomiting; subsequently typhoid then jaundice. Contaminated drinking water is suspected; authorities criticized for not stopping the source promptly or ensuring chlorination. The first victim, 16-year-old Ritesh Geina, suffered typhoid with liver, lung, and kidney failure; after referrals to private hospitals, Delhi’s LBS and AIIMS were advised for a liver transplant, but care proved unaffordable and he died at Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital in Delhi. The second victim, 26-year-old Neema Joshi, mother of two, developed liver infection and jaundice in early September and died at Ram Murti Hospital, Bareilly, after initial treatment in Haldwani and Bareilly. Her five other household members are also afflicted by jaundice. Questions are being raised about health-system responsiveness, water-treatment lapses, and costly, prolonged referrals.

triage.headline_ja: ハルドワニ・ニュース：ジョリコットで水系感染症が猛威！16歳のリテシュ君と2児の母親が死亡、医療体制にも疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: 水系感染（腸チフス・黄疸/肝炎）によるローカルなアウトブレイクで死亡例が複数あるが、地理的範囲は小規模な村落に限定されており国際的拡大の懸念は低い。水源汚染への対応不備など公衆衛生上の懸念があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 汚染された飲料水源への塩素消毒未実施など地方自治体の対応不備が指摘されている。腸チフス後に肝炎・黄疸へ進行し死亡に至る非典型的な臨床経過だが、地域限定的な水系感染症であり国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。続報（症例数増加や地域拡大の有無）を注視すべき。
