article.articleHeadline: पंजाब में स्वाइन फ्लू से पहली संदिग्ध मौत, 85 वर्षीय बुजुर्ग ने तोड़ा दम... H1N1 के मामले 220 पार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First suspected swine flu death in Punjab, an 85-year-old man dies... H1N1 cases cross 220
article.articleSummary: Punjab reports its first suspected swine-flu death this season: an 85-year-old Jalandhar resident, Mool Raj, dies after testing positive for H1N1. He had COPD; the exact cause will be determined after a formal health audit. H1N1 was confirmed on September 2 at Amritsar GMCH; he died September 6 at Jalandhar Civil Hospital. Officials caution against linking the death to influenza until the audit is complete. A total of 220 H1N1 infections have been confirmed across Punjab from 1,513 suspected cases tested since January, with 14 new cases on Friday. Ludhiana leads with 72 cases, followed by SAS Nagar (Mohali) 36, Patiala 16, Moga 11, Jalandhar 10, Roop Nagar 9, Fazilka 1. Since August, cases have risen and hospitals activated flu corners and isolation units to speed testing and care.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州でスワインフルによる初の疑い死亡例、85歳男性死亡…H1N1感染者数220人超
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザの流行で症例数増加と初の疑い死亡例が報告されているが、既知の病原体による国内限定の季節性流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: パンジャブ州における季節性H1N1インフルエンザの流行。死亡した85歳男性はCOPDの基礎疾患があり、死因は監査完了まで確定していない。220例確認、地域病院ではflu corner設置等の対応が進んでいる。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : deux malades sur trois meurent au Nord-Kivu, moins d'un sur deux en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two out of three patients die in North Kivu, fewer than half in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: As of 4 September 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a sharp North Kivu–Ituri split: lethality 65.8% in North Kivu vs 45.1% in Ituri. National totals reach 6,522 confirmed cases and 3,134 deaths (CFR 48.1%), with 86 new cases in the prior 24 hours (53 Ituri, 31 North Kivu, 2 Haut-Uélé). The WHO notes thresholds surpassed: over 6,000 cases and over 3,000 deaths. Sixty-one of 151 health zones are affected (Kayna added). North Kivu has 969 cases and 638 deaths across 16 zones, driven by Katwa (440/286; 65.0%), Butembo (197/138; 70.1%), Beni (157/115; 73.2%), Musienene (92/50). Ituri zones show lower CFRs: Bunia (31.0%), Rwampara (35.1%), Nizi (38.8%), Mongbwalu (46.2%), Komanda (67.3%). Hospital capacity is overwhelmed in North Kivu (237 of 220 beds, 107.7%), while Ituri uses 495 of 978 beds (50.6%). WHO cites unseen transmission chains and aims to reach 3,000 beds; Ervebo vaccine guidance issued Sept 1.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：北キブ州で3人に2人が死亡、イトゥリ州では2人に1人未満
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおける大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、症例致死率が極めて高く（全国48.1%、北キブ州65.8%）、病床が定員超過（107.7%）となるなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響があり、WHOも介入している大規模シグナルであるため。
triage.notes: 位置情報にルワンダ（Kigali Province）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC国内（北キブ州・イトゥリ州・オートウェレ州）の状況のみが述べられており、ルワンダでの発生は言及されていないため verified_locations には含めない。既知の大規模継続アウトブレイクの続報である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: بسبب إيبولا.. قيود على دخول المسافرين إلى الإمارات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to Ebola, restrictions on travelers entering the UAE.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-06, Emirates Airline said the United Arab Emirates will not permit entry to travelers who have previously been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan during the period specified in the travel instructions, as a precautionary measure against Ebola. The restrictions cover both direct arrivals and those transiting through UAE airports, including indirect routes or layovers, with no automatic exemption for changing itineraries. Travelers must comply with the UAE’s entry and transit requirements for their final destination, including any health measures. Ebola is described as a highly dangerous viral disease that can spread via contact with blood or bodily fluids of an infected or deceased person. Passengers are advised to verify current travel requirements before departure, as rules may change with the evolving situation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の影響でUAEが渡航者の入国制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生国（コンゴ民主共和国等）からの渡航者に対しUAEが入国・乗継制限を課しており、国際的拡大懸念と渡航制限の両方が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEの渡航制限措置に焦点を当てているが、根本原因はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を中心としたエボラ出血熱の流行。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon fever in India: Why diagnosis matters more than self-medication and which tests can help identify dengue, malaria and typhoid
article.articleSummary: Monsoon in India elevates dengue, malaria, and typhoid risk due to stagnant water and flooding, with fever as a common early symptom. Self-medication is common but may mask infection; diagnosis matters for appropriate treatment. Dengue: NS1 antigen test and IgM within 7 days; after day 7, IgM testing primary, with CBC to monitor platelets as needed. Malaria: peripheral blood smear or malaria rapid diagnostic test (Vivax and Falciparum antigens). Typhoid: rapid tests such as Widal agglutination and Typhidot. Lab access challenges during the rains; home sample collection can aid timely testing. Early correct diagnosis prevents inappropriate self-treatment and guides infection-specific therapy. Dr. Rajeev Sharma, VP Medical Affairs, Tata1mg, underscores avoiding delays in testing.

triage.headline_ja: インドのモンスーン熱：自己判断による服薬より診断が重要な理由、デング熱・マラリア・腸チフスを見分ける検査とは
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や重症例の急増を示す情報はなく、診断法に関する解説記事にとどまる。
triage.notes: モンスーン期の毎年恒例のデング熱・マラリア・腸チフスに関する健康啓発記事であり、具体的な発生数や異常な増加を示すデータはない。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго из-за Эболы начали нападать на врачей и поджигать больницы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, Ebola sparks attacks on doctors and the burning of hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues to provoke violence against health workers and arson of hospitals. At least 45 medical workers, social workers, and humanitarian staff were injured in 76 incidents across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Distrust of visiting doctors and aid workers, and accusations of profiting from the epidemic, fuel clashes, including assaults on staff and hospitals torched after bodies were refused. Safe burials spark contention since traditional rites involve body contact and raise transmission risk, hindering contact tracing. Epidemiologists warn official counts may vastly underestimate true infections: Neil Ferguson of Imperial College London suggests cases could be up to three times higher; Airfinity estimates up to 4.7 times. The DRC reports 6,436 lab-confirmed Ebola cases and 3,095 deaths; outbreak began May 15 in DRC and Uganda and is the second-deadliest on record. Uganda's outbreak was declared over by August 25 (WHO).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ流行により医療従事者への攻撃や病院放火が発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で記録上2番目に致死率の高いエボラ流行が継続し、感染者数・死者数が極めて多く、医療従事者への暴力や病院放火など社会的混乱も深刻化しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの流行は2026年8月25日にWHOにより終息宣言済み。英国（ロンドン/イングランド）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際の症例数は公式報告の最大4.7倍に上る可能性が専門家により指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Suvendu highlights success of 3-day 'Swachhata Sankalp Abhiyan' to check dengue
article.articleSummary: West Bengal faces rising dengue cases. On 2026-09-06, Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari highlighted a three-day statewide cleanliness and larvicidal drive, Swachhata Sankalp Abhiyan, across 1,600+ wards in 128 municipalities within 22 districts to curb dengue by destroying mosquito breeding grounds. Desilting 6,065 choked drains, clearing 1,608 garbage dumping sites, and removing 4,511 roadside waste spots; 27,378 vulnerable areas were cleaned and sprayed for larvae. Special teams operated in high-traffic spaces: 1,106 markets/haats, 1,304 school/college premises, 544 government offices, and 315 hospital compounds. Public awareness was amplified with over 35,000 IEC materials, and 118 voluntary groups participated. Data from municipalities will feed intensive monitoring, focusing on wards with high vector density. The drive, synchronized across urban local bodies following a Nabanna meeting, aims to convert dengue prevention into a mass movement and improve sanitation statewide.

triage.headline_ja: スヴェンドゥ氏、デング熱対策の「スワッチャタ・サンカルプ・アビヤン」3日間キャンペーンの成功を強調
triage.triage_reason: 西ベンガル州でデング熱症例増加への言及があるが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数・重症度データがなく、内容は政府の清掃・防蚊キャンペーンの広報が中心であるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の症例数増加傾向に言及するが、具体的な統計（症例数・死亡数）は記載されておらず、内容の主眼は政府の防疫キャンペーンの成果報告である。季節性の流行対策として通常の対応範囲内と考えられるが、今後の症例数動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mengenal ALTNV, Virus Baru dari Caplak yang Ditemukan di Tiongkok
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meet ALTNV, a New Tick-Borne Virus Found in China.
article.articleSummary: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV), a newly identified tick-borne virus, was discovered in China and described in The New England Journal of Medicine. Hospital-based surveillance in China enrolled patients with fever following tick exposure, leading to genetic sequencing that defined ALTNV as a novel member of genus Orthonairovirus, family Nairoviridae; researchers also isolated the virus from patient samples for further characterization. Laboratory analysis shows ALTNV differs significantly from known species within its group. Clinically, infected patients typically report tick contact and fever; presentations may vary. Transmission risk depends on tick species, pathogen presence in the tick, and exposure geography. Preventive measures include protective clothing, thorough body and clothing checks after outdoor activities, and prompt medical evaluation for fever after a tick bite. Ongoing research is needed to clarify transmission patterns, risk levels, and long-term health effects.

triage.headline_ja: ALTNVとは何か──中国で発見されたマダニ由来の新型ウイルス
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新種のマダニ媒介性ウイルス（ALTNV）がNEJMに報告されたが、重症度・ヒトーヒト感染の可能性・拡大リスクに関する情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ALTNV（Asian longhorned tick nairovirus）はOrthonairovirus属の新種で、CCHFと同じNairoviridae科に分類される。現時点では臨床像・伝播様式の詳細が不明であり、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: आजमगढ़ में स्वाइन फ्लू की जांच के लिए मिलेंगी 45 किट, इमरजेंसी वाले सभी बेड फुल - azamgarh swine flu testing kits awaited emergency full
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Azamgarh, 45 swine flu testing kits will be available; all emergency beds are full.
article.articleSummary: In Azamgarh, India, the Government Medical College and Super Facility Hospital has not yet started swine flu testing despite rising viral fever and respiratory infections linked to weather changes. The third-floor skin department has 12 beds across four-bed cabins, plus 30 mosquito nets. An order for 45 swine flu testing kits has been placed and is expected to arrive by Monday–Tuesday; once available, the microbiology department with a TruNet machine will begin testing. The lab operates at BSL-2 under Dr. Aatosh Tripathi. Some swine flu antivirals are already available. The 30-bed emergency department is at full capacity, with four additional beds added but ongoing crowding. Medicine OPD sees over 400 patients daily with viral fever, high fever, cough, sore throat, body pains, and fatigue. Public advised to seek medical advice for prolonged fever, stay hydrated, avoid self-medication, and high-risk patients should take precautions.

triage.headline_ja: アザムガルで45個のスワインフル検査キットが到着予定、救急病床は満床
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のウイルス性発熱・呼吸器感染増加とスワインフル検査体制の不備が報告されているが、確定症例数や重症度、地域拡大の詳細情報は不明のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: スワインフル(H1N1)確定症例数や検査結果が未報告であり、現時点では疑い例と季節性ウイルス性疾患の増加が中心。検査キット到着後の確定診断状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng nhiễm virus, vi khuẩn, trẻ nhỏ đối mặt biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Co-infection with viruses and bacteria: Young children face severe complications.
article.articleSummary: Co-infection with respiratory viruses and bacteria is common in young children, with RSV, Adenovirus, influenza, Haemophilus influenzae and Streptococcus pneumoniae circulating during the summer-to-autumn transition in Vietnam. Infections can begin as a routine fever and cough but rapidly progress to pneumonia, respiratory failure, meningitis and sepsis. Co-infections involving pneumococcus and RSV are frequently observed, and modern diagnostics can detect two or three pathogens simultaneously. Streptococcus pneumoniae remains a leading cause of disease in children under five; vaccines reduce disease from covered serotypes, but non-covered serotypes persist and may be highly virulent or antibiotic-resistant. Overuse of antibiotics drives multidrug-resistant pneumococcus, complicating treatment and prompting broad-spectrum regimens. Consequences include meningitis with high fever, neck stiffness, seizures, and potential long-term sequelae such as cognitive impairment and hearing loss. Prevention emphasizes timely vaccination and consulting health professionals to tailor protection by age and exposure, especially during the August–September season in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスと細菌の混合感染:幼い子供が重い合併症に直面
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症に関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、異常なアウトブレイクや新規事象の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性の呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザ、肺炎球菌等）の混合感染に関する一般啓発・医学解説であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常な増加を報告するものではない。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事内容が通常の季節性疾患説明のためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ମ୍ୟାଲେରିଆ ସଂକ୍ରମଣ, ଓଡ଼ିଶା ପ୍ରଥମ Odisha Malaria News | Over 30,000 Cases Reported Till July 2026
article.articleSummary: Odisha, India, records the highest malaria burden in 2026 to date, per the National Center for Vector Borne Diseases Control (NCVBDC). Through the end of July 2026, Odisha reported 30,268 malaria cases and six deaths; the national total is about 109,000 cases and 26 deaths. Odisha had 62,137 malaria cases in 2025, placing the state among the country’s highest-burden areas. With cases continuing to be reported, the Odisha government is preparing new strategies to strengthen malaria control and prevention. The report provides no symptom profiles, transmission sources, or details on imported/exported cases. Data reflect ongoing surveillance and public health responses, underscoring the need for continued vigilance and program enhancements.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア感染、オディシャ州が全国トップ - 2026年7月までに30,000件以上の症例報告
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはインド・オディシャ州の風土病であり既知の疾患だが、症例数が高水準で継続報告されているため経過観察とする。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの風土病であり、症例数は多いが致死率は比較的低い（30,268例中6死亡）。政府が対策強化を準備中との記載あり。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria claims 122 lives as cases spike to 122 000
article.articleSummary: Namibia reports 122 malaria deaths and 122,612 confirmed cases in 2026, with 1.2 million households to be sprayed in the indoor residual spraying (IRS) campaign launched in Divundu. Of confirmed cases, 99,078 were locally transmitted and 23,354 imported; hospital admissions reach 9,956. Kavango East leads with 37,488 cases (30.6% of national total) and 22 deaths. Malaria remains present in 10 of Namibia’s 14 regions: Zambezi, Kavango East/West, Ohangwena, Omusati, Oshana, Kunene, Oshikoto, Omaheke and Otjozondjupa. A Roll Back Malaria/ALMA/WHO review found diagnostic surveillance effective (all suspected public-facility cases tested) but identified gaps in prevention planning/implementation, including IRS coverage below the WHO 85% target, and nets distribution, breeding-site management, and mosquito monitoring. Investigations backlog and supervision gaps are being addressed with targeted resources, plus cross-border collaboration with Angola, Zambia and Botswana to curb imports.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアで122人死亡、症例数は122,000件に急増
triage.triage_reason: ナミビアで大規模なマラリア流行（死亡122人、症例12万件超、入院約1万件）が発生し、WHO/ALMAレビューで予防対策の不備（IRS目標未達等）が指摘されており、WPRO基準の複数（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当するためフルRRAを検討すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題国はナミビア（対象国リスト外）であり、ザンビア・ボツワナ・アンゴラは越境協力の文脈での言及のみで、当該国内での症例発生を示すものではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: У ДР Конгу повређено 45 хуманитараца у инцидентима током борбе против еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, 45 humanitarian workers were injured in incidents during the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: In DR Congo, at least 45 humanitarian workers were injured in 76 incidents across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu during Ebola response activities, according to the Financial Times. Attacks by relatives of infected or deceased patients, and hospital arson after staff refused to hand over corpses, reflect mistrust in health workers who largely came from Kinshasa or abroad. Local residents blame outsiders and online hashtags like 'business with Ebola' circulate. Authorities emphasize safe burials, but communities prefer traditional rites involving contact with the deceased, fueling friction and hindering contact tracing and reporting. Experts estimate true Ebola morbidity and mortality may be several times higher than official counts: Ferguson suggests about triple the official figure; Airfinity's models indicate up to 4.7 times higher. Official lab-confirmed cases: 6,436; deaths: 3,095. The outbreak began May 15 in DRC and Uganda, with six provinces affected and Ituri as epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、エボラ対策活動中の事件により人道支援者45人が負傷
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRCエボラ流行において、公式統計の過小報告の可能性や医療従事者への暴力、接触追跡の妨げなど新たな深刻な事象が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はセルビア語メディアがFinancial Times記事を引用したもの。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外のため除外。公式統計（症例6,436、死亡3,095）に加え、専門家は実際の死者数が最大4.7倍高い可能性を指摘しており、過小報告と地域住民の医療従事者への不信が接触追跡を阻害している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Yogyakarta siapkan 3.000 dosis vaksin pertahankan nol rabies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yogyakarta City Government prepares 3,000 vaccine doses to maintain zero rabies cases.
article.articleSummary: Yogyakarta City Government’s Dinas Pertanian dan Pangan announced a September 2026 drive of 3,000 free rabies vaccines for domestic cats, dogs, and monkeys to maintain zero rabies cases in Yogyakarta. The plan follows 2025 vaccinations totaling 3,011 animals (2,435 cats, 565 dogs, 11 monkeys). Vaccines are free for animals domiciled in Yogyakarta and require the owner’s ID; vaccinations began at Pendopo Kelurahan Mantrijeron in early September 2026. Veterinary officials note most vaccinations target cats, with dogs also vaccinated; some animals are ineligible due to fever or illness, with temperature screening used to determine eligibility. Emphasis is placed on broader pet-health practices—nutrition, housing, and hygiene—to prevent zoonotic transmission. Although rabies cases are currently zero, Yogyakarta and the DIY region are tourist destinations where visiting pets may pose risks, underscoring the need for continued vaccination and vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ジョグジャカルタ市政府、狂犬病ゼロ維持のためワクチン3,000回分を準備
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の発生はゼロで、予防的なワクチン接種活動を報じる内容であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な動物ワクチン接種プログラムの通常業務報告であり、実際の狂犬病症例発生を報じるものではないため、対象国の発生地域として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго десятки врачей пострадали от нападений местных жителей из-за Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, dozens of doctors were injured in attacks by local residents over Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with cross-border relevance to Uganda. At least 45 humanitarian workers, including UN OCHA staff, were injured in attacks by local residents, and the Financial Times cites at least 76 incidents linked to relatives and villagers of Ebola patients or decedents. Locals distrust medics from Kinshasa and foreigners, accusing outsiders of profiting from the outbreak. In several incidents, health workers were assaulted and hospitals set ablaze after authorities refused to hand over bodies of Ebola victims. Communities push for traditional funeral rites; authorities emphasize safe burials. The outbreak began earlier this year in DRC and Uganda; DRC reports about 6,400 cases and roughly 3,000 deaths, while the Uganda outbreak ended in August.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、エボラ出血熱をめぐり地元住民の襲撃により数十人の医師が負傷
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（約6,400症例、約3,000死亡）が継続し、地域住民による医療従事者への攻撃という異常事態が発生。ウガンダへの越境拡大歴もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、同国のアウトブレイクは8月に終息済みであり、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。地元住民による医療従事者・国連職員への暴力、遺体引き渡し拒否を巡る対立など社会的緊張が高い点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'एक साथ कई बीमारियों के शिकार हुए बच्चे'; MP में बच्चों की मौतों पर केंद्र की रिपोर्ट में खुलासा - balaghat child deaths central report reveals multiple illnesses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A child who fell victim to several diseases at once; Centre's report reveals child deaths in Madhya Pradesh — Balaghat.
article.articleSummary: Measles, malaria, respiratory distress, dehydration, anemia, malnutrition, and shock emerged as a multi-factor illness cluster among children in Balaghat district, Madhya Pradesh. A total of 431 children were hospitalised; 379 recovered, 52 remain under treatment. Investigations were expanded from three villages to about 50, with over 32,000 people tested. A national review on August 4 preceded on-site work by NJORT and ICMR teams on August 12, with specialists from Jabalpur Medical College conducting rounds. Early deaths at home hindered initial data collection, now supplemented by door-to-door inquiries. Preventive actions include MR vaccination for over 14,000 children aged 1–10, cleaning 600+ water sources, and spraying insecticide in 4,000+ homes; six mobile medical vans deployed to Birsa and Baher areas. Severe malnutrition affected 7,711 children (518 admitted to nutrition centers); diarrhea affected 13,000+ and pneumonia 274 identified and treated. No new measles cases in the past week; ongoing surveillance and care.

triage.headline_ja: 『一度に複数の病気に襲われた子どもたち』；マディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガートの子ども死亡事案、中央政府報告書が判明
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・マラリア・重度栄養失調等が絡む複合的な小児疾患クラスターで431人が入院、複数の子どもの死亡が示唆され、NJORT/ICMRによる国家的調査が行われている点でIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 本事案はインド・マディヤ・プラデーシュ州バラガート県に限定的なローカルクラスターであり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、麻疹・マラリア・重度栄養失調が絡む複合要因による小児死亡が報告され、国家的な調査・対応（NJORT、ICMR、MRワクチン接種、給水源清掃、殺虫剤散布等）が実施されている。過去1週間で新規麻疹症例なしとの記載があり、状況は改善傾向にある可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: कांगड़ा में स्वाइन फ्लू के 48 पॉजिटिव केस, स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट; जानें बचाव के तरीके
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Kangra, 48 positive swine flu cases; Health Department on alert; Learn preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1 influenza) in Kangra district has prompted heightened health vigilance. From January to date, 48 positive cases have been reported, among 141 individuals with flu-like symptoms who were tested. No deaths have occurred so far. Most patients exhibit mild symptoms and are receiving appropriate treatment, with quick clinical improvement expected. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Omesh Bharti warns against ignoring symptoms such as persistent nasal discharge, sore throat, fever, and body pains, and advises immune-supportive measures including a nutritious diet, ample fluids, and mask use in crowded areas. To protect households, officials urge maintaining distance from symptomatic family members and seeking medical advice promptly. The Health Department continues monitoring the situation and reinforcing preventive guidance, as transmission remains a concern in the district.

triage.headline_ja: カングラでスワインフル（豚インフルエンザ）陽性48例、保健当局が警戒；予防法を紹介
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)の地域的増加で死亡例なく軽症が中心だが、地域内での感染継続が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、死亡例なし・軽症中心のため重大なリスクは低いが、地域内での持続的感染が報告されており継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Γερμανία: Συμμαχία με Κόσοβο απέναντι σε φονικούς ιούς από τσιμπούρια - SBC TV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany: Alliance with Kosovo against deadly tick-borne viruses - SBC TV
article.articleSummary: Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) is presented as a marker of how climate change shifts tick-borne viruses north into Europe, with Hyalomma ticks moving from Africa and Southern Europe toward Germany and Central Europe as milder winters aid survival. Germany and Kosovo form a strategic biosecurity partnership: Germany provides high-containment laboratories, diagnostic technology, training, and funding, while Kosovo offers access to real-world cases, field data, and community knowledge from rural areas. Since the mid-2000s, Kosovo has recorded CCHF cases in agricultural settings; mortality in some foci reaches double digits, and there is no vaccine or specific therapy. Joint surveillance and human–animal sero-epidemiological studies aim to create early warning across Europe before the virus establishes further north. The model emphasizes biosecurity as a shared defense, with implications for agriculture and economies, and urges Greece to strengthen cross-border surveillance with Balkan and Central European structures.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ:マダニ媒介性の致死性ウイルスに対抗しコソボと同盟 - SBC TV
triage.triage_reason: 記事はドイツ・コソボ間のCCHF共同監視体制構築に関する内容であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）における発生事例ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 記事はドイツとコソボの生物安全保障協力に関する内容で、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生事例ではない。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が地域リストに含まれるが、記事本文はコソボの事例を扱っており、DRCでの発生は言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னையில் 60,000 தெருநாய்களுக்கு ரேபிஸ் தடுப்பூசி: மாநகராட்சி தகவல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies vaccination for 60,000 stray dogs in Chennai: Municipal Corporation information
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination and deworming for Chennai’s stray dogs is underway under the Chennai Municipal Corporation. Launched on August 11, 2026, the drive aims to vaccinate about 200,000 dogs; 60,216 have already received the rabies vaccine and anti-parasitic treatment. The program covers six zones: Thiruvottiyur (11,795), Manali (7,207), Tondiarpet (12,684), Royapuram (8,672), Ambattur (11,895), and Madhavaram (7,963). Currently, Madhavaram and Ambattur operate with ten teams; after completion, the campaign will expand to remaining zones, targeting completion within 50 working days. The objective is a rabies-free Chennai, with cooperation sought from residents, pet owners, and animal welfare groups. City Commissioner J. S. Samiran announced the initiative.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイで野良犬6万匹に狂犬病ワクチン接種：市当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はチェンナイ市による野良犬への狂犬病予防接種・駆虫プログラムの進捗報告であり、ヒトの感染事例や異常な公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 動物への予防的ワクチン接種プログラムの進捗報告であり、感染症アウトブレイクではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: DRC launches 180-day Ebola plan, seeks $1.3 billion funding
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus. As of September 2, 2026, 6,342 reported cases and 3,072 deaths have been recorded, with transmission across 60 health zones in six provinces in eastern DRC, including the Beni area in North Kivu. Declared in May 2026, it is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the DRC to date. A revised 180-day multi-sectoral response plan, aiming to be the six-month operational roadmap, seeks $1.3 billion in funding and is supported by WHO and Africa CDC. The plan emphasizes rapid detection and community engagement, noting a large share of deaths occur in communities where cases and contacts were not identified or reached by health facilities. Authorities highlight the need for cross-sector coordination and flexible, predictable funding to curb transmission and protect residents.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、180日間のエボラ対応計画を開始、13億ドルの資金調達を要請
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国において過去最速の拡大ペースを示すエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が6州60保健地域に拡大し、6,342症例・3,072死亡と甚大な公衆衛生影響を及ぼしており、IHR基準の複数該当およびWHO/Africa CDCによる国際支援が既に行われている。
triage.notes: 致死率は約48%と高く、多数の死亡が医療機関未接触の地域社会で発生している点が特に懸念材料。DRC国内における大規模流行であり、国際的な資金・技術支援が既に動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: Zdravstveni radnici napadnuti, bolnice zapaljene: Epidemija ebole izmiče kontroli u DR Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Healthcare workers attacked, hospitals set on fire: Ebola outbreak spiraling out of control in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On September 6, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to spiral, with at least 45 humanitarian workers injured in 76 incidents during response efforts in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Some relatives of Ebola patients or the deceased attacked healthcare workers, and several hospitals were set on fire after staff refused to hand over bodies. Widespread distrust toward doctors and nurses—many deployed from Kinshasa or abroad—has fueled misinformation, including hashtags such as 'business with Ebola' and 'conspiracy with Ebola' on social media. When patients die, authorities pursue safe burials, clashing with communities preferring traditional rites involving contact with the deceased. Experts estimate true case counts may be several times higher than official figures. Lab-confirmed cases: 6,436; deaths: 3,095. The outbreak began May 15 in DRC and Uganda; the epicenter is Ituri, with six provinces affected, second-deadliest since monitoring began.

triage.headline_ja: 医療従事者への攻撃、病院放火：DRCのエボラ流行が制御不能に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ確定症例6,436件・死亡3,095件と大規模で、複数州に拡大し医療従事者への暴力や病院放火など公衆衛生対応が破綻しつつあり、IHR・WPRO基準の多くに該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも発生開始とあるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。医療従事者への攻撃や情報操作により公衆衛生対応が著しく阻害されており、地域拡大・制御不能化のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Raiva mata sete cavalos em Goiás; funcionários são monitorados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies kills seven horses in Goiás; employees are monitored.
article.articleSummary: Seven horses died of herbivore rabies at a farm about 20 kilometers from Santa Helena de Goiás in southwestern Goiás, Brazil. Laboratory confirmation from a dead horse prompted containment by animal health authorities. Three farm workers received preventive prophylaxis after contact with horse saliva; they were given human rabies vaccine and remain under clinical observation with no symptoms. Rabies in herbivores is a severe zoonosis, almost 100% fatal, typically transmitted by hematophagous vampire bats that attack cattle and unprotected horses at night. Affected horses showed weight loss, loss of appetite, motor incoordination, stumbling, severe difficulty chewing and swallowing, excessive salivation, and muscular paralysis before death. Agrodefesa inspectors mapped the area, established surveillance to locate bat colonies, and reinforced vaccination of horses, cattle, and mules within radius. Producers should report suspected cases immediately; animals with motor or neurological dysfunction must not be slaughtered for consumption, and carcass handling requires technical management.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州で狂犬病により馬7頭死亡、従業員は経過観察下に
triage.triage_reason: 動物(馬)の狂犬病発生で人への感染は確認されていないが、農場従業員が曝露後予防を受けており、コウモリを媒介とした地域拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物(草食動物)の狂犬病であり、人への感染例は報告されていない。ヴァンパイアコウモリによる伝播で地域内の家畜へのリスクは継続するため、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC deja ya más de 6.500 casos, con cerca de 3.150 muertos | La Gaceta de Salamanca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already left more than 6,500 cases, with about 3,150 deaths | The Salamanca Gazette
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), declared mid-May in the eastern region, has reached 6,522 cases and 3,134 deaths, with 86 new infections and 30 deaths in the past 24 hours; 21 discharged, total recoveries 1,516. Case fatality rate 48.1%. Contact tracing follow-up at 86%. Ituri Province in the northeast remains the epicenter, accounting for 80.9% of detected cases. The outbreak is the deadliest in DRC's history, with projections potentially surpassing West Africa's 2014–2016 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone), which totaled 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO. The DRC, which ended a Kasai outbreak in December 2025, remains the country with the most Ebola experience, facing multiple outbreaks since the virus was identified in 1976 near Yambuku.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、既に6,500人以上の感染者、約3,150人の死者
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.1%、感染者6,500人超・死者3,150人超で拡大継続中、DRC史上最悪規模と報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRC（イトゥリ州が中心）でのエボラ流行を報じている。西アフリカ2014-2016流行（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）は比較対象として言及されているのみで、現時点でこれらの国での発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Bengal carries out mega dengue prevention drive ahead of Durga Puja
article.articleSummary: West Bengal, India conducted a three-day statewide cleanliness and dengue-prevention drive ahead of Durga Puja, covering more than 1,600 wards under 128 municipalities across 22 districts. The campaign, Swachhata Sankalp Abhiyan, aimed to curb dengue by clearing debris and destroying mosquito breeding grounds. Authorities sprayed 27,378 locations, and cleared 6,065 clogged drains, removed waste from 1,608 garbage points, and addressed 4,511 roadside locations. Special drives targeted 1,106 markets/haats, 1,304 school/college premises, 544 government offices, and 315 hospital premises. Public awareness was emphasized with over 35,000 IEC materials distributed, and 118 NGOs participated. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari urged turning the effort into a mass movement to achieve a garbage-free West Bengal and united action against dengue, integrating community participation with sanitation and vector-control measures ahead of the festival season.

triage.headline_ja: 西ベンガル州、ドゥルガー・プージャを前に大規模なデング熱予防運動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は季節性の年次デング熱予防清掃活動の実施報告であり、感染急増や異常な症例報告は含まれていないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は祭り(Durga Puja)前の予防的清掃・防蚊活動の報告であり、症例数や流行状況についての言及はない。ルーティンの公衆衛生対策として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: ज्योलीकोट: दूषित पानी से 2 मौतें, 8 गांवों में फैला संक्रमण, विभाग में हड़कंप
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jyolikot: 2 deaths due to contaminated water, infection spreads to eight villages, department in a tizzy.
article.articleSummary: Jyolikot, Nainital district, India, faces a severe waterborne outbreak from contaminated drinking water. Since June, residents have suffered vomiting, diarrhea and typhoid, progressing to fatal jaundice across eight villages: Belwakhān, Bhalyuti, Sadiyatāl, Cheda, Ganja, Chopra, Krishnapur and Gethiya; Veerbhatti area is under special surveillance. Two deaths have occurred: 16-year-old Ritesh Geina and 26-year-old Neema Joshi; five other family members are also with jaundice. The Chief Medical Officer has declared a Public Health Emergency, with ASHA workers conducting active case-finding, ORS distribution and ambulance/Hospital transport. Ritesh’s symptoms began August 18; his condition worsened, requiring liver transplant, and he died after care in Delhi. Neema’s liver infection and jaundice were confirmed in early September; she died in Bareilly. Public health guidance urges boiling water, avoiding spoiled foods, frequent handwashing, and seeking formal medical care rather than home remedies.

triage.headline_ja: ジョリコット：汚染水により2人死亡、感染は8つの村に拡大、当局は騒然
triage.triage_reason: 汚染飲料水を原因とする腸チフス・黄疸の集団発生で2名が死亡し、8村に感染が拡大。地元当局が公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域はインド・ウッタラーカンド州ナイニタール県ジョリコット周辺の8村に限定されており、国際的拡大の兆候はない。ただし汚染水源による感染症流行が6月から継続しており、死者・肝移植を要する重症例が報告されているため経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: الإمارات تفرض قيوداً على المسافرين من الكونجو الديمقراطية وأوغندا وجنوب السودان بسبب إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE imposes restrictions on travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan due to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-09-06, Emirates airline announced that the United Arab Emirates will not permit entry to travelers who have previously been in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, due to concerns related to the Ebola virus. The report provides no Ebola case counts, outbreaks, symptoms, laboratory confirmations, or infection sources. It offers no details on how long the restriction lasts or potential exemptions. The article does not report any Ebola-related cases in the UAE. The measure targets individuals with recent exposure to Ebola-affected regions and signals heightened travel precautions in response to the virus. No further details were provided by Emirates.

triage.headline_ja: UAE、エボラ出血熱を理由にコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ・南スーダンからの渡航者に対する入国制限を課す
triage.triage_reason: UAEがエボラ関連国からの渡航制限を実施したことは国際的拡大懸念と渡航制限の両基準に該当し、IHR基準2項目以上を満たすためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事はUAEによる渡航制限措置の発表のみで、コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ・南スーダンにおける実際のエボラ症例数や発生状況の詳細は記載されていない。ウガンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يعاود الظهور من جديد بشرق الكونغو بعد شهرين من اختفاء الفيروس - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola re-emerges in eastern Congo after two months since the virus disappeared
article.articleSummary: Ebola re-emerges in eastern Congo with a new case in Kaïna Health Zone, North Kivu, near Lubero, after rebel-controlled areas claimed Ebola-free status in late June following 21 days without a new infection. The patient, a 21-year-old male, arrived from Botembo in government-controlled territory; the site of infection remains unclear. He was identified as a suspected Ebola case at a health checkpoint and transferred to an isolation facility, where laboratory tests confirmed the infection the next day. Authorities have begun contact tracing and intensified surveillance to prevent further spread. Since mid-May, rebel-controlled areas have reported four Ebola cases overall. The outbreak context involves the M23 rebel group, backed by Rwanda, which controls parts of North Kivu and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ東部で2か月ぶりに再出現
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の再燃事例であり、致死率の高い疾患かつ紛争地域での発生でサーベイランス・対応能力に懸念があるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の患者が政府支配地域から反乱軍支配地域近隣（北キブ州、ルベロ近郊カイナ保健区）へ移動しており、M23反乱軍支配地域では5月中旬以降計4例のエボラ症例が報告されている。紛争によりサーベイランス・接触者追跡の実施が困難な可能性が高い点に留意。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれるが記事の主題は反乱軍支配下地域を含むDRC国内の事案であり、ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: ظهور جديد لفيروس إيبولا في شرق الكونغو بعد شهرين من اختفائه
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo two months after its disappearance.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease (EVD) case has been detected in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), two months after authorities declared the outbreak over in rebel-held areas. The case is in Kaïna Health Zone, north of Lubero, North Kivu. The patient is a 21-year-old male from Botembo under government control; the place of infection is not known. He was flagged as a suspected case at a health checkpoint, quarantined at an isolation facility, and laboratory tests confirmed Ebola the following day. Health authorities have begun contact tracing and heightened surveillance to prevent further spread. Rebel-controlled areas have reported four Ebola cases since the outbreak began in mid-May. This renewed transmission underscores ongoing vigilance in eastern DRC amid conflict-affected zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部で、終息宣言から2か月後に新たなエボラ出血熱の発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤な感染症であり、終息宣言後の再発かつ紛争地域での発生であるため、国際的拡大・管理困難のリスクが高く、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 感染経路不明の新規症例であり、反政府支配地域を含む紛争地帯での発生のため、接触追跡・監視の実効性に懸念がある。過去の同地域アウトブレイクの経験からWHO等の外部支援が必要となる可能性が高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Swine Flu Alert: उन्नाव में स्वाइन फ्लू का कहर, H1N1 से दो की मौत, 8 मामले सामने आए - swine flu deaths in unnao h1n1 infected two people died during treatment in lucknow cases rise to 8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine Flu Alert: Swine flu ravages Unnao, two deaths due to H1N1, eight cases reported.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu (H1N1) outbreak in Uttar Pradesh: Unnao district reports two deaths after Kanpur had a prior fatality. In Ganjmuradabad block’s Atwa Back village, a 50‑year‑old uncle and his 56‑year‑old mother died on 2–3 September after testing positive for H1N1; their RT‑PCR confirmations came from a Lucknow lab. A doctor’s team collected samples from 15 family members, sent for RT‑PCR to KGMU Lucknow. Separately, a 53‑year‑old diabetic woman admitted to Kanpur Lilamani Hospital tested positive and was referred to LLR Hospital’s swine flu ward. Overall swine flu cases in the district have risen to eight, with two deaths this year. No official portal confirmation has been posted by Lucknow hospitals/labs yet; multiple samples remain pending.

triage.headline_ja: スワインフルー警報：ウンナオで猛威、H1N1で2人死亡、症例8件に増加
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州で季節性H1N1による死亡例が報告されているが、症例数は少なく地域限定的であり、公式ポータルでの確認も未了のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: H1N1は季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり、ウッタルプラデーシュ州カンプール・ウンナオ地域での限定的なクラスターと考えられる。公式検査確認は保留中で続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يعاود الظهور من جديد بشرق الكونغو بعد شهرين من اختفاء الفيروس - ستاد الأهلي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola resurges in eastern Congo after two months of the virus's disappearance - Al Ahly Stadium
article.articleSummary: As of 6 September 2026, Ebola has re-emerged in eastern Congo after more than two months without a case in rebel-controlled areas. The Movement for 23 March (M23), backed by Rwanda, controls parts of North Kivu and South Kivu and had announced Ebola-free status in late June after 21 days with no new infections. The latest case is a 21-year-old man in the Kaina health zone, North Kivu, near Lubero. He arrived from Butembo, a government-controlled city, and the infection source remains undetermined. He was identified as a suspected Ebola case at a health checkpoint, transferred to a quarantine facility, with laboratory confirmation the following day. Health authorities have begun contact tracing and intensified surveillance to prevent further spread. Rebel-controlled areas have recorded four Ebola cases since the outbreak was first declared in mid-May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラが再燃、ウイルス消失から2カ月後 - スタッド・アハリ
triage.triage_reason: 反政府勢力支配地域で2カ月間新規感染ゼロだったエボラが再燃し、感染源不明のまま政府支配地域からの移動者に確認された。紛争地域での対応能力の限界とヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクからIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 感染源不明の症例が紛争地域と政府支配地域の境界で発生。M23（ルワンダが支援）が実効支配する地域での保健活動の困難さが管理可能性・拡大リスクを高めている。ルワンダは支援国として言及されているのみで感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: 449 suspected cases of cholera, 13 deaths in one week in South Kivu
article.articleSummary: In the 33rd epidemiological week (late August/early September 2026) in South Kivu, 449 suspected cholera cases were reported, with 13 deaths. Of 34 health zones, 17 reported at least one suspected case. The most affected areas are Kimbi-Lulenge, Bunyakiri, Shabunda, Mulungu and Ibanda in the city of Bukavu. Among the deaths, 9 occurred in care facilities and 4 in communities. Cumulatively, South Kivu has more than 11,100 cholera cases and 195 deaths since the beginning of 2026. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing its worst cholera crisis in 25 years, driven by conflict displacement, poor sanitation and limited clean water, with eastern provinces heavily impacted and outbreaks in western zones and prisons. In 2025, the country reported 61,171 cases and 1,815 deaths (CFR ~3%). From the start of 2026 through Aug 16, the DRC tallied 33,182 cases and 943 deaths (Africa CDC).

triage.headline_ja: DRC: 南キブ州で1週間にコレラ疑い症例449件、死者13人
triage.triage_reason: 南キブ州で大規模なコレラ流行が継続しており、致死率も高く、25年ぶりの最悪の流行と報告されているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響がありフルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil（Paraíba, Mulungu）が含まれるが、記事本文はDRCの南キブ州コレラ流行のみを扱っており、Brazilは主題ではないため除外した。紛争による避難民、衛生状態悪化、水不足が流行の背景とされ、2026年通年でDRC全体では3万件超の症例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例超6500例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 6,500 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: 6,522 confirmed Ebola cases and 3,134 deaths, with 1,516 recoveries, have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo for the current outbreak. Contact tracing is 86% complete. The epidemic’s core remains in eastern Ituri Province, which accounts for 80.9% of all cases. The outbreak was declared on May 15. On August 12, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described it as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The figures come from updates reported by CCTV News citing the DRC National Institute of Public Health. The data highlight the concentrated transmission in Ituri and the ongoing national public health response to curb spread and protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例が6,500例を超える
triage.triage_reason: WHO事務局長が史上2番目の規模と言及するほどの大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率も高く、IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州が全症例の80.9%を占める。コンタクトトレーシングは86%完了だが継続中で、WHOも過去最大級の流行と位置付けている。

article.articleHeadline: 58 Tahun DBD di Indonesia, Ancaman Belum Usai: Mungkinkah Nol Kematian pada 2030?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 58 Years of Dengue Fever in Indonesia: The Threat Is Not Over Yet — Could There Be Zero Deaths by 2030?
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a persistent health challenge in Indonesia, first reported in 1968 and year-round. The Ministry of Health is developing a National Dengue Control Action Plan with a target of zero dengue deaths by 2030. A 2024 Burden of Disease study by Universitas Gadjah Mada estimates more than 2 million dengue-related hospitalizations in Indonesia and an economic burden nearing Rp9 trillion. Clinician Dr. Gia Pratama Putra notes early dengue symptoms mimic other febrile illnesses, and deterioration can occur even after fever subsides; families should monitor for warning signs such as severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, extreme weakness, agitation, or decreased consciousness and seek prompt care. Healthcare facilities emphasize rapid triage, appropriate management, and fast referrals. Prevention emphasizes consistent 3M Plus measures to reduce mosquito bites and vectors, environmental hygiene, and considering dengue vaccination with health professionals. The national goal underscores the urgency of prevention, control, and early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の58年間:脅威は終わっていない—2030年までに死亡者ゼロは可能か?
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで既知の風土病であり、本記事は既存の国家対策計画や啓発内容を扱う一般的な健康情報記事であって、新規異常発生や緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は年次的・継続的なデング熱対策に関する一般啓発記事であり、特定の異常発生や急増を報じるものではないため対象国リストへの計上は見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Új, kullancsok által terjesztett vírust azonosítottak Kínában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New tick-borne virus identified in China.
article.articleSummary: Newly identified tick-borne virus in China: Asian longhorned tick nairovirus (ALTNV) is a distinct orthonairovirus causing influenza-like illness with fever, myalgia, fatigue and GI symptoms, and can trigger thrombocytopenia and liver cell injury. In Beijing-based studies of over 3,000 tick-bite patients, ALTNV was detected in about 10% of cases. The virus is genetically separate from Dabie bandavirus, a known hemorrhagic fever virus. Co-infection with ALTNV and Dabie bandavirus was linked to more frequent respiratory and kidney complications; among double-infected patients, mortality reached 18.4% (7 deaths). Overall mortality in the cohort reached about 30%. There are no virus-specific antivirals; management is supportive and antibiotics are ineffective. The authors urge improved differential diagnosis in endemic areas. Prevention advice includes protective clothing (pants into socks), adult skin repellents, and rigorous post-hike tick checks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でマダニが媒介する新しいウイルスを同定
triage.triage_reason: 北京での研究で新規ダニ媒介性ウイルス(ALTNV)が同定され、SFTSウイルスとの重複感染例で致死率18.4%、コホート全体でも約30%の死亡率が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事象と判断されるため。
triage.notes: 新規オルトナイロウイルス(ALTNV)はダビエ・バンダウイルス(SFTS)とは遺伝的に別種。ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はなく、マダニ媒介性のためこの点は不明。重複感染時の高い致死率が特に懸念材料。続報および専門的なリスク評価が必要。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: पंजाब में तेजी से बढ़ रहे स्वाइन फ्लू के मामले, जालंधर में पहली संदिग्ध मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu cases on the rise in Punjab, first suspected death in Jalandhar.
article.articleSummary: Swine flu cases are rising in Punjab, with a suspected death in Jalandhar. The deceased, Raj, 85, a resident of Tajpur in Jamsher Khas, had chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and a likely weakened immune system. He was admitted to hospital after experiencing breathing difficulties, and his test result was positive for H1N1. Health authorities emphasize that the death’s final cause will be confirmed only after formal audit, and cannot be attributed to swine flu alone at this stage. Punjab’s latest health department data show 220 confirmed swine flu cases in the state to date. The report highlights ongoing transmission and the need for vigilance, especially among high-risk groups with COPD or other comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: パンジャブ州で豚インフルエンザ症例が急増、ジャランダルで初の疑い死亡例
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1（豚インフルエンザ）の国内既知流行であり、基礎疾患を有する高齢者の疑い死亡例が1件報告されているが、季節性インフルエンザとして既知の病原体であり国際的拡大リスクは低い。継続的なモニタリングが必要。
triage.notes: H1N1は既知の季節性インフルエンザ株であり、220例の確認例は州内での既知流行パターン。死亡例は基礎疾患（COPD）を有する高齢者で、最終死因は監査待ち。新規性・異常性は低いが、州内での継続的な症例増加のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: WHO / DRC EBOLA RESPONSE
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the WHO-led Ebola response reports rapid scale-up of care capacity amid the outbreak. An Ebola Treatment Centre at the Evangelical Medical Centre is featured with health workers, PPE, and patient care. Over the past four weeks, functional bed capacity has increased by more than 500 across more than 50 facilities in five affected provinces. WHO Incident Manager Dr Thierno Balde states the objective to add 3,000 additional beds in the next two months and emphasizes expanding the health workforce, including clinicians, doctors, and nurses, to operate the expanded facilities. The updates, dated 26 August 2026 and 04 September 2026, are supported by imagery of treatment centers and PPE, underscoring a large-scale containment effort for Ebola in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO/DRCエボラ対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC5州に拡大し、WHO主導で大規模な病床拡充（3000床増床計画）が進行中であり、重大な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 5州に拡大し大規模な病床・人員増強が行われていることから、既にWHOによる大規模対応が進行中の深刻なアウトブレイクと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le leadership de l'OMS salué dans la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: WHO leadership praised in the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: 6 September 2026, Bunia, Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo: The leadership of the World Health Organization in the Ebola response was praised by Dr. Patience-Pacifique Lokengama, chief medical officer of the Lita health zone in Ituri. She credited WHO with driving transmission interruption, improving collaboration among partners, and addressing government-related challenges in the outbreak response. Lokengama noted that WHO, as health leader, works with the government to identify response bottlenecks and develop tailored solutions, and can mobilize additional partners when gaps are observed to strengthen capacity. The collaboration is described as central to implementing activities in case management, surveillance, prevention, and community engagement for the Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：エボラ対応におけるWHOのリーダーシップが称賛される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中とみられるエボラ対応に関する広報的な内容であり、新規発生や拡大に関する具体的情報はないが、エボラという疾患の性質上、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの対応活動への称賛が主旨であり、感染者数や新規拡大に関する具体的データは含まれていない。ルーマニア（Cluj/Lita）は地名の同名による誤ジオタグと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO / DRC EBOLA TREATMENT CENTRE EXTENSION
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola Treatment Centre at Lita General Reference Hospital is being expanded. The old facility had 33 beds; the new camp is about 90% complete and will have 42 beds, including 18 for suspected cases and 4 for suspected cases in critical condition. WHO funds 100% of construction, covering tents, more than 25 latrines and showers, a waste disposal area, laundry facilities, water drainage, electrical installation, and solar-powered lighting. Dr Tshidibi Kalala Sandrine, WHO Field Coordinator, confirms the project is entirely WHO-funded. The upgrade enhances treatment capacity at Lita and expands essential camp infrastructure in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO / コンゴ民主共和国 エボラ治療センターの拡張
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対応するため治療センターが拡張されており、疾患の重篤性・异常性・国際的拡大リスクからIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事は治療センターのインフラ拡張に関する報道だが、疑い症例用ベッドの増設（18床、うち重症4床）は現地でエボラ症例が継続的に発生していることを示唆する。地名データにRomania(Cluj/Lita)が含まれるが、記事本文の文脈から実際の発生地はDRCのLita（イトゥリ州）であり、Romaniaは地理データの誤付与と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : les mesures protectrices contre Ebola recommandées aux dépendants des militaires et policiers - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Protective measures against Ebola recommended for the dependents of the military and police - ACP
article.articleSummary: On September 6, 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, a workshop educated dependents of military and police, and other community members, on Ebola protection. Organized by ASSESSOFP with funding from the Fonds pour les Femmes Congolaises (FFC) under the Solola Ebola project, the session aimed to reinforce core community prevention measures. Facilitators stressed regular handwashing, early reporting of suspected Ebola cases, and combating stigma against survivors. Serge Liwela underscored that Ebola is a public health threat for all, not deterred by weapons or fortifications, and that dependents of security personnel must be equipped with preventive knowledge. Participants from Beni’s four communes were encouraged to become health ambassadors in their neighborhoods, reinforcing community engagement as the most effective weapon against any outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：軍人・警察官の家族にエボラ対策の防護措置を推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はエボラ予防啓発ワークショップの実施報告であり、新規症例や発生の急増を示す情報は含まれていない。DRCはエボラの既知の流行国であるため、今後の症例報告動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は軍人・警察官の家族を対象としたエボラ予防教育プログラム（Solola Ebolaプロジェクト）に関する報告であり、具体的な症例数や新規アウトブレイクの発生を示す情報は含まれていない。DRC北キブ州はエボラの既知の流行歴がある地域のため、実際の症例動向について続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 226 cas confirmés dont 120 décès à Lita (Médecin chef de zone de santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 226 confirmed cases, including 120 deaths in Lita (Chief Medical Officer of the Health Zone) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 September 2026, Ebola in the Lita health zone, Djugu Territory, Ituri Province, north-eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, totals 226 confirmed cases and 120 deaths (case-fatality 53.1%). Since the epidemic began, the Ebola Treatment Center in Lita sees about three to four new cases daily. Dr. Patience-Pacifique Lokengama, medical chief of the Lita health zone, says response efforts continue to provide patient care, maintain surveillance, and strengthen infection prevention and control, with rapid access to care highlighted as crucial for improving survival. Community sensitization remains a priority to counter fear and misinformation surrounding the outbreak. The Lita zone continues to experience ongoing transmission and sustained preventive measures amid the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ出血熱：リタで226例確定、うち120人死亡（保健地区首席医師）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的なアウトブレイクで致死率53.1%と高く、症例が継続的に発生しており公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的懸念のある事案のため。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州リタ保健地区でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク継続中。1日3-4例の新規症例発生、致死率53.1%と高い。地域社会の恐怖・誤情報対策も課題。

article.articleHeadline: Sete cavalos morrem em fazenda de Goiás e acendem alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seven horses die on a Goiás farm, triggering an alert
article.articleSummary: Seven horses died at a Santa Helena de Goiás farm in southwestern Goiás, Brazil, with rabies laboratory-confirmed in one animal after it showed compatible signs. The remaining six horses had died earlier, leaving insufficient material for confirmation; authorities consider the herd status as suspected rather than fully confirmed. Three rural workers who handled the horses are under precautionary monitoring for exposures, remaining asymptomatic as of the latest update. In response, about 40 cattle on the property were vaccinated against rabies, and nearby producers were advised to reinforce herd protection. Surveillance efforts target roosts of the common vampire bat (Desmodus rotundus), a known rabies vector in rural settings, with bats monitored for potential spillover. Rabies in animals can cause behavioral changes, gait disturbances, tremors, paralysis, and excessive salivation; other diseases may mimic symptoms, so confirmation relies on lab testing. Investigations are ongoing in Santa Helena de Goiás.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州の農場で馬7頭が死亡、警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: 動物間での狂犬病確定例だが人への感染は確認されておらず、曝露者も無症状。動物衛生上の懸念はあるが公衆衛生上の即時対応が必要な段階ではない。
triage.notes: 農場動物における狂犬病の発生で、人への感染は未確認（曝露した3名は無症状）。吸血コウモリ（Desmodus rotundus）が感染源として疑われ、地域の畜産・野生動物監視が継続されている。人獣共通感染症としての動向を注視する必要がある。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: চোখ রাঙাচ্ছে সোয়াইন ফ্লু, বাড়িতে একের পর এক সদস্য আক্রান্ত হচ্ছেন? কীভাবে নিজেকে বাঁচাবেন? জানালেন চিকিৎসক
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine flu looms as one family member after another gets infected at home? How can you protect yourself? The doctor explains.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-09-06, India is seeing a surge in swine flu caused by H1N1 influenza (A/Missouri/11/2025 H1N1 pdm09). Delhi, Mumbai, and Bengaluru report rising infections and hospitalizations with fever, cough, breathlessness, and influenza-like illness. Household transmission appears common once one member is infected, given the virus’s high contagiousness and droplet spread. Dr. Apurba Ray of Newburg Pulse Diagnostics in Kolkata outlines protective measures: isolate the infected person; minimize close contact; avoid sharing personal items; cover coughs and sneezes; ensure adequate ventilation. Emphasizes regular handwashing and sanitizers. If close contact cannot be avoided, wear an N95 mask (or two surgical masks). Since symptoms overlap with other respiratory illnesses, laboratory confirmation via NAAT-based tests such as real-time PCR is essential, especially for older individuals or those with comorbidities or worsening symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: スイン・フルーが猛威、家庭内で次々と感染者が発生?自分を守る方法を医師が解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザに関する一般向け予防啓発記事であり、既知の病原体・通常の季節性流行の範囲内で、国際的な異常性や緊急対応の必要性は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性H1N1インフルエンザ(A/Missouri/11/2025)の家庭内感染に関する予防啓発記事。デリー、ムンバイ、ベンガルールで入院増加が報告されているが、これは例年見られる季節性流行の一環と考えられ、新規変異株や重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。医師による一般的な予防アドバイスが中心の記事。

article.articleHeadline: HFMD у Вʼєтнамі: 100 тис. випадків -- що робити зараз
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease in Vietnam: 100,000 cases — what to do now.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in Vietnam totals about 100,000 suspected and laboratory-confirmed cases nationwide as the new school year approaches. Education facilities are reinforcing hygiene, isolation, and return-to-class protocols. The brief calls for a rapid data package, including total cases (PCR/serology), weekly hospitalizations and severe outcomes (neuro- and cardio- complications), and fatalities (data not explicitly provided); infection source and details for imported or exported cases; age distribution (pre‑school vs school-age); and provincial hotspots. It notes circulating serotypes EV-A71 and Coxsackie A6/A16, with surveillance for new strains. An editorial 0–3 hour checklist emphasizes official figures, regional updates, and updated school/childcare protocols. Health-education plans for 0–72 hours include intensified surveillance, expanded pediatric beds, triage criteria, and coordination with international partners on EV-A71 vaccination where available. 24–72 hour analytics should track growth, serotype distribution, hospital load, and vaccine feasibility.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムで手足口病(HFMD)が急増、約10万件の症例 — 今すべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでHFMDが約10万例に達し、EV-A71による重症合併症（神経・心臓系）のリスクが指摘されている。学校再開に伴う継続的な曝露やヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、国際パートナーとのワクチン協力の必要性が示唆されており、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: HFMDはベトナムで毎年季節性に発生する疾患だが、今回は約10万例と規模が大きく、EV-A71による重症化・死亡データが未確定である点、および学校再開に伴う感染拡大リスクから経過を注視する必要がある。死亡者数や重症例の具体的な統計は記事内で明示されておらず、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tanzania Delivers 52 Tonnes Of Medical Aid To DRC For Ebola Fight
article.articleSummary: 52 tonnes of medicines and medical supplies, worth about US$88,000 (220 million Tanzanian shillings), were handed from Tanzania to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to support Ebola containment. The handover in Kinshasa was led by Tanzania’s Deputy Minister for Health, Florence Samizi, on behalf of the government. The consignment includes medicines, personal protective equipment for healthcare workers, medical devices and other supplies intended to strengthen patient care and break the Ebola transmission chain. The aid follows Tanzania’s commitments made during a June 16 virtual Ebola response heads-of-state meeting and signals continued regional cooperation on cross-border health emergencies. A DRC health ministry official, Romain Muboyayi, expressed gratitude, noting the supplies will aid government efforts to contain the outbreak and protect frontline staff. As of early September 2026, the DRC reported over 6,300 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 3,000 related deaths, the deadliest outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: タンザニア、エボラ対策支援としてDRCへ医療物資52トンを提供
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（確定症例6,300超、死亡3,000超）が継続しており、国際支援体制も動いているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はタンザニアからDRCへの支援物資提供に関するものだが、主題はDRCで進行中のエボラ流行（史上最悪規模）。タンザニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une nouvelle zone de santé touchée à Lubero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a new health zone hit in Lubero
article.articleSummary: Kayna health zone in Lubero territory, North Kivu, has been struck by the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bundibugyo strain now affecting six of Lubero’s seven health zones. The first confirmed case is a 21-year-old man from Butembo, intercepted Sept 2 at an Itsu health-area checkpoint and placed in quarantine; laboratory results released Sept 3 were positive for Ebola. Lubero administrator Kiwewa Mitela said community surveillance and risk communication have been strengthened in Kayna and Kirumba. The detection comes two months after AFC-M23 announced the end of the outbreak in zones under its administration. Masereka has also reported a new case. As of Sept 3, Lubero counts 12 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, 4 recoveries, and 6 active patients. Authorities urge vigilance and continued surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ルベロで新たな保健地区が被害
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で第17次エボラ流行が継続中、ルベロ地域の新たな保健地区（カイナ）に拡大し確定症例・死亡例が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: AFC-M23がザイール終息宣言をした2ヶ月後に新規症例発生。紛争地域における監視体制の脆弱性が懸念される。ブンディブギョ株での第17次流行。ルベロの7保健地区中6地区に拡大、確定12例・死亡2例。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : un député provincial appelle le gouvernement à débloquer des moyens contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: a provincial legislator calls on the government to unlock funding to combat Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Beni territory, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is battling its 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak. As of August 29, 2026, authorities report 6,041 confirmed Ebola cases and 2,911 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%). A provincial legislator, Alain Kasereka, urged national MPs to press the central government to unlock funding essential for the response, highlighting four months of unpaid community relays and communications units, which threatens to disrupt control efforts. Health workers and response teams continue operations, with calls for the population to maintain barrier measures until funds are released. Alain Siwako emphasized collaboration with national deputies and the provincial governor to resolve the funding gap, while warning youths not to attack frontline teams, who largely volunteer their services. The article notes the protracted, resource-constrained response contributing to the outbreak’s severity in four months compared to the prior ten outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ある州議会議員が政府にエボラ対策資金の解放を要求 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、確定症例6,041例・死亡2,911例（致死率48.2%）という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、資金不足により対応が破綻するリスクも報告されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模アウトブレイク（第17次）に関する続報。資金不足によりコミュニティ・リレー要員や通信班への支払いが4か月滞っており、対応の継続性に懸念がある。致死率48.2%は非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une malade et son garde meurent au centre de traitement de Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a female patient and her guard die at the Beni treatment center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, continues with deadly impact. A woman confirmed with Ebola died at the Beni Ebola Treatment Center, and her caregiver husband died minutes later, reportedly from hypertension after her death; both were part of a couple, parents of three. The deaths occurred around September 4, 2026, amid ongoing transmission in Beni, where limited access to specific medicines fuels high mortality. Medical teams provide symptomatic treatment and urge rapid clinic presentation for suspected cases. The provincial response bulletin (Aug 30–31, 2026) records a 70% case fatality rate in Nord-Kivu. The outbreak—17th in the region—originates from Bundibugyo, with Katwa health zone the most affected among 16 zones. Community donations and tributes were organized at Mayangosse parking as authorities appeal for support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ベニの治療センターで女性患者とその介護者(夫)が死亡 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて致死率70%が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事中の「Bundibugyo」はウイルス株名（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の由来地を指しており、現行アウトブレイクの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州ベニ市であるため、ウガンダは検証済み発生地域から除外した。致死率70%という高い数値と医薬品アクセス制限、地域社会への影響拡大が報告されており、既存のアウトブレイク（当該地域で17回目）の継続的悪化を示す重要なシグナルである。
